text: Is surat ki ibtida mein jo huroof hain, un ke mutaliq jo kuch bayan hamein karna tha, use tafseel ke sath Surah Al-Baqarah ki tafsir ke shuru mein ma'a ikhtilaf-e-ulama ke hum likh aaye hain. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se is ke ma'ani mein marwi hai ke is se murad hadith (Ana Allahu Afzal) hai yani main Allah hoon main tafseel-war bayan farma raha hoon, Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) se bhi yeh marwi hai, yeh Kitab-e-Quran-e-Kareem teri janib tere Rab ki taraf se nazil ki gayi hai, is mein koi shak na karna, dil tang na hona, is ke pahunchane mein kisi se na darna, na kisi ka lihaz karna, balkay sabqa Ulul-Azm paighambaron ki tarah sabr-o-istaqamat ke sath Kalam-e-Allah ki tabligh makhlooq-e-Ilahi mein karna, is ka nuzool is liye hua hai ke tu kafiron ko dara kar hoshiyar aur chaukanna kar de, yeh Quran mominon ke liye nasihat-o-ibrat, wa'az-o-pand hai. Is ke baad tamam duniya ko hukum hota hai ke is Nabi-e-Ummi ki poori pairwi karo, is ke qadam ba qadam chalo, yeh tumhare Rab ka bheja hua hai, Kalam-e-Allah tumhare paas laya hai woh Allah tum sab ka Khaliq-o-Malik hai aur tamam jan-daron ka Rab hai, khabardar hargiz hargiz Nabi se hat kar dusre ki tabedari na karana warna hukum-e-adooli par saza milegi, afsos tum bahut hi kam nasihat hasil karte ho. Jaise farman hai ke go tum chaho lekin aksar log apni be-imani par ade hi rahenge. Aur ayat mein hai (Wa in tuti' aksara man fil-ardi yudilluka 'an sabilillah, in yattabi'una illaz-zanna wa in hum illa yakhrusun) (6:116 - Surah Al-An'am) yani "Agar tu insanon ki kasrat ki taraf jhuk jayega to woh tujhe behka kar hi chain lenge". Surah Yusuf mein farman hai "Aksar log Allah ko mante hue bhi shirk se baaz nahin rehte."

Sabiqa baghiyon ki bastiyon ke khandrat ba'is-e-ibrat hain un logon ko jo hamare rasoolon ki mukhalifat karte the unhein jhutlate the tum se pehle hum halak kar chuke hain. Duniya aur aakhirat ki zillat un par baras padi, jaise farman hai tujh se agle rasoolon se bhi mazaq kiya gaya, lekin natija yeh hua ke mazaq ne unhein tah-o-bala kar diya, ek aur aayat mein hai, bahut si zalim bastiyon ko hum ne gharat kar diya jo ab tak ulti padi hain aur jagah irshad hai bahut se itrate hue logon ke shahar hum ne veeran kar diye dekh lo ke ab tak un ke khandrat tumhare samne hain jo bahut kam aabad hue. Haqiqatan waris-o-malik hum hi hain aise zalimon ke paas hamare azab achanak aa gaye aur woh apni ghaflaton aur ayyashiyon mein mashghool the kahin din ko dopahar ke aaram ke waqt, kahin raat ke sone ke waqt, chunancha ek aayat mein hai (Afamina ahlul qura an yatiyahum ba'suna bayatan wahum na'imun, awamina ahlul qura an yatiyahum ba'suna duhan wahum yal'abun) yani log is se be-khauf ho gaye hain ke un ke sote hue raton raat achanak hamara azab aa jaye? Ya unhein dar nahin ke din dihare dopahar ko un ke aaram ke waqt un par hamara azab aa jaye? Aur aayat mein hai ke makkariyon ki wajah se hamari nafarmaniyan karne wale is baat se nidar ho gaye hain ke Allah unhein zameen mein dhansa de? Ya un ke paas azab-e-Ilahi is tarah aa jaye ke unhein pata bhi na chale ya Allah unhein un ki be-khabari mein aaram ki ghadiyon mein hi pakad le koi nahin jo Allah ko aajiz kar sake, yeh to Rabb ki rahmat-o-raafat hai jo gunahgar zameen par chalte phirte hain, azab-e-Rabb aa jane ke baad to yeh khud apni zabanon se apne gunahon ka iqrar kar lenge lekin us waqt kya nafa? Isi mazmoon ko aayat (Wa kam qasamna) mein bayan farmaya hai ek hadith mein aaya hai ke jab tak Allah Ta'ala bandon ke uzr khatam nahin kar deta unhein azab nahin karta, Abdul Malik se jab yeh hadith mein aaya hai ke jab tak Allah Ta'ala bandon ke uzr khatam nahin kar deta unhein azab nahin karta to aap ne yeh aayat (Fama kana da'wahum) ilakh, padh sunayi phir farmaya ummaton se bhi, un ke rasoolon se bhi yani sab se Qayamat ke din sawal hoga, jaise farman hai (Wa yauma yunadihim fayaqulu maza ajabtumul mursaleen 65) (28-Al-Qasas) yani us din nida ki jayegi aur daryaft kiya jayega ke tum ne rasoolon ko kya jawab diya? Is aayat mein ummaton se sawal kiya jana bayan kiya gaya hai aur aayat mein hai (Yauma yajma'ullahur rusula fayaqulu maza ujibtum, qalu la ilma lana, innaka antal allamul ghuyub 109) (5-Al-Ma'idah), rasoolon ko Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala jama karega aur un se puchega ke tumhein kya jawab mila?

Woh kahenge ke hamein koi ilm nahin, ghaib ka janne wala toh Tu hi hai. Pas ummat se rasoolon ki qabooliyat ki babat aur rasoolon se tableegh ki babat Qayamat ke din sawal hoga. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain: Tum mein se har ek ba-ikhtiyar hai aur apne zer-e-ikhtiyar logon ki babat us se sawal kiya jane wala hai. Badshah se uski ra'aya ka, har aadmi se uske ahl-o-ayal ka, har aurat se uske khawand ke ghar ka, har ghulam se uske aaqa ke maal ka sawal hoga. Rawi-e-hadith Hazrat Ta'oos (R.H) ne is hadith ko bayan farma kar phir aayat ki tilawat ki. Is ziyadati ke baghair yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim ki nikali hui bhi hai aur ziyadati Ibn Marduyah ne naqal ki hai. Qayamat ke din aamal-name rakhe jayenge aur sare aamal zahir ho jayenge. Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se khabar di jayegi. Allah har shakhs ke aamal se ba-khabar hai, us par koi cheez posheeda nahin. Na woh kisi cheez se ghafil hai. Aankhon ki khayanat se seenon ki chupi hui baton ka janne wala hai. Har patte ke jhadne ka use ilm hai. Zameen ki andheriyon mein jo dana hota hai use bhi woh janta hai. Tar-o-khushk cheez uske paas khuli kitab mein maujood hai.

Tar-o-khushk cheez uske paas khuli kitab mein maujood hai.

Mizan aur a'maal ka wazan Qayamat ke din neki badi insaaf-o-adl ke sath toli jaane ki, Allah Ta'ala kisi par zulm na karega. Jaise farman hai aayat (Wa nada'ul mawazinal qista liyawmil qiyamati) al-kh, Qayamat ke din hum adl ki tarazu rakhenge, kisi par koi zulm na hoga, rai ke daane ke barabar bhi amal hoga toh hum use le aayenge aur hum hisab lene mein kafi hain aur aayat mein hai "Allah Ta'ala ek zarre ke barabar bhi zulm nahin karta, woh neki ko badhata hai aur apne paas se ajar-e-azeem ata farmata hai." Surah Qari'ah mein farmaya jis ka nekiyon ka pallada bhari ho gaya use aish-o-nishat ki zindagi mili aur jis ka nekiyon ka pallada halka ho gaya us ka thikana (Hawiyah) hai jo bhadakti hui aag ke khazane ka naam hai aur aayat mein hai (Fa-iza nufikha fis-suri fala ansaba bainahum yawma-izin wala yatasa'alun) (23. Al-Mu'minun) yani nafkha phoonk diya jayega saare rishte naate aur nasab-o-hasab toot jayenge, koi kisi ka pursan-e-haal na hoga. Agar tol mein nek a'maal badh gaye toh falah pali warna khasare ke sath jahannam mein dakhil honge. Fasl: Koi toh kehta hai ke khud a'maal tole jayenge, koi kehta hai nama-e-a'maal tole jayenge, koi kehta hai khud amal karne wale tole jayenge. In teenon qaulon ko is tarah jama karna bhi mumkin hai ke hum kahein yeh sab sahi hain, kabhi a'maal tole jayenge, kabhi nama-e-a'maal, kabhi khud amal karne wale, Wallahu A'lam. In teenon baaton ki daleelein bhi maujood hain. Pehle qaul ka matlab yeh hai ke a'maal go ek be-jism cheez hain lekin Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala unhein jism ata farmayega jaise ke sahih hadith mein hai Surah Baqarah aur Surah Aal-e-Imran Qayamat ke din do saayebanon ki ya do abr ki ya par phailaye hue parindon ke do jhund ki surat mein aayengi aur hadith mein hai ke Quran apne qari aur aamil ke paas ek naujawan khush-shakal noorani chehre wale ki surat mein aayega, yeh use dekh kar puchega ke tu kaun hai? Yeh kahega main Quran hoon jo tujhe raaton ki neend nahin sone deta tha aur dinon mein paani peene se rokta tha. Hazrat Bara (R.A) wali hadith mein jis mein qabr ke sawal jawab ka zikr hai us mein yeh bhi farman hai ke momin ke paas ek naujawan khubsurat khushbudar aayega, yeh is se puchega ke tu kaun hai? Woh jawab dega ke main tera nek amal hoon aur kafir-o-munafiq ke paas is ke bar-khilaf shakhs ke aane ka bayan hai, yeh toh thin pehle qaul ki daleelein. Dusre qaul ki daleelein yeh hain: Ek hadith mein hai ke ek shakhs ke samne us ke gunahon ke ninnanve daftar phailaye jayenge jis mein se har ek itna bada hoga jitna door tak nazar pahunche. Phir ek parcha neki ka laya jayega jis par (La ilaha illallah) hoga. Yeh kahega ya Allah yeh itna sa parcha in daftaron ke muqable mein kya haisiyat rakhta hai?

Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga tu is se be-khatar reh ke tujh par zulm kiya jaye, ab woh parcha un daftaron ke muqable mein neki ke palre mein rakha jaye ga to woh sab daftar unche ho jayenge aur yeh sab se zyada wazan-dar aur bhari ho jayenge (Tirmidhi). Teesra qaul bhi daleel rakhta hai, hadith mein hai ek bohat mota taza gunahgar insan Allah ke samne laya jaye ga lekin ek machhar ke par ke barabar bhi wazan Allah ke paas is ka na hoga, phir Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh aayat tilawat farmayi (Ula'ika-lladhina kafaru bi-ayati Rabbihim wa liqa'ihi fahabitat a'maluhum fala nuqimu lahum yawmal-qiyamati wazna) (Surah Al-Kahf: 105). Hum Qayamat ke din in ke liye koi wazan qaim na karenge. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud (R.A) ki tareef mein jo hadithein hain un mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya in ki patli pindliyon pe na jana, Allah ki qasam Allah ke nazdeek yeh Uhud pahar se bhi zyada wazan-dar hai.

Allah Ta'ala ke ehsanat: Allah Ta'ala apna ehsan bayan farma raha hai ke usne zameen apne bandon ke rehne sehne ke liye banayi. Is mein mazboot pahar gaar diye ke hile jule nahin, is mein chashme jaari kiye, is mein manzilein aur ghar banane ki taqat insaan ko ata farmayi aur bahut se nafa ki cheezein is liye paida farmayein. Abr muqarrar kar ke is mein se paani barsa kar un ke liye khet aur baghaat paida kiye. Talash-e-ma'ash ke wasail muhayya farmaye. Tijarat aur kamayi ke tariqe sikha diye. Bawajood is ke aksar log poori shukr-guzari nahin karte. Ek aayat mein farman hai (Wa in ta'uddu ni'matallahi la tuhsuha, innallaha la ghafurur rahim) (16:18 - Surah An-Nahl) yani agar tum Allah ki ne'maton ko ginne baitho to yeh bhi tumhare bas ki baat nahin. Lekin insaan bada hi na-insaf aur nashukra hai. Ma'ayish to jamhoor ki qira'at hai lekin Abdur Rahman bin Hurmuz A'raj ma'ayish padhte hain aur theek wahi hai jis par aksariyat hai is liye ke (ma'ayish) jama hai (ma'eeshat) ki. Is ka baab (aasha ya'eeshu aishan) hai, (ma'eeshat) ki asal (ma'eeshat) hai. Kasra ya par taqeel tha, naqal kar ke ma-qabl ko diya (ma'eeshat) ho gaya lekin jama ke waqt phir kasra ya par aa gaya kyunke ab saqal na raha, pas mafa'il ke wazan par (ma'ayish) ho gaya kyunke is kalma mein ya asli hai. Ba-khilaf madayin, saha'if aur basair ke jo madina, sahifa aur baseera ki jama hai baab mudun, suhuf aur absar se, in mein chunke ya za'id hai is liye hamza di jaati hai aur mafa'il ke wazan par jama aati hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Iblees, Adam A.S aur nasl-e-Adam insaan ke sharaf ko is tarah bayan farmata hai ke tumhare baap Adam ko main ne khud hi banaya aur Iblees ki adawat ko bayan farma raha hai ke us ne tumhare baap Adam ka hasad kiya. Hamare farman se sab farishton ne sajda kiya magar us ne nafarmani ki pas tumhein chahiye ke dushman ko dushman samjho aur us ke dao pech se hoshiyar raho isi waqia ka zikr aayat (Wa iz qala rabbuka lil-malaikati inni khaliqun basharan min salsalin min hamain masnoon - 15. (Al-Hijr: 28) mein bhi hai. Hazrat Adam ko Parwardigar ne apne haath se mitti se banaya insani surat ata farmayi phir apne paas se is mein rooh phonki phir apni shaan ki jalalat manwane ke liye farishton ko hukum diya ke un ke samne jhuk jao sab ne sunte hi itaat ki lekin Iblees na mana is waqia ko Surah Baqarah ki tafsir mein hum khulasa-war likh aaye hain. Is aayat ka bhi yahi matlab hai aur isi ko Imam Ibn-e-Jarir R.H ne bhi pasand farmaya hai. Ibn-e-Abbas se marwi hai ke insaan apne baap ki peeth mein paida kiya jata hai aur apni maa ke pet mein surat diya jata hai aur baaz salaf ne bhi likha hai ke is aayat mein murad aulad-e-Adam hai. Zahhak ka qaul hai ke Adam ko paida kiya phir us ki aulad ki surat banayi. Lekin yeh sab aqwal gaur talab hain kyunke aayat mein is ke baad hi farishton ke sajde ka zikr hai aur zahir hai ke sajda Hazrat Adam A.S ke liye hi hua tha. Jama ke seegha se is ka bayan is liye hua ke Hazrat Adam tamam insanon ke baap hain aayat (Wa zallalna alaikumul ghamama wa anzalna alaikumul manna was-salwa, kulu min tayyibati ma razaqnakum, wa ma zalamuna wa lakin kanu anfusahum yazlimoon - 2. (Al-Baqarah: 57) isi ki nazeer hai yahan khitab un Bani Israel se hai jo Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke zamane mein maujood thay aur darasal abr ka saya un ke sabiqon par hua tha jo Hazrat Musa A.S ke zamane mein thay na ke un par, lekin chunke un ke akabir par saya karna aisa ehsan tha ke un ko bhi is ka shukr guzar hona chahiye tha is liye unhi ko khitab kar ke apni woh nemat yaad dilayi. Yahan yeh baat wazeh hai is ke bilkul bar-aks aayat (Wa laqad khalaqnal insana min sulalatin min teen - 23. (Al-Muminun: 12) hai ke murad Adam hain kyunke sirf wohi mitti se banaye gaye un ki kul aulad nutfay se paida hui aur yahi sahih hai kyunke murad jins-e-insan hai na ke muayyan. Wallahu A'lam.)))

Uzr-e-gunah badtar az gunah. (Alla tasjud) mein 'la' baqol ba'az nahwiyon ke zaid hai aur ba'az ke nazdeek inkar ki takeed ke liye hai. Jaise ke shayar ke qaul 'ma an ra'aitu wala sami'tu bimislihi' mein 'ma' nafiya par 'an' nafi ke liye sirf takeedan dakhil hua hai isi tarah yahan bhi hai ke pehle aayat (lam yakun minas sajideen) hai phir (ma mana'aka alla tasjud) hai. Imam Ibn Jarir (R.H) in dono qaulon ko bayan kar ke unhein radd karte hain aur farmate hain (mana'aka) ek dusre fe'l muqaddar ka mutazammin hai to taqreer-e-ibarat yun hui (ma ahwajaka walzamaka wa idtarraka alla tasjud idh amartuka) yani tujhe kis cheez ne bebas, mohtaj aur mulzim kar diya ke tu sajda na kare? Waghaira. Yeh qaul bohat hi qawi hai aur bohat umda hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Iblees ne jo wajah batai sach to yeh hai ke woh uzr-e-gunah badtar az gunah ki misdaq hai. Goya woh ita'at se is liye baaz rehta hai ke us ke nazdeek fazil ko mafzool ke samne sajda kiye jane ka hukm hi nahin diya ja sakta. To woh mal'oon keh raha hai ke main is se behtar hoon phir mujhe is ke samne jhukne ka hukm kyun ho raha hai? Phir behtar hone ke suboot mein kehta hai ke main aag se bana, yeh mitti se. Mal'oon asal unsur ko dekhta hai aur is fazeelat ko bhool jata hai ke mitti wale ko Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne apne haath se banaya hai aur apni rooh phonki hai. Pas is wajah se ke us ne farman-e-Ilahi ke muqable mein qayas-e-fasid se kaam liya aur sajde se ruk gaya, Allah ki rehmaton se door kar diya gaya aur tamam ne'maton se mehroom ho gaya.

Is mal'oon ne apne qayas aur apne da'we mein bhi khata ki. Mitti ke ausaf hain, narm hona, hamil-e-mashaqqat hona, dusron ka bojh sahana, cheezon ko ugana, barhana, parwarish karna, islah karna waghaira aur aag ki sifat hai jaldi karna, jala dena, bechaini phailana, phonk dena. Isi wajah se Iblees apne gunah par ad gaya aur Hazrat Adam (A.S) ne apne gunah ki ma'zarat ki, is se tauba ki aur Allah ki taraf ruju kiya. Rabb ke ahkaam ko tasleem kiya, apne gunah ka iqrar kiya, Rabb se ma'afi chahi, bakhshish ke talib hue.

Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya farishtay noor se paida kiye gaye hain, Iblees aag ke sholay se aur insaan us cheez se jo tumhare samne bayan kar di gayi hai yani mitti se (Muslim). Ek aur riwayat mein hai farishtay noor-e-arsh se, jinn aag se. Ek ghair sahih hadith mein itni ziyadati bhi hai ke hoor-e-ain za'faran se banai gayi hain. Imam Hasan (R.H) farmate hain Iblees ne yeh kaam kiya aur yahi pehla shakhs hai jis ne qayas ka darwaza khola. Is ki asnaad sahih hai. Hazrat Imam Ibn Sireen (R.H) farmate hain sab se pehle qayas karne wala Iblees hai. Yaad rakho suraj chand ki parastish isi ki badaulat shuru hui hai. Is ki asnaad bhi sahih hai.

Nafarmani ki saza: Iblees ko usi waqt hukm mila ke meri nafarmani aur meri itaat se rukne ke baais ab tu yahan jannat mein nahin reh sakta, yahan se utar ja kyunke yeh jagah takabbur karne ki nahin. Baaz ne kaha hai (fiha) ki zameer ka marja manzilat hai yani jin malakoot-e-aala mein tu hai us martabe mein koi sarkash reh nahin sakta. Ja yahan se chala ja tu apni sarkashi ke badle zaleel-o-khwar hastiyon mein shamil kar diya gaya. Teri zid aur hat ki yahi saza hai. Ab la'een ghabraya aur Allah se mohlat chahne laga ke mujhe Qayamat tak ki dheel di jaye. Chyunke Janab-e-Bari Jalla Jalaluhu ki is mein maslahatein aur hikmatein thin, bhale buron ko duniya mein zahir karna tha aur apni hujjat poori karni thi, is mal'oon ki is darkhwast ko manzoor farma liya. Is hukm par kisi ki hukumat nahin, us ke samne bolne ki kisi ko majal nahin, koi nahin jo us ke irade ko taal sake, koi nahin jo us ke hukm ko badal sake. Woh Saree-ul-Hisab hai.

Iblees ka tariqa-e-wardat us ki apni zabani: Iblees ne jab ahd-e-Ilahi le liya toh ab barh barh kar baatein banane laga ke jaise tu ne meri raah maari main bhi is ki aulad ki raah maaroon ga aur haq-o-najat ke seedhe raaste se unhein rokoon ga, teri tauheed se behka kar teri ibadat se sab ko hata doon ga. Ba'az nahvi kehte hain ke 'fima' mein 'ba' qasam ke liye hai, yani mujhe qasam hai main apni barbadi ke muqable mein is ki aulad ko barbad kar ke rahoon ga. Awn bin Abdullah kehte hain main Makkah ke raaste par baith jaoon ga, lekin sahih yahi hai ke neki ke har raaste par. Chunancha Musnad-e-Ahmad ki marfoo hadith mein hai ke shaitan ibn-e-Adam ki tamam raahon mein baithta hai. Woh Islam ki raah mein rukawat banne ke liye Islam lane wale ke dil mein waswase paida karta hai ke tu apne aur apne baap dada ke deen ko kyun chhodta hai? Allah ko agar behtari manzoor hoti hai toh woh is ki baaton mein nahin aata aur Islam qabool kar leta hai. Hijrat ki raah se rokne ke liye are aata hai aur ise kehta hai ke tu apne watan ko kyun chhodta hai? Apni zameen-o-aasman se alag hota hai? Ghurbat-o-bekasi ki zindagi ikhtiyar karta hai? Lekin musalman is ke behkawe mein nahin aata aur hijrat kar guzarta hai. Phir jihad ki rok ke liye aata hai aur jihad maal se hai aur jaan se. Is se kehta hai ke tu kyun jihad mein jata hai? Wahan qatl kar diya jaye ga, phir teri biwi dusre ke nikah mein chali jaye gi, tera maal auron ke qabze mein chala jaye ga, lekin musalman is ki nahin maanta aur jihad mein qadam rakh deta hai. Pas aise logon ka Allah par haq hai ke woh unhein jannat mein le jaye go woh janwar se gir kar hi mar jayen.

Is dusri aayat ki tafsir mein Ibn-e-Abbas ka qaul hai ke aage se aane ka matlab aakhirat ke mamle mein shak-o-shuba paida karna hai. Dusre jumle ka matlab yeh hai ke duniya ki raghbatein dilaoon ga. Dayen taraf se aana amr-e-deen ko mashkook karna hai, bayen taraf se aana gunahon ko lazeez banana hai, shaitanon ka yahi kaam hai. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke shaitan kehta hai main in ki duniya-o-aakhirat, nekiyan bhaliyan sab tabah kar dene ki koshish mein rahoon ga aur buraiyon ki taraf in ki rehbari karoon ga. Woh samne se aa kar kehta hai ke jannat, dozakh, qayamat koi cheez nahin. Woh pusht ki janib se aa kar kehta hai dekh duniya kis qadar zeenat-dar hai. Woh dayen se aa kar kehta hai khabardar neki ki raah bahut kathan hai. Woh bayen se aa kar kehta hai dekh gunah kis qadar lazeez hain. Pas har taraf se aa kar har tarah behkata hai, haan yeh Allah ka karam hai ke woh upar ki taraf se nahin aa sakta. Allah ke bande ke darmiyan hail ho kar rahmat-e-Ilahi ki rok nahin ban sakta. Pas samne yani duniya aur peeche yani aakhirat aur dayen yani is tarah ki dekhein aur bayen yani is tarah na dekh sakein, yeh aqwal sab theek hain.

Imam Ibn Jarir (R.H) farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke tamam khair ke kamon se rokta hai aur shar ke tamam kam samjha jata hai, upar ki samt ka naam aayat mein nahin woh samt Rahmat-e-Rabb ke aane ke liye khali hai aur wahan shaitan ki rok nahin. Woh kehta hai ke aksaron ko toh shakir nahin payega yani muwahhid. Iblees ko yeh wahm hi wahm tha lekin nikla mutabiq-e-waqia. Jaise farman hai aayat (Walaqad saddaqa 'alaihim Ibleesu zannahu) al-kh, yani Iblees ne apna guman pura kar dikhaya siwaye mominon ki pakbaz jamaat ke aur log uske muti ban gaye halankeh shaitan ki kuch hukumat toh un par na thi magar haan hum sahih taur se imaan rakhne walon ko aur shakki logon ko alag alag kar dena chahte thay. Tera Rabb har cheez ka hafiz hai. Musnad-e-Bazzar ki ek Hasan hadith mein har taraf se panah mangne ki ek dua aayi hai. Alfaaz yeh hain dua: (Allahumma inni as'alukal 'afwa wal 'afiyata fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali, Allahummastur 'aurati wa amin rau'ati wahfazni min baini yadayya wa min khalfi wa 'an yamini wa 'an shamali wa min fawqi wa a'uzu bika Allahumma an ughtala min tahti). Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) har subh sham is dua ko parhte thay dua: (Allahumma inni as'alukal 'afiyata fid-dini wal aakhirah) iske baad ki dua ke kuch farq se taqreeban wahi alfaaz hain jo upar mazkoor hue.

Iblees ka tariqa-e-wardat us ki apni zabani: Iblees ne jab ahd-e-Ilahi le liya toh ab barh barh kar baatein banane laga ke jaise tu ne meri raah maari main bhi is ki aulad ki raah maaroon ga aur haq-o-najat ke seedhe raaste se unhein rokoon ga, teri tauheed se behka kar teri ibadat se sab ko hata doon ga. Ba'az nahvi kehte hain ke 'fima' mein 'ba' qasam ke liye hai, yani mujhe qasam hai main apni barbadi ke muqable mein is ki aulad ko barbad kar ke rahoon ga. Awn bin Abdullah kehte hain main Makkah ke raaste par baith jaoon ga, lekin sahih yahi hai ke neki ke har raaste par. Chunancha Musnad-e-Ahmad ki marfoo hadith mein hai ke shaitan ibn-e-Adam ki tamam raahon mein baithta hai. Woh Islam ki raah mein rukawat banne ke liye Islam lane wale ke dil mein waswase paida karta hai ke tu apne aur apne baap dada ke deen ko kyun chhodta hai? Allah ko agar behtari manzoor hoti hai toh woh is ki baaton mein nahin aata aur Islam qabool kar leta hai. Hijrat ki raah se rokne ke liye are aata hai aur ise kehta hai ke tu apne watan ko kyun chhodta hai? Apni zameen-o-aasman se alag hota hai? Ghurbat-o-bekasi ki zindagi ikhtiyar karta hai? Lekin musalman is ke behkawe mein nahin aata aur hijrat kar guzarta hai. Phir jihad ki rok ke liye aata hai aur jihad maal se hai aur jaan se. Is se kehta hai ke tu kyun jihad mein jata hai? Wahan qatl kar diya jaye ga, phir teri biwi dusre ke nikah mein chali jaye gi, tera maal auron ke qabze mein chala jaye ga, lekin musalman is ki nahin maanta aur jihad mein qadam rakh deta hai. Pas aise logon ka Allah par haq hai ke woh unhein jannat mein le jaye go woh janwar se gir kar hi mar jayen.

Is dusri aayat ki tafsir mein Ibn-e-Abbas ka qaul hai ke aage se aane ka matlab aakhirat ke mamle mein shak-o-shuba paida karna hai. Dusre jumle ka matlab yeh hai ke duniya ki raghbatein dilaoon ga. Dayen taraf se aana amr-e-deen ko mashkook karna hai, bayen taraf se aana gunahon ko lazeez banana hai, shaitanon ka yahi kaam hai. Allah Ta'ala ke nafarman Jahannam ka indhan hain, is par Allah ki la'nat nazil hui hai, rahmat se door kar diya jata hai. Farishton ki jama'at se alag kar diya jata hai. Aib-dar kar ke utar diya jata hai, lafz mazoom makhooz hai zaam aur zeem se, yeh lafz ba-nisbat lafz-e-zamm ke zyada mubalaghe wala hai, pas is ke ma'ani aib-dar ke hue aur madhoor ke ma'ani door kiye hue ke hain, maqsad dono se ek hi hai. Pas yeh zaleel ho kar Allah ke ghazab mein mubtala ho kar neeche utar diya gaya. Allah ki la'nat is par nazil hui aur nikal diya gaya aur farmaya gaya ke tu aur tere manne wale sab ke sab Jahannam ka indhan hain, jaise aur aayat mein hai (Fa-inna Jahannama jaza'ukum) al-kh, tumhari sab ki saza Jahannam hai, to jis tarah chaho inhe behka lekin is se mayoos ho ja ke mere khaas bande tere waswason mein aa jayen, un ka wakeel main aap hoon.

Pehla imtihan aur isi mein laghzish aur iska anjam. Iblees ko nikal kar Hazrat Adam-o-Hawa (A.S) ko jannat mein pahuncha diya gaya aur bajuz ek darakht ke unhein sari jannat ki cheezein khane ki rukhsat de di gayi. Iska tafseeli bayan Surah Al-Baqarah ki tafsir mein guzar chuka hai. Shaitan ko is se bada hi hasad hua, unki na'amaton ko dekh kar la'een jal gaya aur thaan li ke jis tarah se ho unhein behka kar Allah ke khilaf kar doon. Chunancha jhoot iftira bandh kar un se kehne laga ke dekho yeh darakht woh hai jis ke khane se tum farishte ban jaoge aur hamesha ki zindagi isi jannat mein paoge. Jaise aur ayat mein hai ke Iblees ne kaha main tumhein ek darakht ka pata deta hoon jis se tumhein baqa aur hamishgi wala mulk mil jayega. Yahan hai ke un se kaha tumhein is darakht se sirf is liye roka gaya hai ke kahin tum farishte na ban jao. Jaise farman hai ayat (Yubayyinu Allahu lakum an tadillu) matlab yeh hai ke (Li-alla tadillu) aur ayat mein hai (An tamidda bikum) yahan bhi yahi matlab hai. (Malakain) ki dusri qira'at (Milkain) bhi hai lekin jamhoor ki qira'at laam ke zabar ke sath hai. Phir apna aitbar jamane ke liye qasmein khane laga ke dekho meri baat ko sach mano main tumhara khair khwah hoon tum se pehle se hi yahan rehta hoon har ek cheez ke khawas se waqif hoon tum ise kha lo bas phir yahin rahoge balkay farishte ban jaoge. Qasam baab-e-mufa'ala se hai aur iski khasiyat tarafain ki musharikat hai lekin yahan yeh khasiyat nahin hai. Aise ashaar bhi hain jahan qasam aaya hai aur sirf ek taraf ke liye. Is qasam ki wajah se is khabeeth ke behkawe mein Hazrat Adam (A.S) aa gaye. Sach hai momin us waqt dhoka kha jata hai jab koi napak insan Allah ko beech mein deta hai. Chunancha salaf ka qaul hai ke hum Allah ke naam ke baad apne hathiyar daal diya karte hain.

Laghzish ke baad kya hua? Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) farmate hain "Hazrat Adam (A.S) ka qad misl-e-darakht-e-khajoor ke bahut lamba tha aur sar par bahut lambe lambe baal thay, darakht khane se pehle unhein apni sharmgah ka ilm bhi na tha nazar hi na padi thi. Lekin is khata ke hote hi woh zahir ho gayi, bhagne lage to baal ek darakht mein ulajh gaye, kehne lage ae darakht mujhe chhod de darakht se jawab mila ke namumkin hai, isi waqt Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se aawaz aayi ke ae Adam mujh se bhag raha hai? Kehne lage ya Allah sharmindagi hai, sharmsar hoon, go yeh riwayat marfoo' bhi marwi hai lekin zyada sahih mauqoof hona hi hai, Ibn Abbas farmate hain, darakht ka phal kha liya aur chhupane ki cheez zahir ho gayi, jannat ke patton se chhupane lage, ek ko ek par chipkane lage, Hazrat Adam mare ghairat ke idhar udhar bhagne lage lekin ek darakht ke sath ulajh kar reh gaye Allah Ta'ala ne nida di ke Adam mujh se bhagta hai? Aap ne farmaya nahin ya Allah magar sharmata hoon. Janab-e-Bari ne farmaya Adam jo kuch main ne tujhe de rakha tha kya woh tujhe kafi na tha? Aap ne jawab diya beshak kafi tha lekin ya Allah mujhe yeh ilm na tha ke koi tera naam le kar teri qasam kha kar jhoot kahe ga. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ab to meri nafarmani ka khamyaza bhugatna padega aur takleefein uthana hongi. Chunancha jannat se dono ko utaar diya gaya, ab is kushadgi ke baad ki yeh tangi un par bahut garan guzri khane peene ko tars gaye, phir unhein lohay ki sanat sikhayi gayi, kheti ka kaam bataya gaya, aap ne zameen saaf ki daane boye, woh aage badhe, baalein niklin, daane pakke, phir tode gaye, phir peese gaye, aata gundha, phir roti tayyar hui, phir khayi jab ja kar bhook ki takleef se nijaat payi. Teen ke patton se apna aaga peecha chhupate phirte thay jo misl-e-kapde ke thay, woh noorani parde jin se ek dusre se yeh a'za chhupe hue thay, nafarmani hote hi hat gaye aur woh nazar aane lage, Hazrat Adam isi waqt Allah ki taraf raghbat karne lage tauba istighfar ki taraf jhuk pade, bakhilaf Iblees ke ke us ne saza ka naam sunte hi apne Ibleesi hathiyar yani hamesha ki zindagi waghera talab ki. Allah ne dono ki dua suni aur dono ki talab karda cheezein inayat farmayin. Marwi hai ke Hazrat Adam ne jab darakht kha liya isi waqt Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya in ki saza yeh hai ke hamal ki halat mein bhi takleef mein rahengi bacha hone ke waqt bhi takleef uthayengi, yeh sunte hi Hazrat Hawa ne nauha shuru kiya, hukum hua ke yahi tujh par aur teri aulad par likh diya gaya. Hazrat Adam ne Janab-e-Bari mein arz ki aur Allah ne unhein dua sikhayi, unhon ne dua ki jo qabool hui. Qusoor maaf farma diya gaya falhamdulillah!

Safar-e-Arzi ke baare mein Yahudi riwayatein. Baaz kehte hain yeh khitab Hazrat Adam A.S, Hazrat Hawa R.A, Shaitan-e-Maloon aur saanp ko hai. Baaz saanp ka zikr nahin karte. Yeh zahir hai ke asal maqsad Hazrat Adam A.S hain aur Shaitan-e-Maloon. Jaise Surah Taha mein hai aayat (Ihbitu minha jamee'a) Hawa R.A Hazrat Adam A.S ke tabe thin aur saanp ka zikr agar sehat tak pahunch jaye toh woh Iblees ke hukm mein aa gaya. Mufassireen ne bahut se aqwal zikr kiye hain ke Adam A.S kahan utre, Shaitan kahan phenka gaya waghera. Lekin darasal unka makhraj Bani Israel ki riwayatein hain aur unki sehat ka ilm Allah Ta'ala hi ko hai aur yeh bhi zahir hai ke is jagah ke jaan lene se koi faida nahin agar hota toh unka bayan Quran mein ya Hadith mein zaroor hota, keh diya gaya ke ab tumhare qarar ki jagah zameen hai wahin tum apni muqarrara zindagi ke din poore karoge jaise ke hamari pehli kitab Lauh-e-Mahfooz mein awwal se hi likha hua majood hai. Isi zameen par jiyo ge aur marne ke baad bhi isi mein dabaye jao ge aur phir hashr-o-nashr bhi isi mein hoga. Jaise farman hai aayat (Minha khalaqnakum wa feeha nu'eedukum wa minha nukhrijukum taratan ukhra). Pas aulad-e-Adam ke jeene ki jagah bhi yahi aur marne ki jagah bhi yahi, qabrein bhi isi mein aur Qayamat ke din uthenge bhi isi se, phir badla diye jayenge.

Jaise Surah Taha mein hai aayat (Ihbitu minha jamee'a) Hawa R.A Hazrat Adam A.S ke tabe thin aur saanp ka zikr agar sehat tak pahunch jaye toh woh Iblees ke hukm mein aa gaya. Mufassireen ne bahut se aqwal zikr kiye hain ke Adam A.S kahan utre, Shaitan kahan phenka gaya waghera. Lekin darasal unka makhraj Bani Israel ki riwayatein hain aur unki sehat ka ilm Allah Ta'ala hi ko hai aur yeh bhi zahir hai ke is jagah ke jaan lene se koi faida nahin agar hota toh unka bayan Quran mein ya Hadith mein zaroor hota, keh diya gaya ke ab tumhare qarar ki jagah zameen hai wahin tum apni muqarrara zindagi ke din poore karoge jaise ke hamari pehli kitab Lauh-e-Mahfooz mein awwal se hi likha hua majood hai. Isi zameen par jiyo ge aur marne ke baad bhi isi mein dabaye jao ge aur phir hashr-o-nashr bhi isi mein hoga. Jaise farman hai aayat (Minha khalaqnakum wa feeha nu'eedukum wa minha nukhrijukum taratan ukhra). Pas aulad-e-Adam ke jeene ki jagah bhi yahi aur marne ki jagah bhi yahi, qabrein bhi isi mein aur Qayamat ke din uthenge bhi isi se, phir badla diye jayenge.

Libas aur darhi jamal-o-jalal yahan Allah Ta'ala apna ehsan yaad dilata hai ke usne libas utara aur resh bhi. Libas toh woh hai jis se insan apna satr chupaye aur resh woh hai jo bator-e-zeenat ronaq aur jamal ke pehna jaye. Awwal toh zarooriyaat-e-zindagi se hai aur sani ziyadati hai. Resh ke ma'ani maal ke bhi hain aur zahiri poshak ke bhi hain aur jamal-o-khush libasi ke bhi hain. Hazrat Abu Umamah R.A ne naya kurta pehente hue jabke gale tak woh pehan liya farmaya dua (Alhamdulillahillazi kasani ma uwari bihi awrati wa atajammalu bihi fi hayati) phir farmane lage main ne Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A se suna hai farmate the ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ka irshad hai jo shakhs naya kapra pehne aur uske gale tak pahunchte hi yeh dua parhe phir purana kapra rah-e-lillah de de toh woh Allah ke zimme mein, Allah ki panah mein aur Allah ki hifazat mein aa jata hai zindagi mein bhi aur ba'ad az marg bhi (Tirmidhi, Ibn Majah waghera). Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Ali R.A ne ek naujawan se ek kurta teen dirham ko khareeda aur use pehna jab pahunchon aur takhnon tak pahuncha toh aap ne yeh dua parhi (Alhamdulillahillazi razaqani min riyashi ma atajammalu bihi fin-nasi wa uwari bihi awrati) yeh dua sun kar aap se kisi ne poocha ke kya aap ne ise Rasool ﷺ se suna hai ke aap ise kapra pehne ke waqt parhte the ya aap az-khud ise parh rahe hain? Farmaya main ne ise Huzoor ﷺ se suna hai. Libas-ut-Taqwa ki dusri qira'at Libas-ut-Taqwa seen ke zabar se bhi hai. Rafa se parhne wale ise mubtada kehte hain aur uske ba'ad ka jumla uski khabar hai. Ikrimah farmate hain is se murad Qayamat ke din parhezgaron ko jo libas ata hoga woh hai. Ibn Juraij ka qaul hai libas-e-taqwa iman hai. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain amal-e-saleh hai aur isi se hans-mukh hota hai, Urwah kehte hain murad is se mashiyat-e-Rabbani hai. Abdur Rahman kehte hain Allah ke dar se apni satr poshi karna libas-e-taqwa hai. Yeh kul aqwal aapas mein ek dusre ke khilaf nahin balkay murad yeh sab kuch hai aur yeh sab cheezein mili juli aur baham yak-deegar qareeb qareeb hain. Ek za'eef sanad wali riwayat mein Hazrat Hasan se marqoom hai ke main ne Hazrat Usman bin Affan R.A ko mimbar-e-Nabawi par khuli ghundiyon ka kurta pehne hue khara dekha us waqt aap kutton ke maar dalne aur kabootar bazi ki muman'at ka hukum de rahe the. Phir aap ne farmaya logo Allah se daro khusoosan apni poshidgiyon mein aur chupke chupke kana-phoosi karne mein. Main ne Janab-e-Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna hai aap qasam kha kar bayan farmate the ke jo shakhs jis kaam ko posheeda se posheeda karega Allah Ta'ala usi ki chadar us par alaniya daal dega agar nek hai toh nek aur agar bad hai toh bad. Phir aap ne isi aayat ki tilawat ki aur farmaya is se murad khush khulqi hai. Haan sahih hadith mein sirf itna marwi hai ke Hazrat Usman R.A ne jumma ke din mimbar par kutton ke qatl karne aur kabootaron ke zibah karne ka hukum diya.

Iblees se bachne ki takeed tamam insano ko Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala hoshiyar kar raha hai ke dekho Iblees ki makkariyon se bachte rehna woh tumhara bada hi dushman hai. Dekho isi ne tumhare baap Adam (A.S) ko daar-e-suroor se nikala aur is museebat ke qaid-khane mein dala, unki parda-dari ki. Pas tumhein uske hathkandon se bachna chahiye. Jaise farman hai aayat: (Afattakhizunahu wa zurriyyatahu auliya'a min dooni wa hum lakum aduwwun bi'sa liz-zalimeena badala) (Al-Kahf: 50). Ya'ni kya tum Iblees aur uski qoum ko apna dost banate ho? Mujhe chhod kar? Halan-ke woh to tumhara dushman hai, zalimon ka bahut hi bura badla hai.

Jahalat aur tawaf-e-Ka'aba: Mushrikeen nangay ho kar Baitullah ka tawaf karte thay aur kehte thay ke jaise hum paida huay hain isi halat mein tawaf karenge. Auratein bhi aagay koi chamray ka tukra ya koi cheez rakh leti thin aur kehti thin: "Al-yauma yabdu ba'duhu au kulluhu, wa ma bada minhu fala uhilluhu" (Aaj is ka thora sa hissa zahir ho jayega aur jitna bhi zahir ho main usay us ke liye jaiz nahin rakhti). Is par aayat (Wa iza fa'alu) al-kh, nazil hui hai. Yeh dastoor tha ke Quraish ke siwa tamam Arab Baitullah Sharif ka tawaf apne pehnay huay kapron mein nahin karte thay, samajhte thay ke yeh kapray jinhein pehan kar Allah ki nafarmaniyan ki hain is qabil nahin rahay ke unhein pehnay huay tawaf kar sakein. Haan Quraish jo apne tayein Hums kehte thay apne kapron mein bhi tawaf karte thay aur jin logon ko Quraish kapray bator-e-udhar dein woh bhi un ke diye huay kapray pehan kar tawaf kar sakta tha ya woh shakhs kapray pehnay tawaf kar sakta tha jis ke paas nayay kapray hon. Phir tawaf ke baad hi unhein utaar dalta tha, ab yeh kisi ki malkiyat nahin ho saktay thay. Pas jis ke paas naya kapra na ho aur Hums bhi us ko apna kapra na day to usay zaroori tha ke woh nanga ho kar tawaf karay, khwah aurat ho khwah mard. Aurat apne aagay ke uzu par zara si koi cheez rakh leti aur woh kehti jis ka bayan oopar guzra, lekin umooman auratein raat ke waqt tawaf karti thin. Yeh bid'at unhon ne az-khud ghar li thi, is fe'l ki daleel siwaye baap dada ki taqleed ke aur un ke paas kuch na thi, lekin apni khush-fehmi aur nek-zanni se keh dete thay ke Allah ka bhi yahi hukum hai. Kyunke un ka khayal tha ke agar yeh farmuda-e-Rabb na hota to hamaray buzurg is tarah na karte. Is liye hukum hota hai ke ae Nabi! Aap un se keh dijiye ke Allah Ta'ala behayai ke kamon ka hukum nahin karta. Ek to bura kaam karte ho, dusray jhoot-moot is ki nisbat Allah ki taraf karte ho, yeh chori aur seena-zori hai. Keh day ke Rabb-ul-Aalameen ka hukum to adl-o-insaf ka hai, istiqamat aur diyanat-dari ka hai, buraiyon aur ganday kamon ke chhorne ka hai, ibadaat theek tor par baja lanay ka hai jo Allah ke sachay Rasoolon ke tareeqay ke mutabiq hon, jin ki sachai un ke zabardast mojizon se Allah ne sabit kar di hai, un ki layi hui shariyat par ikhlas ke sath amal karte hon. Jab tak ikhlas aur paighambar ki tabedari kisi kaam mein na ho Allah ke haan woh maqbool nahin hota. Us ne jis tarah tumhein awwal-awwal paida kiya hai isi tarah woh dobara bhi lautaye ga, duniya mein bhi usi ne paida kiya, aakhirat ke din bhi wohi qabron se dobara paida kare ga, pehlay tum kuch na thay us ne tumhein banaya. Ab marnay ke baad phir bhi woh tumhein zinda kar de ga.

Jaise usne shuru mein tumhari ibtida ki thi us tarah phir se tumhara iaada karega. Chunancha hadith mein bhi hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek wa'z mein farmaya: "Logon! Tum Allah ke samne nange pairon, nange badanon, be-khatna jama kiye jaoge, jaise ki humne tumhein paidaish mein kiya tha usi ko phir dohraenge, yeh hamara wada hai aur hum ise kar ke hi rehne wale hain." Yeh riwayat Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi nikali gayi hai.

Yeh ma'ni bhi kiye gaye hain ki jaise humne likh diya hai waise hi tum hooge. Ek riwayat mein hai jaise tumhare a'maal thay waise hi tum hooge. Yeh bhi ma'ni hain ki jis ki ibtida mein badbakhti likh di hai woh badbakhti aur bad-a'mali ki taraf hi lautega go darmiyan mein nek ho gaya, aur jis ki taqdeer mein shuru se hi neki aur sa'adat likh di gayi hai woh anjam-e-kaar nek hi hoga go us se kisi waqt burai ke a'maal bhi sarzad ho jayen. Jaise ki Firaun ke zamane ke jadugar ki sari umr siyah-kariyon aur kufr mein kati lekin aakhir waqt musalman awliya ho kar mare.

Yeh bhi ma'ni hain ki Allah tum mein se har ek ko hidayat par ya gumrahi par paida kar chuka hai, aise hi ho kar tum maa ke batn se nikloge. Yeh bhi matlab hai ki Allah Ta'ala ne Ibn-e-Adam ki paidaish momin-o-kafir hone ki halat mein ki, jaise farman hai aayat (Huwallazi khalaqakum faminkum kafirun wa minkum mu'minun), phir unhein isi tarah Qayamat ke din lautayega yani momin-o-kafir ke girohon mein. Isi qaul ki ta'eed Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki is hadith se bhi hoti hai jis mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: "Uss ki qasam jis ke siwa koi aur ma'bood nahin, ki tum mein se ek shakhs jannatiyon ke a'maal karta hai yahan tak ki us ke aur jannat ke darmiyan sirf ek baam bhar ka ya hath bhar ka farq reh jata hai, phir us par likha hua sabqat kar jata hai aur dozakhiyon ke a'maal shuru kar deta hai aur isi mein dakhil ho jata hai. Aur koi jahannumiyon ke a'maal karne lagta hai yahan tak ki jahannum se ek hath ya ek baam door reh jata hai ki taqdeer ka likha aage aa jata hai aur woh jannatiyon ke a'maal karne lagta hai aur jannat-nasheen ho jata hai."

Doosri riwayat bhi isi tarah ki hai, us mein yeh bhi hai ki us ke woh kaam logon ki nazron mein jahannum aur jannat ke hote hain. A'maal ka dar-o-madar khatme par hai aur hadith mein hai: "Har nafs usi par uthaya jayega jis par tha" (Muslim). Ek aur riwayat mein hai: "Jis par mara." Agar is aayat se murad yahi li jaye to is mein is ke baad farman-e-aayat (Faqim wajhaka) mein aur Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ki har bacha fitrat par paida kiya jata hai phir us ke maa baap use yahoodi ya nasrani ya majoosi bana lete hain, aur Sahih Muslim ki hadith jis mein farman-e-Bari hai ki "Maine apne bandon ko muwahid-o-hanif paida kiya phir shaitan ne un ke deen se unhein behka diya," is mein koi jam' ki wajah honi chahiye aur woh yeh hai ki Allah ne unhein doosre haal mein momin-o-kafir hone ke liye paida kiya.

Go pehle haal mein tamam makhlooq ko apni ma'rifat-o-tauheed par paida kiya tha ke us ke siwa koi mabood-e-barhaq nahin. Jaise ke us ne un se roz-e-meesaq mein ahd bhi liya tha aur isi wade ko un ki jiblat-e-ghatti mein rakh diya tha, is ke bawajood us ne muqaddama kiya tha ke un mein se ba'az shaqi aur badbakht honge aur ba'az sa'eed aur nek bakht honge. Jaise farman hai: Usi ne tumhein paida kiya phir tum mein se ba'az kafir hain aur ba'az momin. Aur hadith mein hai: Har shakhs subh karta hai phir apne nafs ki khareed-o-farokht karta hai, kuch log aise hain jo use azaad kara lete hain, kuch aise hain jo use halak kar baithte hain. Allah ki taqdeer, Allah ki makhlooq mein jaari hai, usi ne muqaddar kiya, usi ne hidayat ki, usi ne har ek ko us ki paidaish di phir rehnumai ki. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke jo log sa'adat walon mein se hain un par nekon ke kaam aasaan honge aur jo shaqawat wale hain un par badiyan aasaan hongi. Chunancha Quran-e-Kareem mein hai: Ek firqe ne raah payi aur ek firqe par gumrahi sabit ho chuki. Phir is ki wajah bayan farmayi ke unhon ne Allah ko chhod kar shaitanon ko dost bana liya hai. Is aayat se us mazhab ki tardeed hoti hai jo yeh khayal karte hain ke Allah Ta'ala kisi shakhs ko kisi ma'asiyat ke amal par ya kisi gumrahi ke aqeeday par azab nahin karta ta-waqtike us ke paas sahih cheez saaf aa jaye aur phir woh apni burai par zid aur inaad se jama rahe. Kyunke agar yeh mazhab sahih hota to jo log gumrah hain lekin apne tayin hidayat par samajhte hain aur jo waqai hidayat par hain un mein koi farq na hona chahiye tha, lekin Allah Ta'ala ne un donon mein farq kiya, un ke naam mein bhi aur un ke ahkaam mein bhi. Aayat aap ke samne maujood hai, padh lijiye.

Auratein bhi aagay koi chamray ka tukra ya koi cheez rakh leti thin aur kehti thin: "Al-yauma yabdu ba'duhu au kulluhu, wa ma bada minhu fala uhilluhu" (Aaj is ka thora sa hissa zahir ho jayega aur jitna bhi zahir ho main usay us ke liye jaiz nahin rakhti). Is par aayat (Wa iza fa'alu) al-kh, nazil hui hai. Yeh dastoor tha ke Quraish ke siwa tamam Arab Baitullah Sharif ka tawaf apne pehnay huay kapron mein nahin karte thay, samajhte thay ke yeh kapray jinhein pehan kar Allah ki nafarmaniyan ki hain is qabil nahin rahay ke unhein pehnay huay tawaf kar sakein. Haan Quraish jo apne tayein Hums kehte thay apne kapron mein bhi tawaf karte thay aur jin logon ko Quraish kapray bator-e-udhar dein woh bhi un ke diye huay kapray pehan kar tawaf kar sakta tha ya woh shakhs kapray pehnay tawaf kar sakta tha jis ke paas nayay kapray hon. Phir tawaf ke baad hi unhein utaar dalta tha, ab yeh kisi ki malkiyat nahin ho saktay thay. Pas jis ke paas naya kapra na ho aur Hums bhi us ko apna kapra na day to usay zaroori tha ke woh nanga ho kar tawaf karay, khwah aurat ho khwah mard. Aurat apne aagay ke uzu par zara si koi cheez rakh leti aur woh kehti jis ka bayan oopar guzra, lekin umooman auratein raat ke waqt tawaf karti thin. Yeh bid'at unhon ne az-khud ghar li thi, is fe'l ki daleel siwaye baap dada ki taqleed ke aur un ke paas kuch na thi, lekin apni khush-fehmi aur nek-zanni se keh dete thay ke Allah ka bhi yahi hukum hai. Kyunke un ka khayal tha ke agar yeh farmuda-e-Rabb na hota to hamaray buzurg is tarah na karte. Is liye hukum hota hai ke ae Nabi! Aap un se keh dijiye ke Allah Ta'ala behayai ke kamon ka hukum nahin karta. Ek to bura kaam karte ho, dusray jhoot-moot is ki nisbat Allah ki taraf karte ho, yeh chori aur seena-zori hai. Keh day ke Rabb-ul-Aalameen ka hukum to adl-o-insaf ka hai, istiqamat aur diyanat-dari ka hai, buraiyon aur ganday kamon ke chhorne ka hai, ibadaat theek tor par baja lanay ka hai jo Allah ke sachay Rasoolon ke tareeqay ke mutabiq hon, jin ki sachai un ke zabardast mojizon se Allah ne sabit kar di hai, un ki layi hui shariyat par ikhlas ke sath amal karte hon. Jab tak ikhlas aur paighambar ki tabedari kisi kaam mein na ho Allah ke haan woh maqbool nahin hota. Us ne jis tarah tumhein awwal-awwal paida kiya hai isi tarah woh dobara bhi lautaye ga, duniya mein bhi usi ne paida kiya, aakhirat ke din bhi wohi qabron se dobara paida kare ga, pehlay tum kuch na thay us ne tumhein banaya. Ab marnay ke baad phir bhi woh tumhein zinda kar de ga.

Jaise usne shuru mein tumhari ibtida ki thi us tarah phir se tumhara iaada karega. Chunancha hadith mein bhi hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek wa'z mein farmaya: "Logon! Tum Allah ke samne nange pairon, nange badanon, be-khatna jama kiye jaoge, jaise ki humne tumhein paidaish mein kiya tha usi ko phir dohraenge, yeh hamara wada hai aur hum ise kar ke hi rehne wale hain." Yeh riwayat Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi nikali gayi hai.

Yeh ma'ni bhi kiye gaye hain ki jaise humne likh diya hai waise hi tum hooge. Ek riwayat mein hai jaise tumhare a'maal thay waise hi tum hooge. Yeh bhi ma'ni hain ki jis ki ibtida mein badbakhti likh di hai woh badbakhti aur bad-a'mali ki taraf hi lautega go darmiyan mein nek ho gaya, aur jis ki taqdeer mein shuru se hi neki aur sa'adat likh di gayi hai woh anjam-e-kaar nek hi hoga go us se kisi waqt burai ke a'maal bhi sarzad ho jayen. Jaise ki Firaun ke zamane ke jadugar ki sari umr siyah-kariyon aur kufr mein kati lekin aakhir waqt musalman awliya ho kar mare.

Yeh bhi ma'ni hain ki Allah tum mein se har ek ko hidayat par ya gumrahi par paida kar chuka hai, aise hi ho kar tum maa ke batn se nikloge. Yeh bhi matlab hai ki Allah Ta'ala ne Ibn-e-Adam ki paidaish momin-o-kafir hone ki halat mein ki, jaise farman hai aayat (Huwallazi khalaqakum faminkum kafirun wa minkum mu'minun), phir unhein isi tarah Qayamat ke din lautayega yani momin-o-kafir ke girohon mein. Isi qaul ki ta'eed Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki is hadith se bhi hoti hai jis mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: "Uss ki qasam jis ke siwa koi aur ma'bood nahin, ki tum mein se ek shakhs jannatiyon ke a'maal karta hai yahan tak ki us ke aur jannat ke darmiyan sirf ek baam bhar ka ya hath bhar ka farq reh jata hai, phir us par likha hua sabqat kar jata hai aur dozakhiyon ke a'maal shuru kar deta hai aur isi mein dakhil ho jata hai. Aur koi jahannumiyon ke a'maal karne lagta hai yahan tak ki jahannum se ek hath ya ek baam door reh jata hai ki taqdeer ka likha aage aa jata hai aur woh jannatiyon ke a'maal karne lagta hai aur jannat-nasheen ho jata hai."

Doosri riwayat bhi isi tarah ki hai, us mein yeh bhi hai ki us ke woh kaam logon ki nazron mein jahannum aur jannat ke hote hain. A'maal ka dar-o-madar khatme par hai aur hadith mein hai: "Har nafs usi par uthaya jayega jis par tha" (Muslim). Ek aur riwayat mein hai: "Jis par mara." Agar is aayat se murad yahi li jaye to is mein is ke baad farman-e-aayat (Faqim wajhaka) mein aur Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ki har bacha fitrat par paida kiya jata hai phir us ke maa baap use yahoodi ya nasrani ya majoosi bana lete hain, aur Sahih Muslim ki hadith jis mein farman-e-Bari hai ki "Maine apne bandon ko muwahid-o-hanif paida kiya phir shaitan ne un ke deen se unhein behka diya," is mein koi jam' ki wajah honi chahiye aur woh yeh hai ki Allah ne unhein doosre haal mein momin-o-kafir hone ke liye paida kiya.

Go pehle haal mein tamam makhlooq ko apni ma'rifat-o-tauheed par paida kiya tha ke us ke siwa koi mabood-e-barhaq nahin. Jaise ke us ne un se roz-e-meesaq mein ahd bhi liya tha aur isi wade ko un ki jiblat-e-ghatti mein rakh diya tha, is ke bawajood us ne muqaddama kiya tha ke un mein se ba'az shaqi aur badbakht honge aur ba'az sa'eed aur nek bakht honge. Jaise farman hai: Usi ne tumhein paida kiya phir tum mein se ba'az kafir hain aur ba'az momin. Aur hadith mein hai: Har shakhs subh karta hai phir apne nafs ki khareed-o-farokht karta hai, kuch log aise hain jo use azaad kara lete hain, kuch aise hain jo use halak kar baithte hain. Allah ki taqdeer, Allah ki makhlooq mein jaari hai, usi ne muqaddar kiya, usi ne hidayat ki, usi ne har ek ko us ki paidaish di phir rehnumai ki. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke jo log sa'adat walon mein se hain un par nekon ke kaam aasaan honge aur jo shaqawat wale hain un par badiyan aasaan hongi. Chunancha Quran-e-Kareem mein hai: Ek firqe ne raah payi aur ek firqe par gumrahi sabit ho chuki. Phir is ki wajah bayan farmayi ke unhon ne Allah ko chhod kar shaitanon ko dost bana liya hai. Is aayat se us mazhab ki tardeed hoti hai jo yeh khayal karte hain ke Allah Ta'ala kisi shakhs ko kisi ma'asiyat ke amal par ya kisi gumrahi ke aqeeday par azab nahin karta ta-waqtike us ke paas sahih cheez saaf aa jaye aur phir woh apni burai par zid aur inaad se jama rahe. Kyunke agar yeh mazhab sahih hota to jo log gumrah hain lekin apne tayin hidayat par samajhte hain aur jo waqai hidayat par hain un mein koi farq na hona chahiye tha, lekin Allah Ta'ala ne un donon mein farq kiya, un ke naam mein bhi aur un ke ahkaam mein bhi. Aayat aap ke samne maujood hai, padh lijiye.

Barahna ho kar tawaf mamnoo qarar de diya gaya. Is ayat mein mushrikeen ka radd hai, woh nangay ho kar Baitullah ka tawaf karte thay jaisa ke pehle guzra. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain ke nangay mard din ko tawaf karte aur nangi auratein raat ko, us waqt auratein kaha karti thin ke aaj is ke khaas jism ka kul hissa ya kuch hissa go zahir ho lekin kisi ko woh is ka dekhna jaiz nahin kartin. Pas is ke bar-khilaf musalmanon ko hukum hota hai ke apna libas pehan kar masjidon mein jao, Allah Ta'ala zeenat ke lene ka hukum deta hai aur zeenat se murad libas hai aur libas woh hai jo aaza-e-makhsoosa ko chupa le aur jo is ke siwa ho maslan acha kapra waghera. Ek hadith mein hai ke yeh ayat jotiyon samet namaz parhne ke bare mein nazil hui hai lekin hai yeh ghaur talab aur is ki sehat mein bhi kalam hai, Wallahu A'lam. Yeh ayat aur jo kuch is ke ma'ani mein sunnat mein warid hai is se namaz ke waqt zeenat karna mustahab sabit hota hai. Khusoosan Jumma ke din aur Eid ke din aur khushbu lagana bhi masnoon tareeqa hai is liye ke woh zeenat mein se hi hai aur miswak karna bhi, kyunke woh bhi zeenat ko pura karne mein dakhil hai. Yeh bhi yaad rahe ke sab se afzal libas safed kapra hai. Jaise ke Musnad-e-Ahmad ki sahih hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain safed kapray pehno woh tumhare tamam kapron se afzal hain aur isi mein apne murdon ko kafan do. Sab surmon mein behtar surma Ismid hai woh nigah ko tez karta hai aur baalon ko ugata hai. Sunan ki ek aur hadith mein hai safed kapron ko zaroori jaano aur unhein pehno woh bohat achay aur bohat paak saaf hain, inhi mein apne murdon ko kafan do. Tabrani mein marwi hai ke Hazrat Tameem Dari R.A ne ek chadar ek hazar ko khareedi thi, namazon ke waqt usay pehan liya karte thay. Is ke baad aadhi ayat mein Allah Ta'ala ne tamam tib ko aur hikmat ko jama kar diya, irshad hai khao piyo lekin had se tajawuz na karo. Ibn Abbas R.A ka qaul hai jo chaho khao jo chaho piyo lekin do baton se bacho, israf aur takabbur. Ek marfoo hadith mein hai khao piyo pehno aur parho lekin sadaqa bhi karte raho aur takabbur aur israf se bachte raho, Allah Ta'ala pasand farmata hai ke apni ne'mat ka asar apne banday ke jism par dekhay. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain khao aur pehno aur sadaqa karo aur israf se aur khud-numai se ruko. Farmate hain insan apne pet se zyada bura koi bartan nahin bharta. Insan ko chand luqmay jis se us ki peeth seedhi rahe kaafi hain, agar yeh bas mein na ho to zyada se zyada apne pet ke teen hissay kar le, ek khanay ke liye, ek pani ke liye, ek saans ke liye. Farmate hain yeh bhi israf hai ke tu jo chahay khaye, lekin hadith ghareeb hai. Mushrikeen jahan nangay ho kar tawaf karte thay wahan zamana-e-hajj mein charbi ko bhi apne upar haram jante thay, Allah ne dono baton ke khilaf hukum nazil farmaya. Yeh bhi israf hai ke Allah ke halal karda khanay ko haram kar liya jaye. Allah ki di hui halal rozi beshak insan khaye piye. Haram cheez ka khana bhi israf hai, Allah ki muqarrar karda haram-o-halal ki hadon se guzar na jao.

Na haram ko halal karo na halal ko haram kaho. Har ek hukm ko usi ki jagah par rakho warna musrif aur dushman-e-Rabb ban jao ge.

Aakhir-e-kaar momin hi Allah ki Rahmat ka sazawaar thehra. Khane peene pehanne ki in baaz cheezon ko baghair Allah ke farmaye haram kar lene walon ki tardeed ho rahi hai aur unhein un ke fe'l se roka ja raha hai. Yeh sab cheezein Allah par imaan rakhne walon aur us ki ibadat karne walon ke liye hi tayyar hui hain, go duniya mein un ke saath aur log bhi shareek hain lekin phir Qayamat ke din yeh alag kar diye jayenge aur sirf momin hi Allah ki ne'maton se nawaze jayenge. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) raawi hain ke mushrik nange ho ke Allah ke ghar ka tawaf karte the, seetiyan aur taliyan bajate jate the, pas aayatein utrin.

Bukhari Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah se zyada ghairat wala koi nahin. Surah An'am mein chupi khuli behayaiyon ke mutaliq poori tafsir guzar chuki hai aur Allah Ta'ala ne har gunah ko haram kar diya hai aur na-haq zulm-o-ta'addi, sarkashi aur ghuroor ko bhi usne haram kiya hai. Pas 'ism' se murad har woh gunah hai jo insaan aap kare aur 'baghi' se murad woh gunah hai jis mein dusre ka nuqsan kare ya uski haq talfi kare. Isi tarah Rabb ki ibadat mein kisi ko shareek karna bhi haram hai aur Zaat-e-Haq par bohtan bandhna bhi. Maslan uski aulad batana waghera. Khilaf-e-waqia baatein bhi jahalat ki baatein hain. Jaise farman hai aayat (Fajtanibul rijsa minal authan) al-kh, buton ki najasat se bacho, al-kh.

Maut ki sa'at tay shuda hai. Aur atal hai har zamane aur har zamane walon ke liye Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se intehai muddat muqarrar hai jo kisi tarah tal nahin sakti. Namumkin hai ke is se ek minute ki takheer ho ya ek lamhe ki jaldi ho. Insanon ko darata hai ke jab woh Rasoolon (A.S) se darana aur raghbat dilana sunen to badkariyon ko tark kardein aur Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at ki taraf jhuk jayen. Jab woh yeh karenge to woh har khatke, har dar se, har khauf aur na-umeedi se mehfooz hojayenge aur agar is ke khilaf kiya na dil se mana na amal kiya to woh dozakh mein jayenge aur wahin pade jhulaste rahenge.

Jab woh yeh karenge to woh har khatke, har dar se, har khauf aur na-umeedi se mehfooz hojayenge aur agar is ke khilaf kiya na dil se mana na amal kiya to woh dozakh mein jayenge aur wahin pade jhulaste rahenge.

Insanon ko darata hai ke jab woh Rasoolon (A.S) se darana aur raghbat dilana sunen to badkariyon ko tark kardein aur Allah Ta'ala ki ita'at ki taraf jhuk jayen. Jab woh yeh karenge to woh har khatke, har dar se, har khauf aur na-umeedi se mehfooz hojayenge aur agar is ke khilaf kiya na dil se mana na amal kiya to woh dozakh mein jayenge aur wahin pade jhulaste rahenge.

Allah Ta'ala par bohtan lagane wala sab se bada zalim hai. Waqia yeh hai ke sab se bada zalim woh hai jo Allah Ta'ala par jhoota bohtan bandhe aur woh bhi jo Allah ke kalam ki aayaton ko jhoota samjhe. Inhein inka muqaddar milega, iske ma'ani ek toh yeh hain ke inhein saza hogi, inke munh kale honge, inke a'amal ka badla mil kar rahega. Allah ke wa'ade wa'eed poore ho kar rahenge. Dusre ma'ani yeh hain ke inki umr, amal, rizq jo Loh-e-Mahfooz mein likha hua hai woh duniya mein toh milega. Yeh qaul qawi maloom hota hai kyunke iske baad ka jumla iski ta'eed karta hai. Isi matlab ki aayat (اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يَفْتَرُوْنَ عَلَي اللّٰهِ الْكَذِبَ لَا يُفْلِحُوْنَ) (Surah An-Nahl: 116) hai ke Allah par jhoot baatein ghad lene wale falah ko nahin paate, go duniya mein kuch faida utha lein lekin aakhir-e-kaar hamare samne hi pesh honge, us waqt inke kufr ke badle hum inhein sakht saza denge. Ek aayat mein hai kafiron ke kufr se toh ghamgeen na ho, inka lautna hamari janib hi hoga, phir hum farmaya ke inki roohon ko qabz karne ke liye hamare bheje hue farishte aate hain toh unko bator-e-tanz kehte hain ke ab apne maboodon ko kyun nahin pukarte ke woh tumhein is azaab se bacha lein. Aaj woh kahan hain? Toh yeh nihayat hasrat se jawab dete hain ke afsos woh toh khoye gaye, hamein un se ab kisi nafa ki umeed nahin rahi, pas apne kufr ka aap hi iqrar kar ke marte hain.

Kuffar ki gardanon mein tauq. Allah Ta'ala Qayamat ke din mushrikon ko jo Allah par iftira bandhte thay, us ki aayaton ko jhutlate thay, farmaye ga ke tum bhi apne jaison ke sath jo tum se pehle guzar chuke hain khwah woh jinnat mein se hon khwah insanon mein se Jahannam mein jao. (Fi-n-nari) ya to (fi umamin) ka badal hai ya (fi umamin) mein (fi) ma'ani mein (ma'a) ke hai. Har giroh apne sath ke apne jaise giroh par la'nat kare ga jaise ke Khalilullah A.S ne farmaya hai ke tum ek dusre se us roz kufr karoge aur aayat mein hai (Iz tabarra) yani woh aisa bura waqt hoga ke giroh apne chelon se dast-bardar ho jayenge, azabon ko dekhte hi aapas ke sare ta'alluqat toot jayenge. Mureed log us waqt kahenge ke agar hamein bhi yahan se phir wapas duniya mein jana mil jaye to jaise yeh log aaj hum se bezar ho gaye hain hum bhi un se bilkul hi dast-bardar ho jayenge. Allah Ta'ala isi tarah un ke kartoot un ke samne laye ga jo un ke liye sar-ta-sar maujib-e-hasrat honge aur yeh dozakh se kabhi azad na honge. Yahan farmata hai ke jab yeh sare ke sare Jahannam mein ja chuke honge to pichle yani tabe-dar mureed aur taqleed karne wale aglon se yani jin ki woh mante rahe un ki babat Allah Ta'ala se faryad karenge. Is se zahir hai ke yeh gumrah karne wale un se pehle hi Jahannam mein maujood hon kyunke un ka gunah bhi barha hua tha. Kahenge ke ya Allah inhe dugna azab kar. Chunancha aur aayat mein hai (Yawma tuqallabu wujuhuhum fi-n-nari yaquluna ya laytana ata'na-llaha wa ata'na-r-rasula) (Al-Ahzab: 66) jabke un ke chehre aatish-e-Jahannam mein idhar se udhar jhulse jate honge. Us waqt hasrat-o-afsos karte hue kahenge ke kash ke hum Allah Rasool ke muti' hote. Ya Allah hum ne apne sardaron aur baron ki tabedari ki jinhon ne hamein gumrah kar diya. Ya Allah inhe dugna azab kar. Inhe jawab mila ke har ek ke liye dugna hai. Yani har ek ko us ki buraiyon ka pura pura badla mil chuka hai. Jaise farman hai aayat (Alladhina kafaru wa saddu 'an sabili-llahi zidnahum 'adhaban fawqa-l-'adhabi bima kanu yufsidun) (An-Nahl: 88) jinhon ne kufr kiya aur rah-e-Rabb se roka un ka hum azab aur zyada karenge aur aayat mein hai aayat (Wa layahmilunna athqalahum wa athqalan ma'a athqalihim wa layus'alunna yawma-l-qiyamati 'amma kanu yaftarun) (Al-Ankabut: 13) yani apne bojh ke sath un ke bojh bhi uthayenge aur aayat mein hai un ke bojh un par lade jayenge jin ko unhon ne be-ilmi se gumrah kiya. Ab woh jin ki mani jati rahi apne manne walon se kahenge ke jaise hum gumrah thay tum bhi gumrah hue ab apne kartoot ka badla uthao aur aayat mein hai (Wa law tara izi-z-zalimuna mauqufuna 'inda rabbihim) kash ke tu dekhta jab ke yeh gunahgar Allah ke samne khare hue honge ek dusre par ilzam rakh rahe honge.

Zaeef log mutakabbiron se kahenge ke agar tum na hote toh hum momin ban jaate. Woh jawab denge ke kya hum ne tumhein hidayat se roka tha? Woh toh tumhare samne khuli hui maujood thi, baat yeh hai ke tum khud hi gunahgar bad-kirdar thay. Yeh phir kahenge ke nahin nahin tumhari din-raat ki chalakiyon ne aur tumhari is taleem ne (ke hum Allah ke sath kufr karein aur us ke shareek thahrayein) hamein gum-karda-rah bana diya. Baat yeh hai ke sab ke sab us waqt sakht nadim honge lekin nadamat ko dabane ki koshish mein honge. Kuffar ki gardanon mein tauq pade honge aur unhein un ke aamal ka badla zaroor diya jayega na kam na zyada (poora poora).

Is se zahir hai ke yeh gumrah karne wale un se pehle hi Jahannam mein maujood hon kyunke un ka gunah bhi barha hua tha. Kahenge ke ya Allah inhe dugna azab kar. Chunancha aur aayat mein hai (Yawma tuqallabu wujuhuhum fi-n-nari yaquluna ya laytana ata'na-llaha wa ata'na-r-rasula) (Al-Ahzab: 66) jabke un ke chehre aatish-e-Jahannam mein idhar se udhar jhulse jate honge. Us waqt hasrat-o-afsos karte hue kahenge ke kash ke hum Allah Rasool ke muti' hote. Ya Allah hum ne apne sardaron aur baron ki tabedari ki jinhon ne hamein gumrah kar diya. Ya Allah inhe dugna azab kar. Inhe jawab mila ke har ek ke liye dugna hai. Yani har ek ko us ki buraiyon ka pura pura badla mil chuka hai. Jaise farman hai aayat (Alladhina kafaru wa saddu 'an sabili-llahi zidnahum 'adhaban fawqa-l-'adhabi bima kanu yufsidun) (An-Nahl: 88) jinhon ne kufr kiya aur rah-e-Rabb se roka un ka hum azab aur zyada karenge aur aayat mein hai aayat (Wa layahmilunna athqalahum wa athqalan ma'a athqalihim wa layus'alunna yawma-l-qiyamati 'amma kanu yaftarun) (Al-Ankabut: 13) yani apne bojh ke sath un ke bojh bhi uthayenge aur aayat mein hai un ke bojh un par lade jayenge jin ko unhon ne be-ilmi se gumrah kiya. Ab woh jin ki mani jati rahi apne manne walon se kahenge ke jaise hum gumrah thay tum bhi gumrah hue ab apne kartoot ka badla uthao aur aayat mein hai (Wa law tara izi-z-zalimuna mauqufuna 'inda rabbihim) kash ke tu dekhta jab ke yeh gunahgar Allah ke samne khare hue honge ek dusre par ilzam rakh rahe honge.

Zaeef log mutakabbiron se kahenge ke agar tum na hote toh hum momin ban jaate. Woh jawab denge ke kya hum ne tumhein hidayat se roka tha? Woh toh tumhare samne khuli hui maujood thi, baat yeh hai ke tum khud hi gunahgar bad-kirdar thay. Yeh phir kahenge ke nahin nahin tumhari din-raat ki chalakiyon ne aur tumhari is taleem ne (ke hum Allah ke sath kufr karein aur us ke shareek thahrayein) hamein gum-karda-rah bana diya. Baat yeh hai ke sab ke sab us waqt sakht nadim honge lekin nadamat ko dabane ki koshish mein honge. Kuffar ki gardanon mein tauq pade honge aur unhein un ke aamal ka badla zaroor diya jayega na kam na zyada (poora poora).

Badkaron ki roohein dhutkari jati hain. Kafiron ke na toh nek aamal Allah ki taraf charhein, na un ki duayein qabool hon, na un ki roohon ke liye aasman ke darwaze khulein. Chunancha Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai ke jab badkaron ki roohein qabz ki jati hain aur farishtay unhein le kar aasmanon ki taraf charhte hain toh farishton ki jis jamaat ke paas se guzarte hain woh kehte hain yeh khabeeth rooh kis ki hai? Yeh us ka bad se bad naam le kar batate hain ke falan ki. Yahan tak ke yeh usay aasman ke darwaze tak pohanchate hain lekin un ke liye darwaza khola nahin jata. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aayat (La tuftahu lahum abwabus-sama) parhi. Yeh bohat lambi Hadith hai jo sunan mein mojood hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein yeh Hadith poori yun hai, Hazrat Bara bin Aazib (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain ek Ansari ke janaze mein hum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath thay. Jab qabristan pohanchay toh qabr tayyar hone mein kuch dair thi, sab baith gaye. Hum is tarah khamosh aur ba-adab thay ke goya hamaray saron par parind hain. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hath mein ek tinka tha jisay aap zameen par phira rahe thay. Thori dair mein aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne sar utha kar do baar ya teen baar hum se farmaya ke azab-e-qabr se Allah Ta'ala ki panah talab karo. Phir farmaya, momin jab duniya ki aakhri aur aakhirat ki pehli ghari mein hota hai us ke paas aasman se noorani chehron wale farishtay aate hain, goya ke un ka munh aaftab hai, un ke sath jannat ka kafan aur jannat ki khushbu hoti hai. Woh aa kar marne wale momin ke paas baith jate hain aur farmate hain: "Ae itminan wali rooh! Allah ki maghfirat aur razamandi ki taraf chal." Yeh suntay hi woh rooh is tarah badan se nikal jati hai jaise mashk ke munh se pani ka qatra tapak jaye. Isi waqt ek palak jhapakne ke barabar ki dair mein woh jannati farishtay us pak rooh ko apne hathon mein le lete hain aur jannati kafan aur jannati khushbu mein rakh lete hain. Is mein aisi umdah aur behtareen khushbu nikalti hai ke kabhi duniya walon ne na soonghi ho. Ab yeh usay le kar aasmanon ki taraf charhte hain, farishton ki jo jamaat unhein milti hai woh poochti hai ke yeh pak rooh kis ki hai? Yeh us ka behtar se behtar jo naam duniya mein mashhoor tha woh le kar kehte hain falan ki. Yahan tak ke aasman-e-duniya tak pohanch jate hain, darwaza khulwa kar oopar charh jate hain. Yahan se us ke sath usay dusre aasman tak pohanchane ke liye farishton ki aur bari jamaat ho jati hai, is tarah satwein aasman tak pohanchte hain. Allah Azza-wa-Jal farmata hai: "Is mere banday ki kitab (Illiyeen) mein rakh kar aur usay zameen ki taraf lota do, main ne unhein isi se paida kiya hai, isi mein lotaunga aur isi se dobara nikalunga." Pas woh rooh lota di jati hai, wahin us ke paas do farishtay aate hain, usay bithate hain aur us se poochte hain ke tera deen kya hai? Woh kehta hai mera deen Islam hai. Phir poochte hain ke woh shakhs jo tum mein bheje gaye kaun thay? Woh kehta hai woh Rasool-e-Allah thay (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam).

Farishtay us se daryaft karte hain ke tujhe kaise maloom hua? Jawab deta hai ke main ne Allah ki Kitab parhi, us par iman laya aur use sacha mana. Wahin aasman se ek munadi nida karta hai ke mera banda sacha hai, is ke liye jannat ka farsh bicha do. Ise jannati libas pehna do aur is ke liye jannat ka darwaza khol do. Pas is ke paas jannat ki tar-o-tazgi, is ki khushbu aur wahan ki hawa aati rehti hai aur is ki qabr kushada kar di jati hai. Jahan tak is ki nazar pohanchti hai, ise kushadagi hi kushadagi nazar aati hai. Is ke paas ek nihayat haseen-o-jameel shakhs libas-e-fakhira pehne hue, khushbu lagaye hue aata hai aur is se kehta hai khush ho ja, yehi woh din hai jis ka tujhe wada diya jata tha. In se poochta hai tu kaun hai? Tere chehray se bhalai payi jati hai. Woh jawab deta hai ke main tera nek amal hoon. Ab to momin aarzoo karne lagta hai ke Allah kare Qayamat aaj hi qaim ho jaye taake main jannat mein pohanch kar apne maal aur apne ahl-o-ayal ko pa loon. Aur kafir ki jab duniya ki aakhri ghari aati hai to is ke paas siyah chehray wale farishtay aasman se aate hain, un ke sath taat hota hai, is ki nigah tak ise yehi nazar aate hain. Phir Malakul Maut aa kar is ke sarhanay baith jate hain aur farmate hain: "Ae khabeeth rooh! Allah ki narazgi aur is ke ghazab ki taraf chal." Ye sun kar woh rooh badan mein chupne lagti hai, jise Malakul Maut jabran ghasit kar nikalte hain. Isi waqt woh farishtay un ke hath se ek aankh jhapne mein le lete hain aur is jahannami taat mein lapet lete hain aur is se nihayat hi sari hui badbu nikalti hai. Ye ise le kar charhne lagte hain, farishton ka jo giroh milta hai us se poochta hai ke ye napak rooh kis ki hai? Ye is ki rooh jiska badtareen naam duniya mein tha, unhein batate hain. Phir aasman ka darwaza is ke liye khulwana chahte hain magar khola nahin jata. Phir Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne Quran-e-Kareem ki ye aayat (La tuftahu) ilakh, tilawat farmayi. Janab-e-Bari Azza-wa-Jal ka irshad hota hai is ki kitab (Sijjeen) mein sab se neeche ki zameen mein rakho. Phir is ki rooh wahan se phenk di jati hai. Phir Aap (ﷺ) ne ye aayat tilawat farmayi: (Wa man yushrik billahi faka-annama kharra minas-sama-i fatakhtafuhut-tairu au tahwi bihir-reehu fi makani saheeq) yani jis ne Allah ke sath shareek kiya goya woh aasman se gir para, pas ise ya to parinday uchak le jayenge ya hawayein kisi door daraz ki darauni veeran jagah par phenk dengi. Ab is ki rooh is ke jism mein lautayi jati hai aur is ke paas woh farishtay pohanchte hain, ise utha kar bithate hain aur poochte hain tera Rabb kaun hai? Ye kehta hai haye haye mujhe khabar nahin. Poochte hain tera deen kya hai? Jawab deta hai afsos mujhe is ki bhi khabar nahin. Poochte hain bata is shakhs ki babat tu kya kehta hai jo tum mein bheje gaye thay? Ye kehta hai aah! Main is ka jawab bhi nahin janta.

Usi waqt aasman se nida hoti hai ke mere is ghulam ne ghalat kaha, is ke liye jahannam ki aag bicha do aur jahannam ka darwaza is ki qabr ki taraf khol do. Wahan se ise garmi aur aag ke jhonke aane lagte hain, is ki qabr is par tang ho jati hai yahan tak ke idhar ki pasliyan udhar aur udhar ki idhar ho jati hain. Is ke paas ek shakhs nihayat makrooh aur darauni surat wala, bure kapre pehne, buri badbu wala aata hai aur ise kehta hai ke ab apni buraiyon ka maza chakh, isi din ka tujh se wada kiya jata tha. Yeh puchta hai tu kaun hai? Tere to chehre se wehshat aur burai tapak rahi hai? Yeh jawab deta hai ke main tera khabeeth amal hoon. Yeh kehta hai ya Allah qayamat qaim na ho. Isi riwayat ki dusri sanad mein hai ke momin ki rooh ko dekh kar aasman-o-zameen ke tamam farishtay dua-e-maghfirat-o-rahmat karte hain, is ke liye aasmanon ke darwazay khul jate hain aur har darwazay ke farishton ki tamanna hoti hai ke Allah kare yeh rooh hamari taraf se aasman par charhay. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke kafir ki qabr mein andha, behra, gunga farishta muqarrar ho jata hai jis ke haath mein ek gurz hota hai ke agar ise kisi baray pahar par mara jaye to woh mitti ho jaye, phir ise jaisa woh tha Allah Ta'ala kar deta hai. Farishta dobara ise gurz marta hai jis se yeh cheekhne chillane lagta hai jise insaan aur jinnat ke siwa tamam makhlooq sunti hai. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke nek saleh shakhs se farishtay kehte hain, "Aye mutma'in nafs! Jo tayyab jism mein tha, tu tareefon wala ban kar nikal aur jannat ki khushbu aur naseem-e-jannat ki taraf chal. Is Allah ke paas chal jo tujh par ghussay nahin hai." Farmate hain ke jab is rooh ko le kar aasmanon ki taraf charhte hain, darwaza khulwate hain to pucha jata hai ke yeh kaun hai? Yeh is ka naam batate hain to woh ise marhaba keh kar wahi kehte hain yahan tak ke yeh us aasman mein pahunchte hain jahan Allah hai. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke buray shakhs se woh kehte hain, "Aye khabeeth nafs! Jo khabeeth jism mein tha, tu bura ban kar nikal aur tez kholte hue pani aur lahu peep aur isi qisam ke mukhtalif azabon ki taraf chal." Is ke nikalne tak farishtay ise yahi sunate rehte hain. Phir ise le kar aasmanon ki taraf charhte hain, pucha jata hai ke yeh kaun hai? Yeh is ka naam batate hain to aasman ke farishtay kehte hain, "Is khabeeth ko marhaba na kaho." Yeh thi bhi khabeeth jism mein, bad ban kar laut ja. Is ke liye aasman ke darwazay nahin khulte aur aasman-o-zameen ke darmiyan chor di jati hai, phir qabr ki taraf laut aati hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer R.H ne likha hai ke na in ke aamal charhein na in ki roohein, is se dono qaul mil jate hain. Wallahu A'lam. Is ke baad ke jumlay mein jamhoor ki qira'at to 'jamal' hai jis ke ma'ni nar oont ke hain, lekin ek qira'at mein 'jummal' hai is ke ma'ni baray pahar ke hain. Matlab ba-har-do surat ek hi hai ke na oont sui ke naakay se guzar sakay na pahar, isi tarah kafir jannat mein nahin ja sakta, in ka orhna bichona aag hai, zalimon ki yahi saza hai.

Matlab ba-har-do surat ek hi hai ke na oont sui ke naakay se guzar sakay na pahar, isi tarah kafir jannat mein nahin ja sakta, in ka orhna bichona aag hai, zalimon ki yahi saza hai.

Allah Ta'ala ke ahkamat ki tameel insani bas mein hai! Upar gunahgaron ka zikr hua yahan ab nek-bakhton ka zikr ho raha hai ke jin ke dil mein iman hai aur jo apne jism se Quran-o-Hadith ke mutabiq kaam karte hain bakhilaf badkaron ke ke woh dil mein kufr rakhte hain aur amal se door bhagte hain. Phir farman hai ke iman aur nekiyan insan ke bas mein hain Allah ke ahkam insani taqat se zyada nahin hain. Aise log jannati hain aur hamesha jannat mein hi rahenge. Un ke dilon mein se aapas ki kuduratein had-e-bughz door kar di jayengi. Chunancha Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke momin aag se chhutkara hasil kar ke jannat-o-dozakh ke darmiyan ek hi pul par rok diye jayenge wahan un ke aapas ke mazalim ka badla ho jayega aur pak ho kar jannat mein jane ki ijazat payenge. Wallah woh log apne apne darjon ko aur makanon ko is tarah pehchan lenge jaise duniya mein jaan lete the balkay is se bhi zyada. Suddi (R.H) se marvi hai ke ahl-e-jannat darwaza-e-jannat par ek darakht dekhenge jis ki jadon ke paas se do nahrein beh rahi hongi yeh un mein se ek ka pani piyenge jis se dilon ki kuduratein dhul jayengi yeh sharab-e-tahoor hai phir dusri nehar mein ghusal karenge jis se chehron par tar-o-tazgi aa jayegi phir na to baal bikhrein na surma lagane aur singhar karne ki zaroorat pade. Hazrat Ali bin Abu Talib (R.A) se bhi isi jaisa qaul marvi hai jo ayat (وَسِيْقَ الَّذِيْنَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ اِلَى الْجَنَّةِ زُمَرًا ۭ حَتّىٰٓ اِذَا جَاۗءُوْهَا وَفُتِحَتْ اَبْوَابُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَـــتُهَا سَلٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ طِبْتُمْ فَادْخُلُوْهَا خٰلِدِيْنَ 73) 39-Az-Zumar ki tafsir mein aayega Insha'Allah. Aap se yeh bhi marvi hai ke Insha'Allah mein aur Usman aur Talha aur Zubair un logon mein se honge jin ke dil Allah Ta'ala saaf kar dega. Farmate hain ke hum ahl-e-Badr ke bare mein yeh ayat utri hai. Ibn Marduyah mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain har jannati ko apna jahannam ka thikana dikhaya jayega taake woh aur bhi shukr kare aur woh kahega ke Allah ka shukr hai jis ne mujhe hidayat inayat farmayi aur har jahannami ko us ka jannat ka thikana dikhaya jayega taake us ki hasrat badhe us waqt woh kahega kaash ke mein bhi rah-yafta hota. Phir jannatiyon ko jannat ki jaghein de di jayengi aur ek munadi nida karega ke yahi woh jannat hai jis ke tum ba-sabab apni nekiyon ke waris bana diye gaye yani tumhare aamal ki wajah se tumhein Rahmat-e-Rabb mili aur Rahmat-e-Rabb se tum dakhil-e-jannat huye. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yaad rakho! Tum mein se koi bhi sirf apne aamal ki wajah se jannat mein nahin ja sakta logon ne poocha aap bhi nahin? Farmaya haan mein bhi nahin magar yeh ke Allah mujhe apni rahmat-o-fazl mein dhanp le.

Jannatiyon aur dozakhiyon mein mukalma: Jannati jab jannat mein ja kar aman-o-chain se baith jayenge toh dozakhiyon ko sharminda karne ke liye un se daryaft farmayenge ke hum ne toh apne Rab ke un wadon ko jo hum se kiye gaye the sahi paya, tum apni kaho. Yahan par 'in' mansura hai qaul-e-mahzoof ka aur 'qad' tahqeeq ke liye hai. Is ke jawab mein mushrikeen nadamat se kahenge ke haan hum ne bhi apne Rab ke un wadon ko jo hum se the theek paya. Jaisa Surah Saffat mein farman hai ke ahl-e-jannat mein se ek kahega ke mera ek sathi tha jo mujh se ta'ajjub ke sath sawal kiya karta tha ke kya tu bhi un logon mein se hai jo qayamat ke qail hain? Kya jab hum mar kar mitti ho jayenge aur haddiyan ho kar reh jayenge kya waqai hi hum dobara zinda kiye jayenge? Aur hamein badle diye jayenge? Yeh keh kar woh upar se jhank kar dekhega toh apne us sathi ko beech jahannam mein payega, kahega qasam Allah ki tu toh mujhe bhi tabah karne hi ko tha, agar mere Rab ka fazl shamil-e-haal na hota toh main bhi aaj giraftar-e-azab hota. Ab batao duniya mein jo kaha karta tha kya sacha tha ke hum mar kar jeene wale aur badla bhugatne wale hi nahin? Is waqt farishtey kahenge yahi woh jahannam hai jise tum jhoota maan rahe the, ab batao kya yeh jadoo hai? Ya tumhari aankhein nahin hain? Ab yahan pade jalte bhunte raho, sabr aur be-sabri dono natije ke aitbar se tumhare liye yaksan hain. Tumhein apne kiye ka badla pana hi hai. Isi tarah Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne kuffar-e-Quraish ke un maqtoolon ko jo Badr mein kaam aaye the aur jin ki lashein ek khai mein thin danta tha aur yeh farmaya tha ke ae Abu Jahl bin Hisham, ae Utba bin Rabia, ae Shaiba bin Rabia aur dusre sardaron ka bhi naam liya aur farmaya kya tum ne apne Rab ke wade ko sacha paya? Main ne toh apne Rab ke woh wade dekh liye jo us ne mujh se kiye the. Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ne farmaya ya Rasool Allah! Aap un se baatein kar rahe hain jo mar kar murdar ho gaye? Toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya us ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai ke meri baat ko tum bhi un se zyada nahin sun rahe lekin woh jawab nahin de sakte. Phir farmata hai ke isi waqt ek munadi nida kar ke maloom kara dega ke zalimon par Rab ki abadi la'nat waqay ho chuki. Jo logon ko rah-e-haq aur shariat-e-huda se rokte the aur chahte the ke Allah ki shariat tedhi kar dein taake is par koi amal na kare. Aakhirat par bhi unhein yaqeen na tha, Allah ki mulaqat ko nahin maante the isi liye be-parwahi se buraiyan karte the. Hisab ka dar na tha is liye sab se zyada bad-zaban aur bad-a'maal the.
