Jannat aur Jahannam mein deewar-o-hijab jannatiyon aur dozakhiyon ki baat bayan farma kar irshad hota hai ke jannat dozakh ke darmiyan ek aur hijab had-e-fasil aur deewar hai ke dozakhiyon ko jannat se fasle par rakhe. Isi deewar ka zikr aayat (Faduriba bainahum bisooril lahu babun, batinuhu feehi-r-rahmatu wa zahiruhu min qibalihi-l-azab) (Surah Al-Hadid: 13) mein hai, yani un ke darmiyan ek deewar hail kar di jayegi jis mein ek darwaza hai. Is ke andar rahmat hai aur bahar azab hai. Isi ka naam (A'raf) hai. (A'raf) (Urf) ki jama hai, har oonchi zameen ko Arab mein Urfa kehte hain, isi liye murgh ke sar ki kaling ko bhi Arab mein (Urf-ud-deek) kaha jata hai kyunke oonchi jagah hota hai. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain yeh ek oonchi jagah hai jannat dozakh ke darmiyan jahan kuch log rok diye jayenge. Suddi R.H farmate hain is ka naam A'raf is liye rakha gaya hai ke yahan ke log aur logon ko jante pehchante hain. Yahan kaun log honge? Is mein bahut se aqwal hain, sab ka hasil yeh hai ke woh yeh log honge jin ke gunah aur nekiyan barabar honge, ba'az salaf se bhi yahi manqool hai. Hazrat Huzaifa R.A, Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A, Hazrat Ibn Mas'ood R.A waghera ne yahi farmaya hai. Yahi ba'ad wale mufassireen ka qaul hai. Ek marfoo hadith mein bhi hai lekin sanadan woh hadith ghareeb hai aur sanad se marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se jab un logon ki babat jin ki nekiyan badiyan barabar hon aur jo A'raf wale hain sawal kiya gaya to aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yeh woh nafarman log hain jo apne baap ki ijazat baghair phir Allah ki rah mein qatl kar diye gaye aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh log Allah ki rah mein qatl kiye gaye aur apne walidain ke nafarman the to jannat mein jaane se baap ki nafarmani ne rok diya aur jahannam mein jaane se shahadat ne rok diya. Ibn Majah waghera mein bhi yeh riwayatein hain. Ab Allah hi ko un ki sehat ka ilm hai, bahut mumkin hai ke yeh mauqoof riwayatein hon. Bahar soorat un se Ashab-e-A'raf ka haal maloom ho raha hai. Hazrat Huzaifa R.A se jab un ki babat sawal kiya gaya to aap (R.A) ne farmaya yeh woh log hain jin ki nekiyan badiyan barabar barabar thin. Buraiyon ki wajah se jannat mein na ja sake aur nekiyon ki wajah se jahannam se bach gaye, pas yahan aar mein rok diye jayenge yahan tak ke Allah ka faisla un ke bare mein sarzad ho aur aayat mein aap (R.A) se marwi hai ke yeh dozakhiyon ko dekh dekh kar dar rahe honge aur Allah se nijat talab kar rahe honge ke nagah un ka Rabb un ki taraf dekhega aur farmayega jao jannat mein dakhil ho jao main ne tumhein bakhsha.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A farmate hain Qayamat ke din logon ka hisab hoga, ek neki bhi agar buraiyon se barh gayi toh dakhil-e-Jannat hoga aur ek burai bhi agar nekiyon se zyada ho gayi toh Dozakh mein jayega. Phir aap ne aayat (Faman saqulat mawazinuhu) se do aayaton tak tilawat keen aur farmaya ek rai ke daane ke barabar ki kami zyadati se Meezan ka palra halka bhari ho jata hai aur jin ki nekiyan badiyan barabar barabar huin yeh A'raaf wale hain, yeh thehra liye jayenge aur Jannati Dozakhi mashhoor ho jayenge. Yeh jab Jannat ko dekhenge toh Ahl-e-Jannat par salam karenge aur jab Jahannam ko dekhenge toh Allah se panah talab karenge. Nek logon ko noor milega jo un ke aage aur un ke dahine maujood rahega, har insaan ko woh mard hon khwah auratein hon ek noor milega lekin Pul-e-Sirat par munafiqon ka noor chheen liya jayega, us waqt sache momin Allah se apne noor ke baqi rehne ki duayein karenge. A'raaf walon ka noor chheena nahin jayega woh un ke aage aage maujood hoga, unhein Jannat mein jaane ki tama' hogi. Logon! Ek neki das guni kar ke likhi jati hai aur burai utni hi likhi jati hai jitni ho, afsos un par jin ki ikaiyan dahaiyon par ghalib aa jayen.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka farman hai ke A'raaf ek deewar hai jo Jannat-Dozakh ke darmiyan hai, Ashab-e-A'raaf wahin honge. Jab unhein aafiyat dene ka Allah ka irada hoga toh hukm milega unhein nehar-e-hayat ki taraf le jao, us ke dono kinaron par sone ke khaime honge jo motiyon se murassa honge, us ki mitti mushk-e-khalis hogi, us mein ghota lagate hi un ki rangatein nikhar jayengi aur un ki gardanon par ek safed chamkila nishan ho jayega jis se woh pehchan liye jayen. Yeh Allah ke samne laye jayenge, Allah Ta'ala farmayega jo chaho mango, yeh mangenge yahan tak ke un ki tamam tamannayein Allah Ta'ala poori kar dega, phir farmayega in jaisi sattar guna aur ne'matein bhi main ne tumhein dein. Phir yeh Jannat mein jayenge, woh alamat un par maujood hogi, Jannat mein un ka naam Masakeen-e-Ahl-e-Jannat hoga. Yehi riwayat Hazrat Mujahid ke apne qaul se bhi marwi hai aur yehi zyada sahih hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Ek Hasan sanad ki Mursal hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se A'raaf walon ki nisbat daryaft kiya gaya toh aap ne farmaya ke un ka faisla sab se aakhir mein hoga. Rabb-ul-Aalameen jab apne bandon ke faisle kar chuke ga toh un se farmayega ke tum logon ko tumhari nekiyon ne Dozakh se toh mehfooz kar liya lekin tum Jannat mein jaane ke haqdar sabit nahin huye, ab tum ko main apni taraf se azaad karta hoon, jao Jannat mein raho saho aur jahan chaho khao piyo. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh zina ki aulad hain. Ibn-e-Asakir mein farman-e-Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai ke momin jinnon ko sawab hai aur un mein se jo bure hain unhein azab bhi hoga. Hum ne un ke sawab aur un ke imandaron ke babat Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft kiya toh aap ne farmaya woh A'raaf mein honge, Jannat mein meri ummat ke sath na honge. Hum ne poocha Ya Rasool Allah! A'raaf kya hai?

Farmaya Jannat ka ek bagh jahan nehrein jaari hain aur phal pak rahe hain (Baihaqi). Hazrat Mujahid R.A farmate hain yeh saleh deenar fuqaha-e-ulama log honge. Abu Majaz R.A farmate hain yeh farishte hain, Jannat Dozakh walon ko jaante hain, phir aap ne in aayaton ki tilawat ki aur farmaya sab Jannati Jannat mein jaane lagenge toh kaha jayega ke tum amn-o-amaan ke sath be-khauf-o-khatar ho kar Jannat mein jao. Is ki sanad go theek hai lekin yeh qaul bahut ghareeb hai kyunke rawani-e-ibarat bhi is ke khilaf hai aur jamhoor ka qaul hi muqaddam hai kyunke aayat ke zahiri alfaaz ke mutabiq hai. Hazrat Mujahid R.A ka qaul bhi jo oopar bayan hua gharabat se khali nahin, Wallahu A'lam. Qurtubi R.H ne is mein barah qaul naqal kiye hain; sulaha, ambiya, malaika waghera. Yeh Jannatiyon ko un ke chehre ki raunaq aur safedi se aur Dozakhiyon ko un ke chehre ki siyahi se pehchan lenge, yeh yahan isi liye hain ke har ek ka imtiyaz kar lein aur sab ko pehchan lein. Yeh Jannatiyon se salam karenge, Jannatiyon ko dekh dekh kar Allah ki panah chahenge aur tama' rakhenge ke Allah Ta'ala apne fazl se unhein bhi Bahisht-e-Bareen mein pahuncha de. Yeh tama' un ke dil mein Allah ne isi liye dala hai ke us ka irada unhein Jannat mein le jaane ka ho chuka hai. Jab woh Ahl-e-Dozakh ko dekhte hain toh kehte hain ke Parwardigar hamein zalimon mein se na kar. Jab koi jamaat Jahannam mein pahunchayi jaati hai toh yeh apne bachao ki duayein karne lagte hain. Jahannam se un ke chehre koile jaise ho jayenge lekin jab Jannat walon ko dekhenge toh yeh cheez chehron se door ho jayegi. Jannatiyon ke chehron ki pehchan nooraniyat hogi aur Dozakhiyon ke chehron par siyahi aur aankhon mein bhenga-pan hoga.

Jannat aur Jahannam mein deewar-o-hijab jannatiyon aur dozakhiyon ki baat bayan farma kar irshad hota hai ke jannat dozakh ke darmiyan ek aur hijab had-e-fasil aur deewar hai ke dozakhiyon ko jannat se fasle par rakhe. Isi deewar ka zikr aayat (Faduriba bainahum bisooril lahu babun, batinuhu feehi-r-rahmatu wa zahiruhu min qibalihi-l-azab) (Surah Al-Hadid: 13) mein hai, yani un ke darmiyan ek deewar hail kar di jayegi jis mein ek darwaza hai. Is ke andar rahmat hai aur bahar azab hai. Isi ka naam (A'raf) hai. (A'raf) (Urf) ki jama hai, har oonchi zameen ko Arab mein Urfa kehte hain, isi liye murgh ke sar ki kaling ko bhi Arab mein (Urf-ud-deek) kaha jata hai kyunke oonchi jagah hota hai. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain yeh ek oonchi jagah hai jannat dozakh ke darmiyan jahan kuch log rok diye jayenge. Suddi R.H farmate hain is ka naam A'raf is liye rakha gaya hai ke yahan ke log aur logon ko jante pehchante hain. Yahan kaun log honge? Is mein bahut se aqwal hain, sab ka hasil yeh hai ke woh yeh log honge jin ke gunah aur nekiyan barabar honge, ba'az salaf se bhi yahi manqool hai. Hazrat Huzaifa R.A, Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.A, Hazrat Ibn Mas'ood R.A waghera ne yahi farmaya hai. Yahi ba'ad wale mufassireen ka qaul hai. Ek marfoo hadith mein bhi hai lekin sanadan woh hadith ghareeb hai aur sanad se marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se jab un logon ki babat jin ki nekiyan badiyan barabar hon aur jo A'raf wale hain sawal kiya gaya to aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yeh woh nafarman log hain jo apne baap ki ijazat baghair phir Allah ki rah mein qatl kar diye gaye aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh log Allah ki rah mein qatl kiye gaye aur apne walidain ke nafarman the to jannat mein jaane se baap ki nafarmani ne rok diya aur jahannam mein jaane se shahadat ne rok diya. Ibn Majah waghera mein bhi yeh riwayatein hain. Ab Allah hi ko un ki sehat ka ilm hai, bahut mumkin hai ke yeh mauqoof riwayatein hon. Bahar soorat un se Ashab-e-A'raf ka haal maloom ho raha hai. Hazrat Huzaifa R.A se jab un ki babat sawal kiya gaya to aap (R.A) ne farmaya yeh woh log hain jin ki nekiyan badiyan barabar barabar thin. Buraiyon ki wajah se jannat mein na ja sake aur nekiyon ki wajah se jahannam se bach gaye, pas yahan aar mein rok diye jayenge yahan tak ke Allah ka faisla un ke bare mein sarzad ho aur aayat mein aap (R.A) se marwi hai ke yeh dozakhiyon ko dekh dekh kar dar rahe honge aur Allah se nijat talab kar rahe honge ke nagah un ka Rabb un ki taraf dekhega aur farmayega jao jannat mein dakhil ho jao main ne tumhein bakhsha.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A farmate hain Qayamat ke din logon ka hisab hoga, ek neki bhi agar buraiyon se barh gayi toh dakhil-e-Jannat hoga aur ek burai bhi agar nekiyon se zyada ho gayi toh Dozakh mein jayega. Phir aap ne aayat (Faman saqulat mawazinuhu) se do aayaton tak tilawat keen aur farmaya ek rai ke daane ke barabar ki kami zyadati se Meezan ka palra halka bhari ho jata hai aur jin ki nekiyan badiyan barabar barabar huin yeh A'raaf wale hain, yeh thehra liye jayenge aur Jannati Dozakhi mashhoor ho jayenge. Yeh jab Jannat ko dekhenge toh Ahl-e-Jannat par salam karenge aur jab Jahannam ko dekhenge toh Allah se panah talab karenge. Nek logon ko noor milega jo un ke aage aur un ke dahine maujood rahega, har insaan ko woh mard hon khwah auratein hon ek noor milega lekin Pul-e-Sirat par munafiqon ka noor chheen liya jayega, us waqt sache momin Allah se apne noor ke baqi rehne ki duayein karenge. A'raaf walon ka noor chheena nahin jayega woh un ke aage aage maujood hoga, unhein Jannat mein jaane ki tama' hogi. Logon! Ek neki das guni kar ke likhi jati hai aur burai utni hi likhi jati hai jitni ho, afsos un par jin ki ikaiyan dahaiyon par ghalib aa jayen.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka farman hai ke A'raaf ek deewar hai jo Jannat-Dozakh ke darmiyan hai, Ashab-e-A'raaf wahin honge. Jab unhein aafiyat dene ka Allah ka irada hoga toh hukm milega unhein nehar-e-hayat ki taraf le jao, us ke dono kinaron par sone ke khaime honge jo motiyon se murassa honge, us ki mitti mushk-e-khalis hogi, us mein ghota lagate hi un ki rangatein nikhar jayengi aur un ki gardanon par ek safed chamkila nishan ho jayega jis se woh pehchan liye jayen. Yeh Allah ke samne laye jayenge, Allah Ta'ala farmayega jo chaho mango, yeh mangenge yahan tak ke un ki tamam tamannayein Allah Ta'ala poori kar dega, phir farmayega in jaisi sattar guna aur ne'matein bhi main ne tumhein dein. Phir yeh Jannat mein jayenge, woh alamat un par maujood hogi, Jannat mein un ka naam Masakeen-e-Ahl-e-Jannat hoga. Yehi riwayat Hazrat Mujahid ke apne qaul se bhi marwi hai aur yehi zyada sahih hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Ek Hasan sanad ki Mursal hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se A'raaf walon ki nisbat daryaft kiya gaya toh aap ne farmaya ke un ka faisla sab se aakhir mein hoga. Rabb-ul-Aalameen jab apne bandon ke faisle kar chuke ga toh un se farmayega ke tum logon ko tumhari nekiyon ne Dozakh se toh mehfooz kar liya lekin tum Jannat mein jaane ke haqdar sabit nahin huye, ab tum ko main apni taraf se azaad karta hoon, jao Jannat mein raho saho aur jahan chaho khao piyo. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh zina ki aulad hain. Ibn-e-Asakir mein farman-e-Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai ke momin jinnon ko sawab hai aur un mein se jo bure hain unhein azab bhi hoga. Hum ne un ke sawab aur un ke imandaron ke babat Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft kiya toh aap ne farmaya woh A'raaf mein honge, Jannat mein meri ummat ke sath na honge. Hum ne poocha Ya Rasool Allah! A'raaf kya hai?

Farmaya Jannat ka ek bagh jahan nehrein jaari hain aur phal pak rahe hain (Baihaqi). Hazrat Mujahid R.A farmate hain yeh saleh deenar fuqaha-e-ulama log honge. Abu Majaz R.A farmate hain yeh farishte hain, Jannat Dozakh walon ko jaante hain, phir aap ne in aayaton ki tilawat ki aur farmaya sab Jannati Jannat mein jaane lagenge toh kaha jayega ke tum amn-o-amaan ke sath be-khauf-o-khatar ho kar Jannat mein jao. Is ki sanad go theek hai lekin yeh qaul bahut ghareeb hai kyunke rawani-e-ibarat bhi is ke khilaf hai aur jamhoor ka qaul hi muqaddam hai kyunke aayat ke zahiri alfaaz ke mutabiq hai. Hazrat Mujahid R.A ka qaul bhi jo oopar bayan hua gharabat se khali nahin, Wallahu A'lam. Qurtubi R.H ne is mein barah qaul naqal kiye hain; sulaha, ambiya, malaika waghera. Yeh Jannatiyon ko un ke chehre ki raunaq aur safedi se aur Dozakhiyon ko un ke chehre ki siyahi se pehchan lenge, yeh yahan isi liye hain ke har ek ka imtiyaz kar lein aur sab ko pehchan lein. Yeh Jannatiyon se salam karenge, Jannatiyon ko dekh dekh kar Allah ki panah chahenge aur tama' rakhenge ke Allah Ta'ala apne fazl se unhein bhi Bahisht-e-Bareen mein pahuncha de. Yeh tama' un ke dil mein Allah ne isi liye dala hai ke us ka irada unhein Jannat mein le jaane ka ho chuka hai. Jab woh Ahl-e-Dozakh ko dekhte hain toh kehte hain ke Parwardigar hamein zalimon mein se na kar. Jab koi jamaat Jahannam mein pahunchayi jaati hai toh yeh apne bachao ki duayein karne lagte hain. Jahannam se un ke chehre koile jaise ho jayenge lekin jab Jannat walon ko dekhenge toh yeh cheez chehron se door ho jayegi. Jannatiyon ke chehron ki pehchan nooraniyat hogi aur Dozakhiyon ke chehron par siyahi aur aankhon mein bhenga-pan hoga.

Kufr ke sutoon aur un ka hashr. Kufr ke jin sutoonon ko, kafiron ke jin sardaron ko A'raf wale un ke chehron se pehchan lenge unhein daant-dupat kar ke poochenge ke aaj tumhari kasrat-e-jam'iyat kahan gayi? Is ne to tumhein mutlaqan faida na pahunchaya. Aaj woh tumhari akar-foon kya hui tum to buri tarah azabon mein jakar diye gaye. Un ke baad hi Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se unhein farmaya jayega ke bad-bakhto inhi ki nisbat tum kaha karte the ke Allah inhein koi rahat nahin de ga. Ae A'raf walo main tumhein ijazat deta hoon ke jao ba-aram be-khatke jannat mein jao. Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) farmate hain ke A'raf walon ke a'mal-e-saliha is qabil na nikle ke unhein jannat mein pahunchayen lekin itni buraiyan bhi un ki na thin ke dozakh mein jayen to yeh A'raf par hi rok diye gaye, logon ko un ke andaze se pehchante honge jab Allah Ta'ala apne bandon mein faisle kar chuke ga shafa'at ki ijazat de ga log Hazrat Adam (A.S) ke paas ayenge aur kahenge ke ae Adam aap hamare baap hain hamari shafa'at Allah Ta'ala ki janib mein kijiye. Aap jawab denge ke kya tum nahin jante ho ke mere siwa kisi ko Allah Ta'ala ne apne hath se paida kiya ho, apni rooh is mein phoonki ho, apni rahmat is par apne ghazab se pehle pahunchayi ho, apne farishton se ise sajda karaya ho? Sab jawab denge ke nahin aisa koi aap ke siwa nahin. Aap farmayenge main is ki haqeeqat se be-khabar hoon main tumhari shafa'at nahin kar sakta hoon tum mere larke Ibrahim ke paas jao. Ab sab log Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ke paas pahunchenge aur un se shafa'at karne ki darkhwast karenge. Aap jawab denge ke kya tum jante ho ke mere siwa aur koi Khalilullah hua ho? Ya Allah ke bare mein is ki qoum ne aag mein phenka ho? Sab kahenge nahin aap ke siwa aur koi nahin, farmayenge mujhe is ki haqeeqat maloom nahin main tumhari darkhwast-e-shafa'at nahin le ja sakta tum mere larke Musa ke paas jao. Hazrat Musa (A.S) jawab denge ke batao mere siwa Allah ne kisi ko apna Kaleem banaya, apni sargoshiyon ke liye nazdiki ata farmayi? Jawab denge ke nahin. Farmayenge main is ki haqeeqat se be-khabar hoon main tumhari sifarish karne ki taqat nahin rakhta. Haan tum Hazrat Isa ke paas jao. Log Hazrat Isa (A.S) ke paas ayenge un se shafa'at talbi ka taqaza karenge yeh jawab denge ke kya tum jante ho ke mere siwa kisi ko Allah ne baghair baap ke paida kiya ho? Jawab mile ga ke nahin. Poochhenge jante ho ke koi madar-zad andhon aur korhiyon ko ba-hukm-e-Ilahi mere siwa achha karta ho ya koi murda ko ba-hukm-e-Ilahi zinda kar deta ho? Kahenge ke koi nahin. Farmayenge ke main to aaj apne nafs ke bachao mein hoon, main is ki haqeeqat se be-khabar hoon. Mujh mein itni taqat kahan ke tumhari sifarish kar sakoon, haan tum sab ke sab Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas jao.

Chunancha sab log mere paas aayenge main apna seena thonk kar kahunga ke haan haan main isi liye maujood hoon, phir main chal kar Allah ke Arsh ke saamne thehar jaunga. Apne Rabb-e-Azz-o-Jal ke paas pahunch jaunga aur aisi aisi uski tareefein bayan karunga ke kisi sunne wale ne kabhi na suni hon. Phir sajde mein gir padunga phir mujhse farmaya jayega ke ae Muhammad (ﷺ) apna sar uthao. Mango diya jayega. Shafa'at karo, qabool ki jayegi. Pas main apna sar utha kar kahunga mere Rabb meri ummat. Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga woh sab teri hi hai. Phir toh har har paighambar aur har ek farishta rashk karne lagega. Yehi maqam Maqam-e-Mahmood hai. Phir main un sab ko le kar Jannat ki taraf aaunga. Jannat ka darwaza khulwaunga aur woh mere liye aur unke liye khol diya jayega phir unhein ek nehar ki taraf le jayenge jiska naam Nehar-ul-Haiwan hai uske dono kinaron par sone ke mahal hain jo yaqoot se jadao kiye gaye hain us mein ghusal karenge jis se Jannati rang aur Jannati khushbu un mein paida ho jayegi aur chamakte hue sitaron jaise woh noorani ho jayenge haan unke seenon par safed nishan baqi reh jayenge jis se woh pehchane jayenge unhein masakeen-e-Ahl-e-Jannat kaha jayega.

Jaisi karni waisi bharni. Dozakhiyon ki zillat-o-khwari aur un ka bheek mangna aur daant diya jana bayan ho raha hai ke woh jannatiyon se pani ya khana mangenge. Apne nazdeek ke rishte-kunbe wale jaise baap, bete, bhai, behan waghera se kahenge ke hum jal bhun rahe hain, bhooke pyase hain, hamein ek ghont pani ya ek luqma khana de do. Woh bahukm-e-Ilahi unhein jawab denge ke yeh sab kuch kuffar par haram hai. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se sawal hota hai ke kis cheez ka sadqa afzal hai? Farmaya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka irshad hai ke sab se afzal khairat pani hai. Dekho jahannami ahl-e-jannat se isi ka sawal karenge. Marwi hai ke jab Abu Talib maut ki bimari mein mubtala hua to Quraishiyon ne us se kaha kisi ko bhej kar apne bhatije se kehwao ke woh tumhare paas jannati angoor ka ek khosha bhijwa de taake teri bimari jati rahe. Jis waqt qasid Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aata hai Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.A aap ke paas majood thay. Sunte hi farmane lage Allah ne jannat ki khane peene ki cheezein kafiron par haram kar di hain. Phir un ki bad-kirdari bayan farmayi ke yeh log deen-e-haq ko ek hansi khel samjhe hue thay, duniya ki zeenat aur us ke banao-chunao mein hi umr bhar mashghool rahe. Yeh chunke is din ko bhool-bisar gaye thay is ke badle hum bhi un ke sath aisa mamla karenge jo kisi bhool jane wale ka mamla ho kyunke Allah Ta'ala bhoolne se pak hai, us ke ilm se koi cheez nikal nahin sakti. Farmata hai ayat (Lā yaḍillu rabbī wa lā yansā) (Taha: 52) na woh behke na bhoole. Yahan jo farmaya yeh sirf muqable ke liye hai jaise farman hai ayat (Nasullaha fanasiyahum) aur jaise dusri ayat mein hai (Qāla kadhalika atatka āyātunā fanasītahā, wa kadhalika al-yawma tunsā) (Taha: 126). Farman hai (Al-yawma nansākum kamā nasītum liqā'a yawmikum hādhā, wa ma'wākumu al-nāru wa mā lakum min nāṣirīn) (Al-Jathiya: 34). Tere paas hamari nishaniyan aayi thin jinhein tu bhula baitha tha, isi tarah aaj tujhe bhi bhula diya jayega waghera. Pas yeh bhulaiyon se bil-qasd bhula diye jayenge. Haan buraiyan aur azab barabar hote rahenge. Unhon ne is din ki mulaqat ko bhulaya, hum ne unhein aag mein chhora, rahmat se door kiya jaise yeh amal se door thay. Sahih hadith mein hai qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala bande se farmayega kya main ne tujhe biwi bache nahin diye thay? Kya izzat-o-abroo nahin di thi? Kya ghore aur oont tere muti' nahin kiye thay? Aur kya tujhe qisam-qisam ki rahaton mein azad nahin rakha tha? Banda jawab dega ke haan Parwardigar beshak tu ne aisa hi kiya tha. Allah Ta'ala farmayega phir kya tu meri mulaqat par iman rakhta tha? Woh jawab dega ke nahin. Allah Ta'ala farmayega pas main bhi aaj tujhe aisa hi bhool jaunga jaise tu mujhe bhool gaya tha.

Yahan jo farmaya yeh sirf muqable ke liye hai jaise farman hai ayat (Nasullaha fanasiyahum) aur jaise dusri ayat mein hai (Qāla kadhalika atatka āyātunā fanasītahā, wa kadhalika al-yawma tunsā) (Taha: 126). Farman hai (Al-yawma nansākum kamā nasītum liqā'a yawmikum hādhā, wa ma'wākumu al-nāru wa mā lakum min nāṣirīn) (Al-Jathiya: 34). Tere paas hamari nishaniyan aayi thin jinhein tu bhula baitha tha, isi tarah aaj tujhe bhi bhula diya jayega waghera. Pas yeh bhulaiyon se bil-qasd bhula diye jayenge. Haan buraiyan aur azab barabar hote rahenge. Unhon ne is din ki mulaqat ko bhulaya, hum ne unhein aag mein chhora, rahmat se door kiya jaise yeh amal se door thay. Sahih hadith mein hai qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala bande se farmayega kya main ne tujhe biwi bache nahin diye thay? Kya izzat-o-abroo nahin di thi? Kya ghore aur oont tere muti' nahin kiye thay? Aur kya tujhe qisam-qisam ki rahaton mein azad nahin rakha tha? Banda jawab dega ke haan Parwardigar beshak tu ne aisa hi kiya tha. Allah Ta'ala farmayega phir kya tu meri mulaqat par iman rakhta tha? Woh jawab dega ke nahin. Allah Ta'ala farmayega pas main bhi aaj tujhe aisa hi bhool jaunga jaise tu mujhe bhool gaya tha.

Aakhri haqeeqat jannat aur dozakh ka mushahida. Allah Ta'ala ne mushrikon ke kul uzr khatam kar diye thay apne rasoolon ki ma'rifat apni kitab bheji jo mufassal aur wazeh thi. Jaise farman hai aayat (Alif-Laam-Raa, Kitabun uhkimat aayatuhu thumma fussilat min ladun Hakeemin Khabeer) (Hud: 1), is Quran ki aayatein mazboot aur tafseel-war hain. Is ki jo tafseel hai woh bhi ilm par hai jaise farman hai aayat (Anzalahu bi-ilmihi) ise apne ilm ke sath utara hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) farmate hain yeh aayat isi aayat par jati hai jis mein farman hai aayat (Kitabun unzila ilaika fala yakun fee sadrika harajun minhu litunzira bihi wa dhikra lil-mu'mineen) (Al-A'raf: 2), yeh kitab teri taraf nazil farmayi gayi hai pas is se tere seene mein koi haraj na hona chahiye. Yahan farmaya aayat (Walaqad ji'nahum bikitabin) al-kh, lekin yeh mahal-e-nazar hai is liye ke fasla bahut hai aur yeh qaul be-daleel hai. Darhaqeeqat jab un ke is khasare ka zikr hua jo unhein aakhirat mein hoga toh bayan farmaya ke duniya mein hi hum ne toh apna paigham pahuncha diya tha rasool bhi kitab bhi. Jaise irshad hai ke jab tak hum rasool na bhej dein azab nahin karte isi liye is ke baad hi farmaya. Unhein toh ab jannat dozakh ke apne samne aane ka intezar hai. Ya yeh matlab ke is ki haqeeqat yak-e-baad-e-deegare roshan hoti rahegi yahan tak ke aakhri haqeeqat yani jannat dozakh hi samne aa jayengi aur har ek apne laiq maqam mein pahunch jayega. Qayamat wale din yeh waqiyat ronuma ho jayenge, ab jo sun rahe hain us waqt dekh lenge. Us waqt ise faramosh kar ke baith rehne wale amal se kore log maan lenge ke beshak Allah ke ambiya sachay thay, Rabb ki kitabein bar-haq thin. Kash ab koi hamara sifarishi khara ho aur hamein is halakat se nijat dilaye ya aisa ho ke hum phir se duniya ki taraf lota diye jayen toh jo kaam kiye thay ab un ke khilaf karein. Jaise farman hai aayat (Wa law tara iz wuqufoo alan-nari faqaloo ya laitana nuraddu wa la nukazziba bi-aayati Rabbina wa nakuna minal-mu'mineen) (Al-An'am: 27), kash ke hum phir duniya mein lotaye jate, apne Rabb ki aayaton ko na jhutlate aur momin ban jate. Is se pehle jo woh chupa rahe thay ab zahir ho gaya. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke agar yeh dobara duniya mein bheje bhi jayen toh jis cheez se roke jayenge wahi dobara karenge aur jhootay sabit honge. Unhon ne aap hi apna bura kiya, Allah Ta'ala ke siwa auron se ummeedein rakhte rahe, aaj sab batil ho gayin, na koi un ka sifarishi na himayati.

Allah Ta'ala ki hamd-o-sana bahut si aayaton mein yeh bayan hua hai ke aasman-o-zameen aur kul makhlooq Allah Ta'ala ne chhay din mein banayi hai yani itwar se jumma tak. Jumma ke din saari makhlooq paida ho chuki. Isi din Hazrat Adam A.S paida huye ya toh yeh din duniya ke mamooli dinon ke barabar hi thay jaise ke aayat ke zahiri alfaaz se fil-faur samajha jata hai ya har din ek hazar saal ka tha jaise ke Hazrat Mujahid ka qaul hai aur Hazrat Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal ka farman hai aur barwayat-e-Zahhak Ibn-e-Abbas ka qaul hai. Hafta ke din koi makhlooq paida nahin hui. Isi liye is ka naam arabi mein (Yaum-us-Sabt) hai, (Sabt) ke ma'ani qata karne, khatam karne ke hain. Haan Musnad-e-Ahmad, Nasai aur Sahih Muslim mein jo hadith hai ke Allah ne mitti ko hafta ke din paida kiya aur paharon ko itwar ke din aur darakhton ko peer ke din aur buraiyon ko mangal ke din aur noor ko budh ke din aur janwaron ko jumeraat ke din aur Adam A.S ko jumma ke din asr ke baad din ki aakhri ghari mein asr se le kar maghrib tak. Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ka haath pakar kar yeh ginwaya. Is se maloom hota hai ke saat din tak paidaish ka silsila jaari raha halanke Quran mein majood hai ke chhay din mein paidaish khatam hui. Isi wajah se Imam Bukhari R.H waghera zabardast huffaz-e-hadith ne is hadith par kalam kiya hai aur farmaya hai ke yeh ibarat Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ne Ka'ab Ahbar se li hai, farman-e-Rasool ﷺ nahin hai, Wallahu A'alam. Phir farmata hai ke woh apne Arsh par mustawi hua. Is par logon ne bahut kuch che-migoiyaan ki hain. Jinhein tafseel se bayan karne ki yeh jagah nahin. Munasib yahi hai ke is maqam mein Salaf-e-Saliheen ki raush ikhtiyar ki jaye. Jaise Imam Malik, Imam Auza'i, Imam Thauri, Imam Laith, Imam Shafi'i, Imam Ahmad, Imam Ishaq bin Rahwiya waghera waghera aimma-e-salaf-o-khalaf rahimahumullah. In sab buzrugan-e-deen ka mazhab yahi tha ke jaisi yeh aayat hai isi tarah ise rakha jaye baghair kaifiyat ke, baghair tashbeeh ke aur baghair muhmal chorne ke. Haan mushabbiheen ke zehnon mein jo cheez aa rahi hai is se Allah Ta'ala paak aur bahut door hai, Allah ke mushaba us ki makhlooq mein se koi nahin. Farman hai aayat (لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهٖ شَيْءٌ ۚ وَهُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْبَصِيْرُ) (Surah Ash-Shura: 11) is ke misl koi nahin aur woh sunne dekhne wala hai. Balkay haqeeqat yahi hai jo aimma-e-kiram rahmatullahi alaihim ne farmayi hai, inhi mein se Hazrat Na'eem bin Hammad Khaza'i R.H hain. Aap hazrat Imam Bukhari R.H ke ustad hain, farmate hain jo shakhs Allah ko makhlooq se tashbeeh de woh kafir hai aur jo shakhs Allah ke is wasf se inkar kare jo us ne apni zaat-e-paak ke liye bayan farmaya hai woh bhi kafir hai. Khud Allah Ta'ala ne aur Rasool Allah ﷺ ne jo ausaf-e-zaat-e-bari Ta'ala jalla shanuhu ke bayan farmaye hain un mein hargiz tashbeeh nahin.

Pas sahih hidayat ke raaste par wahi hai jo aasar-e-sahiha aur akhbar-e-sariha se jo ausaf Rabb-ul-Izzat Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu ke saabit hain unhein isi tarah jaane jo Allah ki jalalat-e-shaan ke shayan hai aur har aib-o-nuqsan se apne Rabb ko paak aur mubarra-o-munazzah samjhe. Phir farman hai ke raat ka andhera din ke ujaale se aur din ka ujaala raat ke andhere se door hojata hai, har ek dusre ke peeche lapka chala aata hai yeh gaya woh aaya woh gaya yeh aaya. Jaise farmaya aayat (Wa aayatul-lahumul-lail) al-kh, unke samajhne ke liye hamari ek nishani raat hai ke is mein se hum din ko nikalte hain jis se yeh andhere mein aajate hain. Suraj apne thikane ki taraf barabar ja raha hai yeh hai andaza Allah ka muqarrar kiya hua jo Ghalib aur Ba-ilm hai. Humne chaand ki bhi manzilein thehra di hain yahan tak ke woh khajoor ki purani tehni jaisa ho kar reh jaata hai. Na aaftab mahtaab se aage nikal sakta hai na raat din se pehle aasakti hai. Sab ke sab apne apne madaar mein tairte phirte hain. Raat din mein koi faasla nahin ek ka jaana hi dusre ka aajana hai har ek dusre ke barabar peeche hai aayat (Wash-shamsu wal-qamaru wan-nujumu) ko baaz ne pesh se bhi padha hai. Maani matlab dono suraton mein qareeb qareeb barabar hai. Yeh sab Allah ke zer-e-farman, uske matahat aur uske irade mein hain. Mulk aur tasarruf usi ka hai. Woh barkaton wala aur tamam jahan ka paalne wala hai. Farman hai aayat (TABARAKAL-LAZII JA'ALA FIS-SAMAA'I BURUUJANW-WA JA'ALA FIIHAA SIRAAJANW-WA QAMARAM-MUNII-RAA) (Al-Furqan: 61). Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jis kisi ne kisi naik par Allah ki hamd na ki balkay apne nafs ko saraha usne kufr kiya aur uske aamaal ghaarat hue aur jisne yeh aqeeda rakha ke Allah ne kuch ikhtiyarat apne bandon ko bhi diye hain usne uske saath kufr kiya jo Allah ne apne nabiyon par naazil farmaya hai kyunke uska farman hai aayat (ALAA LAHUL-KHALQU WAL-AMR; TABARAKAL-LAAHU RABBUL-'AALAMIIN) (Al-A'raf: 54). (Ibn-e-Jarir) Ek marfoo dua Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki yeh bhi marwi hai ke Aap farmate the dua (ALLAHUMMA LAKAL-MULKU KULLUHU WA LAKAL-HAMDU KULLUHU WA ILAIKA YURJA'UL-AMRU KULLUHU AS'ALUKA MINAL-KHAIRI KULLIHI WA A'UUDU BIKA MINASH-SHARRI KULLIHI) ya Allah saara mulk tera hi hai sab hamd tere liye hi hai sab kaam teri hi taraf laut-te hain main tujh se tamam bhalaaiyan talab karta hoon aur saari buraiyon se teri panah chahta hoon.

Insaan dua mange qabool hogi. Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ko dua ki hidayat karta hai jis mein un ki duniya aur aakhirat ki bhalai hai. Farmata hai ke apne Parwardigar ko aajizi, maskeeni aur aahistagi se pukaro jaise farman hai aayat (Wazkur Rabbaka fi nafsika) al-kh, apne Rab ko apne nafs mein yaad kar. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari (R.A) se riwayat hai ke logon ne dua mein apni aawazein bahut buland kar dein to Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya logon apni jaanon par raham karo tum kisi behre ko ya ghaib ko nahin pukaar rahe, jise tum pukaar rahe ho woh bahut sunne wala aur bahut nazdeek hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke poshidgi murad hai, Imam Ibn Jareer (R.H) farmate hain (Tadarru'an) ke ma'ani zillat, maskeeni aur ita'at guzari ke hain aur (Khufyatan) ke ma'ani dilon ke khushoo-o-khuzoo se, yaqeen ki sehat se, us ki wahdaniyat aur rububiyat ka us ke aur apne darmiyan yaqeen rakhte hue pukaro na ke riya kaari ke sath bahut buland aawaz se. Hazrat Hasan (R.H) se marwi hai ke log hafiz-e-Quran hote the aur kisi ko maloom bhi nahin hota tha, log bahut bade faqeeh ho jaate the aur koi jaanta bhi na tha, log lambi lambi namazein apne gharon mein padhte the aur mehmanon ko bhi pata na chalta tha. Yeh woh log the ke jahan tak un ke bas mein hota tha apni kisi neki ko logon par zahir nahin hone dete the. Poori koshish se duayein karte the lekin is tarah jaise koi sargoshi kar raha ho, yeh nahin ke cheekhein chillayein. Yehi farman-e-Rabb hai ke apne Rab ko aajizi aur aahistagi se pukaro. Dekho Allah Ta'ala ne apne ek nek bande ka zikr kiya jis se woh khush tha ke us ne apne Rab ko khufiya taur par pukara. Imam Ibn Juraij (R.H) farmate hain dua mein buland aawaz, nida aur cheekhne ko makrooh samjha jaata tha, balkay girya-o-zari aur aahistagi ka hukm diya jaata tha. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain dua waghera mein had se guzar jaane walon ko Allah dost nahin rakhta. Abu Majaz (R.H) kehte hain maslan apne liye Nabi ban jaane ki dua karna waghera. Hazrat Sa'ad (R.A) ne suna ke un ka ladka apni dua mein keh raha hai ke Aye Allah main tujh se Jannat aur us ki ne'matein aur us ke resham-o-hareer waghera waghera talab karta hoon aur Jahannam, us ki zanjeeron aur us ke tauq waghera se teri panah chahta hoon. To aap ne farmaya tu ne Allah se bahut si bhalaiyan talab keen aur bahut si buraiyon se panah chahi, main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai aap farmate the ke anqareeb kuch log honge jo dua mein had se guzar jaya karenge.

Ek sanad se marwi hai ke woh dua mangne mein aur wazu karne mein had se nikal jayenge phir Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yahi aayat tilawat farmayi aur farmaya tujhe apni dua mein yahi kehna kafi hai ke Aye Allah main tujh se jannat aur jannat se qareeb karne wale qaul-o-fel ki taufiq talab karta hoon aur jahannam aur us se nazdeek karne wale qaul-o-fel se teri panah chahta hoon (Abu Dawood). Ibn Majah waghera mein hai un ke sahibzade apni dua mein yeh keh rahe the ke Ya Allah jannat mein dakhil hone ke baad jannat ki dayin janib ka safed rang ka aalishan mahal main tujh se talab karta hoon. Phir zameen par aman-o-aman ke baad fasad karne ko mana farma raha hai kyunke us waqt ka fasad khusoosiyat se zyada buraiyan paida karta hai. Pas Allah use haram qarar deta hai aur apni ibadat karne ka, dua karne ka, maskeeni aur aajizi karne ka hukum deta hai ke Allah ko us ke azabon se dar kar aur us ki nematon ke umeedwar ban kar pukaro. Allah ki rahmat neko-karon ke saron par mandla rahi hai. Jo us ke ahkam baja late hain us ke mana karda kamon se baaz rehte hain jaise farmaya aayat (Wa Rahmat-i Wasi'at Kulla Shai'in Fasaktubuha Lilladhina Yattaquna Wa Yu'tuna Az-Zakata Walladhina Hum Bi-Ayatina Yu'minun) (Surah Al-A'raf: 156). Yun to meri rahmat tamam cheezon ko ghere hue hai lekin main ise makhsoos kar doonga parhezgar logon ke liye. Chunke rahmat sawab ki zamin hoti hai is liye qareeb kaha qareebatan na kaha ya is liye ke woh Allah ki taraf muzaf hai. Unhon ne Allah ke wadon ka sahara liya. Allah ne apna faisla kar diya ke us ki rahmat bilkul qareeb hai.

Allah ne apna faisla kar diya ke us ki rahmat bilkul qareeb hai.

Tamam mazahir-e-qudrat us ki shaan ke mazhar hain. Upar bayan hua ke zameen-o-aasman ka khaliq Allah hai. Sab par qabza rakhne wala, hakim, tadbeer karne wala, muti aur farmanbardar rakhne wala Allah hi hai. Phir duayein karne ka hukum diya kyunke woh har cheez par qadir hai. Ab yahan bayan ho raha hai ke razzaq bhi wahi hai aur qayamat ke din murdon ko zinda kar dene wala bhi wahi hai. Pas farmaya ke barish se pehle bhini bhini khushgawar hawayein wahi chalata hai (bushran) ki dusri qiraat mubashshirat bhi hai. Rahmat se murad yahan barish hai jaise farman hai aayat (وَهُوَ الَّذِيْ يُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا قَنَطُوْا وَيَنْشُرُ رَحْمَتَهٗ ۭ وَهُوَ الْوَلِيُّ الْحَمِيْدُ 28؀) (42-Ash-Shura: 28) woh hai jo logon ki na-umeedi ke baad barish utarta hai aur apni rahmat ki rail-pel kar deta hai, woh wali hai aur qabil-e-tareef. Ek aur aayat mein hai rahmat-e-Rabb ke aasar dekho ke kis tarah murda zameen ko woh jila deta hai, wahi murda insanon ko zinda karne wala hai aur woh har cheez par qadir hai. Baadal jo pani ki wajah se bojhal ho rahe hain unhein yeh hawayein utha le chalti hain, yeh zameen se bahut qareeb hote hain aur siyah hote hain. Chunancha Hazrat Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail R.H ke sher mein hai: Main us ka muti hoon jis ke itaat-guzar meethe aur saaf pani ke bhare hue baadal hain aur jis ke tabe-e-farman bhari bojhal paharon wali zameen hai. Phir hum un baadalon ko murda zameen ki taraf le chalte hain jis mein koi sabza nahin, khushk aur banjar hai, jaise aayat (wa aayatul lahumul ard) mein bayan hua hai, phir us se pani barsa kar usi ghair-abad zameen ko sarsabz bana dete hain. Isi tarah hum murdon ko zinda kar denge halanke woh boseeda haddiyan aur phir reza reza ho kar mitti mein mil gaye honge. Qayamat ke din un par Allah Azzawajal barish barsaye ga, chalis din tak barabar barasti rahe gi jis se jism qabron mein ugane lagenge jaise dana zameen par ugta hai. Yeh bayan Quran-e-Kareem mein kayi jagah hai. Qayamat ki misaal barish ki paidawar se di jati hai. Phir farmaya yeh tumhari nasihat ke liye hai. Achhi zameen mein se paidawar umda bhi nikalti hai aur jaldi bhi jaise farman hai aayat (wa ambataha nabatan hasana) aur jo zameen kharab hai jaise sanglakh zameen, shor zameen waghera, us ki paidawar bhi waisi hi hoti hai. Yahi misaal momin-o-kafir ki hai. Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain jis ilm-o-hidayat ke sath Allah ne mujhe bheja hai us ki misaal aisi hai jaise zameen par bahut zyada barish hui, zameen ke ek saaf umda tukre the un par bhi woh pani barsa lekin na to wahan ruka na wahan kuch uga. Yahi misaal us ki hai jis ne deen-e-haq ki samajh paida ki aur meri ba'asat se us ne faida uthaya, khud seekha aur dusron ko sikhaya aur aise bhi hain ke unhon ne sar hi na uthaya aur Allah ki woh hidayat hi na li jo meri ma'arifat bheji gayi (Muslim-o-Nasa'i).

Phir tazkira-e-Anbiya chunke surat ke shuru mein Hazrat Adam (A.S) ka qissa bayan hua tha phir is ke mutaliqat bayan hue aur is ke mutasil aur bayanat farma kar ab phir aur Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) ke waqiyat ke bayan ka aaghaz hua aur pai dar pai un ke bayanat hue. Sab se pehle Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ka zikr hua kyunke Adam (A.S) ke baad sab se pehle paighambar ahl-e-zameen ki taraf aap hi aaye the. Aap Nuh bin Malik bin Maqushalakh bin Akhnukh (yani Idris A.S, yahi pehle woh shakhs hain jinhon ne qalam se likha) bin Bard bin Mahlil bin Qanin bin Yanshan bin Shees bin Adam (A.S). Aimma-e-nasab jaise Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq waghera ne aap ka nasab-nama isi tarah bayan farmaya hai. Imam sahab farmate hain Hazrat Nuh (A.S) jaisa koi aur nabi ummat ki taraf se sataya nahin gaya. Haan Anbiya qatl zaroor kiye gaye. Inhein Nuh isi liye kaha gaya ke yeh apne nafs ka rona bahut rote the. Hazrat Adam (A.S) aur Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ke darmiyan das zamane the jo Islam par guzre the. Asnam parasti ka riwaj isi tarah shuru hua ke jab Auliya-e-Allah faut ho gaye to un ki qoum ne un ki qabron par masjidein bana lein aur un mein un buzurgon ki tasweerein bana lein taake un ka haal aur un ki ibadat ka naqsha samne rahe aur apne aap ko un jaisa banane ki koshish karein lekin kuch zamane ke baad un tasweeron ke mujasme bana liye, kuch aur zamane ke baad inhi buton ko pooja karne lage aur un ke naam inhi Auliya-e-Allah ke namon par rakh liye. Wadd, Suwa', Yaghus, Ya'uq, Nasr waghera. Jab but parasti ka riwaj ho gaya, Allah ne apne Rasool Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ko bheja. Aap ne unhein Allah-e-Wahid ki ibadat ki talqeen ki aur kaha ke Allah ke siwa koi mabood nahin, mujhe to dar hai ke kahin Roz-e-Qayamat ke din tumhein azab na ho. Qoum-e-Nuh ke baron ne, un ke sardaron ne aur un ke chaudhriyon ne Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ko jawab diya ke tum to behak gaye ho, hamein apne baap dada ke deen se hata rahe ho. Har bad shakhs nek logon ko gumrah samjha karta hai. Quran mein hai ke jab yeh badkar in nek karon ko dekhte hain kehte hain ke yeh to behke hue hain. Kaha karte the ke agar yeh deen achha hota to in se pehle hum na maan lete? Yeh to baat hi ghalat aur jhoot hai. Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ne jawab diya ke main behka hua nahin hoon balki main Allah ka Rasool hoon, tumhein paigham-e-Rabb pahuncha raha hoon. Tumhara khair khwah hoon aur Allah ki woh baatein jaanta hoon jinhein tum nahin jaante. Har Rasool muballigh, faseeh, baleegh, nasi, khair khwah aur Aalim-billah hota hai. In sifat mein aur koi un ki humsari aur barabari nahin kar sakta. Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne Arafah ke din apne as-haab se farmaya jabke woh bahut badi tadaad mein bahut zyada the ke ae logo tum meri babat Allah ke haan poochhe jaoge to batao kya jawab doge?

Sab ne kaha hum kahenge ke aap ne tabligh kar di thi aur haq-e-risalat ada kar diya tha aur poori khair-khwahi ki thi. Pas aap ne apni ungli aasman ki taraf uthayi aur phir neeche zameen ki taraf ishara kiya aur farmaya: Ya Allah tu gawah reh, ae Allah tu shahid reh, ya Allah tu gawah reh.

Nuh A.S par kya guzri? Hazrat Nuh A.S apni qoum se farma rahe hain ke tum is baat ko anokha aur ta'ajjub wala na samjho ke Allah Ta'ala apne lutf-o-karam se kisi insaan par apni wahi nazil farmaye aur use apni paighambari se mumtaz kar de taake woh tumhein hoshiyar kar de phir tum shirk-o-kufr se alag ho kar azab-e-Ilahi se nijat palo aur tum par gona-gon rahmatein nazil hon. Hazrat Nuh A.S ki in daleelon aur wa'azon ne in sang-dilon par koi asar na kiya, yeh unhein jhutlate rahe, mukhalifat se baaz na aaye, imaan qabool na kiya, sirf chand log sanwar gaye. Pas hum ne in nek logon ko apne Nabi ke saath kashti mein bitha kar toofan se nijat di aur baqi logon ko teh-e-aab gharq kar diya. Jaise Surah Nuh mein farmaya hai ke woh apne gunahon ke ba'is gharq kar diye gaye, phir dozakh mein daal diye gaye aur koi aisa nahin tha jo un ki kisi qisam ki madad karta. Yeh log haq se aankhein band kiye hue the, nabina ho gaye the, rah-e-haq unhein aakhir tak sujhayi na di. Pas Allah ne apne Nabi ko, apne doston ko nijat di. Apne aur un ke dushmanon ko teh-e-aab barbad kar diya. Jaise us ka wa'ada hai ke hum apne rasoolon ki aur imandaron ki zaroor madad farmaya karte hain. Nuh A.S par kya guzri? Hazrat Nuh A.S apni qoum se farma rahe hain ke tum is baat ko anokha aur ta'ajjub wala na samjho ke Allah Ta'ala apne lutf-o-karam se kisi insaan par apni wahi nazil farmaye aur use apni paighambari se mumtaz kar de taake woh tumhein hoshiyar kar de phir tum shirk-o-kufr se alag ho kar azab-e-Ilahi se nijat palo aur tum par gona-gon rahmatein nazil hon. Hud A.S aur un ka rawayya! Farmata hai ke jaise Qaum-e-Nuh ki taraf Hazrat Nuh A.S ko hum ne bheja tha, Qaum-e-Ad ki taraf Hazrat Hud A.S ko hum ne Nabi bana kar bheja. Yeh log Ad bin Iram bin Aus bin Sam bin Nuh ki aulad thay. Yeh Ad-e-Ula hain. Yeh jangal mein sutoonon mein rehte thay. Farman hai aayat (Alam tara kaifa fa'ala rabbuka bi'ad, Irama zatil-imad, allati lam yukhlaq misluha fil-bilad) yani kya tu ne nahin dekha ke Ad-e-Iram ke sath tere Rab ne kya kiya? Jo buland qamat thay, dusre shahron mein jin ki manind log paida hi nahin kiye gaye. Yeh log bade qawi taqatwar aur lambe chaure qad ke thay, jaise farman hai ke Adiyon ne zameen mein na-haq takabbur kiya aur na'ra lagaya ke hum se zyada qawi kaun hai? Kya unhein itni bhi tameez nahin ke un ka paida karne wala yaqeenan un se zyada taqat wala hai. Woh hamari aayaton se inkar kar baithe. Un ke shehar Yaman mein Ahqaf thay, yeh retle pahar thay. Hazrat Ali R.A ne Hazramaut ke ek shakhs se kaha ke tu ne ek surkh teela dekha hoga jis mein surkh rang ki raakh jaisi mitti hai, us ke aas paas peelu aur beri ke darakht bakasrat hain, woh teela falan jagah Hazramaut mein hai. Us ne kaha Ameer-ul-Momineen aap to is tarah ke nishan bata rahe hain goya aap ne ba-chashm-e-khud dekha hai. Aap ne farmaya nahin dekha to nahin lekin haan mujh tak hadees pahunchi hai ke wahin Hazrat Hud A.S ki qabr hai. Is se sabit hota hai ke un logon ki bastiyan Yaman mein thin, isi liye un ke paighambar wahin madfoon hain. Aap un sab mein shareef qabeele ke thay, is liye ke Anbiya hamesha hasb-o-nasab ke aitbar se aali khandan mein hi hote rahe hain. Lekin aap ki qaum jis tarah jismani taur se sakht aur zordar thi, isi tarah dilon ke aitbar se bhi bahut sakht thi. Jab apne Nabi ki zabani Allah ki ibadat aur taqwa ki nasihat suni to logon ki bhari aksariyat aur un ke sardar aur bade bol uthay ke tu to pagal ho gaya hai, hamein apne buton ki in khubsurat tasweeron ki ibadat se hata kar Allah-e-Wahid ki ibadat ki taraf bula raha hai. Yehi ta'ajjub Quraish ko hua tha. Unhon ne kaha tha ke is ne saare maboodon ko ibadat se hata kar ek ki ibadat ki dawat kyun di? Hazrat Hud A.S ne unhein jawab diya ke mujh mein to bewaqoofi ki ba-fazl-e-Allah koi baat nahin. Main to tumhein Kalam-e-Ilahi pahuncha raha hoon, tumhari khair-khwahi karta hoon aur amanat-dari se haq-e-risalat ada kar raha hoon. Yehi woh sifatein hain jo tamam Rasoolon mein yaksan hoti hain, yani paigham-e-haq pahunchana, logon ki bhalai chahna aur amanat-dari ka namuna banna. Tum meri risalat par ta'ajjub na karo balkay Allah ka shukr baja lao ke us ne tum mein se ek fard ko apna paighambar banaya ke woh tumhein azab-e-Ilahi se daraway. Tumhein Rab ke is ehsan ko bhi faramosh na karna chahiye ke us ne tumhein halak hone walon ke baqaya mein se banaya. Tumhein baqi rakha, itna hi nahin balkay tumhein qawi haikal, mazboot aur taqatwar kar diya.

Yehi na'mat Hazrat Talut par thi ke unhein jismani aur ilmi kushadgi di gayi thi. Tum Allah ki na'mton ko yaad rakho taake nijaat hasil karsako.

Qaum-e-Aad ka baghiyana rawayya. Qaum-e-Aad ki sarkashi, takabbur, zid aur inaad ka bayan ho raha hai ke unhon ne Hazrat Hud (A.S) se kaha ke kya aap ki tashreef-awari ka maqsad yehi hai ke hum Allah-e-Wahid ke parastar ban jayen aur baap dadon ke purane maboodon se rogardani kar len? Suno agar yehi maqsood hai to iska poora hona muhaal hai. Hum tayyar hain agar tum sachay ho to apne Allah se hamare liye azab talab karo. Yehi kuffar-e-Makkah ne kaha tha, kehne lage ke ya Allah Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka kaha haq hai aur woh waqai tera kalam hai aur hum nahin maante to tu hum par aasman se patthar barsa ya koi aur sakht alamnak azab humein kar. Qaum-e-Aad ke buton ke naam ye hain: Samad, Samoodha. Un ki is dhitai ke muqablay mein Allah ka azab aur us ka ghazab sabit ho gaya. Rijs se murad rijs yani azab hai, narazgi aur gussay ke ma'ani yehi hain. Phir farmaya ke tum in buton ki babat mujh se jhagad rahe ho jin ke naam bhi tum ne khud rakhay hain ya tumhare badon ne, aur khwah-makhwah be-wajah unhein mabood samajh baithe ho, ye patthar ke tukray mehez be-zarar aur be-nafa hain. Na Allah ne in ki ibadat ki koi daleel utari hai. Haan agar tum muqablay par utar hi aaye ho to muntazir raho, main bhi muntazir hoon, abhi maloom ho jayega ke maqbool-e-bargah-e-Rabb kaun hai aur mardood-e-bargah kaun hai? Kaun mustahiq-e-azab hai aur kaun qabil-e-sawab hai? Aakhir hum ne apne Nabi ko aur un ke imandar sathiyon ko nijat di aur kafiron ki jarein kaat dein. Quran-e-Kareem ke kayi maqamat par Janab-e-Bari Azzawajal ne un ki tabahi ki soorat bayan farmayi hai ke un par khair se khali, tund aur tez hawayein bheji gayin jis ne unhein aur un ki tamam cheezon ko gharat aur barbad kar diya. Aad log baray zanatay ki sakht aandhi se halak kar diye gaye jo un par barabar saat raat aur aath din chalti rahi. Saaray ke saaray is tarah ho gaye jaise khajoor ke darakhton ke tanay alag hon aur shakhain alag hon. Dekh le in mein se ek bhi ab nazar aa raha hai? Un ki sarkashi ki saza mein sarkash hawa un par musallat kar di gayi jo un mein se ek ek ko utha kar aasman ki bulandi ki taraf le jati aur wahan se girati jis se sar alag ho jata, dhar alag gir jata. Ye log Yaman ke mulk mein, Oman aur Hadhramaut mein rehte thay, idhar udhar nikalte aur logon ko maar peet ki jabran-o-qahran un ke mulk-o-maal par ghasibana qabza kar lete. Saaray ke saaray but parast thay. Hazrat Hud (A.S) jo un ke shareef khandani shakhs thay un ke paas Rabb ki risalat le kar aaye, Allah ki tauheed ka hukum diya, shirk se roka, logon par zulm karne ki burai samjhai lekin unhon ne is nasihat ko qabool na kiya. Muqablay par tan gaye aur apni quwwat se haq ko dabane lage. Go baaz log iman laye thay lekin woh bhi bechare jaan ke khauf se posheeda rakhay hue thay. Baqi log badastoor apni be-imani aur na-insafi par jamay rahe, khwah-makhwah fauqiyat zahir karne lage, bekar imaratain banate aur phoolay na samate.

In sab kamon ko Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) napasand farmate, unhein rokte, taqwe ki, ita'at ki hidayat karte lekin yeh kabhi toh unhein bedaleel batate, kabhi unhein majnoon kehte. Aap (ﷺ) apni barat zahir karte aur un se saaf farmate ke mujhe tumhari quwwat-o-taqat ka mutlaqan khauf nahin, jao tum se jo ho sake kar lo. Mera bharosa Allah par hai. Us ke siwa na koi bharose ke laiq na ibadat ke qabil, sari makhlooq us ke samne aajiz, past aur lachar hai. Sachi rah Allah ki rah hai. Aakhir jab yeh apni buraiyon se baaz na aaye toh un par barish na barsayi gayi, teen saal tak qahat-sali rahi. Aajiz ho gaye, tang aa gaye, aakhir yeh socha ke chand admiyon ko Baitullah Sharif bhejein, woh wahan ja kar Allah se duayein karein. Yehi un ka dastoor tha ke jab kisi museebat mein phans jate toh wahan wafd bhejte. Us waqt un ka qabeela Amaliq Haram Sharif mein bhi rehta tha, yeh log Amliq bin Adam bin Sam bin Nuh ki nasl mein se thay. Un ka sardar us zamane mein Mu'awiyah bin Bakr tha. Us ki maa qoum-e-Aad se thi jis ka naam Jahida bint-e-Khabiri tha. Aadiyon ne apne yahan se sattar shakhson ko muntakhab kar ke bator-e-wafd Makkah Sharif ko rawana kiya. Yahan aa kar yeh Mu'awiyah ke mehman bane. Pur-takalluf dawat-o-ke udane, sharab khori karne aur Mu'awiyah ki do laundiyon ka gana sunne mein is be-khudi se mashghool ho gaye ke kamil ek mahina guzar gaya. Unhein apne kaam ki taraf mutlaq tawajjah na hui. Mu'awiyah un ki yeh raush dekh kar aur apni qoum ki buri halat samne rakh kar bahut karhta tha lekin yeh mehman nawazi ke khilaf tha ke khud un se kehta ke jao. Is liye us ne kuch ashaar likhe aur un hi dono kaneezon ko yaad karaye ke woh yehi ga kar unhein sunayein. In sher-on ka mazmoon yeh tha ke ae logo jo qoum ki taraf se Allah se duayein karne ke liye bheje gaye ho ke Allah Aadiyon par barish barsaye jo aaj qahat-sali ki wajah se tabah ho gaye hain, bhooke pyase mar rahe hain, budhe, bache, mard, aurtein tabah-haal phir rahe hain, yahan tak ke bolna chalna un par dushwar ho gaya hai. Jungli janwar un ki abadiyon mein phir rahe hain kyunke kisi aadmi mein itni quwwat kahan ke woh teer chala sake. Lekin afsos ke tum yahan apne man-mane mashghalon mein munhamik ho gaye aur be-faida waqt zaya karne lage. Tum se zyada bura wafd duniya mein koi na hoga, yaad rakho agar ab bhi tum ne musta'idi se qaumi khidmat na ki toh tum barbad aur gharat ho jaoge. Yeh sun kar un ke kaan khade hue, yeh Haram mein gaye aur duayein mangna shuru keen. Allah Ta'ala ne teen badal un ke samne pesh kiye, ek safed, ek siyah, ek surkh aur ek aawaz aayi ke in mein se ek ikhtiyar kar lo. Us ne siyah badal pasand kiya, aawaz aayi ke tu ne siyah pasand kiya jo Aadiyon mein se kisi ko bhi na chhore ga, na baap ko na bete ko, sab ko gharat kar de ga siwaye Banu Lawiziyah ke. Yeh Banu Lawiziyah bhi Aadiyon ka ek qabeela tha jo Makkah mein muqeem thay, un par woh azab nahin aaye thay, yehi baqi rahe aur inhi mein se Aad-e-Ukhra hue.

Is wafd ke sardar ne siyah badal pasand kiya tha jo usi waqt Aadiyon ki taraf chala. Is shakhs ka naam Qail bin Ghaz tha. Jab yeh badal Aadiyon ke maidan mein pahuncha jis ka naam Mughis tha to use dekh woh log khushiyan manane lage ke is abr se pani zaroor barse ga halankeh yeh woh tha jis ki yeh log Nabi ke muqable mein jaldi macha rahe the jis mein almnak azab tha jo tamam cheezon ko fana kar dene wala tha. Sab se pehle is azab-e-Ilahi ko ek aurat ne dekha jis ka naam Mumaid tha yeh cheekh maar kar behosh ho gayi. Jab hosh aayi to logon ne us se poocha ke tu ne kya dekha? Us ne kaha aag ka bagola jo ba-surat-e-hawa tha jise farishte ghasite liye chale aate the. Barabar saat raatein aur aath din tak yeh aag wali hawa un par chalti rahi aur azab ka badal un par barasta raha. Tamam Aadiyon ka satyanas ho gaya. Hazrat Hud (A.S) aur aap ke momin sathi ek bagheeche mein chale gaye wahan Allah ne unhein mehfooz rakha wahi hawa thandi aur bhini bhini ho kar un ke jismon ko lagti rahi jis se rooh ko tazgi aur aankhon ko thandak pahunchti rahi. Haan Aadiyon par is hawa ne sangbari shuru kar di, un ke dimagh phat gaye. Aakhir unhein utha utha kar de patkha sar alag ho gaye dhad alag ja pade yeh hawa sawar ko sawari samet idhar utha leti thi aur bahut oonche le ja kar use ondha de patakhti thi. Yeh siyaq bahut ghareeb hai aur is mein bahut se fawaid hain. Azab-e-Ilahi ke aa jane se Hazrat Hud (A.S) ko aur mominon ko nijat mil gayi rahmat-e-Haq un ke shamil-e-haal rahi aur baqi kuffar is badtareen saza mein giraftar huye. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Haris Bakri (R.A) farmate hain main apne haan se Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein Ala bin Hazrami ki shikayat le kar chala jab main Rabzah mein pahuncha to Banu Tamim ki ek budhiya lachar ho kar baithi hui mili. Mujh se kehne lagi ae Allah ke bande mujhe Sarkar-e-Risalat Ma'ab mein pahunchna hai. Kya tu mere sath itna sulook kare ga ke mujhe darbar-e-Risalat mein pahuncha de? Main ne kaha aao chunancha main ne use apne oont par bitha liya aur Madine pahuncha dekha ke masjid logon se bhari hui hai siyah jhande lehra rahe hain aur Hazrat Bilal (R.A) An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne talwar latkaye khade hain main ne poocha kya baat hai? Logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hazrat Amr bin Aas (R.A) ki mat-huti mein kahin lashkar bhejne wale hain. Main thori der baitha raha itne mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni manzil mein tashreef le gaye. Main aap ke peeche hi gaya. Ijazat talab ki ijazat mili jab main ne andar ja kar salam kiya to aap ne mujh se daryaft farmaya kya tum mein aur Banu Tamim mein kuch chashmak hai? Main ne kaha Huzoor is ke zimmedar wahi hain. Main ab hazir-e-khidmat ho raha tha to raste mein qabila Tamim ki ek budhiya aurat mil gayi jis ke paas sawari waghera na thi us ne mujh se darkhwast ki aur main use apni sawari par bitha kar yahan laya hoon woh darwaze par baithi hui hai. Aap ne use bhi andar aane ki ijazat di. Main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum mein aur Banu Tamim mein koi rok kar dijiye.

Is par burhiya tez ho kar boli agar aap ne aisa kar diya toh phir aap ke yahan ke bebas kahan panah lenge? Main ne kaha SubhanAllah! Teri aur meri toh wahi misl hui ke bakri apni maut ko aap utha kar le gayi, main ne hi tujhe yahan pahunchaya, mujhe is ke anjam ki kya khabar thi? Allah na kare ke main bhi Aadi qabile ke wafd ki tarah ho jaaun. Toh Huzoor (ﷺ) ne mujh se daryaft farmaya ke bhai Aadiyon ke wafd ka qissa kya hai? Bawajood yeh ke aap ko mujh se zyada is ka ilm tha lekin yeh samajh kar ke is waqt aap baatein karna chahte hain, main ne qissa shuru kar diya ke Huzoor (ﷺ) jis waqt Aadiyon mein qahat-sali namudar hui toh unhon ne Qail naam-e-ek shakhs ko bator apne qasid ke Baitullah Sharif dua waghera karne ke liye bheja. Yeh Muawiyah bin Bakr ke yahan aa kar mehman bana. Yahan sharab-o-kabab aur raag-rang mein aisa mashghool hua ke mahine bhar tak jaam lundhata raha aur Muawiyah ki do laundiyon ke gaane sunta raha un ka naam Jarada tha. Mahine bhar ke baad Mahra ke pahadon par gaya aur Allah se dua maangne laga ke Bari Ta'ala main kisi bimar ki dawa ke liye ya kisi qaidi ke fidiye ke liye nahin aaya, ya Allah Aadiyon ko toh woh pila jo pilaya karta tha, itne mein woh dekhta hai ke chand siyah rang ke badal us ke sar par mandla rahe hain, un mein se ek ghaibi sada aayi ke in mein se jo tujhe pasand ho qabool kar le. Us ne sakht siyah badal ko ikhtiyar kiya, isi waqt dusri aawaz aayi ke le le khaak raakh jo Aadiyon mein se ek ko bhi na chhore. Aadiyon par hawa ke khazane mein se sirf ba-qadr angoothi ke halqe ke hawa chhori gayi thi jis ne sab ko gharat aur teh-o-bala kar diya. Abu Wail kehte hain, yeh waqea saare Arab mein zarb-ul-misl ho gaya tha jab log kisi ko bator wafd ke bhejte the toh keh diya karte the ke Aadiyon ke wafd ki tarah na ho jana. Isi tarah Musnad-e-Ahmed mein bhi yeh riwayat maujood hai, Sunan ki aur kitabon mein bhi yeh waqea maujood hai. Wallahu A'lam.
