Mahine bhar ke baad Mahra ke pahadon par gaya aur Allah se dua maangne laga ke Bari Ta'ala main kisi bimar ki dawa ke liye ya kisi qaidi ke fidiye ke liye nahin aaya, ya Allah Aadiyon ko toh woh pila jo pilaya karta tha, itne mein woh dekhta hai ke chand siyah rang ke badal us ke sar par mandla rahe hain, un mein se ek ghaibi sada aayi ke in mein se jo tujhe pasand ho qabool kar le. Us ne sakht siyah badal ko ikhtiyar kiya, isi waqt dusri aawaz aayi ke le le khaak raakh jo Aadiyon mein se ek ko bhi na chhore. Aadiyon par hawa ke khazane mein se sirf ba-qadr angoothi ke halqe ke hawa chhori gayi thi jis ne sab ko gharat aur teh-o-bala kar diya. Abu Wail kehte hain, yeh waqea saare Arab mein zarb-ul-misl ho gaya tha jab log kisi ko bator wafd ke bhejte the toh keh diya karte the ke Aadiyon ke wafd ki tarah na ho jana. Isi tarah Musnad-e-Ahmed mein bhi yeh riwayat maujood hai, Sunan ki aur kitabon mein bhi yeh waqea maujood hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Qaum-e-Aad ka baghiyana rawayya. Qaum-e-Aad ki sarkashi, takabbur, zid aur inaad ka bayan ho raha hai ke unhon ne Hazrat Hud (A.S) se kaha ke kya aap ki tashreef-awari ka maqsad yehi hai ke hum Allah-e-Wahid ke parastar ban jayen aur baap dadon ke purane maboodon se rogardani kar len? Suno agar yehi maqsood hai to iska poora hona muhaal hai. Hum tayyar hain agar tum sachay ho to apne Allah se hamare liye azab talab karo. Yehi kuffar-e-Makkah ne kaha tha, kehne lage ke ya Allah Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka kaha haq hai aur woh waqai tera kalam hai aur hum nahin maante to tu hum par aasman se patthar barsa ya koi aur sakht alamnak azab humein kar. Qaum-e-Aad ke buton ke naam ye hain: Samad, Samoodha. Un ki is dhitai ke muqablay mein Allah ka azab aur us ka ghazab sabit ho gaya. Rijs se murad rijs yani azab hai, narazgi aur gussay ke ma'ani yehi hain. Phir farmaya ke tum in buton ki babat mujh se jhagad rahe ho jin ke naam bhi tum ne khud rakhay hain ya tumhare badon ne, aur khwah-makhwah be-wajah unhein mabood samajh baithe ho, ye patthar ke tukray mehez be-zarar aur be-nafa hain. Na Allah ne in ki ibadat ki koi daleel utari hai. Haan agar tum muqablay par utar hi aaye ho to muntazir raho, main bhi muntazir hoon, abhi maloom ho jayega ke maqbool-e-bargah-e-Rabb kaun hai aur mardood-e-bargah kaun hai? Kaun mustahiq-e-azab hai aur kaun qabil-e-sawab hai? Aakhir hum ne apne Nabi ko aur un ke imandar sathiyon ko nijat di aur kafiron ki jarein kaat dein. Quran-e-Kareem ke kayi maqamat par Janab-e-Bari Azzawajal ne un ki tabahi ki soorat bayan farmayi hai ke un par khair se khali, tund aur tez hawayein bheji gayin jis ne unhein aur un ki tamam cheezon ko gharat aur barbad kar diya. Aad log baray zanatay ki sakht aandhi se halak kar diye gaye jo un par barabar saat raat aur aath din chalti rahi. Saaray ke saaray is tarah ho gaye jaise khajoor ke darakhton ke tanay alag hon aur shakhain alag hon. Dekh le in mein se ek bhi ab nazar aa raha hai? Un ki sarkashi ki saza mein sarkash hawa un par musallat kar di gayi jo un mein se ek ek ko utha kar aasman ki bulandi ki taraf le jati aur wahan se girati jis se sar alag ho jata, dhar alag gir jata. Ye log Yaman ke mulk mein, Oman aur Hadhramaut mein rehte thay, idhar udhar nikalte aur logon ko maar peet ki jabran-o-qahran un ke mulk-o-maal par ghasibana qabza kar lete. Saaray ke saaray but parast thay. Hazrat Hud (A.S) jo un ke shareef khandani shakhs thay un ke paas Rabb ki risalat le kar aaye, Allah ki tauheed ka hukum diya, shirk se roka, logon par zulm karne ki burai samjhai lekin unhon ne is nasihat ko qabool na kiya. Muqablay par tan gaye aur apni quwwat se haq ko dabane lage. Go baaz log iman laye thay lekin woh bhi bechare jaan ke khauf se posheeda rakhay hue thay. Baqi log badastoor apni be-imani aur na-insafi par jamay rahe, khwah-makhwah fauqiyat zahir karne lage, bekar imaratain banate aur phoolay na samate.

In sab kamon ko Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) napasand farmate, unhein rokte, taqwe ki, ita'at ki hidayat karte lekin yeh kabhi toh unhein bedaleel batate, kabhi unhein majnoon kehte. Aap (ﷺ) apni barat zahir karte aur un se saaf farmate ke mujhe tumhari quwwat-o-taqat ka mutlaqan khauf nahin, jao tum se jo ho sake kar lo. Mera bharosa Allah par hai. Us ke siwa na koi bharose ke laiq na ibadat ke qabil, sari makhlooq us ke samne aajiz, past aur lachar hai. Sachi rah Allah ki rah hai. Aakhir jab yeh apni buraiyon se baaz na aaye toh un par barish na barsayi gayi, teen saal tak qahat-sali rahi. Aajiz ho gaye, tang aa gaye, aakhir yeh socha ke chand admiyon ko Baitullah Sharif bhejein, woh wahan ja kar Allah se duayein karein. Yehi un ka dastoor tha ke jab kisi museebat mein phans jate toh wahan wafd bhejte. Us waqt un ka qabeela Amaliq Haram Sharif mein bhi rehta tha, yeh log Amliq bin Adam bin Sam bin Nuh ki nasl mein se thay. Un ka sardar us zamane mein Mu'awiyah bin Bakr tha. Us ki maa qoum-e-Aad se thi jis ka naam Jahida bint-e-Khabiri tha. Aadiyon ne apne yahan se sattar shakhson ko muntakhab kar ke bator-e-wafd Makkah Sharif ko rawana kiya. Yahan aa kar yeh Mu'awiyah ke mehman bane. Pur-takalluf dawat-o-ke udane, sharab khori karne aur Mu'awiyah ki do laundiyon ka gana sunne mein is be-khudi se mashghool ho gaye ke kamil ek mahina guzar gaya. Unhein apne kaam ki taraf mutlaq tawajjah na hui. Mu'awiyah un ki yeh raush dekh kar aur apni qoum ki buri halat samne rakh kar bahut karhta tha lekin yeh mehman nawazi ke khilaf tha ke khud un se kehta ke jao. Is liye us ne kuch ashaar likhe aur un hi dono kaneezon ko yaad karaye ke woh yehi ga kar unhein sunayein. In sher-on ka mazmoon yeh tha ke ae logo jo qoum ki taraf se Allah se duayein karne ke liye bheje gaye ho ke Allah Aadiyon par barish barsaye jo aaj qahat-sali ki wajah se tabah ho gaye hain, bhooke pyase mar rahe hain, budhe, bache, mard, aurtein tabah-haal phir rahe hain, yahan tak ke bolna chalna un par dushwar ho gaya hai. Jungli janwar un ki abadiyon mein phir rahe hain kyunke kisi aadmi mein itni quwwat kahan ke woh teer chala sake. Lekin afsos ke tum yahan apne man-mane mashghalon mein munhamik ho gaye aur be-faida waqt zaya karne lage. Tum se zyada bura wafd duniya mein koi na hoga, yaad rakho agar ab bhi tum ne musta'idi se qaumi khidmat na ki toh tum barbad aur gharat ho jaoge. Yeh sun kar un ke kaan khade hue, yeh Haram mein gaye aur duayein mangna shuru keen. Allah Ta'ala ne teen badal un ke samne pesh kiye, ek safed, ek siyah, ek surkh aur ek aawaz aayi ke in mein se ek ikhtiyar kar lo. Us ne siyah badal pasand kiya, aawaz aayi ke tu ne siyah pasand kiya jo Aadiyon mein se kisi ko bhi na chhore ga, na baap ko na bete ko, sab ko gharat kar de ga siwaye Banu Lawiziyah ke. Yeh Banu Lawiziyah bhi Aadiyon ka ek qabeela tha jo Makkah mein muqeem thay, un par woh azab nahin aaye thay, yehi baqi rahe aur inhi mein se Aad-e-Ukhra hue.

Is wafd ke sardar ne siyah badal pasand kiya tha jo usi waqt Aadiyon ki taraf chala. Is shakhs ka naam Qail bin Ghaz tha. Jab yeh badal Aadiyon ke maidan mein pahuncha jis ka naam Mughis tha to use dekh woh log khushiyan manane lage ke is abr se pani zaroor barse ga halankeh yeh woh tha jis ki yeh log Nabi ke muqable mein jaldi macha rahe the jis mein almnak azab tha jo tamam cheezon ko fana kar dene wala tha. Sab se pehle is azab-e-Ilahi ko ek aurat ne dekha jis ka naam Mumaid tha yeh cheekh maar kar behosh ho gayi. Jab hosh aayi to logon ne us se poocha ke tu ne kya dekha? Us ne kaha aag ka bagola jo ba-surat-e-hawa tha jise farishte ghasite liye chale aate the. Barabar saat raatein aur aath din tak yeh aag wali hawa un par chalti rahi aur azab ka badal un par barasta raha. Tamam Aadiyon ka satyanas ho gaya. Hazrat Hud (A.S) aur aap ke momin sathi ek bagheeche mein chale gaye wahan Allah ne unhein mehfooz rakha wahi hawa thandi aur bhini bhini ho kar un ke jismon ko lagti rahi jis se rooh ko tazgi aur aankhon ko thandak pahunchti rahi. Haan Aadiyon par is hawa ne sangbari shuru kar di, un ke dimagh phat gaye. Aakhir unhein utha utha kar de patkha sar alag ho gaye dhad alag ja pade yeh hawa sawar ko sawari samet idhar utha leti thi aur bahut oonche le ja kar use ondha de patakhti thi. Yeh siyaq bahut ghareeb hai aur is mein bahut se fawaid hain. Azab-e-Ilahi ke aa jane se Hazrat Hud (A.S) ko aur mominon ko nijat mil gayi rahmat-e-Haq un ke shamil-e-haal rahi aur baqi kuffar is badtareen saza mein giraftar huye. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Haris Bakri (R.A) farmate hain main apne haan se Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein Ala bin Hazrami ki shikayat le kar chala jab main Rabzah mein pahuncha to Banu Tamim ki ek budhiya lachar ho kar baithi hui mili. Mujh se kehne lagi ae Allah ke bande mujhe Sarkar-e-Risalat Ma'ab mein pahunchna hai. Kya tu mere sath itna sulook kare ga ke mujhe darbar-e-Risalat mein pahuncha de? Main ne kaha aao chunancha main ne use apne oont par bitha liya aur Madine pahuncha dekha ke masjid logon se bhari hui hai siyah jhande lehra rahe hain aur Hazrat Bilal (R.A) An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne talwar latkaye khade hain main ne poocha kya baat hai? Logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Hazrat Amr bin Aas (R.A) ki mat-huti mein kahin lashkar bhejne wale hain. Main thori der baitha raha itne mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni manzil mein tashreef le gaye. Main aap ke peeche hi gaya. Ijazat talab ki ijazat mili jab main ne andar ja kar salam kiya to aap ne mujh se daryaft farmaya kya tum mein aur Banu Tamim mein kuch chashmak hai? Main ne kaha Huzoor is ke zimmedar wahi hain. Main ab hazir-e-khidmat ho raha tha to raste mein qabila Tamim ki ek budhiya aurat mil gayi jis ke paas sawari waghera na thi us ne mujh se darkhwast ki aur main use apni sawari par bitha kar yahan laya hoon woh darwaze par baithi hui hai. Aap ne use bhi andar aane ki ijazat di. Main ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum mein aur Banu Tamim mein koi rok kar dijiye.

Is par burhiya tez ho kar boli agar aap ne aisa kar diya toh phir aap ke yahan ke bebas kahan panah lenge? Main ne kaha SubhanAllah! Teri aur meri toh wahi misl hui ke bakri apni maut ko aap utha kar le gayi, main ne hi tujhe yahan pahunchaya, mujhe is ke anjam ki kya khabar thi? Allah na kare ke main bhi Aadi qabile ke wafd ki tarah ho jaaun. Toh Huzoor (ﷺ) ne mujh se daryaft farmaya ke bhai Aadiyon ke wafd ka qissa kya hai? Bawajood yeh ke aap ko mujh se zyada is ka ilm tha lekin yeh samajh kar ke is waqt aap baatein karna chahte hain, main ne qissa shuru kar diya ke Huzoor (ﷺ) jis waqt Aadiyon mein qahat-sali namudar hui toh unhon ne Qail naam-e-ek shakhs ko bator apne qasid ke Baitullah Sharif dua waghera karne ke liye bheja. Yeh Muawiyah bin Bakr ke yahan aa kar mehman bana. Yahan sharab-o-kabab aur raag-rang mein aisa mashghool hua ke mahine bhar tak jaam lundhata raha aur Muawiyah ki do laundiyon ke gaane sunta raha un ka naam Jarada tha. Mahine bhar ke baad Mahra ke pahadon par gaya aur Allah se dua maangne laga ke Bari Ta'ala main kisi bimar ki dawa ke liye ya kisi qaidi ke fidiye ke liye nahin aaya, ya Allah Aadiyon ko toh woh pila jo pilaya karta tha, itne mein woh dekhta hai ke chand siyah rang ke badal us ke sar par mandla rahe hain, un mein se ek ghaibi sada aayi ke in mein se jo tujhe pasand ho qabool kar le. Us ne sakht siyah badal ko ikhtiyar kiya, isi waqt dusri aawaz aayi ke le le khaak raakh jo Aadiyon mein se ek ko bhi na chhore. Aadiyon par hawa ke khazane mein se sirf ba-qadr angoothi ke halqe ke hawa chhori gayi thi jis ne sab ko gharat aur teh-o-bala kar diya. Abu Wail kehte hain, yeh waqea saare Arab mein zarb-ul-misl ho gaya tha jab log kisi ko bator wafd ke bhejte the toh keh diya karte the ke Aadiyon ke wafd ki tarah na ho jana. Isi tarah Musnad-e-Ahmed mein bhi yeh riwayat maujood hai, Sunan ki aur kitabon mein bhi yeh waqea maujood hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Thamud ki qoum aur uska ibrat-naak anjam ulama-e-nasab ne bayan kiya hai ke Thamud bin Aamir bin Iram bin Saam bin Nooh. Yeh bhai tha Jad-e-Bas bin Aamir ka. Isi tarah qabeela Tasm yeh sab khalis Arab thay. Hazrat Ibrahim Khalilullah (A.S) se pehle Thamudi Aadiyon ke baad hue hain unke shehar Hijaz aur Shaam ke darmiyan Wadi-ul-Qura aur uske gird-o-nawah mein mashhoor hain. Sanah 9 Hijri mein Tabook jaate hue Rasool Allah (ﷺ) unki ujaar bastiyon mein se guzray thay. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke jab Huzoor (ﷺ) Tabook ke maidan mein utray logon ne Thamudiyon ke gharon ke paas deray daalay aur inhi ke kunwon ke paani se aatay goondhay handiyan charhayin toh Aap (ﷺ) ne hukum diya ke sab handiyan ulat di jayen aur gundhay hue aatay oonton ko khila diye jayen. Phir farmaya yahan se kooch karo aur us kunway ke paas thehro jis se Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ki oontni paani peeti thi aur farmaya aayinda azaab wali bastiyon mein parao na kiya karo. Kahin aisa na ho ke isi azaab ke shikaar tum bhi ban jao. Ek riwayat mein hai ke unki bastiyon se rotay aur dartay hue guzro ke mabada wahi azaab tum par aa jayen jo un par aaye thay. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Ghazwa-e-Tabook mein log ba-ujlat Hijr ke logon ke gharon ki taraf lapkay. Aap (ﷺ) ne usi waqt yeh aawaz buland karne kaha hadees (As-Salatu Jami'ah) jab log jama ho gaye toh Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya ke in logon ke gharon mein kyun ghusay ja rahe ho jin par ghazab-e-Ilahi nazil hua. Rawi-e-hadees Abu Kabsha farmatay hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke haath mein ek neza tha. Main ne yeh sun kar arz ki ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) hum toh sirf ta'ajjub ke tor par unhein dekhne chale gaye thay Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya main tumhein is se bhi ta'ajjub khaiz cheez bata raha hoon tum mein se hi ek shakhs hai jo tumhein woh cheez bata raha hai jo guzar chukin aur woh khabrein de raha hai jo tumhare samne hain aur jo tumhare baad hone wali hain pas tum theek thaak raho aur seedhay chale jao tumhein azaab karte hue bhi Allah Ta'ala ko koi parwah nahin yaad rakho aisay log aayenge jo apni jaanon se kisi cheez ko dafa na kar sakenge. Hazrat Abu Kabsha ka naam Umar bin Sa'ad hai aur kaha gaya hai ke Aamir bin Sa'ad hai Wallahu A'alam. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Hijr ki basti ke paas aatay hi Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya mojzay na talab karo dekho Qoum-e-Saleh ne mojza talab kiya jo zahir hua yani oontni jo is raastay se aati thi aur is raastay se jaati thi lekin un logon ne apne Rabb ke hukum se sartabi ki aur oontni ki kochein kaat dein ek din oontni unka paani peeti thi aur ek din yeh sab uska doodh peetay thay us oontni ko maar daalne par un par ek cheekh aayi aur yeh jitnay bhi thay sab ke sab dher ho gaye. Bajuz us ek shakhs ke jo Haram Shareef mein tha logon ne poocha uska naam kya tha? Farmaya Abu Ghal yeh bhi jab hadd-e-Haram se bahar aaya toh usay bhi wahi azaab hua. Yeh hadees Sahah-e-Sitta mein toh nahin lekin hai Muslim Shareef ki shart par. Aayat ka matlab yeh hai ke Thamudi qabeelay ki taraf se unke bhai Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ko Nabi bana kar bheja gaya.

Tamam nabiyon ki tarah aap ne bhi apni ummat ko sab se pehle Tauheed-e-Ilahi sikhayi ke faqat us ki ibadat karein us ke siwa aur koi laiq-e-ibadat nahin. Allah ka farman hai jitne bhi Rasool aaye sab ki taraf yahi wahi ki jati rahi ke mere siwa koi mabood nahin, sirf meri hi ibadat karo aur irshad hai hum ne har ummat mein Rasool bheje ke Allah hi ki ibadat karo aur us ke siwa auron ki ibadat se bacho. Hazrat Saleh (A.S) farmate hain logon tumhare paas daleel-e-Ilahi aa chuki jis mein meri sachayi zahir hai. In logon ne Hazrat Saleh (A.S) se yeh mojiza talab kiya tha ke ek sanglakh chattan jo un ki basti ke ek kinare padi thi jis ka naam Katiba tha us se aap ek oontni nikalein jo gabhan ho (doodh dene wali oontni jo das mah ki hamila ho). Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ne un se farmaya ke agar aisa ho jaye to tum iman qabool kar loge? Unhon ne pukhta wade kiye aur mazboot ahd-o-paiman kiye. Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ne namaz padhi dua ki un sab ke dekhte hi chattan ne hilna shuru kiya aur chatakh gayi us ke beech se ek oontni namudar hui. Use dekhte hi un ke sardar Junda bin Amr ne to Islam qabool kar liya aur us ke sathiyon ne bhi. Baqi jo aur sardar the woh iman lane ke liye tayyar the magar Zawab bin Amr bin Labeed ne aur Hubab ne jo buton ka mujawar tha aur Rabab bin Hamar bin Jalmas waghera ne unhein rok diya. Hazrat Junda ka bhatija Shahab nami tha yeh Thamudiyon ka bada aalim fazil aur shareef shakhs tha us ne bhi iman lane ka irada kar liya tha lekin inhi badbakhton ne use bhi roka jis par ek momin Thamudi Mahwash bin Ghunma ne kaha ke Aal-e-Amr ne Shahab ko deen-e-haq ki dawat di qareeb tha ke woh musharraf ba-Islam ho jaye aur agar ho jata to us ki izzat siwa ho jati magar badbakhton ne use rok diya aur neki se hata kar badi par laga diya. Is hamila oontni ko us waqt bacha hua ek muddat tak dono in mein rahe. Ek din oontni un ka pani peeti. Us din us qadar doodh deti ke yeh log apne sab bartan bhar lete jaise Quran mein hai aayat (وَنَبِّئْهُمْ اَنَّ الْمَاۗءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ 28؀) (Surah Al-Qamar: 28), aur aayat mein hai (قَالَ هٰذِهٖ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَّلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُوْمٍ 155؀) (Surah Ash-Shu'ara: 155) yeh hai oontni us ke aur tumhare pani peene ke din taqseem shuda aur muqarrara hain. Yeh oontni Thamudiyon ki basti Hijr ke ird-gird charti chugti thi ek rah jati dusri rah aati yeh bohat hi moti tazi aur haibat wali oontni thi jis rah se guzarti sab janwar idhar udhar ho jate. Kuch zamana guzarne ke baad in aubashon ne irada kiya ke is ko maar dalein taake har din un ke janwar barabar pani pee sakein in aubashon ke iradon par sab ne ittefaq kiya yahan tak ke aurton aur bachon ne bhi un ki haan mein haan milayi aur unhein sheh di ke haan is paap ko kaat do. Is oontni ko maar dalo.

Chunancha Quran-e-Kareem mein hai aayat (فَكَذَّبُوْهُ فَعَقَرُوْهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ بِذَنْۢبِهِمْ فَسَوّٰىهَا) (Surah Ash-Shams: 14), Qaum-e-Saleh ne apne Nabi ko jhutlaya aur oontni ki kochein kaat kar use maar dala toh un ke Parwardigar ne un ke gunahon ke badle un par halakat nazil farmayi aur un sab ko yaksan kar diya. Ek aur aayat mein hai ke hum ne Thamudiyon ko oontni di jo un ke liye poori samajh boojh ki cheez thi lekin unhon ne is par zulm kiya, yahan bhi farmaya ke unhon ne is oontni ko maar dala. Pas is fe'l ki isnaad saare hi qabeele ki taraf hai jis se saaf zahir hai ke chhote bade sab is amr par muttafiq thay. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir waghera ka farman hai ke is ke qatl ki wajah yeh hui ke Unaiza bint-e-Ghanam bin Mujliz jo ek budhiya kafira thi aur Hazrat Saleh (A.S) se badi dushmani rakhti thi, us ki ladkiyan bahut khubsurat thin aur thi bhi yeh aurat maaldar. Is ke khawand ka naam Zawab bin Amr tha jo Thamudiyon ka ek sardar tha yeh bhi kafir tha. Isi tarah ek aur aurat thi jis ka naam Sadaqa bint-e-Muhayya bin Zuhair bin Mukhtar tha. Yeh bhi husn ke alawa maal aur hasab-nasab mein badhi hui thi, is ke khawand musalman ho gaye thay (R.A). Is sarkash aurat ne un ko chhod diya. Ab yeh dono auratein logon ko uksati thin ke koi aamada ho jaye aur Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ki oontni ko qatl kar de. Sadaqa nami aurat ne ek shakhs Hubab ko bulaya aur us se kaha ke main tere ghar aa jaungi agar tu is oontni ko qatl kar de lekin us ne inkar kar diya, is par us ne Musadda bin Muhraj bin Muhayya ko bulaya jo us ke chacha ka ladka tha aur use bhi isi baat par aamada kiya. Yeh khabeeth us ke husn-o-jamal ka maftoon tha, is burai par aamada ho gaya. Idhar Unaiza ne Qudar bin Salif bin Jaz'a ko bula kar us se kaha ke meri in khubsurat naujawan ladkiyon mein se jise tu pasand kare use main tujhe de doon gi isi shart par ke tu is oontni ki kochein kaat daal. Yeh khabeeth bhi aamada ho gaya, yeh tha bhi zina-kari ka bacha, Salif ki aulad mein na tha, Jaisan nami ek shakhs se is ki badkar maa ne zina-kari ki thi isi se yeh paida hua tha. Ab dono chale aur Ahl-e-Thamud aur dusre shareeron ko bhi is par aamada kiya, chunancha saat shakhs aur bhi is par aamada ho gaye aur yeh nau (9) fasadi shakhs is bad-irade par tul gaye jaise Quran-e-Kareem mein hai aayat (وَكَانَ فِي الْمَدِيْنَةِ تِسْعَةُ رَهْطٍ يُّفْسِدُوْنَ فِي الْاَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُوْنَ) (Surah An-Naml: 48), is shehar mein nau shakhs thay jin mein islah ka madda hi na tha, sarasar fasadi hi thay. Chunke yeh log qaum ke sardar thay un ke kehne sunne se tamam kuffar bhi is par raazi ho gaye aur oontni ke wapas aane ka raste mein yeh dono shareer apni apni kamin-gahon mein baith gaye, jab oontni nikli toh pehle Musadda ne use teer mara jo us ki raan ki haddi mein paiwast ho gaya, isi waqt Unaiza ne apni khubsurat ladki ko khule munh Qudar ke paas bheja, us ne kaha Qudar kya dekhte ho utho aur is ka kaam tamam kar do.

Yeh us ka munh dekhte hi daura aur us ke dono pichle paon kaat diye. Oontni chakra kar giri aur ek aawaz nikali jis se us ka bacha hoshiyar ho gaya aur us raaste ko chhor kar pahari par chala gaya. Yahan Qudar ne oontni ka gala kaat diya aur woh mar gayi. Us ka bacha pahar ki choti par charh gaya aur teen martaba bilbilaya. Hasan Basri R.H farmate hain us ne Allah ke samne apni maa ke qatl ki faryad ki, phir jis chattan se nikla tha usi mein sama gaya. Yeh riwayat bhi hai ke use bhi us ki maa ke sath hi zibah kar diya gaya tha. Wallahu A'lam.

Hazrat Saleh A.S ko jab yeh khabar pahunchi to aap ghabraye hue mauqe par pahunche, dekha ke oontni be-jaan pari hai. Aap ki aankhon se aansu nikal aaye aur farmaya bas ab teen din mein tum halak kar diye jaoge, hua bhi yahi. Budh ke din un logon ne oontni ko qatl kiya tha aur chunke koi azab na aaya is liye itra gaye aur un mufsidon ne irada kar liya ke aaj shaam ko Saleh ko bhi maar daalo. Agar waqai hum halak hone wale hi hain to phir yeh kyun bacha rahe? Aur agar hum par azab nahin aata to bhi aao roz-roz ke is jhanjhat se paak ho jayen. Chunancha Quran-e-Kareem ka bayan hai ke un logon ne mil kar mashwara kiya aur phir qasmein kha kar iqrar kiya ke raat ko Saleh ke ghar par chapa maaro aur use aur us ke gharane ko teh-e-tegh karo aur saaf inkaar kar do ke hamein kya khabar ke kis ne maara? Allah Ta'ala farmate hain un ke is makr ke muqabil hum ne bhi makr kiya aur yeh hamare makr se bilkul be-khabar rahe. Ab anjam dekh lo ke kya hua? Raat ko yeh apni bad-niyati se Hazrat Saleh A.S ke ghar ki taraf chale, aap ka ghar pahari ki bulandi par tha, abhi yeh oopar charh hi rahe the jo oopar se ek chattan patthar ki lurhakti hui aayi aur sab ko hi pees dala.

Un ka to yeh hashr hua, udhar jumerat ke din tamam Thamudiyon ke chehre zard par gaye, jumma ke din un ke chehre aag jaise surkh ho gaye aur hafte ke din jo muhlat ka aakhri din tha un ke munh siyah ho gaye. Teen din jab guzar gaye to chautha din itwar subh hi subh suraj ke roshan hote hi oopar aasman se sakht karaka hua jis ki holnaak dehshat-angez chinghaar ne un ke kaleje phaad diye, sath hi neeche se zabardast zalzala aaya. Ek hi sa'at mein ek sath hi un sab ka dher ho gaya, murdon se makanat, bazaar, gali, koche bhar gaye. Mard, aurat, bache, burhe awwal se aakhir tak saare ke saare tabah ho gaye. Shaan-e-Rabb dekhiye ke is waqiye ki khabar duniya ko pahunchane ke liye ek kafira aurat bacha di gayi, yeh bhi bari khabeesa thi, Hazrat Saleh A.S ki adawat ki aag se bhari hui thi, us ki dono taangein nahin thin lekin udhar azab aaya udhar us ke paon khul gaye, apni basti se sarpat bhagi aur tez daurti hui dusre shehar mein pahunchi aur wahan ja kar un sab ke samne sara waqiya bayan kar hi chukne ke baad un se paani manga. Abhi poori pyaas bhi na bujhi thi ke azab-e-Ilahi aa para aur wahin dher ho kar reh gayi.

Haan Abu Righal nami ek shakhs aur bach gaya tha yeh yahan na tha, Haram ki pak zameen mein tha lekin kuch dinon ke baad jab yeh apne kisi kaam ki gharz se hadd-e-Haram se bahar aaya usi waqt aasman se patthar aaya aur ise bhi Jahannam wasil kiya. Samudiyon mein se siwaye Hazrat Saleh (A.S) aur unke momin sahaba ke aur koi bhi na bacha, Abu Righal ka waqia is se pehle hadith se bayan ho chuka hai. Qabila-e-Saqif jo Taif mein hai mazkoor hai ke yeh usi ki nasl se hain. Abdur Razzaq mein hai ke is ki qabr ke paas se Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ) jab guzre to farmaya jante ho yeh kis ki qabr hai? Logon ne jawab diya ke Allah aur us ke Rasool ko zyada ilm hai. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya yeh Abu Righal ki qabr hai. Yeh ek Samudi shakhs tha, apni qoum ke azab ke waqt yeh Haram mein tha is wajah se azab-e-Ilahi se bach raha lekin Haram-e-Sharif se nikla to usi waqt apni qoum ke azab se yeh bhi halak hua aur yahin dafan kiya gaya aur is ke sath is ki sone ki lakdi bhi dafan kar di gayi. Chunancha logon ne is gaddhe ko khod kar is mein se woh lakdi nikal li aur hadith mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya tha Saqif qabila isi ki aulad hai. Ek mursal hadith mein bhi yeh zikr majood hai, yeh bhi hai ke Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya tha is ke sath sone ki shakh dafan kar di gayi thi yahi nishan is ki qabr ka hai agar tum ise khodo to woh shakh zaroor nikal aayegi chunancha baaz logon ne ise khoda aur woh shakh nikal li. Abu Dawood mein bhi yeh riwayat hai aur hasan aziz hai lekin main kehta hoon is hadith ke wasl ka sirf ek tariqa Buheir bin Abi Buheir ka hai aur yeh sirf isi hadith ke sath maroof hai aur baqol Hazrat Imam Yahya bin Ma'een siwaye Ismail bin Abi Umayyah ke ise is se aur kisi ne riwayat nahin kiya. Ehtemal hai ke kahin is hadith ke marfoo karne mein khata na ho, yeh Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) hi ka qaul ho aur phir is surat mein yeh bhi mumkinat se hai ke unhon ne ise un do daftaron se le liya ho jo unhein jang-e-Yarmouk mein mile the. Mere ustad Sheikh Abu Al-Hajjaj is riwayat ko pehle to hasan aziz kehte the lekin jab main ne un ke samne yeh hujjat pesh ki to Aap (R.H) ne farmaya beshak in umoor ka is mein ehtemal hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Thamud ki qoum aur uska ibrat-naak anjam ulama-e-nasab ne bayan kiya hai ke Thamud bin Aamir bin Iram bin Saam bin Nooh. Yeh bhai tha Jad-e-Bas bin Aamir ka. Isi tarah qabeela Tasm yeh sab khalis Arab thay. Hazrat Ibrahim Khalilullah (A.S) se pehle Thamudi Aadiyon ke baad hue hain unke shehar Hijaz aur Shaam ke darmiyan Wadi-ul-Qura aur uske gird-o-nawah mein mashhoor hain. Sanah 9 Hijri mein Tabook jaate hue Rasool Allah (ﷺ) unki ujaar bastiyon mein se guzray thay. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke jab Huzoor (ﷺ) Tabook ke maidan mein utray logon ne Thamudiyon ke gharon ke paas deray daalay aur inhi ke kunwon ke paani se aatay goondhay handiyan charhayin toh Aap (ﷺ) ne hukum diya ke sab handiyan ulat di jayen aur gundhay hue aatay oonton ko khila diye jayen. Phir farmaya yahan se kooch karo aur us kunway ke paas thehro jis se Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ki oontni paani peeti thi aur farmaya aayinda azaab wali bastiyon mein parao na kiya karo. Kahin aisa na ho ke isi azaab ke shikaar tum bhi ban jao. Ek riwayat mein hai ke unki bastiyon se rotay aur dartay hue guzro ke mabada wahi azaab tum par aa jayen jo un par aaye thay. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Ghazwa-e-Tabook mein log ba-ujlat Hijr ke logon ke gharon ki taraf lapkay. Aap (ﷺ) ne usi waqt yeh aawaz buland karne kaha hadees (As-Salatu Jami'ah) jab log jama ho gaye toh Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya ke in logon ke gharon mein kyun ghusay ja rahe ho jin par ghazab-e-Ilahi nazil hua. Rawi-e-hadees Abu Kabsha farmatay hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke haath mein ek neza tha. Main ne yeh sun kar arz ki ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) hum toh sirf ta'ajjub ke tor par unhein dekhne chale gaye thay Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya main tumhein is se bhi ta'ajjub khaiz cheez bata raha hoon tum mein se hi ek shakhs hai jo tumhein woh cheez bata raha hai jo guzar chukin aur woh khabrein de raha hai jo tumhare samne hain aur jo tumhare baad hone wali hain pas tum theek thaak raho aur seedhay chale jao tumhein azaab karte hue bhi Allah Ta'ala ko koi parwah nahin yaad rakho aisay log aayenge jo apni jaanon se kisi cheez ko dafa na kar sakenge. Hazrat Abu Kabsha ka naam Umar bin Sa'ad hai aur kaha gaya hai ke Aamir bin Sa'ad hai Wallahu A'alam. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Hijr ki basti ke paas aatay hi Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya mojzay na talab karo dekho Qoum-e-Saleh ne mojza talab kiya jo zahir hua yani oontni jo is raastay se aati thi aur is raastay se jaati thi lekin un logon ne apne Rabb ke hukum se sartabi ki aur oontni ki kochein kaat dein ek din oontni unka paani peeti thi aur ek din yeh sab uska doodh peetay thay us oontni ko maar daalne par un par ek cheekh aayi aur yeh jitnay bhi thay sab ke sab dher ho gaye. Bajuz us ek shakhs ke jo Haram Shareef mein tha logon ne poocha uska naam kya tha? Farmaya Abu Ghal yeh bhi jab hadd-e-Haram se bahar aaya toh usay bhi wahi azaab hua. Yeh hadees Sahah-e-Sitta mein toh nahin lekin hai Muslim Shareef ki shart par. Aayat ka matlab yeh hai ke Thamudi qabeelay ki taraf se unke bhai Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ko Nabi bana kar bheja gaya.

Tamam nabiyon ki tarah aap ne bhi apni ummat ko sab se pehle Tauheed-e-Ilahi sikhayi ke faqat us ki ibadat karein us ke siwa aur koi laiq-e-ibadat nahin. Allah ka farman hai jitne bhi Rasool aaye sab ki taraf yahi wahi ki jati rahi ke mere siwa koi mabood nahin, sirf meri hi ibadat karo aur irshad hai hum ne har ummat mein Rasool bheje ke Allah hi ki ibadat karo aur us ke siwa auron ki ibadat se bacho. Hazrat Saleh (A.S) farmate hain logon tumhare paas daleel-e-Ilahi aa chuki jis mein meri sachayi zahir hai. In logon ne Hazrat Saleh (A.S) se yeh mojiza talab kiya tha ke ek sanglakh chattan jo un ki basti ke ek kinare padi thi jis ka naam Katiba tha us se aap ek oontni nikalein jo gabhan ho (doodh dene wali oontni jo das mah ki hamila ho). Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ne un se farmaya ke agar aisa ho jaye to tum iman qabool kar loge? Unhon ne pukhta wade kiye aur mazboot ahd-o-paiman kiye. Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ne namaz padhi dua ki un sab ke dekhte hi chattan ne hilna shuru kiya aur chatakh gayi us ke beech se ek oontni namudar hui. Use dekhte hi un ke sardar Junda bin Amr ne to Islam qabool kar liya aur us ke sathiyon ne bhi. Baqi jo aur sardar the woh iman lane ke liye tayyar the magar Zawab bin Amr bin Labeed ne aur Hubab ne jo buton ka mujawar tha aur Rabab bin Hamar bin Jalmas waghera ne unhein rok diya. Hazrat Junda ka bhatija Shahab nami tha yeh Thamudiyon ka bada aalim fazil aur shareef shakhs tha us ne bhi iman lane ka irada kar liya tha lekin inhi badbakhton ne use bhi roka jis par ek momin Thamudi Mahwash bin Ghunma ne kaha ke Aal-e-Amr ne Shahab ko deen-e-haq ki dawat di qareeb tha ke woh musharraf ba-Islam ho jaye aur agar ho jata to us ki izzat siwa ho jati magar badbakhton ne use rok diya aur neki se hata kar badi par laga diya. Is hamila oontni ko us waqt bacha hua ek muddat tak dono in mein rahe. Ek din oontni un ka pani peeti. Us din us qadar doodh deti ke yeh log apne sab bartan bhar lete jaise Quran mein hai aayat (وَنَبِّئْهُمْ اَنَّ الْمَاۗءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ 28؀) (Surah Al-Qamar: 28), aur aayat mein hai (قَالَ هٰذِهٖ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَّلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُوْمٍ 155؀) (Surah Ash-Shu'ara: 155) yeh hai oontni us ke aur tumhare pani peene ke din taqseem shuda aur muqarrara hain. Yeh oontni Thamudiyon ki basti Hijr ke ird-gird charti chugti thi ek rah jati dusri rah aati yeh bohat hi moti tazi aur haibat wali oontni thi jis rah se guzarti sab janwar idhar udhar ho jate. Kuch zamana guzarne ke baad in aubashon ne irada kiya ke is ko maar dalein taake har din un ke janwar barabar pani pee sakein in aubashon ke iradon par sab ne ittefaq kiya yahan tak ke aurton aur bachon ne bhi un ki haan mein haan milayi aur unhein sheh di ke haan is paap ko kaat do. Is oontni ko maar dalo.

Chunancha Quran-e-Kareem mein hai aayat (فَكَذَّبُوْهُ فَعَقَرُوْهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ بِذَنْۢبِهِمْ فَسَوّٰىهَا) (Surah Ash-Shams: 14), Qaum-e-Saleh ne apne Nabi ko jhutlaya aur oontni ki kochein kaat kar use maar dala toh un ke Parwardigar ne un ke gunahon ke badle un par halakat nazil farmayi aur un sab ko yaksan kar diya. Ek aur aayat mein hai ke hum ne Thamudiyon ko oontni di jo un ke liye poori samajh boojh ki cheez thi lekin unhon ne is par zulm kiya, yahan bhi farmaya ke unhon ne is oontni ko maar dala. Pas is fe'l ki isnaad saare hi qabeele ki taraf hai jis se saaf zahir hai ke chhote bade sab is amr par muttafiq thay. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir waghera ka farman hai ke is ke qatl ki wajah yeh hui ke Unaiza bint-e-Ghanam bin Mujliz jo ek budhiya kafira thi aur Hazrat Saleh (A.S) se badi dushmani rakhti thi, us ki ladkiyan bahut khubsurat thin aur thi bhi yeh aurat maaldar. Is ke khawand ka naam Zawab bin Amr tha jo Thamudiyon ka ek sardar tha yeh bhi kafir tha. Isi tarah ek aur aurat thi jis ka naam Sadaqa bint-e-Muhayya bin Zuhair bin Mukhtar tha. Yeh bhi husn ke alawa maal aur hasab-nasab mein badhi hui thi, is ke khawand musalman ho gaye thay (R.A). Is sarkash aurat ne un ko chhod diya. Chunancha logon ne is gaddhe ko khod kar is mein se woh lakdi nikal li aur hadith mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya tha Saqif qabila isi ki aulad hai. Ek mursal hadith mein bhi yeh zikr majood hai, yeh bhi hai ke Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya tha is ke sath sone ki shakh dafan kar di gayi thi yahi nishan is ki qabr ka hai agar tum ise khodo to woh shakh zaroor nikal aayegi chunancha baaz logon ne ise khoda aur woh shakh nikal li. Abu Dawood mein bhi yeh riwayat hai aur hasan aziz hai lekin main kehta hoon is hadith ke wasl ka sirf ek tariqa Buheir bin Abi Buheir ka hai aur yeh sirf isi hadith ke sath maroof hai aur baqol Hazrat Imam Yahya bin Ma'een siwaye Ismail bin Abi Umayyah ke ise is se aur kisi ne riwayat nahin kiya. Ehtemal hai ke kahin is hadith ke marfoo karne mein khata na ho, yeh Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) hi ka qaul ho aur phir is surat mein yeh bhi mumkinat se hai ke unhon ne ise un do daftaron se le liya ho jo unhein jang-e-Yarmouk mein mile the. Mere ustad Sheikh Abu Al-Hajjaj is riwayat ko pehle to hasan aziz kehte the lekin jab main ne un ke samne yeh hujjat pesh ki to Aap (R.H) ne farmaya beshak in umoor ka is mein ehtemal hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Thamud ki qoum aur uska ibrat-naak anjam ulama-e-nasab ne bayan kiya hai ke Thamud bin Aamir bin Iram bin Saam bin Nooh. Yeh bhai tha Jad-e-Bas bin Aamir ka. Isi tarah qabeela Tasm yeh sab khalis Arab thay. Hazrat Ibrahim Khalilullah (A.S) se pehle Thamudi Aadiyon ke baad hue hain unke shehar Hijaz aur Shaam ke darmiyan Wadi-ul-Qura aur uske gird-o-nawah mein mashhoor hain. Sanah 9 Hijri mein Tabook jaate hue Rasool Allah (ﷺ) unki ujaar bastiyon mein se guzray thay. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke jab Huzoor (ﷺ) Tabook ke maidan mein utray logon ne Thamudiyon ke gharon ke paas deray daalay aur inhi ke kunwon ke paani se aatay goondhay handiyan charhayin toh Aap (ﷺ) ne hukum diya ke sab handiyan ulat di jayen aur gundhay hue aatay oonton ko khila diye jayen. Phir farmaya yahan se kooch karo aur us kunway ke paas thehro jis se Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ki oontni paani peeti thi aur farmaya aayinda azaab wali bastiyon mein parao na kiya karo. Kahin aisa na ho ke isi azaab ke shikaar tum bhi ban jao. Ek riwayat mein hai ke unki bastiyon se rotay aur dartay hue guzro ke mabada wahi azaab tum par aa jayen jo un par aaye thay. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Ghazwa-e-Tabook mein log ba-ujlat Hijr ke logon ke gharon ki taraf lapkay. Aap (ﷺ) ne usi waqt yeh aawaz buland karne kaha hadees (As-Salatu Jami'ah) jab log jama ho gaye toh Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya ke in logon ke gharon mein kyun ghusay ja rahe ho jin par ghazab-e-Ilahi nazil hua. Rawi-e-hadees Abu Kabsha farmatay hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke haath mein ek neza tha. Main ne yeh sun kar arz ki ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) hum toh sirf ta'ajjub ke tor par unhein dekhne chale gaye thay Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya main tumhein is se bhi ta'ajjub khaiz cheez bata raha hoon tum mein se hi ek shakhs hai jo tumhein woh cheez bata raha hai jo guzar chukin aur woh khabrein de raha hai jo tumhare samne hain aur jo tumhare baad hone wali hain pas tum theek thaak raho aur seedhay chale jao tumhein azaab karte hue bhi Allah Ta'ala ko koi parwah nahin yaad rakho aisay log aayenge jo apni jaanon se kisi cheez ko dafa na kar sakenge. Hazrat Abu Kabsha ka naam Umar bin Sa'ad hai aur kaha gaya hai ke Aamir bin Sa'ad hai Wallahu A'alam. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Hijr ki basti ke paas aatay hi Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya mojzay na talab karo dekho Qoum-e-Saleh ne mojza talab kiya jo zahir hua yani oontni jo is raastay se aati thi aur is raastay se jaati thi lekin un logon ne apne Rabb ke hukum se sartabi ki aur oontni ki kochein kaat dein ek din oontni unka paani peeti thi aur ek din yeh sab uska doodh peetay thay us oontni ko maar daalne par un par ek cheekh aayi aur yeh jitnay bhi thay sab ke sab dher ho gaye. Bajuz us ek shakhs ke jo Haram Shareef mein tha logon ne poocha uska naam kya tha? Farmaya Abu Ghal yeh bhi jab hadd-e-Haram se bahar aaya toh usay bhi wahi azaab hua. Yeh hadees Sahah-e-Sitta mein toh nahin lekin hai Muslim Shareef ki shart par. Aayat ka matlab yeh hai ke Thamudi qabeelay ki taraf se unke bhai Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ko Nabi bana kar bheja gaya.

Tamam nabiyon ki tarah aap ne bhi apni ummat ko sab se pehle Tauheed-e-Ilahi sikhayi ke faqat us ki ibadat karein us ke siwa aur koi laiq-e-ibadat nahin. Allah ka farman hai jitne bhi Rasool aaye sab ki taraf yahi wahi ki jati rahi ke mere siwa koi mabood nahin, sirf meri hi ibadat karo aur irshad hai hum ne har ummat mein Rasool bheje ke Allah hi ki ibadat karo aur us ke siwa auron ki ibadat se bacho. Hazrat Saleh (A.S) farmate hain logon tumhare paas daleel-e-Ilahi aa chuki jis mein meri sachayi zahir hai. In logon ne Hazrat Saleh (A.S) se yeh mojiza talab kiya tha ke ek sanglakh chattan jo un ki basti ke ek kinare padi thi jis ka naam Katiba tha us se aap ek oontni nikalein jo gabhan ho (doodh dene wali oontni jo das mah ki hamila ho). Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ne un se farmaya ke agar aisa ho jaye to tum iman qabool kar loge? Unhon ne pukhta wade kiye aur mazboot ahd-o-paiman kiye. Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ne namaz padhi dua ki un sab ke dekhte hi chattan ne hilna shuru kiya aur chatakh gayi us ke beech se ek oontni namudar hui. Use dekhte hi un ke sardar Junda bin Amr ne to Islam qabool kar liya aur us ke sathiyon ne bhi. Baqi jo aur sardar the woh iman lane ke liye tayyar the magar Zawab bin Amr bin Labeed ne aur Hubab ne jo buton ka mujawar tha aur Rabab bin Hamar bin Jalmas waghera ne unhein rok diya. Hazrat Junda ka bhatija Shahab nami tha yeh Thamudiyon ka bada aalim fazil aur shareef shakhs tha us ne bhi iman lane ka irada kar liya tha lekin inhi badbakhton ne use bhi roka jis par ek momin Thamudi Mahwash bin Ghunma ne kaha ke Aal-e-Amr ne Shahab ko deen-e-haq ki dawat di qareeb tha ke woh musharraf ba-Islam ho jaye aur agar ho jata to us ki izzat siwa ho jati magar badbakhton ne use rok diya aur neki se hata kar badi par laga diya. Is hamila oontni ko us waqt bacha hua ek muddat tak dono in mein rahe. Ek din oontni un ka pani peeti. Us din us qadar doodh deti ke yeh log apne sab bartan bhar lete jaise Quran mein hai aayat (وَنَبِّئْهُمْ اَنَّ الْمَاۗءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ 28؀) (Surah Al-Qamar: 28), aur aayat mein hai (قَالَ هٰذِهٖ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَّلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُوْمٍ 155؀) (Surah Ash-Shu'ara: 155) yeh hai oontni us ke aur tumhare pani peene ke din taqseem shuda aur muqarrara hain. Yeh oontni Thamudiyon ki basti Hijr ke ird-gird charti chugti thi ek rah jati dusri rah aati yeh bohat hi moti tazi aur haibat wali oontni thi jis rah se guzarti sab janwar idhar udhar ho jate. Kuch zamana guzarne ke baad in aubashon ne irada kiya ke is ko maar dalein taake har din un ke janwar barabar pani pee sakein in aubashon ke iradon par sab ne ittefaq kiya yahan tak ke aurton aur bachon ne bhi un ki haan mein haan milayi aur unhein sheh di ke haan is paap ko kaat do. Is oontni ko maar dalo.

Chunancha Quran-e-Kareem mein hai aayat (فَكَذَّبُوْهُ فَعَقَرُوْهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ بِذَنْۢبِهِمْ فَسَوّٰىهَا) (Surah Ash-Shams: 14), Qaum-e-Saleh ne apne Nabi ko jhutlaya aur oontni ki kochein kaat kar use maar dala toh un ke Parwardigar ne un ke gunahon ke badle un par halakat nazil farmayi aur un sab ko yaksan kar diya. Ek aur aayat mein hai ke hum ne Thamudiyon ko oontni di jo un ke liye poori samajh boojh ki cheez thi lekin unhon ne is par zulm kiya, yahan bhi farmaya ke unhon ne is oontni ko maar dala. Pas is fe'l ki isnaad saare hi qabeele ki taraf hai jis se saaf zahir hai ke chhote bade sab is amr par muttafiq thay. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir waghera ka farman hai ke is ke qatl ki wajah yeh hui ke Unaiza bint-e-Ghanam bin Mujliz jo ek budhiya kafira thi aur Hazrat Saleh (A.S) se badi dushmani rakhti thi, us ki ladkiyan bahut khubsurat thin aur thi bhi yeh aurat maaldar. Is ke khawand ka naam Zawab bin Amr tha jo Thamudiyon ka ek sardar tha yeh bhi kafir tha. Isi tarah ek aur aurat thi jis ka naam Sadaqa bint-e-Muhayya bin Zuhair bin Mukhtar tha. Yeh bhi husn ke alawa maal aur hasab-nasab mein badhi hui thi, is ke khawand musalman ho gaye thay (R.A). Is sarkash aurat ne un ko chhod diya. Ab yeh dono auratein logon ko uksati thin ke koi aamada ho jaye aur Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ki oontni ko qatl kar de. Sadaqa nami aurat ne ek shakhs Hubab ko bulaya aur us se kaha ke main tere ghar aa jaungi agar tu is oontni ko qatl kar de lekin us ne inkar kar diya, is par us ne Musadda bin Muhraj bin Muhayya ko bulaya jo us ke chacha ka ladka tha aur use bhi isi baat par aamada kiya. Yeh khabeeth us ke husn-o-jamal ka maftoon tha, is burai par aamada ho gaya. Idhar Unaiza ne Qudar bin Salif bin Jaz'a ko bula kar us se kaha ke meri in khubsurat naujawan ladkiyon mein se jise tu pasand kare use main tujhe de doon gi isi shart par ke tu is oontni ki kochein kaat daal. Yeh khabeeth bhi aamada ho gaya, yeh tha bhi zina-kari ka bacha, Salif ki aulad mein na tha, Jaisan nami ek shakhs se is ki badkar maa ne zina-kari ki thi isi se yeh paida hua tha. Ab dono chale aur Ahl-e-Thamud aur dusre shareeron ko bhi is par aamada kiya, chunancha saat shakhs aur bhi is par aamada ho gaye aur yeh nau (9) fasadi shakhs is bad-irade par tul gaye jaise Quran-e-Kareem mein hai aayat (وَكَانَ فِي الْمَدِيْنَةِ تِسْعَةُ رَهْطٍ يُّفْسِدُوْنَ فِي الْاَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُوْنَ) (Surah An-Naml: 48), is shehar mein nau shakhs thay jin mein islah ka madda hi na tha, sarasar fasadi hi thay. Chunke yeh log qaum ke sardar thay un ke kehne sunne se tamam kuffar bhi is par raazi ho gaye aur oontni ke wapas aane ka raste mein yeh dono shareer apni apni kamin-gahon mein baith gaye, jab oontni nikli toh pehle Musadda ne use teer mara jo us ki raan ki haddi mein paiwast ho gaya, isi waqt Unaiza ne apni khubsurat ladki ko khule munh Qudar ke paas bheja, us ne kaha Qudar kya dekhte ho utho aur is ka kaam tamam kar do.

Yeh us ka munh dekhte hi daura aur us ke dono pichle paon kaat diye. Oontni chakra kar giri aur ek aawaz nikali jis se us ka bacha hoshiyar ho gaya aur us raaste ko chhor kar pahari par chala gaya. Yahan Qudar ne oontni ka gala kaat diya aur woh mar gayi. Us ka bacha pahar ki choti par charh gaya aur teen martaba bilbilaya. Hasan Basri R.H farmate hain us ne Allah ke samne apni maa ke qatl ki faryad ki, phir jis chattan se nikla tha usi mein sama gaya. Yeh riwayat bhi hai ke use bhi us ki maa ke sath hi zibah kar diya gaya tha. Wallahu A'lam.

Hazrat Saleh A.S ko jab yeh khabar pahunchi to aap ghabraye hue mauqe par pahunche, dekha ke oontni be-jaan pari hai. Aap ki aankhon se aansu nikal aaye aur farmaya bas ab teen din mein tum halak kar diye jaoge, hua bhi yahi. Budh ke din un logon ne oontni ko qatl kiya tha aur chunke koi azab na aaya is liye itra gaye aur un mufsidon ne irada kar liya ke aaj shaam ko Saleh ko bhi maar daalo. Agar waqai hum halak hone wale hi hain to phir yeh kyun bacha rahe? Aur agar hum par azab nahin aata to bhi aao roz-roz ke is jhanjhat se paak ho jayen. Chunancha Quran-e-Kareem ka bayan hai ke un logon ne mil kar mashwara kiya aur phir qasmein kha kar iqrar kiya ke raat ko Saleh ke ghar par chapa maaro aur use aur us ke gharane ko teh-e-tegh karo aur saaf inkaar kar do ke hamein kya khabar ke kis ne maara? Allah Ta'ala farmate hain un ke is makr ke muqabil hum ne bhi makr kiya aur yeh hamare makr se bilkul be-khabar rahe. Ab anjam dekh lo ke kya hua? Raat ko yeh apni bad-niyati se Hazrat Saleh A.S ke ghar ki taraf chale, aap ka ghar pahari ki bulandi par tha, abhi yeh oopar charh hi rahe the jo oopar se ek chattan patthar ki lurhakti hui aayi aur sab ko hi pees dala.

Un ka to yeh hashr hua, udhar jumerat ke din tamam Thamudiyon ke chehre zard par gaye, jumma ke din un ke chehre aag jaise surkh ho gaye aur hafte ke din jo muhlat ka aakhri din tha un ke munh siyah ho gaye. Teen din jab guzar gaye to chautha din itwar subh hi subh suraj ke roshan hote hi oopar aasman se sakht karaka hua jis ki holnaak dehshat-angez chinghaar ne un ke kaleje phaad diye, sath hi neeche se zabardast zalzala aaya. Ek hi sa'at mein ek sath hi un sab ka dher ho gaya, murdon se makanat, bazaar, gali, koche bhar gaye. Mard, aurat, bache, burhe awwal se aakhir tak saare ke saare tabah ho gaye. Shaan-e-Rabb dekhiye ke is waqiye ki khabar duniya ko pahunchane ke liye ek kafira aurat bacha di gayi, yeh bhi bari khabeesa thi, Hazrat Saleh A.S ki adawat ki aag se bhari hui thi, us ki dono taangein nahin thin lekin udhar azab aaya udhar us ke paon khul gaye, apni basti se sarpat bhagi aur tez daurti hui dusre shehar mein pahunchi aur wahan ja kar un sab ke samne sara waqiya bayan kar hi chukne ke baad un se paani manga. Abhi poori pyaas bhi na bujhi thi ke azab-e-Ilahi aa para aur wahin dher ho kar reh gayi.

Haan Abu Righal nami ek shakhs aur bach gaya tha yeh yahan na tha, Haram ki pak zameen mein tha lekin kuch dinon ke baad jab yeh apne kisi kaam ki gharz se hadd-e-Haram se bahar aaya usi waqt aasman se patthar aaya aur ise bhi Jahannam wasil kiya. Samudiyon mein se siwaye Hazrat Saleh (A.S) aur unke momin sahaba ke aur koi bhi na bacha, Abu Righal ka waqia is se pehle hadith se bayan ho chuka hai. Qabila-e-Saqif jo Taif mein hai mazkoor hai ke yeh usi ki nasl se hain. Abdur Razzaq mein hai ke is ki qabr ke paas se Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ) jab guzre to farmaya jante ho yeh kis ki qabr hai? Use dekhte hi un ke sardar Junda bin Amr ne to Islam qabool kar liya aur us ke sathiyon ne bhi. Baqi jo aur sardar the woh iman lane ke liye tayyar the magar Zawab bin Amr bin Labeed ne aur Hubab ne jo buton ka mujawar tha aur Rabab bin Hamar bin Jalmas waghera ne unhein rok diya. Hazrat Junda ka bhatija Shahab nami tha yeh Thamudiyon ka bada aalim fazil aur shareef shakhs tha us ne bhi iman lane ka irada kar liya tha lekin inhi badbakhton ne use bhi roka jis par ek momin Thamudi Mahwash bin Ghunma ne kaha ke Aal-e-Amr ne Shahab ko deen-e-haq ki dawat di qareeb tha ke woh musharraf ba-Islam ho jaye aur agar ho jata to us ki izzat siwa ho jati magar badbakhton ne use rok diya aur neki se hata kar badi par laga diya. Is hamila oontni ko us waqt bacha hua ek muddat tak dono in mein rahe. Ek din oontni un ka pani peeti. Us din us qadar doodh deti ke yeh log apne sab bartan bhar lete jaise Quran mein hai aayat (وَنَبِّئْهُمْ اَنَّ الْمَاۗءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ 28؀) (Surah Al-Qamar: 28), aur aayat mein hai (قَالَ هٰذِهٖ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَّلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُوْمٍ 155؀) (Surah Ash-Shu'ara: 155) yeh hai oontni us ke aur tumhare pani peene ke din taqseem shuda aur muqarrara hain. Yeh oontni Thamudiyon ki basti Hijr ke ird-gird charti chugti thi ek rah jati dusri rah aati yeh bohat hi moti tazi aur haibat wali oontni thi jis rah se guzarti sab janwar idhar udhar ho jate. Kuch zamana guzarne ke baad in aubashon ne irada kiya ke is ko maar dalein taake har din un ke janwar barabar pani pee sakein in aubashon ke iradon par sab ne ittefaq kiya yahan tak ke aurton aur bachon ne bhi un ki haan mein haan milayi aur unhein sheh di ke haan is paap ko kaat do. Is oontni ko maar dalo.

Chunancha Quran-e-Kareem mein hai aayat (فَكَذَّبُوْهُ فَعَقَرُوْهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ بِذَنْۢبِهِمْ فَسَوّٰىهَا) (Surah Ash-Shams: 14), Qaum-e-Saleh ne apne Nabi ko jhutlaya aur oontni ki kochein kaat kar use maar dala toh un ke Parwardigar ne un ke gunahon ke badle un par halakat nazil farmayi aur un sab ko yaksan kar diya. Ek aur aayat mein hai ke hum ne Thamudiyon ko oontni di jo un ke liye poori samajh boojh ki cheez thi lekin unhon ne is par zulm kiya, yahan bhi farmaya ke unhon ne is oontni ko maar dala. Pas is fe'l ki isnaad saare hi qabeele ki taraf hai jis se saaf zahir hai ke chhote bade sab is amr par muttafiq thay. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir waghera ka farman hai ke is ke qatl ki wajah yeh hui ke Unaiza bint-e-Ghanam bin Mujliz jo ek budhiya kafira thi aur Hazrat Saleh (A.S) se badi dushmani rakhti thi, us ki ladkiyan bahut khubsurat thin aur thi bhi yeh aurat maaldar. Is ke khawand ka naam Zawab bin Amr tha jo Thamudiyon ka ek sardar tha yeh bhi kafir tha. Isi tarah ek aur aurat thi jis ka naam Sadaqa bint-e-Muhayya bin Zuhair bin Mukhtar tha. Yeh bhi husn ke alawa maal aur hasab-nasab mein badhi hui thi, is ke khawand musalman ho gaye thay (R.A). Is sarkash aurat ne un ko chhod diya. Ab yeh dono auratein logon ko uksati thin ke koi aamada ho jaye aur Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ki oontni ko qatl kar de. Sadaqa nami aurat ne ek shakhs Hubab ko bulaya aur us se kaha ke main tere ghar aa jaungi agar tu is oontni ko qatl kar de lekin us ne inkar kar diya, is par us ne Musadda bin Muhraj bin Muhayya ko bulaya jo us ke chacha ka ladka tha aur use bhi isi baat par aamada kiya. Yeh khabeeth us ke husn-o-jamal ka maftoon tha, is burai par aamada ho gaya. Idhar Unaiza ne Qudar bin Salif bin Jaz'a ko bula kar us se kaha ke meri in khubsurat naujawan ladkiyon mein se jise tu pasand kare use main tujhe de doon gi isi shart par ke tu is oontni ki kochein kaat daal. Yeh khabeeth bhi aamada ho gaya, yeh tha bhi zina-kari ka bacha, Salif ki aulad mein na tha, Jaisan nami ek shakhs se is ki badkar maa ne zina-kari ki thi isi se yeh paida hua tha. Ab dono chale aur Ahl-e-Thamud aur dusre shareeron ko bhi is par aamada kiya, chunancha saat shakhs aur bhi is par aamada ho gaye aur yeh nau (9) fasadi shakhs is bad-irade par tul gaye jaise Quran-e-Kareem mein hai aayat (وَكَانَ فِي الْمَدِيْنَةِ تِسْعَةُ رَهْطٍ يُّفْسِدُوْنَ فِي الْاَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُوْنَ) (Surah An-Naml: 48), is shehar mein nau shakhs thay jin mein islah ka madda hi na tha, sarasar fasadi hi thay. Chunke yeh log qaum ke sardar thay un ke kehne sunne se tamam kuffar bhi is par raazi ho gaye aur oontni ke wapas aane ka raste mein yeh dono shareer apni apni kamin-gahon mein baith gaye, jab oontni nikli toh pehle Musadda ne use teer mara jo us ki raan ki haddi mein paiwast ho gaya, isi waqt Unaiza ne apni khubsurat ladki ko khule munh Qudar ke paas bheja, us ne kaha Qudar kya dekhte ho utho aur is ka kaam tamam kar do.

Yeh us ka munh dekhte hi daura aur us ke dono pichle paon kaat diye. Oontni chakra kar giri aur ek aawaz nikali jis se us ka bacha hoshiyar ho gaya aur us raaste ko chhor kar pahari par chala gaya. Yahan Qudar ne oontni ka gala kaat diya aur woh mar gayi. Us ka bacha pahar ki choti par charh gaya aur teen martaba bilbilaya. Hasan Basri R.H farmate hain us ne Allah ke samne apni maa ke qatl ki faryad ki, phir jis chattan se nikla tha usi mein sama gaya. Yeh riwayat bhi hai ke use bhi us ki maa ke sath hi zibah kar diya gaya tha. Wallahu A'lam.

Hazrat Saleh A.S ko jab yeh khabar pahunchi to aap ghabraye hue mauqe par pahunche, dekha ke oontni be-jaan pari hai. Aap ki aankhon se aansu nikal aaye aur farmaya bas ab teen din mein tum halak kar diye jaoge, hua bhi yahi. Budh ke din un logon ne oontni ko qatl kiya tha aur chunke koi azab na aaya is liye itra gaye aur un mufsidon ne irada kar liya ke aaj shaam ko Saleh ko bhi maar daalo. Agar waqai hum halak hone wale hi hain to phir yeh kyun bacha rahe? Aur agar hum par azab nahin aata to bhi aao roz-roz ke is jhanjhat se paak ho jayen. Chunancha Quran-e-Kareem ka bayan hai ke un logon ne mil kar mashwara kiya aur phir qasmein kha kar iqrar kiya ke raat ko Saleh ke ghar par chapa maaro aur use aur us ke gharane ko teh-e-tegh karo aur saaf inkaar kar do ke hamein kya khabar ke kis ne maara? Allah Ta'ala farmate hain un ke is makr ke muqabil hum ne bhi makr kiya aur yeh hamare makr se bilkul be-khabar rahe. Ab anjam dekh lo ke kya hua? Raat ko yeh apni bad-niyati se Hazrat Saleh A.S ke ghar ki taraf chale, aap ka ghar pahari ki bulandi par tha, abhi yeh oopar charh hi rahe the jo oopar se ek chattan patthar ki lurhakti hui aayi aur sab ko hi pees dala.

Un ka to yeh hashr hua, udhar jumerat ke din tamam Thamudiyon ke chehre zard par gaye, jumma ke din un ke chehre aag jaise surkh ho gaye aur hafte ke din jo muhlat ka aakhri din tha un ke munh siyah ho gaye. Teen din jab guzar gaye to chautha din itwar subh hi subh suraj ke roshan hote hi oopar aasman se sakht karaka hua jis ki holnaak dehshat-angez chinghaar ne un ke kaleje phaad diye, sath hi neeche se zabardast zalzala aaya. Ek hi sa'at mein ek sath hi un sab ka dher ho gaya, murdon se makanat, bazaar, gali, koche bhar gaye. Mard, aurat, bache, burhe awwal se aakhir tak saare ke saare tabah ho gaye. Shaan-e-Rabb dekhiye ke is waqiye ki khabar duniya ko pahunchane ke liye ek kafira aurat bacha di gayi, yeh bhi bari khabeesa thi, Hazrat Saleh A.S ki adawat ki aag se bhari hui thi, us ki dono taangein nahin thin lekin udhar azab aaya udhar us ke paon khul gaye, apni basti se sarpat bhagi aur tez daurti hui dusre shehar mein pahunchi aur wahan ja kar un sab ke samne sara waqiya bayan kar hi chukne ke baad un se paani manga. Abhi poori pyaas bhi na bujhi thi ke azab-e-Ilahi aa para aur wahin dher ho kar reh gayi.

Haan Abu Righal nami ek shakhs aur bach gaya tha yeh yahan na tha, Haram ki pak zameen mein tha lekin kuch dinon ke baad jab yeh apne kisi kaam ki gharz se hadd-e-Haram se bahar aaya usi waqt aasman se patthar aaya aur ise bhi Jahannam wasil kiya. Samudiyon mein se siwaye Hazrat Saleh (A.S) aur unke momin sahaba ke aur koi bhi na bacha, Abu Righal ka waqia is se pehle hadith se bayan ho chuka hai. Qabila-e-Saqif jo Taif mein hai mazkoor hai ke yeh usi ki nasl se hain. Abdur Razzaq mein hai ke is ki qabr ke paas se Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ) jab guzre to farmaya jante ho yeh kis ki qabr hai? Logon ne jawab diya ke Allah aur us ke Rasool ko zyada ilm hai. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya yeh Abu Righal ki qabr hai. Yeh ek Samudi shakhs tha, apni qoum ke azab ke waqt yeh Haram mein tha is wajah se azab-e-Ilahi se bach raha lekin Haram-e-Sharif se nikla to usi waqt apni qoum ke azab se yeh bhi halak hua aur yahin dafan kiya gaya aur is ke sath is ki sone ki lakdi bhi dafan kar di gayi. Chunancha logon ne is gaddhe ko khod kar is mein se woh lakdi nikal li aur hadith mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya tha Saqif qabila isi ki aulad hai. Ek mursal hadith mein bhi yeh zikr majood hai, yeh bhi hai ke Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya tha is ke sath sone ki shakh dafan kar di gayi thi yahi nishan is ki qabr ka hai agar tum ise khodo to woh shakh zaroor nikal aayegi chunancha baaz logon ne ise khoda aur woh shakh nikal li. Abu Dawood mein bhi yeh riwayat hai aur hasan aziz hai lekin main kehta hoon is hadith ke wasl ka sirf ek tariqa Buheir bin Abi Buheir ka hai aur yeh sirf isi hadith ke sath maroof hai aur baqol Hazrat Imam Yahya bin Ma'een siwaye Ismail bin Abi Umayyah ke ise is se aur kisi ne riwayat nahin kiya. Ehtemal hai ke kahin is hadith ke marfoo karne mein khata na ho, yeh Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) hi ka qaul ho aur phir is surat mein yeh bhi mumkinat se hai ke unhon ne ise un do daftaron se le liya ho jo unhein jang-e-Yarmouk mein mile the. Mere ustad Sheikh Abu Al-Hajjaj is riwayat ko pehle to hasan aziz kehte the lekin jab main ne un ke samne yeh hujjat pesh ki to Aap (R.H) ne farmaya beshak in umoor ka is mein ehtemal hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Thamud ki qoum aur uska ibrat-naak anjam ulama-e-nasab ne bayan kiya hai ke Thamud bin Aamir bin Iram bin Saam bin Nooh. Yeh bhai tha Jad-e-Bas bin Aamir ka. Isi tarah qabeela Tasm yeh sab khalis Arab thay. Hazrat Ibrahim Khalilullah (A.S) se pehle Thamudi Aadiyon ke baad hue hain unke shehar Hijaz aur Shaam ke darmiyan Wadi-ul-Qura aur uske gird-o-nawah mein mashhoor hain. Sanah 9 Hijri mein Tabook jaate hue Rasool Allah (ﷺ) unki ujaar bastiyon mein se guzray thay. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke jab Huzoor (ﷺ) Tabook ke maidan mein utray logon ne Thamudiyon ke gharon ke paas deray daalay aur inhi ke kunwon ke paani se aatay goondhay handiyan charhayin toh Aap (ﷺ) ne hukum diya ke sab handiyan ulat di jayen aur gundhay hue aatay oonton ko khila diye jayen. Phir farmaya yahan se kooch karo aur us kunway ke paas thehro jis se Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ki oontni paani peeti thi aur farmaya aayinda azaab wali bastiyon mein parao na kiya karo. Kahin aisa na ho ke isi azaab ke shikaar tum bhi ban jao. Ek riwayat mein hai ke unki bastiyon se rotay aur dartay hue guzro ke mabada wahi azaab tum par aa jayen jo un par aaye thay. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Ghazwa-e-Tabook mein log ba-ujlat Hijr ke logon ke gharon ki taraf lapkay. Aap (ﷺ) ne usi waqt yeh aawaz buland karne kaha hadees (As-Salatu Jami'ah) jab log jama ho gaye toh Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya ke in logon ke gharon mein kyun ghusay ja rahe ho jin par ghazab-e-Ilahi nazil hua. Rawi-e-hadees Abu Kabsha farmatay hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke haath mein ek neza tha. Main ne yeh sun kar arz ki ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) hum toh sirf ta'ajjub ke tor par unhein dekhne chale gaye thay Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya main tumhein is se bhi ta'ajjub khaiz cheez bata raha hoon tum mein se hi ek shakhs hai jo tumhein woh cheez bata raha hai jo guzar chukin aur woh khabrein de raha hai jo tumhare samne hain aur jo tumhare baad hone wali hain pas tum theek thaak raho aur seedhay chale jao tumhein azaab karte hue bhi Allah Ta'ala ko koi parwah nahin yaad rakho aisay log aayenge jo apni jaanon se kisi cheez ko dafa na kar sakenge. Hazrat Abu Kabsha ka naam Umar bin Sa'ad hai aur kaha gaya hai ke Aamir bin Sa'ad hai Wallahu A'alam. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Hijr ki basti ke paas aatay hi Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya mojzay na talab karo dekho Qoum-e-Saleh ne mojza talab kiya jo zahir hua yani oontni jo is raastay se aati thi aur is raastay se jaati thi lekin un logon ne apne Rabb ke hukum se sartabi ki aur oontni ki kochein kaat dein ek din oontni unka paani peeti thi aur ek din yeh sab uska doodh peetay thay us oontni ko maar daalne par un par ek cheekh aayi aur yeh jitnay bhi thay sab ke sab dher ho gaye. Bajuz us ek shakhs ke jo Haram Shareef mein tha logon ne poocha uska naam kya tha? Farmaya Abu Ghal yeh bhi jab hadd-e-Haram se bahar aaya toh usay bhi wahi azaab hua. Yeh hadees Sahah-e-Sitta mein toh nahin lekin hai Muslim Shareef ki shart par. Aayat ka matlab yeh hai ke Thamudi qabeelay ki taraf se unke bhai Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ko Nabi bana kar bheja gaya.

Tamam nabiyon ki tarah aap ne bhi apni ummat ko sab se pehle Tauheed-e-Ilahi sikhayi ke faqat us ki ibadat karein us ke siwa aur koi laiq-e-ibadat nahin. Allah ka farman hai jitne bhi Rasool aaye sab ki taraf yahi wahi ki jati rahi ke mere siwa koi mabood nahin, sirf meri hi ibadat karo aur irshad hai hum ne har ummat mein Rasool bheje ke Allah hi ki ibadat karo aur us ke siwa auron ki ibadat se bacho. Hazrat Saleh (A.S) farmate hain logon tumhare paas daleel-e-Ilahi aa chuki jis mein meri sachayi zahir hai. Yahan Qudar ne oontni ka gala kaat diya aur woh mar gayi. Us ka bacha pahar ki choti par charh gaya aur teen martaba bilbilaya. Hasan Basri R.H farmate hain us ne Allah ke samne apni maa ke qatl ki faryad ki, phir jis chattan se nikla tha usi mein sama gaya. Yeh riwayat bhi hai ke use bhi us ki maa ke sath hi zibah kar diya gaya tha. Wallahu A'lam.

Hazrat Saleh A.S ko jab yeh khabar pahunchi to aap ghabraye hue mauqe par pahunche, dekha ke oontni be-jaan pari hai. Aap ki aankhon se aansu nikal aaye aur farmaya bas ab teen din mein tum halak kar diye jaoge, hua bhi yahi. Budh ke din un logon ne oontni ko qatl kiya tha aur chunke koi azab na aaya is liye itra gaye aur un mufsidon ne irada kar liya ke aaj shaam ko Saleh ko bhi maar daalo. Agar waqai hum halak hone wale hi hain to phir yeh kyun bacha rahe? Aur agar hum par azab nahin aata to bhi aao roz-roz ke is jhanjhat se paak ho jayen. Chunancha Quran-e-Kareem ka bayan hai ke un logon ne mil kar mashwara kiya aur phir qasmein kha kar iqrar kiya ke raat ko Saleh ke ghar par chapa maaro aur use aur us ke gharane ko teh-e-tegh karo aur saaf inkaar kar do ke hamein kya khabar ke kis ne maara? Allah Ta'ala farmate hain un ke is makr ke muqabil hum ne bhi makr kiya aur yeh hamare makr se bilkul be-khabar rahe. Ab anjam dekh lo ke kya hua? Raat ko yeh apni bad-niyati se Hazrat Saleh A.S ke ghar ki taraf chale, aap ka ghar pahari ki bulandi par tha, abhi yeh oopar charh hi rahe the jo oopar se ek chattan patthar ki lurhakti hui aayi aur sab ko hi pees dala.

Un ka to yeh hashr hua, udhar jumerat ke din tamam Thamudiyon ke chehre zard par gaye, jumma ke din un ke chehre aag jaise surkh ho gaye aur hafte ke din jo muhlat ka aakhri din tha un ke munh siyah ho gaye. Teen din jab guzar gaye to chautha din itwar subh hi subh suraj ke roshan hote hi oopar aasman se sakht karaka hua jis ki holnaak dehshat-angez chinghaar ne un ke kaleje phaad diye, sath hi neeche se zabardast zalzala aaya. Ek hi sa'at mein ek sath hi un sab ka dher ho gaya, murdon se makanat, bazaar, gali, koche bhar gaye. Mard, aurat, bache, burhe awwal se aakhir tak saare ke saare tabah ho gaye. Shaan-e-Rabb dekhiye ke is waqiye ki khabar duniya ko pahunchane ke liye ek kafira aurat bacha di gayi, yeh bhi bari khabeesa thi, Hazrat Saleh A.S ki adawat ki aag se bhari hui thi, us ki dono taangein nahin thin lekin udhar azab aaya udhar us ke paon khul gaye, apni basti se sarpat bhagi aur tez daurti hui dusre shehar mein pahunchi aur wahan ja kar un sab ke samne sara waqiya bayan kar hi chukne ke baad un se paani manga. Abhi poori pyaas bhi na bujhi thi ke azab-e-Ilahi aa para aur wahin dher ho kar reh gayi.

Haan Abu Righal nami ek shakhs aur bach gaya tha yeh yahan na tha, Haram ki pak zameen mein tha lekin kuch dinon ke baad jab yeh apne kisi kaam ki gharz se hadd-e-Haram se bahar aaya usi waqt aasman se patthar aaya aur ise bhi Jahannam wasil kiya. Samudiyon mein se siwaye Hazrat Saleh (A.S) aur unke momin sahaba ke aur koi bhi na bacha, Abu Righal ka waqia is se pehle hadith se bayan ho chuka hai. Qabila-e-Saqif jo Taif mein hai mazkoor hai ke yeh usi ki nasl se hain. Abdur Razzaq mein hai ke is ki qabr ke paas se Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ) jab guzre to farmaya jante ho yeh kis ki qabr hai? Logon ne jawab diya ke Allah aur us ke Rasool ko zyada ilm hai. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya yeh Abu Righal ki qabr hai. Yeh ek Samudi shakhs tha, apni qoum ke azab ke waqt yeh Haram mein tha is wajah se azab-e-Ilahi se bach raha lekin Haram-e-Sharif se nikla to usi waqt apni qoum ke azab se yeh bhi halak hua aur yahin dafan kiya gaya aur is ke sath is ki sone ki lakdi bhi dafan kar di gayi. Chunancha logon ne is gaddhe ko khod kar is mein se woh lakdi nikal li aur hadith mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya tha Saqif qabila isi ki aulad hai. Ek mursal hadith mein bhi yeh zikr majood hai, yeh bhi hai ke Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya tha is ke sath sone ki shakh dafan kar di gayi thi yahi nishan is ki qabr ka hai agar tum ise khodo to woh shakh zaroor nikal aayegi chunancha baaz logon ne ise khoda aur woh shakh nikal li. Abu Dawood mein bhi yeh riwayat hai aur hasan aziz hai lekin main kehta hoon is hadith ke wasl ka sirf ek tariqa Buheir bin Abi Buheir ka hai aur yeh sirf isi hadith ke sath maroof hai aur baqol Hazrat Imam Yahya bin Ma'een siwaye Ismail bin Abi Umayyah ke ise is se aur kisi ne riwayat nahin kiya. Ehtemal hai ke kahin is hadith ke marfoo karne mein khata na ho, yeh Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) hi ka qaul ho aur phir is surat mein yeh bhi mumkinat se hai ke unhon ne ise un do daftaron se le liya ho jo unhein jang-e-Yarmouk mein mile the. Mere ustad Sheikh Abu Al-Hajjaj is riwayat ko pehle to hasan aziz kehte the lekin jab main ne un ke samne yeh hujjat pesh ki to Aap (R.H) ne farmaya beshak in umoor ka is mein ehtemal hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Thamud ki qoum aur uska ibrat-naak anjam ulama-e-nasab ne bayan kiya hai ke Thamud bin Aamir bin Iram bin Saam bin Nooh. Yeh bhai tha Jad-e-Bas bin Aamir ka. Isi tarah qabeela Tasm yeh sab khalis Arab thay. Hazrat Ibrahim Khalilullah (A.S) se pehle Thamudi Aadiyon ke baad hue hain unke shehar Hijaz aur Shaam ke darmiyan Wadi-ul-Qura aur uske gird-o-nawah mein mashhoor hain. Sanah 9 Hijri mein Tabook jaate hue Rasool Allah (ﷺ) unki ujaar bastiyon mein se guzray thay. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke jab Huzoor (ﷺ) Tabook ke maidan mein utray logon ne Thamudiyon ke gharon ke paas deray daalay aur inhi ke kunwon ke paani se aatay goondhay handiyan charhayin toh Aap (ﷺ) ne hukum diya ke sab handiyan ulat di jayen aur gundhay hue aatay oonton ko khila diye jayen. Phir farmaya yahan se kooch karo aur us kunway ke paas thehro jis se Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ki oontni paani peeti thi aur farmaya aayinda azaab wali bastiyon mein parao na kiya karo. Kahin aisa na ho ke isi azaab ke shikaar tum bhi ban jao. Ek riwayat mein hai ke unki bastiyon se rotay aur dartay hue guzro ke mabada wahi azaab tum par aa jayen jo un par aaye thay. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Ghazwa-e-Tabook mein log ba-ujlat Hijr ke logon ke gharon ki taraf lapkay. Aap (ﷺ) ne usi waqt yeh aawaz buland karne kaha hadees (As-Salatu Jami'ah) jab log jama ho gaye toh Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya ke in logon ke gharon mein kyun ghusay ja rahe ho jin par ghazab-e-Ilahi nazil hua. Rawi-e-hadees Abu Kabsha farmatay hain Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke haath mein ek neza tha. Main ne yeh sun kar arz ki ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) hum toh sirf ta'ajjub ke tor par unhein dekhne chale gaye thay Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya main tumhein is se bhi ta'ajjub khaiz cheez bata raha hoon tum mein se hi ek shakhs hai jo tumhein woh cheez bata raha hai jo guzar chukin aur woh khabrein de raha hai jo tumhare samne hain aur jo tumhare baad hone wali hain pas tum theek thaak raho aur seedhay chale jao tumhein azaab karte hue bhi Allah Ta'ala ko koi parwah nahin yaad rakho aisay log aayenge jo apni jaanon se kisi cheez ko dafa na kar sakenge. Hazrat Abu Kabsha ka naam Umar bin Sa'ad hai aur kaha gaya hai ke Aamir bin Sa'ad hai Wallahu A'alam. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Hijr ki basti ke paas aatay hi Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya mojzay na talab karo dekho Qoum-e-Saleh ne mojza talab kiya jo zahir hua yani oontni jo is raastay se aati thi aur is raastay se jaati thi lekin un logon ne apne Rabb ke hukum se sartabi ki aur oontni ki kochein kaat dein ek din oontni unka paani peeti thi aur ek din yeh sab uska doodh peetay thay us oontni ko maar daalne par un par ek cheekh aayi aur yeh jitnay bhi thay sab ke sab dher ho gaye. Bajuz us ek shakhs ke jo Haram Shareef mein tha logon ne poocha uska naam kya tha? Farmaya Abu Ghal yeh bhi jab hadd-e-Haram se bahar aaya toh usay bhi wahi azaab hua. Yeh hadees Sahah-e-Sitta mein toh nahin lekin hai Muslim Shareef ki shart par. Aayat ka matlab yeh hai ke Thamudi qabeelay ki taraf se unke bhai Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ko Nabi bana kar bheja gaya.

Tamam nabiyon ki tarah aap ne bhi apni ummat ko sab se pehle Tauheed-e-Ilahi sikhayi ke faqat us ki ibadat karein us ke siwa aur koi laiq-e-ibadat nahin. Allah ka farman hai jitne bhi Rasool aaye sab ki taraf yahi wahi ki jati rahi ke mere siwa koi mabood nahin, sirf meri hi ibadat karo aur irshad hai hum ne har ummat mein Rasool bheje ke Allah hi ki ibadat karo aur us ke siwa auron ki ibadat se bacho. Hazrat Saleh (A.S) farmate hain logon tumhare paas daleel-e-Ilahi aa chuki jis mein meri sachayi zahir hai. In logon ne Hazrat Saleh (A.S) se yeh mojiza talab kiya tha ke ek sanglakh chattan jo un ki basti ke ek kinare padi thi jis ka naam Katiba tha us se aap ek oontni nikalein jo gabhan ho (doodh dene wali oontni jo das mah ki hamila ho). Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ne un se farmaya ke agar aisa ho jaye to tum iman qabool kar loge? Unhon ne pukhta wade kiye aur mazboot ahd-o-paiman kiye. Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ne namaz padhi dua ki un sab ke dekhte hi chattan ne hilna shuru kiya aur chatakh gayi us ke beech se ek oontni namudar hui. Use dekhte hi un ke sardar Junda bin Amr ne to Islam qabool kar liya aur us ke sathiyon ne bhi. Baqi jo aur sardar the woh iman lane ke liye tayyar the magar Zawab bin Amr bin Labeed ne aur Hubab ne jo buton ka mujawar tha aur Rabab bin Hamar bin Jalmas waghera ne unhein rok diya. Hazrat Junda ka bhatija Shahab nami tha yeh Thamudiyon ka bada aalim fazil aur shareef shakhs tha us ne bhi iman lane ka irada kar liya tha lekin inhi badbakhton ne use bhi roka jis par ek momin Thamudi Mahwash bin Ghunma ne kaha ke Aal-e-Amr ne Shahab ko deen-e-haq ki dawat di qareeb tha ke woh musharraf ba-Islam ho jaye aur agar ho jata to us ki izzat siwa ho jati magar badbakhton ne use rok diya aur neki se hata kar badi par laga diya. Is hamila oontni ko us waqt bacha hua ek muddat tak dono in mein rahe. Ek din oontni un ka pani peeti. Us din us qadar doodh deti ke yeh log apne sab bartan bhar lete jaise Quran mein hai aayat (وَنَبِّئْهُمْ اَنَّ الْمَاۗءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ 28؀) (Surah Al-Qamar: 28), aur aayat mein hai (قَالَ هٰذِهٖ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَّلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُوْمٍ 155؀) (Surah Ash-Shu'ara: 155) yeh hai oontni us ke aur tumhare pani peene ke din taqseem shuda aur muqarrara hain. Yeh oontni Thamudiyon ki basti Hijr ke ird-gird charti chugti thi ek rah jati dusri rah aati yeh bohat hi moti tazi aur haibat wali oontni thi jis rah se guzarti sab janwar idhar udhar ho jate. Kuch zamana guzarne ke baad in aubashon ne irada kiya ke is ko maar dalein taake har din un ke janwar barabar pani pee sakein in aubashon ke iradon par sab ne ittefaq kiya yahan tak ke aurton aur bachon ne bhi un ki haan mein haan milayi aur unhein sheh di ke haan is paap ko kaat do. Is oontni ko maar dalo.

Chunancha Quran-e-Kareem mein hai aayat (فَكَذَّبُوْهُ فَعَقَرُوْهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ بِذَنْۢبِهِمْ فَسَوّٰىهَا) (Surah Ash-Shams: 14), Qaum-e-Saleh ne apne Nabi ko jhutlaya aur oontni ki kochein kaat kar use maar dala toh un ke Parwardigar ne un ke gunahon ke badle un par halakat nazil farmayi aur un sab ko yaksan kar diya. Ek aur aayat mein hai ke hum ne Thamudiyon ko oontni di jo un ke liye poori samajh boojh ki cheez thi lekin unhon ne is par zulm kiya, yahan bhi farmaya ke unhon ne is oontni ko maar dala. Pas is fe'l ki isnaad saare hi qabeele ki taraf hai jis se saaf zahir hai ke chhote bade sab is amr par muttafiq thay. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir waghera ka farman hai ke is ke qatl ki wajah yeh hui ke Unaiza bint-e-Ghanam bin Mujliz jo ek budhiya kafira thi aur Hazrat Saleh (A.S) se badi dushmani rakhti thi, us ki ladkiyan bahut khubsurat thin aur thi bhi yeh aurat maaldar. Is ke khawand ka naam Zawab bin Amr tha jo Thamudiyon ka ek sardar tha yeh bhi kafir tha. Isi tarah ek aur aurat thi jis ka naam Sadaqa bint-e-Muhayya bin Zuhair bin Mukhtar tha. Yeh bhi husn ke alawa maal aur hasab-nasab mein badhi hui thi, is ke khawand musalman ho gaye thay (R.A). Is sarkash aurat ne un ko chhod diya. Ab yeh dono auratein logon ko uksati thin ke koi aamada ho jaye aur Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ki oontni ko qatl kar de. Sadaqa nami aurat ne ek shakhs Hubab ko bulaya aur us se kaha ke main tere ghar aa jaungi agar tu is oontni ko qatl kar de lekin us ne inkar kar diya, is par us ne Musadda bin Muhraj bin Muhayya ko bulaya jo us ke chacha ka ladka tha aur use bhi isi baat par aamada kiya. Yeh khabeeth us ke husn-o-jamal ka maftoon tha, is burai par aamada ho gaya. Idhar Unaiza ne Qudar bin Salif bin Jaz'a ko bula kar us se kaha ke meri in khubsurat naujawan ladkiyon mein se jise tu pasand kare use main tujhe de doon gi isi shart par ke tu is oontni ki kochein kaat daal. Yeh khabeeth bhi aamada ho gaya, yeh tha bhi zina-kari ka bacha, Salif ki aulad mein na tha, Jaisan nami ek shakhs se is ki badkar maa ne zina-kari ki thi isi se yeh paida hua tha. Ab dono chale aur Ahl-e-Thamud aur dusre shareeron ko bhi is par aamada kiya, chunancha saat shakhs aur bhi is par aamada ho gaye aur yeh nau (9) fasadi shakhs is bad-irade par tul gaye jaise Quran-e-Kareem mein hai aayat (وَكَانَ فِي الْمَدِيْنَةِ تِسْعَةُ رَهْطٍ يُّفْسِدُوْنَ فِي الْاَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُوْنَ) (Surah An-Naml: 48), is shehar mein nau shakhs thay jin mein islah ka madda hi na tha, sarasar fasadi hi thay. Chunke yeh log qaum ke sardar thay un ke kehne sunne se tamam kuffar bhi is par raazi ho gaye aur oontni ke wapas aane ka raste mein yeh dono shareer apni apni kamin-gahon mein baith gaye, jab oontni nikli toh pehle Musadda ne use teer mara jo us ki raan ki haddi mein paiwast ho gaya, isi waqt Unaiza ne apni khubsurat ladki ko khule munh Qudar ke paas bheja, us ne kaha Qudar kya dekhte ho utho aur is ka kaam tamam kar do.

Hasan Basri R.H farmate hain us ne Allah ke samne apni maa ke qatl ki faryad ki, phir jis chattan se nikla tha usi mein sama gaya. Yeh riwayat bhi hai ke use bhi us ki maa ke sath hi zibah kar diya gaya tha. Wallahu A'lam.

Saleh A.S halakat ke asbab ki nishandahi karte hain. Qaum ki halakat dekh kar afsos, hasrat aur aakhri daant-dupat ke taur par Paighambar-e-Haq Hazrat Saleh A.S farmate hain ke na tumhein Rabb ki risalat ne faida pahunchaya, na meri khair-khwahi thikane lagi. Tum apni besamjhi se dost ko dushman samajh baithe aur aakhir is roz-e-bad ko dawat de li. Chunancha Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ bhi jab Badri kuffar par ghalib aaye, wahin teen din tak thehre rahe, phir raat ke aakhri waqt oontni par zeen kas kar Aap tashreef le chale aur jab is ghati ke paas pahunche jahan un kafiron ki lashein dali gayi thin to Aap thehar gaye aur farmane lage: "Ae Abu Jahl, ae Utbah, ae Shaibah, ae falan, ae falan, batao Rabb ke wade tum ne durust paye? Main ne to apne Rabb ke farman ki sadaqat apni aankhon dekh li." Hazrat Umar R.A ne kaha: "Ya Rasool Allah! Aap in jismon se baatein kar rahe hain jo murdar ho gaye?" Aap ﷺ ne farmaya: "Us Allah ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai, ke main jo kuch in se keh raha hoon, ise yeh tum se zyada sun rahe hain lekin jawab ki taqat nahin." Seerat ki kitabon mein hai ke Aap ﷺ ne farmaya: "Tum ne mera khandan hone ke bawajood mere saath woh burai ki ke kisi khandan ne apne paighambar ke saath na ki. Tum ne mere ham-qabeela hone ke bawajood mujhe jhutlaya aur dusre logon ne mujhe sacha samjha. Tum ne rishtedari ke bawajood mujhe des nikala diya aur dusron ne mujhe apne haan jagah di. Afsos! Tum apne ho kar mujh se barsar-e-jang rahe aur dusron ne meri imdad ki. Pas tum apne Nabi ke badtareen qabeele ho." Yehi Hazrat Saleh A.S apni qaum se farma rahe hain ke main ne to hamdardi ki inteha kar di, Allah ke paigham ki tabligh mein, tumhari khair-khwahi mein koi kotahi nahin ki, lekin aah! Na tum ne is se koi faida uthaya, na haq ki pairwi ki, na apne khair-khwah ki mani, balkeh use apna dushman samjha. Baaz mufassireen ka qaul hai ke har Nabi jab dekhta ke ab meri ummat par aam azab aane wala hai, unhein chhod kar nikal khada hota aur Haram-e-Makkah mein panah leta. Wallahu A'lam. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hajj ke mauqa par jab Rasool-e-Kareem ﷺ wadi-e-Usfan pahunche to Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar R.A se daryaft farmaya ke yeh kaunsi wadi hai? Aap R.A ne jawab diya: "Wadi-e-Usfan." Farmaya: "Mere saamne se Hazrat Hood aur Hazrat Saleh (Alaihimas Salam) abhi abhi guzre, oontniyon par sawar the jin ki nakeelein khajoor ke patton ki thin, kambalon ke teh-band bandhe hue aur moti chadrein odhe hue the. Labbaik pukarte hue Baitullah Sharif ki taraf tashreef le ja rahe the." Yeh hadith ghareeb hai, Sahah-e-Sitta mein nahin.

Lut A.S ki badnaseeb qoum. Farman hai ke Hazrat Lut A.S ko bhi hum ne un ki qoum ki taraf apna Rasool bana kar bheja toh un ke waqiye ko bhi yaad kar, Hazrat Lut A.S Haran bin Azar ke bete thay. Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke bhatije thay, aap hi ke haath par imaan qabool kiya tha aur aap hi ke saath Shaam ki taraf hijrat ki thi. Allah Ta'ala ne unhein apna Nabi bana kar Sadum nami basti ki taraf bheja, aap ne unhein aur aas paas ke logon ko Allah ki tauheed aur apni ita'at ki taraf bulaya, nekiyon ke karne aur buraiyon ko chhorne ka hukum diya. Jin mein ek burai aghlam bazi thi jo un se pehle duniya se mafqood thi. Is badkari ke maujid yahi mal'oon log thay. Amr bin Dinar yahi farmate hain. Jame-e-Damishq ke bani Khalifa Waleed bin Abdul Malik kehte hain agar yeh khabar Quran mein na hoti toh main toh is baat ko kabhi na maanta ke mard mard se haajat rawa'i kar le, isi liye Hazrat Lut A.S ne un haram karon se farmaya ke tum se pehle toh yeh na-paak aur khabeeth fe'l kisi ne nahin kiya. Aurton ko jo is kaam ke liye thin chhor kar tum mardon par rijh rahe ho? Is se barh kar israf aur jahalat aur kya hogi? Chunancha aur aayat mein hai ke aap ne farmaya yeh hain meri bachiyan yani tumhari qoum ki aurtein. Lekin unhon ne jawab diya ke hamein un ki chahat nahin. Hum toh tumhare un mehman larkon ke khwahan hain. Mufassireen farmate hain jis tarah mard mardon mein mashghool thay, aurtein aurton mein phansi hui thin.

Qaum-e-Lut par bhi Nabi ki nasihat kaargar na hui balkay ulta dushmani karne lage aur des nikal dene par tul gaye, Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi ko ma'a imandaron ke wahan se sahih salim bacha liya aur tamam basti walon ko zillat-o-pasti ke sath tabah-o-gharat kar diya, un ka yeh kehna ke yeh baray pakbaz log hain bator-e-ta'anay ke tha aur yeh bhi matlab tha ke yeh is kaam se jo hum karte hain door hain phir un ka hum mein kya kaam? Mujahid aur Ibn-e-Abbas R.H ka yahi qaul hai.

Looti tabah ho gaye. Hazrat Loot A.S aur un ka gharana Allah ke un azabon se bach gaya jo Lootiyon par nazil hue, bajuz aap ke gharane ke aur koi aap par iman na laya. Jaise farman-e-Rabb hai ayat (Fama wajadna fiha ghaira baitim minal muslimeen) yani wahan jitne momin thay hum ne sab ko nikal diya. Lekin bajuz ek ghar walon ke wahan hum ne kisi musalman ko paya hi nahin. Balkeh khandan-e-Loot mein se bhi khud Hazrat Loot A.S ki biwi halak hui kyunke yeh badnaseeb kafira hi thi, balkeh qoum ke kafiron ki tarafdar thi. Agar koi mehman aata to isharon se qoum ko khabar pahuncha deti, isi liye Hazrat Loot A.S se keh diya gaya tha ke ise apne sath na le jana balkeh ise khabar bhi na karna. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke sath to chali thi lekin jab qoum par azab aaya to us ke dil mein un ki mohabbat aa gayi aur raham ki nigah se unhein dekhne lagi, wahin usi waqt wahi azab us badnaseeb par bhi aa gaya. Lekin zyada zahir qaul pehla hi hai, yani na use Hazrat Loot A.S ne azab ki khabar ki, na use apne sath le gaye, yeh yahin baqi reh gayi aur phir halak ho gayi. (Ghabireen) ke ma'ani bhi baqi reh jane wale hain. Jin buzurgon ne is ke ma'ani halak hone wale kiye hain, woh bator-e-luzoom ke hain, kyunke jo baqi thay woh halak hone wale hi thay. Hazrat Loot A.S aur un ke musalman sahaba Razi Allahu Anhum Ajma'een ke shahar se nikalte hi azab-e-Ilahi un par barish ki tarah baras pada. Woh barish pattharon aur dheelon ki thi jo har ek par bilkhusoos nishan-zada usi ke liye aasman se gir rahe thay. Go Allah ke azab ko be-insaf log door samajh rahe hon lekin haqiqatan aisa nahin. Ae paighambar! Aap khud dekh lijiye ke Allah ki nafarmaniyon aur Rasool-e-Allah ﷺ ki takzeeb karne walon ka kya anjam hota hai? Imam Abu Hanifa R.H farmate hain looti fe'l karne wale ko unchi deewar se gira diya jaye, phir upar se pathrao kar ke use maar dalna chahiye kyunke Lootiyon ko Allah ki taraf se yahi saza di gayi aur ulama-e-kiram ka farman hai ke use rajam kar diya jaye khwah woh shadi-shuda ho ya be-shadi. Imam Shafi'i R.H ke do qaul mein se ek yahi hai. Is ki daleel Musnad-e-Ahmad, Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi aur Ibn Majah ki yeh hadith hai ke Rasool-e-Allah ﷺ ne farmaya: Jab tum looti fe'l karte pao, use aur us ke neeche wale dono ko qatl kar do. Ulama ki ek jama'at ka qaul hai ke yeh bhi misl-e-zina kari ke hai, shadi-shuda hon to rajam warna sau kore. Imam Shafi'i R.H ka dusra qaul bhi yahi hai. Aurton se is qisam ki harkat karna bhi choti lawatat hai aur ba-ijma-e-ummat haram hai, bajuz ek shaz qaul ke aur bahut si ahadees mein is ki hurmat majood hai, is ka poora bayan Surah Al-Baqarah ki tafsir mein guzar chuka hai.
