Khatib-ul-Anbiya Shuaib Alaihis Salam. Mashhoor muwarrikh Hazrat Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq R.H farmate hain yeh log Madyan bin Ibrahim ki nasl se hain. Hazrat Shuaib Mikaeel bin Naishjar ke ladke thay, unka naam Suryani zaban mein Yathroon tha. Yeh yaad rahe ke qabeelay ka naam bhi Madyan tha aur us basti ka naam bhi yahi tha, yeh shehar Ma'an se hotay huay Hijaz janay walay ke raastay mein aata hai. Aayat-e-Quran "Walama warada maa Madyan" mein shehar Madyan ke kunway ka zikr majood hai, is se muraad Aikah walay hain jaisa ke Insha'Allah bayan karenge. Aap ne bhi tamam rasoolon ki tarah unhein tauheed ki aur shirk se bachnay ki dawat di aur farmaya ke Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se meri nabuwwat ki daleelein tumharay samnay aa chuki hain. Khaliq ka haq bata kar phir makhlooq ke haq ki adaigi ki taraf rehbari ki aur farmaya ke naap tol mein kami ki aadat chhoro, logon ke haqooq na maaro. Kaho kuch aur karo kuch, yeh khayanat hai. Farman hai aayat (Wailul-lil-mutaffifeen), in naap tol mein kami karne walon ke liye (Wail) hai. Allah Ta'ala is bad-khaslat se har ek ko bachaye. Phir Hazrat Shuaib A.S ka aur wa'az bayan hota hai. Aap ko ba-sabab fasahat-e-ibarat aur umdagi-e-wa'az ke Khatib-ul-Anbiya kaha jata tha. Alaihis Salatu Wassalam.

Qaum-e-Shuaib ki bada'amaliyan farmate hain ke musafiron ke raaste mein dehshat gardi na phailao. Daaka na daalo aur unhein dara dhamka kar unka maal zabardasti na chhino. Mere paas hidayat hasil karne ke liye jo aana chahta hai use khaufzada kar ke rok dete ho. Imaan-daron ko Allah ki raah par chalne mein rode atkate ho. Raah-e-Haq ko tedha kar dena chahte ho, in tamam buraiyon se bacho. Yeh bhi ho sakta hai balkay zyada zahir hai ke har raaste par na baithne ki hidayat se to qatl-o-gharat se rok ke liye ho jo unki aadat thi aur phir raah-e-Haq se mominon ko na rokne ki hidayat phir ki ho. Tum Allah ke is ehsaan ko yaad karo ke ginti mein, quwwat mein tum kuch na thay, bahut hi kam thay, usne apni meherbani se tumhari tadaad badha di aur tumhein zor-awar kar diya, Rabb ki is naimat ka shukriya ada karo. Ibrat ki aankhon se unka anjaam dekh lo jo tum se pehle abhi abhi guzre hain, jin ke zulm-o-jabr ki wajah se, jin ki bad-amni aur fasaad ki wajah se Rabb ke azaab un par toot pade. Woh Allah ki nafarmaniyon mein, rasoolon ke jhutlane mein mashghool rahe, daleer ban gaye jis ke badle Allah ki pakad un par nazil hui. Aaj unki ek aankh jhapakti hui baqi nahin rahi, neest-o-nabood ho gaye, mar mit gaye. Dekho main tumhein saaf belaag ek baat bata doon, tum mein se ek giroh mujh par imaan la chuka hai aur ek giroh ne mera inkaar aur buri tarah mujh se kufr kiya hai. Ab tum khud dekh loge ke madad-e-Rabbani kis ka saath deti hai aur Allah ki nazron se kaun gir jata hai? Tum Rabb ke faisle ke muntazir raho. Woh sab faisla karne walon se achha aur sacha faisla karne wala hai. Tum khud dekh lo ke Allah wale ba-muraad honge aur dushmanan-e-Allah na-shaad honge.

Shuaib A.S ki qoum ne apni barbadi ko aawaz di. Hazrat Shuaib A.S ki qoum ne aap ki tamam nasihaten sun kar jo jawab diya us ka zikr kiya ja raha hai. Hua yeh ke daleelon se haar kar yeh log apni quwwat jatane par utar aaye aur kehne lage ab tujhe aur tere sathiyon ko hum do baton mein se ek ka ikhtiyar dete hain, ya toh jala-watni qabool kar ya hamare mazhab mein aa jao. Jis par aap ne farmaya ke hum toh dil se tumhare in mushrikana kamon se bezar hain. Inhein sakht na-pasandidagi ki nazar se dekhte hain. Phir tumhare is dabao aur is khwahish ke kya ma'ani? Agar Allah kare hum phir se tumhare kufr mein shamil ho jayen toh hum se barh kar gunahgar kaun hoga? Is ke toh saaf ma'ani yeh hain ke hum ne do ghari pehle mehez ek dhong rachaya tha. Allah Ta'ala par jhoot aur bohtan bandh kar nubuwwat ka da'wa kiya tha. Khayal farmaiye ke is jawab mein Allah ke Nabi A.S ne imandaron ko murtad hone se kis tarah dhamkaya hai? Lekin chunke insaan kamzor hai. Na-maloom kis ka dil kaisa hai aur aage chal kar kya zahir hone wala hai? Is liye farmaya ke Allah ke hath sab kuch hai agar wahi kisi ke khayalat ulat de toh mera zor nahin. Har cheez ke aaghaz-o-anjam ka ilm sirf Allah Ta'ala ko hai. Hamara tawakkul aur bharosa apne tamam kamon mein sirf usi ki zaat-e-pak par hai. Aye Allah tu hum mein aur hamari qoum mein faisla farma, hamari madad farma, tu sab hakimon ka hakim hai, sab se behtar faisla karne wala hai, aadil hai, zalim nahin.

Qaum-e-Shuaib ka shauq-e-tabahi pura hua. Is qaum ki sarkashi aur bad-batini mulahiza ho ke musalmanon ko Islam se hatane ke liye unhein yaqeen dila rahe hain ke Shuaib (A.S) ki ita'at tumhein gharat kar degi, bade nuqsan mein utar jaoge. In mominon ke dilon ko darane ka natija yeh hua ke aasmani azab ba-surat-e-zalzala zameen se aaya aur unhein sach-much larza diya aur gharat-o-barbad ho kar khud hi nuqsan mein phans gaye. Yahan is tarah bayan hua. Surah Hud mein bayan hai ke aasmani karake ki aawaz se yeh halak kiye gaye. Wahan bayan hai ke unhon ne apne watan se nikal jane ki dhamki imandaron ko di thi to aasmani daant ki aawaz ne unki aawaz past kar di aur hamesha ke liye yeh khamosh kar diye gaye. Surah Shu'ara mein bayan hai ke badal un par se azab ban kar barsa. Kyunke wahin zikr hai ke khud unhon ne apne Nabi se kaha tha ke agar sache ho to hum par aasman ka koi tukda gira do. Waqia yeh hai ke yeh teeno azab un par ek sath aaye. Idhar abr utha jis se shola-bari hone lagi, aag barasne lagi. Idhar tund aur sakht karake ki aawaz aayi, idhar zameen par zalzala aaya. Neeche upar ke azabon se dekhte hi dekhte teh-o-bala kar diye gaye, apni apni jagah dher ho gaye. Ya woh waqt tha ke yahan se mominon ko nikalna chahte the ya yeh waqt hai ke yeh bhi nahin maloom hota ke kisi waqt yahan yeh log abad bhi the, ya musalmanon se keh rahe the ke tum nuqsan mein utroge ya yeh hai ke khud barbad ho gaye.

Qaum-e-Shuaib ka shauq-e-tabahi pura hua. Is qaum ki sarkashi aur bad-batini mulahiza ho ke musalmanon ko Islam se hatane ke liye unhein yaqeen dila rahe hain ke Shuaib (A.S) ki ita'at tumhein gharat kar degi, bade nuqsan mein utar jaoge. In mominon ke dilon ko darane ka natija yeh hua ke aasmani azab ba-surat-e-zalzala zameen se aaya aur unhein sach-much larza diya aur gharat-o-barbad ho kar khud hi nuqsan mein phans gaye. Yahan is tarah bayan hua. Surah Hud mein bayan hai ke aasmani karake ki aawaz se yeh halak kiye gaye. Wahan bayan hai ke unhon ne apne watan se nikal jane ki dhamki imandaron ko di thi to aasmani daant ki aawaz ne unki aawaz past kar di aur hamesha ke liye yeh khamosh kar diye gaye. Qaum par Allah Ta'ala ka azab aa chukne ke baad Hazrat Shuaib (A.S) wahan se chale aur bator-e-daant dapat ke farmaya ke main sabakdosh ho chuka hoon. Allah ka paigham suna chuka, samjha bujha chuka, gham-khwari hamdardi kar chuka. Lekin tum kafir ke kafir hi rahe ab mujhe kya padi ke tumhare afsos mein apni jaan halkan karoon?

Adwar-e-mazi agli ummaton mein bhi Allah Ta'ala ke Rasool aaye aur un ke inkar par woh ummatein mukhtalif balaon mein mubtala ki gayin maslan bimariyan, faqiri, muflisi, tangi. Taa-ke woh Allah Ta'ala ke samne akarna chhor dein aur us ke samne jhuk jayen. Musibaton ke talne ki duayen karein aur us ke Rasool ki maan lein. Lekin unhon ne is mauqa ko hath se nikal diya bawajood buri halat hone ke dil ka kufr na tota, apni zid se na hate to hum ne dusri tarah phir ek mauqa diya. Sakhti ko narmi se, burai ko bhalai se, bimari ko tandurusti se, faqiri ko amiri se badal diya taa-ke shukr karein aur hamari hukmrani ke qail ho jayen lekin unhon ne is mauqa se bhi faida na uthaya, jaise jaise barhe waise waise kufr mein phanse, bad-masti mein aur barhe aur maghroor ho gaye aur kehne lage ke yeh zamana ke ittefaqat hain. Pehle se yahi hota chala aaya hai kabhi ke din bare kabhi ki raten bari. Zamana hamesha ek halat par nahin rehta, al-gharaz ittefaq par mahmool kar ke mamooli si baat samajh kar dono mauqe taal diye. Iman wale dono halaton mein ibrat pakarte hain. Musibat par sabr, rahat par shukr un ka shewa hota hai, Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain momin par ta'ajjub hai us ki dono halatein anjam ke lihaz se us ke liye behtar hoti hain. Yeh dukh par sabr karta hai, anjam behtar hota hai, sukh par shukr karta hai, nekiyan pata hai, pas momin ranj-o-rahat dono mein apni aazmaish ko samajh leta hai. Ek aur hadith mein hai balaon ki wajah se momin ke gunah bilkul door ho jate hain aur woh pak saaf ho jata hai. Haan munafiq ki misal gadhe jaisi hai jise nahin maloom ke kyun bandha gaya aur kyun khola gaya? (Au kama qala) Pas un logon ko us ke baad Allah ke azab ne achanak aapakara yeh mehez be-khabar thay apni khur-mastiyon mein lage hue thay. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke achanak maut momin ke liye rahmat hai aur kafiron ke liye hasrat hai.

Awam ki fitrat logon se aam taur par jo ghalti ho rahi hai us ka zikr hai ke umooman imaan se aur nek kamon se bhagte rehte hain. Sirf Hazrat Yunus (A.S) ki poori basti imaan layi thi aur woh bhi us waqt jabke azabon ko dekh liya aur yeh bhi sirf un ke sath hi hua ke aaye hue azab wapas kar diye gaye aur dunya-o-akhirat ki ruswai se bach gaye yeh log ek lakh balkay zaid thay. Apni poori umar tak pohanchay aur dunyawi faiday bhi hasil karte rahe to farmata hai ke agar nabiyon ke aanay par un ke ummati sidq-e-dil se un ki tabedari karte, buraiyon se ruk jatay aur nekiyan karne lagtay to hum un par kushada taur par barishein barsatay aur zameen se paidawar ugate. Lekin unhon ne rasoolon ki na mani balkay unhein jhoota samjha aur rubaru jhoota kaha. Buraiyon se haram kariyon se ek inch na hatay, is wajah se tabah kar diye gaye. Kya kafiron ko is baat ka khauf nahin ke raton raat un ki be-khabri mein un ke sotay hue azab-e-Ilahi aa jaye aur yeh soye ke soye reh jayen? Kya unhein dar nahin lagta ke kahin aisa na ho ke din daharay un ke khel kood aur ghaflat ki halat mein Allah Jalla Jalaluhu ka azab aa jaye? Allah ke azabon se, Allah Ta'ala ki pakar se, us ki be-payan qudrat ke andazay se ghafil wahi hote hain jo apne aap barbadi ki taraf barhay chalay jate hon. Imam Hasan Basri (R.H) ka qaul hai ke momin nekiyan karta hai aur phir darta rehta hai aur fasiq fajir shakhs buraiyan karta hai aur be-khauf rehta hai. Natijay mein momin aman pata hai aur fajir pees diya jata hai.

Gunahon mein doobay log? Irshad hai ke ek garoh ne hamara muqabla kiya aur hum ne unhein takht-o-taraj kiya. Dusra garoh un ke qaim-maqam hua toh kya us par bhi yeh baat wazeh nahin hoti ke agar woh bad-aamaliyan karenge toh apne se aglon ki tarah kho diye jayenge jaise farman hai aayat (A-falam yahdi lahum kam ahlakna qablahum minal-quruni yamshuna fi masakinihim inna fi dhalika la-ayatin li-ulin-nuha) (Taha: 128) yani kya unhein ab tak samajh nahin aayi ke hum ne un se pehle bahut si abad bastiyan ujaar kar rakh dein jin ke makanon mein ab yeh rehte sehte hain. Agar yeh aql-mand hote toh un ke liye bahut si ibratein thin aur is bayan ke baad ki aayat mein hai ke is mein bahut si nishaniyan hain. Kya yeh sun nahin rahe? Ek aayat mein farmaya tum is se pehle pooray yaqeen se kehte the ke tumhein zawal aane ka hi nahin halanke tum jin ke gharon mein the woh khud bhi apne mazalim ke sabab tabah kar diye gaye the. Khali ghar reh gaye. Ek aur aayat mein hai aayat (Wa kam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hum ahsanu athathan wa ri'ya) (Maryam: 74) un se pehle hum ne bahut si bastiyan tabah kar dein na un mein se ab koi nazar aaye na kisi ki aawaz sunayi de aur aayat mein hai ke woh log toh un se zyada mast the, maal-dar the, aish-o-ishrat mein the, rahat-o-aaram mein the, oopar se abr barasta tha neeche se chashmay behte the lekin gunahon mein doobay rahe ke aakhir tehas-nehas hogaye aur dusre log un ke qaim-maqam aaye. Aadiyon ki halakat ka bayan farma kar irshad hua ke aisay azab achanak aa gaye ke un ke wajood ki dhajiyan ud gayin, khandhar kharay reh gaye aur kisi cheez ka naam-o-nishan na bacha. Mujrimon ka yahi haal hota hai. Halanke dunyawi wajahat bhi un ke paas thi aankh, kaan, haath sab tha lekin Allah Jalla Shanuhu ki baton ka tamsukhur karne par aur un ke inkar par jab azab aaya toh hairan-o-shashdar reh gaye, na aql aayi na asbab bachay. Apne aas-paas ki veeran bastiyan dekh kar ibrat hasil karo. Aglon ne jhutlaya toh dekh lo ke kis tarah barbad huye? Tum toh abhi tak un ke daswein hissay ko bhi nahin pohanchay. Tum se pehle ke munkiron par mere azab aaye unhein gaur se suno. Zalimon ki bastiyan main ne ulat dein aur un ke mehalat khandhar bana diye. Zameen mein chal-phir kar, aankhein khol kar, kaan laga kar zara ibrat hasil karo. Jis ki aankhein na hon wahi andha nahin balkay sach-much andha woh hai jis ki dili aankhein bekar hon. Aglay nabiyon ke sath bhi mazaq udaye gaye lekin natija yahi hua ke aisay mazaq karne walon ka nishan mit gaya. Aisay gheray aa gaye ke ek bhi na bacha. Allah Ta'ala ki baatein sachi hain, us ke waaday atal hain woh zaroor apne doston ki madad karta hai aur apne dushmanon ko neecha dikhata hai.

Ahd-shikan logon ki tay-shuda saza pehle qaum-e-Nuh, Hud, Saleh, Lut aur qaum-e-Shuaib ka bayan guzar chuka hai. Is ke baad Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se farmata hai ke in sab ke paas hamare rasool haq le kar pahunche, mojze dikhaye, samjhaya, bujhaya, daleelein dein lekin woh na maane aur apni bad-aadaton se baaz na aaye. Jis ki padash mein halak ho gaye, sirf manne wale bach gaye. Allah ka tariqa isi tarah jaari hai ke jab tak rasool na aa jayen, khabardar na kar diye jayen azab nahin diye jaate, hum zalim nahin lekin jabke log khud zulm par kamar kas lein to phir hamare azab unhein aa pakadte hain. In sab ne jin cheezon ka inkar kar diya tha un par bawajood daleelein dekh lene ke bhi iman na laye. Aayat (Bima kazzabu) mein "Ba" sabbiya hai jaise aayat (Wa iza sami'u) ke paare ke aakhir mein farmaya hai ke tum kya jaano? Yeh log to mojze aane par bhi iman na layenge, hum un ke dilon aur aankhon ko ulat denge jaise ke yeh is Quran par pehli baar iman na laye the aur hum unhein un ki sarkashi ki halat mein bhatakte hue chhod denge, yahan bhi farman hai ke kuffar ke dilon par isi tarah hum mohrein laga diya karte hain. In mein se aksar bad-ahd hain balkay umooman fasiq hain. Yeh ahd woh hai jo roz-e-azal mein liya gaya aur isi par paida kiye gaye isi fitrat aur jablat mein rakha gaya isi ki takeed ambiya (Alaihimas Salam / A.S) karte karte rahe. Lekin unhon ne is ahd ko pas-e-pusht daal diya ya mutlaq parwah na ki aur is ahd ke khilaf ghair-ullah ki parastish shuru kar di. Allah ko malik, khaliq aur laiq-e-ibadat maan kar aaye the lekin yahan is ke sarasar khilaf karne lage aur be-daleel, khilaf-e-aql-o-naql, khilaf-e-fitrat aur khilaf-e-shara, Allah ke siwa dusron ki ibadat mein lag gaye. Sahih Muslim Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai main ne apne bandon ko muwahid aur yak-tarfa paida kiya lekin shaitan ne aa kar unhein behka diya aur meri halal karda cheezein un par haram kar dein. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai har bacha fitrat-e-Islam par paida hota hai phir use us ke maa baap yahudi, nasrani, majoosi bana lete hain. Khud Quran-e-Kareem mein hai hum ne tujh se pehle jitne rasool bheje the sab ki taraf yahi wahi ki thi ke mere siwa aur koi mabood nahin. Aye duniya ke logo tum sab sirf meri hi ibadat karte raho. Aur aayat mein hai to apne se pehle ke rasoolon se daryaft kar lo kya hum ne apne siwa aur mabood un ke liye muqarrar kiye the? Aur farman hai aayat (Walaqad ba'asna fi kulli ummatir rasulan ani'budullaha wajtanibut taghut, faminhum man hadallahu wa minhum man haqqat 'alaihid dalalah, fasiru fil ardi fanzuru kaifa kana aqibatul mukazzibin) (An-Nahl: 36) hum ne har ummat mein rasool bheja ke logo sirf Allah hi ki ibadat karo aur us ke siwa har ek ki ibadat se alag raho. Is mazmoon ki aur bhi bahut si aayatein hain.

Is jumlay ke ma'ani yeh bhi kiye gaye hain ke chunke pehle hi se Allah Ta'ala ke ilm mein yeh baat muqarrar ho gayi thi ke inhe iman naseeb nahin hoga. Yehi ho kar raha ke bawajood dalail samne aa jaane ke iman na laye. Misaq wale din go yeh iman qabool kar baithe lekin unke dilon ki halat Allah Jalla Shanuhu ko maloom thi ke unka iman jabran aur na-khushi se hai. Jaise farman hai ke yeh agar dobara duniya ki taraf lautaye jayen to phir bhi wohi kaam naye sire se karne lagenge jin se inhe roka gaya hai.

Ahd-shikan logon ki tay-shuda saza pehle qaum-e-Nuh, Hud, Saleh, Lut aur qaum-e-Shuaib ka bayan guzar chuka hai. Is ke baad Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se farmata hai ke in sab ke paas hamare rasool haq le kar pahunche, mojze dikhaye, samjhaya, bujhaya, daleelein dein lekin woh na maane aur apni bad-aadaton se baaz na aaye. Jis ki padash mein halak ho gaye, sirf manne wale bach gaye. Allah ka tariqa isi tarah jaari hai ke jab tak rasool na aa jayen, khabardar na kar diye jayen azab nahin diye jaate, hum zalim nahin lekin jabke log khud zulm par kamar kas lein to phir hamare azab unhein aa pakadte hain. In sab ne jin cheezon ka inkar kar diya tha un par bawajood daleelein dekh lene ke bhi iman na laye. Aayat (Bima kazzabu) mein "Ba" sabbiya hai jaise aayat (Wa iza sami'u) ke paare ke aakhir mein farmaya hai ke tum kya jaano? Yeh log to mojze aane par bhi iman na layenge, hum un ke dilon aur aankhon ko ulat denge jaise ke yeh is Quran par pehli baar iman na laye the aur hum unhein un ki sarkashi ki halat mein bhatakte hue chhod denge, yahan bhi farman hai ke kuffar ke dilon par isi tarah hum mohrein laga diya karte hain. In mein se aksar bad-ahd hain balkay umooman fasiq hain. Yeh ahd woh hai jo roz-e-azal mein liya gaya aur isi par paida kiye gaye isi fitrat aur jablat mein rakha gaya isi ki takeed ambiya (Alaihimas Salam / A.S) karte karte rahe. Lekin unhon ne is ahd ko pas-e-pusht daal diya ya mutlaq parwah na ki aur is ahd ke khilaf ghair-ullah ki parastish shuru kar di. Allah ko malik, khaliq aur laiq-e-ibadat maan kar aaye the lekin yahan is ke sarasar khilaf karne lage aur be-daleel, khilaf-e-aql-o-naql, khilaf-e-fitrat aur khilaf-e-shara, Allah ke siwa dusron ki ibadat mein lag gaye. Sahih Muslim Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai main ne apne bandon ko muwahid aur yak-tarfa paida kiya lekin shaitan ne aa kar unhein behka diya aur meri halal karda cheezein un par haram kar dein. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai har bacha fitrat-e-Islam par paida hota hai phir use us ke maa baap yahudi, nasrani, majoosi bana lete hain. Khud Quran-e-Kareem mein hai hum ne tujh se pehle jitne rasool bheje the sab ki taraf yahi wahi ki thi ke mere siwa aur koi mabood nahin. Aye duniya ke logo tum sab sirf meri hi ibadat karte raho. Aur aayat mein hai to apne se pehle ke rasoolon se daryaft kar lo kya hum ne apne siwa aur mabood un ke liye muqarrar kiye the? Aur farman hai aayat (Walaqad ba'asna fi kulli ummatir rasulan ani'budullaha wajtanibut taghut, faminhum man hadallahu wa minhum man haqqat 'alaihid dalalah, fasiru fil ardi fanzuru kaifa kana aqibatul mukazzibin) (An-Nahl: 36) hum ne har ummat mein rasool bheja ke logo sirf Allah hi ki ibadat karo aur us ke siwa har ek ki ibadat se alag raho. Is mazmoon ki aur bhi bahut si aayatein hain.

Is jumlay ke ma'ani yeh bhi kiye gaye hain ke chunke pehle hi se Allah Ta'ala ke ilm mein yeh baat muqarrar ho gayi thi ke inhe iman naseeb nahin hoga. Yehi ho kar raha ke bawajood dalail samne aa jaane ke iman na laye. Misaq wale din go yeh iman qabool kar baithe lekin unke dilon ki halat Allah Jalla Shanuhu ko maloom thi ke unka iman jabran aur na-khushi se hai. Jaise farman hai ke yeh agar dobara duniya ki taraf lautaye jayen to phir bhi wohi kaam naye sire se karne lagenge jin se inhe roka gaya hai.

Naabakaar logon ka tazkirah. Anbiya aur momineen par nazar-e-karam. Jin rasoolon ka zikr guzar chuka hai yani Nooh, Hood, Saleh, Loot, Shoaib, Salawatullahi wa Salamuhu Alaihim wa ala saairil anbiya-e-ajmaeen ke baad hum ne Hazrat Moosa (Alaihis Salatu Wassalam) ko apni daleelein ata farma kar baadshah-e-Misr (Firaun) aur us ki qoum ki taraf bheja. Lekin unhon ne bhi jhutlaya aur zulm-o-ziyadati ki aur saaf inkaar kar diya halankeh un ke dilon mein yaqeen ghar kar chuka tha. Ab aap dekh lo keh Allah ki raah se rukne walon aur us ke rasoolon ka inkaar karne walon ka kya anjaam hua? Woh ma'a apni qoum ke dubo diye gaye aur phir lutf yeh hai keh mominon ke saamne bekasi ki pakad mein pakad liye gaye taake un ke dil thande hon aur ibrat ho.

Musa (A.S) aur Firaun: Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke aur Firaun ke darmiyan jo guftagu hui us ka zikr ho raha hai ke Allah ke Kaleem ne farmaya ke ae Firaun main Rabb-ul-Aalameen ka Rasool hoon. Jo tamam aalam ka Khaliq-o-Malik hai. Mujhe yahi laiq hai ke Allah Ta'ala ke bare mein wahi baatein kahoon jo sarasar haq hon. "Ba" aur "Ala" yeh muta'aqib hua karte hain jaise rameetu bil-qaus aur rameetu alal-qaus waghera. Aur baaz mufassireen kehte hain haqeeqi ke ma'ani hareez ke hain. Yeh ma'ani bhi bayan kiye gaye hain ke mujh par wajib aur haq hai ke Allah Zul-Manan ka naam le kar wahi khabar doon jo haq-o-sadaqat wali ho kyunke main Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki azmat se waqif hoon. Main apni sadaqat ki ilahi daleel bhi sath hi laya hoon. Toh qaum-e-Bani Israel ko apne mazalim se azaad kar de, unhein apni zabardasti ki ghulami se nikal de, unhein un ke Rabb ki ibadat karne de, yeh ek zabardast buzurg paighambar ki nasl se hain yani Hazrat Yaqub bin Ishaq bin Hazrat Ibrahim Khalilullah (Alaihis-Salatu-Wassalam) ki aulad hain. Firaun ne kaha main tujhe saccha nahin samajhta na teri talab poori karoon ga aur agar tu apne da'we mein waqai hi saccha hai toh koi mo'jiza pesh kar.

Asa-e-Musa aur Firaun: Aap ne Firaun ki is talab par apne haath ki lakri zameen par daal di jo bohat bara saanp ban gayi aur munh phaare Firaun ki taraf lapki, woh maaray khauf ke takht par se kood gaya aur faryad karne laga ke Musa Allah ke liye ise rok, us ne is qadar apna munh khola tha ke neeche ka jabra toh zameen par tha aur oopar ka jabra mehal ki bulandi par. Khauf ke maaray Firaun ki hawa nikal gayi aur cheekhne laga ke Musa ise rok le, main imaan lata hoon aur iqrar karta hoon ke Bani Israel ko tere saath kar doonga. Hazrat Musa ne usi waqt is par haath rakha aur usi waqt lakri jaisi lakri ban gaya. Hazrat Wahab farmate hain Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko dekhte hi Firaun kehne laga main tujhe pehchanta hoon. Aap ne farmaya yaqeenan us ne kaha tu ne bachpan hamare ghar ke tukron par hi toh guzara hai. Is ka jawab Hazrat Musa de hi rahe thay ke us ne kaha ise giraftar kar lo. Aap ne jhat se apni lakri zameen par daal di jis ne saanp ban kar un par hamla kar diya is bad-hawasi mein ek dusre ko kuchalte aur qatl karte hue woh sab ke sab bhagay chunancha pachees hazar aadmi isi hangamay mein ek dusre ke hathon maray gaye aur Firaun seedha apne ghar mein ghus gaya lekin is waqia ke bayan ki sanad mein gharabat hai wallahu a'lam. Isi tarah dusra mojiza aap ne yeh zahir kiya ke apna haath apni chadar mein daal kar nikala toh baghair is ke ke koi rog ya baras ya daagh ho woh safed chamakta hua ban kar nikal aaya jise har ek ne dekha phir haath andar kiya toh jaisa tha waisa hi ho gaya.

Darbariyon se mashware hue! Jab dar khauf jata raha Firaun phir se apne takht par aa baitha aur darbariyon ke ausan durust hogaye toh Firaun ne kaha bhai mujhe toh yeh jadugar lagta hai aur hai bhi bada ustad. In logon ne is ki ta'eed ki aur kaha huzoor durust farma rahe hain. Ab mashware karne lage ke agar yeh mamla yunhi raha toh log is ki taraf mail hojayenge aur jab yeh quwwat pakdega toh hum se badshahat chheen lega humein jalawatan kar dega batao kya karna chahiye? Allah ki shaan hai jis se khauf khaya wahi samne aaya.

Darbariyon ka mashwara: Darbariyon ne mashwara diya ke in dono bhaiyon ka mamla toh is waqt dafa karo, ise multavi rakho aur mulk ke har hisse mein harkaray bhej do jo jadugaron ko jama kar ke aap ke darbar mein layein. Toh jab tamam ustad-e-fan jadugar aa jayein un se muqabla karaya jaye toh yeh haar jayega aur munh dikhane ke qabil na rahega, yeh agar jadu jaanta hai toh hamari riyaya mein jadugaron ki kya kami hai? Bade bade mahir jadugar hum mein maujood hain jo apne fan mein be-nazeer hain aur bahut chust-o-chalak hain. Chunancha Hazrat Musa (A.S) se kaha gaya ke hum samajh gaye ke tu jadu ke zor se hamein hamare mulk se nikal dene ke irade se aaya hai toh agar tujh mein koi sakt hai toh aa haath mila hum tujh se muqable ka din aur jagah muqarrar karte hain aur jagah muqarrar hojaye phir jo bhage wahi haara. Aap (A.S) ne farmaya achha yeh hawas bhi nikal lo. Jao tumhara eid ka din mujhe manzoor hai aur din chadhe ujalay ka waqt aur shart yeh ke yeh muqabla majma-e-aam mein ho. Chunancha Firaun is tayari mein masroof hogaya.

Jadugaron se muqabla: Jadugaron ko apni quwwat par bada ghamand tha, woh sab fil-haqiqat apne is fan ke lajawab ustad thay. Is liye unhon ne aate hi Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko challenge diya ke lo hoshiyar ho jao, tumhein ikhtiyar hai maidan mein apne kartab pehle dikhao aur agar kaho to pehal hum kar dein. Aap (A.S) ne farmaya behtar hai ke tumhare hosle nikal jayen aur log tumhara kamal-e-fan dekh lein aur phir Allah ki qudrat ko bhi dekh lein aur haq-o-batil mein dekh bhal kar faisla kar sakein. Woh to yeh chahte hi thay, unhon ne jhat se apni rassiyan aur lakriyan nikal nikal kar maidan mein dalni shuru kar dein. Idhar woh maidan mein parte hi chalti phirti aur bani banai saanp maloom hone lagein. Yeh sirf nazar bandi thi. Fil-waqay kharij mein un ka wajood badal nahin gaya tha balkay is tarah logon ko dikhai deti thin ke goya zinda hain. Hazrat Musa (A.S) apne dil mein khatra mehsoos karne lage. Allah ki taraf se usi waqt wahi aayi ke khauf na kar, tu hi ghalib rahe ga. Apne dayen hath ki lakri daal to sahi, un ka kiya dhara yeh to sab harap kar jaye gi. Yeh sab to jadugari ka karishma hai, bhala jadu wale bhi kabhi kamyab huye hain? Bari moti moti rassiyan aur lambi lambi lakriyan unhon ne dali thin jo sab chalti phirti, daurti bhagti maloom ho rahi thin. Yeh jadugar pandrah hazar ya tees hazar se oopar oopar thay ya sattar hazar ki tadaad mein thay, har ek apne sath rassiyan aur lakriyan laya tha, saff basta kharay thay aur log charon taraf majood thay, har ek hama-tan shauq bana hua tha. Firaun apne lao-lashkar aur darbariyon samet bare raub se apne takht par baitha hua tha. Idhar waqt hua, idhar sab ki nigahon ne dekha ke ek darwesh sifat Allah ka Nabi apne sath apne bhai ko liye huye lakri tikate huye aa rahe hain. Yeh thay jin ke muqable ki yeh dhoom dham thi. Aap (A.S) ke aate hi jadugaron ne sirf yeh daryaft kar ke ke ibtida kis ki taraf se honi chahiye, khud ibtida kar di. Hazrat Musa (A.S) ki, phir Firaun ki, phir tamashaiyon ki aankhon par jadu kar ke sab ko haibat zada kar diya. Ab jo apni apni rassiyan aur lathiyan phenkein to hazar-ha ki tadaad mein paharon ke barabar saanp nazar aane lage jo oopar talay ek dusre se lipat rahe hain, idhar udhar daur rahe hain, maidan bhar gaya hai. Unhon ne apne fan ka poora muzahira kar dikhaya.

Jadugar sajda-rez ho gaye. Isi maidan mein jadugaron ke is hamle ke sath hi Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi ko bazariya-e-wahi hukum farmaya ke apne dayen hath se lakri ko sirf zameen par gira, woh isi waqt un ke sare hi laghwiyat hazam kar jayegi. Chunancha yahi hua. Aap ki lakri ne azdaha ban kar sare maidan ko saaf kar diya, jo kuch wahan tha sab ko harap kar gaya. Ek bhi cheez ab maidan mein nazar na aati thi. Phir Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne jahan is pe hath rakha waisi ki waisi lakri ban gayi. Yeh dekhte hi jadugar samajh gaye ke yeh jadu nahin, yeh to sach-much Allah ki taraf se mojiza hai. Firaun seekh-pa ho gaya. Jadugaron ke is tarah majma-e-aam mein haar jaane phir is tarah sab ke saamne bedharak Islam qabool kar lene se Firaun aag bagola ho gaya aur is asar ko rokne ke liye sab se pehle toh un musalmanon se kehne laga tumhara bhed mujh par khul gaya hai tum sab ma'a Musa (A.S) ke ek hi ho yeh tumhara ustad hai tum is ke shagird ho tum ne aapas mein pehle yeh tay kiya ke bhai tu pehle chala ja phir hum aa jayenge is tarah maidan qaim ho hum masnooi ladai lad kar haar jayenge aur is tarah is mulk ke asli bashindon ko yahan se nikal bahar karenge. Firaun ke is jhoot par Allah ki maar hai. Koi bewaqoof insaan bhi is ke ek jumla ko bhi sahih nahin samajh sakta. Sab ko maloom tha Musa (A.S) apna bachpan Firaun ke mahal mein guzarte hain, is ke baad Madyan mein umar ka ek hissa basar karte hain, Madyan se seedhe Misr ko pahunch kar apni nabuwwat ka elaan karte hain aur mojze dikhate hain jin se aajiz aa kar Firaun apne jadugaron ko jama karta hai woh barah-e-raast is ki sipah ke saath is ke darbar mein pesh hote hain inaam-o-ikraam ke lalach se un ke dil badhaye jaate hain woh apni fatah-mandi ka yaqeen dilate hain Firaun unhein apni razamandi ka yaqeen dilata hai khoob tayariyan kar ke maidan jamate hain Hazrat Musa (A.S) un mein se ek se bhi waqif nahin kabhi na kisi ko dekha hai na suna hai na mile hain na jaante hain. Lekin wazire chunein shahryare chunaan wahan toh un logon ka majma tha ke Firaun ne jab kaha ke main Rabb-e-Aala hoon toh sab ne gardanein jhuka kar kaha beshak huzoor aap khuda hain toh aise jahalat ke palindon se koi baat manwa leni kya mushkil thi? Is ke ra'ab mein aa kar imaan laane ka irada badla aur samajh baithe ke waqai Firaun theek keh raha hai. Ek qaul yeh hai ke Musa (A.S) ne jadugaron ke ameer se farmaya ke agar main ghalib aa jaaun toh kya tu mujh par imaan layega? Us ne kaha aaj maidan mein hamari janib jo jadoo pesh kiya jayega is ka jawab sari makhlooq ke paas nahin toh agar is par ghalib aa gaya toh mujhe beshak yaqeen ho jayega ke woh jadoo nahin mojza hai. Yeh guftagu Firaun ke kanon tak pahunchi ise yeh dohra raha hai ke tum ne mili bhagat kar li. Is tarah logon ke dil haqaniyat se hata kar unhein badzan karne ke liye dusri chaal yeh chalta aur kehta hai ke tum apne ekke, ittefaq aur posheeda jaal se chahte yeh ho ke hamari daulat-o-shaukat cheen lo hamhein yahan se nikal bahar karo, is tarah apni qaum ke dil un ki taraf se pher kar phir unhein khaufzada karne ke liye chauthi chaal chalta hai ke un nau-muslimon se kehta hai ke dekho toh tumhein abhi maloom ho jayega ke sau mein kitne bees hote hain. Mujhe bhi qasam hai jo tumhare haath paanv na katwaye aur woh bhi ulti tarah yani pehle agar seedha haath kaata jaye toh phir bayan paanv aur agar pehle seedha paanv kaata gaya toh phir ulta haath. Isi tarah bedast-o-pa kar ke khajuron ki shakhon par latka doonga. Tareekh se pata chalta hai ke is zalim badshah se pehle in dono sazaon ka riwaj na tha.

Yeh dhamki de kar woh samajhta tha ke ab yeh narm par jayenge lekin woh toh imaan mein aur pukhta hogaye, bil-ittifaq jawab dete hain ke achha daraya? Yahan se toh wapas Allah ke paas jana hi hai usi ke qabza-o-qudrat mein sab kuch hai aaj agar teri sazaon se bach gaye toh kya Allah ke haan ki sazayein bhi maaf ho jayengi? Hamare nazdeek toh duniya ki sazayein bhugat lena ba-nisbat aakhirat ke azaab ke bhugatne ke bahut hi aasaan hai. Tu hum se Allah ke Nabi ka muqabla karachuka hai lekin ab jabke hum par haq wazeh hogaya hum is par imaan le aaye toh tu charh raha hai. Kehne ko toh yeh sab kuch keh gaye lekin phir khayal aaya ke kahin hamara qadam phisal na jaye is liye dua mein dil khol diya ke Aye Allah hamein sabr ata farma, sabit qadmi de, hamein Islam par hi maut de, tere Nabi Hazrat Musa (A.S) ki itteba karte hue hi duniya se rukhsat hon. Aisa na ho is zalim ke raub mein ya is ki dhamkiyon mein aa jayen ya sazaon se dar jayen ya un ke bardasht ki taab na layen. In duaon ke baad dil barh jate hain, himmatein dugni hojati hain Firaun ki aankhon mein aankhein daal kar kehte hain tujhe jo karna hai is mein kami na kar, kasar utha na rakh, jo jee mein hai kar guzar tu duniya hi mein sazayein de sakta hai. Hum sabr kar lenge kya ajab ke hamare imaan ki wajah se Allah hamari khatayein maaf farmaye khususan abhi ki yeh khata ke hum ne jhoot se sach ka muqabla kiya. Beshak Allah behtar hai aur zyada baqi hai. Gunahgaron ke liye is ke haan Jahannam ki saza hai jahan na maut aaye na kaar-amad zindagi ho. Aur mominon ke liye is ke paas jannatein hain jahan bare buland darje hain. SubhanAllah yeh log din ke ibtidai hisse mein kafir aur jadugar the aur isi din ke aakhri hisse mein momin balkeh nek shaheed the.

Mujhe bhi qasam hai jo tumhare haath paanv na katwaye aur woh bhi ulti tarah yani pehle agar seedha haath kaata jaye toh phir bayan paanv aur agar pehle seedha paanv kaata gaya toh phir ulta haath. Isi tarah bedast-o-pa kar ke khajuron ki shakhon par latka doonga. Tareekh se pata chalta hai ke is zalim badshah se pehle in dono sazaon ka riwaj na tha.

Yeh dhamki de kar woh samajhta tha ke ab yeh narm par jayenge lekin woh toh imaan mein aur pukhta hogaye, bil-ittifaq jawab dete hain ke achha daraya? Yahan se toh wapas Allah ke paas jana hi hai usi ke qabza-o-qudrat mein sab kuch hai aaj agar teri sazaon se bach gaye toh kya Allah ke haan ki sazayein bhi maaf ho jayengi? Hamare nazdeek toh duniya ki sazayein bhugat lena ba-nisbat aakhirat ke azaab ke bhugatne ke bahut hi aasaan hai. Tu hum se Allah ke Nabi ka muqabla karachuka hai lekin ab jabke hum par haq wazeh hogaya hum is par imaan le aaye toh tu charh raha hai. Kehne ko toh yeh sab kuch keh gaye lekin phir khayal aaya ke kahin hamara qadam phisal na jaye is liye dua mein dil khol diya ke Aye Allah hamein sabr ata farma, sabit qadmi de, hamein Islam par hi maut de, tere Nabi Hazrat Musa (A.S) ki itteba karte hue hi duniya se rukhsat hon. Aisa na ho is zalim ke raub mein ya is ki dhamkiyon mein aa jayen ya sazaon se dar jayen ya un ke bardasht ki taab na layen. In duaon ke baad dil barh jate hain, himmatein dugni hojati hain Firaun ki aankhon mein aankhein daal kar kehte hain tujhe jo karna hai is mein kami na kar, kasar utha na rakh, jo jee mein hai kar guzar tu duniya hi mein sazayein de sakta hai. Hum sabr kar lenge kya ajab ke hamare imaan ki wajah se Allah hamari khatayein maaf farmaye khususan abhi ki yeh khata ke hum ne jhoot se sach ka muqabla kiya. Beshak Allah behtar hai aur zyada baqi hai. Gunahgaron ke liye is ke haan Jahannam ki saza hai jahan na maut aaye na kaar-amad zindagi ho. Aur mominon ke liye is ke paas jannatein hain jahan bare buland darje hain. SubhanAllah yeh log din ke ibtidai hisse mein kafir aur jadugar the aur isi din ke aakhri hisse mein momin balkeh nek shaheed the.

Firaun seekh-pa ho gaya. Jadugaron ke is tarah majma-e-aam mein haar jaane phir is tarah sab ke saamne bedharak Islam qabool kar lene se Firaun aag bagola ho gaya aur is asar ko rokne ke liye sab se pehle toh un musalmanon se kehne laga tumhara bhed mujh par khul gaya hai tum sab ma'a Musa (A.S) ke ek hi ho yeh tumhara ustad hai tum is ke shagird ho tum ne aapas mein pehle yeh tay kiya ke bhai tu pehle chala ja phir hum aa jayenge is tarah maidan qaim ho hum masnooi ladai lad kar haar jayenge aur is tarah is mulk ke asli bashindon ko yahan se nikal bahar karenge. Firaun ke is jhoot par Allah ki maar hai. Koi bewaqoof insaan bhi is ke ek jumla ko bhi sahih nahin samajh sakta. Sab ko maloom tha Musa (A.S) apna bachpan Firaun ke mahal mein guzarte hain, is ke baad Madyan mein umar ka ek hissa basar karte hain, Madyan se seedhe Misr ko pahunch kar apni nabuwwat ka elaan karte hain aur mojze dikhate hain jin se aajiz aa kar Firaun apne jadugaron ko jama karta hai woh barah-e-raast is ki sipah ke saath is ke darbar mein pesh hote hain inaam-o-ikraam ke lalach se un ke dil badhaye jaate hain woh apni fatah-mandi ka yaqeen dilate hain Firaun unhein apni razamandi ka yaqeen dilata hai khoob tayariyan kar ke maidan jamate hain Hazrat Musa (A.S) un mein se ek se bhi waqif nahin kabhi na kisi ko dekha hai na suna hai na mile hain na jaante hain. Lekin wazire chunein shahryare chunaan wahan toh un logon ka majma tha ke Firaun ne jab kaha ke main Rabb-e-Aala hoon toh sab ne gardanein jhuka kar kaha beshak huzoor aap khuda hain toh aise jahalat ke palindon se koi baat manwa leni kya mushkil thi? Is ke ra'ab mein aa kar imaan laane ka irada badla aur samajh baithe ke waqai Firaun theek keh raha hai. Ek qaul yeh hai ke Musa (A.S) ne jadugaron ke ameer se farmaya ke agar main ghalib aa jaaun toh kya tu mujh par imaan layega? Us ne kaha aaj maidan mein hamari janib jo jadoo pesh kiya jayega is ka jawab sari makhlooq ke paas nahin toh agar is par ghalib aa gaya toh mujhe beshak yaqeen ho jayega ke woh jadoo nahin mojza hai. Aakhri harba baghawat ka ilzaam. Firaun aur Firauniyat ne Hazrat Musa (A.S) aur musalmanon ke khilaf jo mansoobay sochay un ka bayan ho raha hai ke ek dusray ko in musalmanon ke khilaf ubhartay rahay, kehnay lagay yeh toh aap ki ri'aya ko behkatay hain, baghawat phaila dein ge, mulk mein bad-amni paida karein ge, in ka zaroor aur jald koi intezam karna chahiye. Allah ki shaan dekhiye kya musleh banay huay hain ke Allah ke Rasool aur mominon ke fasaad se duniya ko bachana chahtay hain halankeh mufsid aur bad-nafs khud hain. Aayat (Wa-yazaruka) mein ba'az toh kehtay hain Wao-e-haliya hai yani dar-aan-haalikah Musa (A.S) aur qoum-e-Musa (A.S) ne teri parastish chhor rakhi hai phir bhi tu unhein zinda rehnay deta hai? Hazrat Ubay bin Ka'ab (R.A) ki qira'at mein hai aayat (Wa-qad tarakuka an ya'budu aalihataka) aur qaul hai ke Wao-e-aatifa hai yani tu ne unhein chhor rakha hai. Jis fasaad ko yeh barpa kar rahay hain aur teray maboodon ke chhornay par uksa rahay hain. Ba'az ki qira'at 'Aalihataka' hai yani teri ibadat se, ba'az ka bayan hai ke Firaun bhi kisi ko pooja karta tha. Ek qaul hai ke usay woh posheeda raaz mein rakhta tha, ek riwayat mein hai ke us ka but us ki gardan mein hi latakta rehta tha jisay yeh sajda karta tha. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke kisi behtareen gaye par Firaun ki nigah par jati toh logon se keh deta ke is ki parastish karo. Isi liye Samri ne bhi Bani Israel ke liye bachhra nikala. Al-gharaz apnay sardaron ki baat sun kar Firaun jawab deta hai ke ab se in ke liye hum ahkaam jaari karein ge ke in ke haan jo aulad ho dekh li jaye. Agar larka ho toh qatl kar diya jaye, larki ho toh zinda chhor di jaye. Pehlay sarkash Firaun in masakeen ke sath yahi kar chuka tha jabkeh usay yeh manzoor tha ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) paida hi na hon. Lekin Allah Ta'ala ka irada ghalib aaya aur Hazrat Musa (A.S) bawajood us ke hukum ke zinda-o-salim bachay rahay. Ab dobara us ne yahi qanoon jaari kar diya taake Bani Israel ki jam'iyat toot jaye, yeh kamzor par jayein aur bil-aakhir in ka naam mit jaye lekin qudrat ne is ka bhi khilaf kar dikhaya, isi ko aur us ki qoum ko gharat kar diya aur Bani Israel ko auj-o-taraqqi par pohancha diya. Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne is takabbur ke muqablay mein tahammul aur us ke zulm ke muqablay mein sabr se kaam liya, apni qoum ko samjhaya aur bataya ke Allah farma chuka hai ke lihaaz se tum hi achhay raho ge, tum Allah se madad chaho aur sabr karo. Qoum walon ne kaha ae Allah ke Nabi! Aap ki nabuwwat se pehlay bhi hum is tarah sataye jatay rahay, isi zillat-o-ihanat mein mubtala rahay aur ab phir yahi naubat aayi hai. Aap ne mazeed tasalli di aur farmaya ke ghabrao nahin. Yaqeen mano ke tumhara bad-khwah halak hoga aur tum ko Allah Ta'ala auj par pohanchaye ga. Is waqt woh dekhay ga ke kaun kitna shukr baja lata hai? Takleef ka hat jana, rahat ka mil jana insaan ko nihaal-nihaal kar deta hai, yeh pooray shukriye ka waqt hota hai.

Siyah dil log iqrar ke baad inkar karte rahe, un ki sarkashi aur zid dekhiye ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) se saaf kehte hain ke aap khwah kitni hi daleelein pesh karein, kaise hi mojze batayein hum iman lane wale nahin. Hum jante hain ke yeh sab aap ke jadoo ke karishme hain. Un par toofan aaya, bakasrat barishein barsein jis se phal aur anaaj tabah ho gaye aur isi se waba aur ta'oon ki bimari phail padi. Isi liye ba'az mufassireen ne kaha hai toofan se murad maut hai. Ba'az kehte hain koi zabardast aasmani aafat aayi thi jis ne unhein gher liya tha. Tiddiyon ki museebat un par aayi. Yeh ek halal janwar hai. Abdullah bin Abi Aufa (R.A) se sawal hua to aap ne farmaya saat ghazwe main ne Rasool-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke saath kiye hain. Har ek mein hum to tiddiyan khate rahe. Musnad-e-Ahmad aur Ibn-e-Majah mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain do murde aur do khoon hamare liye halal kiye gaye hain, machli aur tiddi aur kaleji aur tilli. Abu Dawood mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se tiddi ki nisbat sawal hua to aap ne farmaya Allah ke lashkar bahut se hain jinhein na khata hoon na haram kehta hoon. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jee na chahne ki wajah se ise chhod diya jaise ke goh aap ne nahin khaya halankeh dusron ko is ke khane ki ijazat marhamat farmayi. Hafiz Ibn-e-Asakir (Rahimahullah / R.H) ne ek mustaqil risala isi mein tasneef farmaya hai, is mein ek riwayat yeh bhi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tiddi nahin khate the aur na gurde khate the aur na goh. Lekin unhein aap ne haram nahin kiya. Tiddi is wajah se ke woh azab hai, gurde is wajah se ke yeh peshab ke qareeb hain aur goh is wajah se ke aap ko khauf tha ke kahin yeh maskh shuda ummat na ho, phir yeh riwayat bhi ghareeb hai sirf yahi ek sanad hai. Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) tiddi ko badi raghbat se khaya karte, talash kar ke mangwaya karte. Chunancha kisi ne aap se masla pucha ke tiddi khai jaye? Aap ne farmaya kaash ke ek do pees mil jatin to kaise maze se khate. Ibn-e-Majah mein hai ke Ummahat-ul-Momineen to tabaqon mein laga kar tiddiyan hadiye aur tohfe ke taur par bhejti thin. Imam Baghawi ek riwayat laye hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Hazrat Maryam bint-e-Imran (Alaihimas Salam) ne Allah Ta'ala se dua ki ke aisa gosht mujhe khila jis mein khoon na ho, Allah Ta'ala ne unhein tiddi khilayi. Aap ne un ke liye dua ki ke aye Allah ise baghair doodh peene ke zindagi de aur is ki aulad ko baghair aawaz nikale is ke peeche laga de. Ek bahut hi ghareeb hadith mein hai tiddiyon ko maro nahin yeh Allah Ta'ala ka bada lashkar hai. Mujahid farmate hain yeh tiddiyan un ke darwazon ki keelein kha jati thin aur lakdi chhod deti thin aur Za'i kehte hain main ek din jungle mein tha kya dekhta hoon ke tiddiyan bahut si aasman ki taraf hain aur un mein se ek tiddi par ek shakhs sawar hai jo hathiyar band hai, jo jis taraf ishara karta hai sari tiddiyan us taraf ko jhuk jati hain aur woh zaban se barabar keh raha hai ke duniya batil hai aur is mein jo hai woh bhi batil hai.

Shuraih Qazi farmate hain is janwar mein saat mukhtalif janwaron ki shaan hai, is ka sar go ghore jaisa hai, gardan bail jaisi hai, seena sher jaisa hai, par gidh jaise hain, par oont jaise hain, dum saanp ki tarah ki hai. Pait bichhoo jaisa hai. Aayat (Uhill lakum saidul bahri wa ta'amuhu mata'al lakum wa lissayyara, wa hurrima alaikum saidul barri ma dumtum huruma, wattaqullaha allazi ilaihi tuhsharun) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 96) ki tafsir mein yeh riwayat guzar chuki hai ke hum Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath Hajj ya Umre mein ja rahe thay to samne se hamain tiddi dal mila, hum ne ehram ki halat mein unhain lakriyon se marna shuru kiya, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal karne par aap ne farmaya dar-yayi shikar mein mohrim ko koi haraj nahin. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab in tiddiyon ke liye bad-dua karte to farmate: Aye Allah jitni in mein se bari hain to unhain sab ko halak kar daal aur jitni choti hain sab ko qatl kar daal, in ke ande kharab kar de, in ki nasl kaat de, in ke munh hamari rozi se rok le, hamain roziyan ata farma, beshak tu duaon ka sunne wala hai. Is par Hazrat Jabir (R.A) ne arz kiya ya Rasool Allah! Allah ke ek lashkar ke gharat-o-barbad ho jane ki aap dua karte hain? To aap ne farmaya ke yeh to samandar ke andar ki machliyon ka naak jhaaran hai. Chunancha ba'az logon ne ise machli mein se isi tarah nikalte dekha hai. Jab machli samandar ke kinare ande de jati hai, wahan se jab pani hat jata hai aur dhoop parne lagti hai to woh ande sab ke sab phoot jate hain aur in mein se tiddiyan nikalti hain jo parwaz kar jati hain. Aayat-e-Quran (Illa umamun amsalukum) ki tafsir mein Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ki woh hadith hum ne bayan kar di hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne ek hazar ummatain paida ki hain jin mein se chhe sau tari mein hain aur char sau khushki mein. Sab se pehle halakat tiddiyon ki hogi. Imam Abu Bakr bin Abu Dawood ek hadith laye hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya lakri talwar ke muqable par kuch nahin aur darakht ki chhaal tiddi ke muqable mein kuch nahin, yeh hadith ghareeb hai. Qatl ke bare mein Ibn Abbas (R.A) se manqool hai ke yeh woh siyah rang ke chote chote janwar hain jo gehun mein se nikalte hain aur qaul hai ke yeh bhi ek qism ki be-par ki tiddiyan hain. Saeed kehte hain siyah rang ke chote se keere hain. Is ka wahid Qummal hai. Yeh janwar jab oont ko chimat jate hain to use halak kar dete hain. Al-gharaz aise hi moozi janwar ba-surat-e-azab Firauniyon ke liye bheje gaye thay. Firaun ki sarkashi aur inkar par toofan aaya jis se unhain yaqeen ho gaya ke yeh Allah ka azab hai. Gar-gara kar Hazrat Musa (A.S) se arz karne lage ke Allah se dua kijiye yeh musla-dhar pani ruk jaye to hum aap par iman layenge aur Bani Israel ko aap ke sath kar denge. Aap ne dua ki toofan hat gaya to yeh apne wade se phir gaye.

Phir Allah ki shaan hai ke khetiyan aur baghaat is qadar phale ke is se pehle kabhi aise nahin phale thay. Jab tayyar hogaye toh tiddiyon ka azaab aaya, ise dekh kar phir ghabraye aur Musa A.S se arz karne lage ke Allah se dua kijiye ke yeh azaab hata le, ab hum pukhta wada karte hain. Aap ki dua se yeh azaab bhi hat gaya lekin unhon ne phir wada shikni ki. Faslein kaat laye, khaliyan utha liye. Lekin Allah Ta'ala ka azaab phir aur shakal mein aaya, tamam anaaj waghera mein keeda lag gaya. Is qadar bakasrat yeh janwar phail gaye ke das paimane lekar koi shakhs paswane nikalta toh paswaye tak woh janwar saat paimane kha lete. Ghabra kar Nabi A.S ki taraf mutawajja hue, phir wade kiye, aap ne phir dua ki, Allah Ta'ala ne is aafat ko bhi hata liya. Lekin unhon ne phir beimani ki, na Bani Israel ko raha kiya na imaan qabool kiya. Is par mendkon ka azaab aaya. Darbar mein Firaun baitha hua hai toh wahin mendak zahir ho kar tarane laga, samajh gaye ke yeh nayi shakal ka azaab-e-Ilahi hai. Ab yeh phailne aur badhne shuru hue yahan tak ke aadmi baithta toh us ki gardan tak aas paas se use mendak gher lete. Jahan baat karne ke liye koi munh kholta ke mendak tarap kar us ke munh mein ghus jata. Phir tang aa kar Hazrat Musa A.S se is azaab ke hatne ki darkhwast ki aur iqrar kiya ke hum khud imaan layenge aur Bani Israel ko bhi azaad kar denge. Aap ne dua ki, Allah Ta'ala ne is museebat ko bhi dafa kar diya lekin phir mukar gaye. Chanancha un par khoon ka azaab aaya, tamam bartanon mein khoon, khane peene ki cheezon mein khoon, kunwein mein se paani nikalte toh khoon, talaab se paani layein toh khoon. Phir tarap uthe, Firaun ne kaha yeh bhi jaadu hai, lekin jab tang aa gaye toh aakhir Hazrat Musa A.S se ma'a wada darkhwast ki ke hum toh paani se taras gaye. Chanancha aap ne qaul-o-qarar le kar pur-zor dua ki aur Allah ne is azaab ko bhi hata liya lekin yeh phir munkir hogaye. Firaun jab maidan se nakam wapas lauta tha us ne thaan li thi ke khwah kuch bhi ho main imaan na launga. Chanancha toofan ki wajah se bhookon marne lage, phir tiddiyon ka azaab aaya toh darakht toh kya ghar ki chaukhaten aur darwazon tak woh kha gayin, makanat girne lage. Phir Hazrat Musa A.S ne Allah ke hukum se ek patthar par lakdi maari jis mein se beshumar chichriyan nikal parin aur phail gayin. Khana, peena, sona, baithna, sab band hogaya. Phir mendkon ka azaab aaya, jahan dekho mendak nazar aane lage. Phir khoon ka azaab aaya, nahrein, talaab, kunwein, matke ghare waghera garz bajaye paani ke khoon hi khoon sab cheezein hogayin. Ubaidullah bin Amr farmate hain mendak ko na maaro, yeh jab ba-surat-e-azaab Firauniyon ke paas aaye toh ek ne Allah ki raza joi ke liye tanoor mein chhalang maari. Allah ne us ke badle unhein paani ki thandak ata farmayi aur un ki aawaz ko apni tasbeeh banaya. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke khoon se murad naseer phootna hai. Al-garz har azaab ko dekh kar iqrar karte lekin jab Hazrat Musa A.S ki dua se woh hat jata toh phir inkaar kar jate.

Aayat (Uhill lakum saidul bahri wa ta'amuhu mata'al lakum wa lissayyara, wa hurrima alaikum saidul barri ma dumtum huruma, wattaqullaha allazi ilaihi tuhsharun) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 96) ki tafsir mein yeh riwayat guzar chuki hai ke hum Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath Hajj ya Umre mein ja rahe thay to samne se hamain tiddi dal mila, hum ne ehram ki halat mein unhain lakriyon se marna shuru kiya, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal karne par aap ne farmaya dar-yayi shikar mein mohrim ko koi haraj nahin. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab in tiddiyon ke liye bad-dua karte to farmate: Aye Allah jitni in mein se bari hain to unhain sab ko halak kar daal aur jitni choti hain sab ko qatl kar daal, in ke ande kharab kar de, in ki nasl kaat de, in ke munh hamari rozi se rok le, hamain roziyan ata farma, beshak tu duaon ka sunne wala hai. Is par Hazrat Jabir (R.A) ne arz kiya ya Rasool Allah! Allah ke ek lashkar ke gharat-o-barbad ho jane ki aap dua karte hain? To aap ne farmaya ke yeh to samandar ke andar ki machliyon ka naak jhaaran hai. Chunancha ba'az logon ne ise machli mein se isi tarah nikalte dekha hai. Jab machli samandar ke kinare ande de jati hai, wahan se jab pani hat jata hai aur dhoop parne lagti hai to woh ande sab ke sab phoot jate hain aur in mein se tiddiyan nikalti hain jo parwaz kar jati hain. Aayat-e-Quran (Illa umamun amsalukum) ki tafsir mein Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A) ki woh hadith hum ne bayan kar di hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne ek hazar ummatain paida ki hain jin mein se chhe sau tari mein hain aur char sau khushki mein. Sab se pehle halakat tiddiyon ki hogi. Imam Abu Bakr bin Abu Dawood ek hadith laye hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya lakri talwar ke muqable par kuch nahin aur darakht ki chhaal tiddi ke muqable mein kuch nahin, yeh hadith ghareeb hai. Qatl ke bare mein Ibn Abbas (R.A) se manqool hai ke yeh woh siyah rang ke chote chote janwar hain jo gehun mein se nikalte hain aur qaul hai ke yeh bhi ek qism ki be-par ki tiddiyan hain. Saeed kehte hain siyah rang ke chote se keere hain. Is ka wahid Qummal hai. Yeh janwar jab oont ko chimat jate hain to use halak kar dete hain. Al-gharaz aise hi moozi janwar ba-surat-e-azab Firauniyon ke liye bheje gaye thay. Firaun ki sarkashi aur inkar par toofan aaya jis se unhain yaqeen ho gaya ke yeh Allah ka azab hai. Gar-gara kar Hazrat Musa (A.S) se arz karne lage ke Allah se dua kijiye yeh musla-dhar pani ruk jaye to hum aap par iman layenge aur Bani Israel ko aap ke sath kar denge. Aap ne dua ki toofan hat gaya to yeh apne wade se phir gaye.

Phir Allah ki shaan hai ke khetiyan aur baghaat is qadar phale ke is se pehle kabhi aise nahin phale thay. Jab tayyar hogaye toh tiddiyon ka azaab aaya, ise dekh kar phir ghabraye aur Musa A.S se arz karne lage ke Allah se dua kijiye ke yeh azaab hata le, ab hum pukhta wada karte hain. Aap ki dua se yeh azaab bhi hat gaya lekin unhon ne phir wada shikni ki. Faslein kaat laye, khaliyan utha liye. Lekin Allah Ta'ala ka azaab phir aur shakal mein aaya, tamam anaaj waghera mein keeda lag gaya. Is qadar bakasrat yeh janwar phail gaye ke das paimane lekar koi shakhs paswane nikalta toh paswaye tak woh janwar saat paimane kha lete. Ghabra kar Nabi A.S ki taraf mutawajja hue, phir wade kiye, aap ne phir dua ki, Allah Ta'ala ne is aafat ko bhi hata liya. Lekin unhon ne phir beimani ki, na Bani Israel ko raha kiya na imaan qabool kiya. Is par mendkon ka azaab aaya. Darbar mein Firaun baitha hua hai toh wahin mendak zahir ho kar tarane laga, samajh gaye ke yeh nayi shakal ka azaab-e-Ilahi hai. Ab yeh phailne aur badhne shuru hue yahan tak ke aadmi baithta toh us ki gardan tak aas paas se use mendak gher lete. Jahan baat karne ke liye koi munh kholta ke mendak tarap kar us ke munh mein ghus jata. Phir tang aa kar Hazrat Musa A.S se is azaab ke hatne ki darkhwast ki aur iqrar kiya ke hum khud imaan layenge aur Bani Israel ko bhi azaad kar denge. Aap ne dua ki, Allah Ta'ala ne is museebat ko bhi dafa kar diya lekin phir mukar gaye. Chanancha un par khoon ka azaab aaya, tamam bartanon mein khoon, khane peene ki cheezon mein khoon, kunwein mein se paani nikalte toh khoon, talaab se paani layein toh khoon. Phir tarap uthe, Firaun ne kaha yeh bhi jaadu hai, lekin jab tang aa gaye toh aakhir Hazrat Musa A.S se ma'a wada darkhwast ki ke hum toh paani se taras gaye. Chanancha aap ne qaul-o-qarar le kar pur-zor dua ki aur Allah ne is azaab ko bhi hata liya lekin yeh phir munkir hogaye. Firaun jab maidan se nakam wapas lauta tha us ne thaan li thi ke khwah kuch bhi ho main imaan na launga. Chanancha toofan ki wajah se bhookon marne lage, phir tiddiyon ka azaab aaya toh darakht toh kya ghar ki chaukhaten aur darwazon tak woh kha gayin, makanat girne lage. Phir Hazrat Musa A.S ne Allah ke hukum se ek patthar par lakdi maari jis mein se beshumar chichriyan nikal parin aur phail gayin. Khana, peena, sona, baithna, sab band hogaya. Phir mendkon ka azaab aaya, jahan dekho mendak nazar aane lage. Phir khoon ka azaab aaya, nahrein, talaab, kunwein, matke ghare waghera garz bajaye paani ke khoon hi khoon sab cheezein hogayin. Ubaidullah bin Amr farmate hain mendak ko na maaro, yeh jab ba-surat-e-azaab Firauniyon ke paas aaye toh ek ne Allah ki raza joi ke liye tanoor mein chhalang maari. Allah ne us ke badle unhein paani ki thandak ata farmayi aur un ki aawaz ko apni tasbeeh banaya. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke khoon se murad naseer phootna hai. Al-garz har azaab ko dekh kar iqrar karte lekin jab Hazrat Musa A.S ki dua se woh hat jata toh phir inkaar kar jate.

Siyah dil log iqrar ke baad inkar karte rahe, un ki sarkashi aur zid dekhiye ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) se saaf kehte hain ke aap khwah kitni hi daleelein pesh karein, kaise hi mojze batayein hum iman lane wale nahin. Hum jante hain ke yeh sab aap ke jadoo ke karishme hain. Un par toofan aaya, bakasrat barishein barsein jis se phal aur anaaj tabah ho gaye aur isi se waba aur ta'oon ki bimari phail padi. Isi liye ba'az mufassireen ne kaha hai toofan se murad maut hai. Ba'az kehte hain koi zabardast aasmani aafat aayi thi jis ne unhein gher liya tha. Tiddiyon ki museebat un par aayi. Yeh ek halal janwar hai. Abdullah bin Abi Aufa (R.A) se sawal hua to aap ne farmaya saat ghazwe main ne Rasool-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke saath kiye hain. Har ek mein hum to tiddiyan khate rahe. Musnad-e-Ahmad aur Ibn-e-Majah mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain do murde aur do khoon hamare liye halal kiye gaye hain, machli aur tiddi aur kaleji aur tilli. Abu Dawood mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se tiddi ki nisbat sawal hua to aap ne farmaya Allah ke lashkar bahut se hain jinhein na khata hoon na haram kehta hoon. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jee na chahne ki wajah se ise chhod diya jaise ke goh aap ne nahin khaya halankeh dusron ko is ke khane ki ijazat marhamat farmayi. Hafiz Ibn-e-Asakir (Rahimahullah / R.H) ne ek mustaqil risala isi mein tasneef farmaya hai, is mein ek riwayat yeh bhi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tiddi nahin khate the aur na gurde khate the aur na goh. Lekin unhein aap ne haram nahin kiya. Tiddi is wajah se ke woh azab hai, gurde is wajah se ke yeh peshab ke qareeb hain aur goh is wajah se ke aap ko khauf tha ke kahin yeh maskh shuda ummat na ho, phir yeh riwayat bhi ghareeb hai sirf yahi ek sanad hai. Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) tiddi ko badi raghbat se khaya karte, talash kar ke mangwaya karte. Chunancha kisi ne aap se masla pucha ke tiddi khai jaye? Aap ne farmaya kaash ke ek do pees mil jatin to kaise maze se khate. Ibn-e-Majah mein hai ke Ummahat-ul-Momineen to tabaqon mein laga kar tiddiyan hadiye aur tohfe ke taur par bhejti thin. Imam Baghawi ek riwayat laye hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Hazrat Maryam bint-e-Imran (Alaihimas Salam) ne Allah Ta'ala se dua ki ke aisa gosht mujhe khila jis mein khoon na ho, Allah Ta'ala ne unhein tiddi khilayi. Aap ne un ke liye dua ki ke aye Allah ise baghair doodh peene ke zindagi de aur is ki aulad ko baghair aawaz nikale is ke peeche laga de. Ek bahut hi ghareeb hadith mein hai tiddiyon ko maro nahin yeh Allah Ta'ala ka bada lashkar hai. Mujahid farmate hain yeh tiddiyan un ke darwazon ki keelein kha jati thin aur lakdi chhod deti thin aur Za'i kehte hain main ek din jungle mein tha kya dekhta hoon ke tiddiyan bahut si aasman ki taraf hain aur un mein se ek tiddi par ek shakhs sawar hai jo hathiyar band hai, jo jis taraf ishara karta hai sari tiddiyan us taraf ko jhuk jati hain aur woh zaban se barabar keh raha hai ke duniya batil hai aur is mein jo hai woh bhi batil hai.

Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne is ke jawab mein farmaya tum Allah Ta'ala ki azmat-o-jalal se mehez na-waqif ho. Tum nahin jante ke Allah shareek-o-maseel se paak aur buland tar hai. Yeh log jis kaam mein mubtala hain woh tabah-kun hai aur in ka amal batil hai. Abu Waqid Laithi (R.A) ka bayan hai ke jab log Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath Makkah Sharif se Hunain ko rawana hue to raste mein unhein beri ka woh darakht mila jahan mushrikeen mujawar ban kar baitha karte thay aur apne hathiyar wahan latkaya karte thay, is ka naam Zaat-e-Anwat tha, to Sahaba ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se arz kiya ke ek Zaat-e-Anwat hamare liye bhi muqarrar kar dein. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya us ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri zaat hai ke tum ne qoum-e-Musa jaisi baat keh di ke hamare liye bhi mabood muqarrar kar dijiye jaisa in ka mabood hai. Jis ke jawab mein Hazrat Kaleemullah (A.S) ne farmaya tum jahil log ho, yeh log jis shughl mein hain woh halakat-khez hai aur jis kaam mein hain woh batil hai (Ibn-e-Jareer). Musnad-e-Ahmad ki riwayat mein hai ke yeh darkhwast karne wale Hazrat Abu Waqid Laithi (R.A) thay, jawab se pehle yeh sawal sun kar An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka Allahu Akbar kehna bhi marwi hai aur yeh bhi ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke tum bhi apne aglon ki si chaal chalne lage.

Maazi ki yaad-dihani unhein is gumrah khayali se rokne ke liye aap Allah Ta'ala ke ehsanat yaad dila rahe hain ke Firauniyon ki ghulami se Allah ne tumhein azadi dilwayi, zillat-o-ruswayi se chutkara diya. Phir auj-o-izzat ata farmayi, tumhare dekhte hue tumhare dushmanon ko gharat kar diya. Aise Rab ke siwa aur koi laiq-e-ibadat kaise ho sakta hai? Firaun ke waqt ki apni abtari ko bhool gaye jis se Allah ne nijat di. Is ki poori tafsir Surah Al-Baqarah mein guzar chuki hai.

Maazi ki yaad-dihani unhein is gumrah khayali se rokne ke liye aap Allah Ta'ala ke ehsanat yaad dila rahe hain ke Firauniyon ki ghulami se Allah ne tumhein azadi dilwayi, zillat-o-ruswayi se chutkara diya. Phir auj-o-izzat ata farmayi, tumhare dekhte hue tumhare dushmanon ko gharat kar diya. Aise Rab ke siwa aur koi laiq-e-ibadat kaise ho sakta hai? Firaun ke waqt ki apni abtari ko bhool gaye jis se Allah ne nijat di. Is ki poori tafsir Surah Al-Baqarah mein guzar chuki hai.

Ahsanat pe ahsanat. Allah Ta'ala Bani Israel ko apna woh ehsan yaad dilata hai jis ki wajah se Musa (A.S) ko sharaf-e-hum-kalami hasil hua aur Taurat mili jo un sab ke liye ba'is-e-hidayat-o-noor thi jis mein un ki shariat ki tafseel thi aur Allah ke tamam ahkaam majood thay. Tees raaton ka wada hua, aap ne yeh din rozon se guzarey. Waqt pura kar ke ek darakht ki chhaal ko chaba kar miswak ki. Hukam hua ke das aur pure kar ke pure chalis karo. Kehte hain ke ek mahina toh Zul-Qa'dah ka tha aur das din Zul-Hijjah ke. Toh Eid wale din woh wada pura hua aur isi din Allah ke kalam se aap ko sharaf mila, isi din Deen-e-Muhammadi bhi kamil hua hai. Jaise Allah ka farman hai ayat (Al-Yauma akmaltu lakum deenakum wa atmamtu alaikum ni'mati wa radhitu lakumul-Islama deena) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 3). Wada pura karne ke baad Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne Toor ka qasd kiya jaise aur ayat mein hai ke aye garoh-e-Bani Israel hum ne tumhein dushman se nijat di aur Toor-e-Aiman ka wada kiya. Aap ne jaate hue apne bhai Hazrat Haroon (A.S) ko apna khalifa banaya aur unhein islah ki aur fasad se bachne ki hidayat ki. Yeh sirf bator-e-wa'z ke tha warna Hazrat Haroon (A.S) bhi Allah ke sharif-o-karim aur zi-izzat paighambar thay. Salawatullahi wa salamuhu alaihi wa ala sa'ir.

Talab-e-ziyarat aur maut wa'ade ke mutabiq Hazrat Musa A.S Toor pahar par pohanche, Allah ka kalam suna to deedar ki aarzu ki, jawab mila ke yeh tere liye namumkin hai. Is se Mu'tazila ne istidlal kiya hai ke duniya aur aakhirat mein Allah ka deedar na hoga kyunke 'Lan' abadi nafi ke liye aata hai lekin yeh qaul bilkul hi boda hai kyunke mutawatir ahadees se sabit hai ke mominon ko Qayamat ke din Allah ka deedar hoga. Woh hadeesain aayat (Wujuhun yawma'izin nadirah) (Surah Al-Qiyamah: 22) aur aayat (Kalla innahum 'ar-rabbihim yawma'izin lamahjubun) (Surah Al-Mutaffifin: 15) ki tafsir mein aayengi Insha'Allah Ta'ala, ek qaul is aayat ki tafsir mein yeh hai ke yeh nafi abadi hai lekin dunyawi zindagi ke liye na ke aakhirat ke liye bhi. Kyunke aakhirat mein deedar-e-Bari Ta'ala mominon ko qatan hoga jaise ke aayat-o-ahadees se sabit hai is tarah koi mu'ariza bhi baqi nahin rehta. Yeh aayat misl (La tudrikuhul-absar) ke hai jis ki tafsir Surah An'am mein guzar chuki hai. Agli kitabon mein hai ke Hazrat Musa A.S ki is darkhwast par un se kaha gaya tha ke ae Musa! Mujhe jo zinda shakhs dekh le woh mar jaye. Mere deedar ki taab koi zinda la nahin sakta. Khushk cheezein bhi meri tajalli se thara uthti hain chunanche pahar ka haal khud Kaleemullah ne apni aankhon se dekh liya aur khud bhi behosh ho gaye. Imam Abu Ja'far Tabari ne is aayat ki tafsir mein likha hai ke Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain ke jab us ke Rab ne pahar par tajalli dali, apni ungli se ishara kiya to woh chakna choor ho gaya. Rawi-e-hadees Abu Ismail ne apne shagirdon ko apni shahadat ki ungli se ishara kar ke bataya, lekin is hadees ki sanad mein ek rawi mubham hai jis ka naam wazeh nahin kiya gaya, ek riwayat mein hai ke Aap ﷺ ne apne angoothe ko apni chhungliya ki oopar ki por par rakh kar bataya ke itne se jamal se pahar zameen ke sath hamwar ho gaya. Musnad ki riwayat mein hai ke Hameed ne apne ustad se kaha is se aap ki kya murad hai? To ustad ne un ke seene par hath maar kar farmaya ke yeh main apni taraf se nahin keh raha balkeh Hazrat Anas bin Malik R.A se main ne yeh suna aur unhon ne Aan-Hazrat Rasool-e-Maqbool ﷺ se. Tirmidhi mein bhi yeh hadees hai aur Imam sahab ne ise Hasan Sahih Ghareeb farmaya hai. Mustadrak mein ise warid kar ke kaha hai ke yeh shart-e-Muslim par hai aur Sahih hai. Khallal kehte hain is ki sanad sahih hai is mein koi illat nahin. Ibn Marduyah mein bhi marfoo'an marwi hai lekin is ki bhi sanad sahih nahin. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain sirf ba-qadr-e-chhungli ungli ke tajalli hui thi jis se woh mitti ki tarah choor choor ho gaya aur Kaleemullah A.S bhi behosh ho gaye. Kehte hain woh pahar dhans gaya samundar mein chala gaya aur Hazrat Musa A.S behosh ho kar gir pade. Ba'az buzurg farmate hain woh pahar ab Qayamat tak zahir na hoga balkeh zameen mein utarta chala jata hai. Ek hadees mein hai is tajalli se chhe pahar apni jagah se ur gaye jin mein se teen Makkah mein hain aur teen Madine mein. Uhud, Riqan aur Radwi Madine mein.

Hira, Thabir aur Thaur Makkah mein. Lekin yeh hadith bilkul ghareeb hai balkay munkar hai. Kehte hain ke Toor par tajalli ke zuhoor se pehle pahar bilkul saaf thay us ke baad un mein ghaar aur khadd aur shakhein qaim ho gayin. Janab-e-Kaleemullah ki aarzoo ke jawab mein inkaar hua aur phir mazeed tashaffi ke liye farmaya gaya ke meri adna si tajalli ki bardasht tujh se toh kya bohat zyada qawi makhlooq mein bhi nahin. Dekh pahar ki jaanib khayal rakh phir us par apni tajalli daali jis se pahar jhuk gaya aur Musa A.S behosh ho gaye sirf Allah ki nazar ne pahar ko reza reza kar diya woh bilkul mitti ho kar ret ka maidan ho gaya. Baaz qiraton mein isi tarah hai aur Ibn-e-Marduyah mein ek marfoo hadith bhi hai. Hazrat Musa A.S ko ghashi aa gayi yeh theek nahin ke maut aa gayi go lughatan yeh bhi ho sakta hai jaise aayat (Wa nufikha fis-soori fasa'iqa man fis-samawati wa man fil-ardi illa man sha' Allah, thumma nufikha feehi ukhra fa-iza hum qiyamun yanzuroon) (Surah Az-Zumar: 68) mein maut ke ma'ani hain. Lekin wahan qareena majood hai jo is lafz se isi ma'ani ke hone ki ta'eed karta hai aur yahan ka qareena behoshi ki ta'eed karta hai kyunke aage farman hai aayat (Falamma afaqa) zahir hai ke afaqa behoshi se hota hai. Hazrat Musa A.S hosh mein aate hi Allah Ta'ala ki pakeezgi aur ta'zeem-o-jalal bayan farmane lage ke waqai woh aisa hi hai ke koi zinda us ke jamal ki taab nahin la sakta. Phir apne sawal se tauba karte hain aur farmate hain ke sab Bani Israel se pehle main imaan lane wala banta hoon. Main is par sab se pehle imaan lata hoon ke waqai koi zinda aankh tujhe dekh nahin sakti. Yeh matlab nahin ke aap se pehle koi momin hi na tha balkay murad yeh hai ke Allah ka deedar zindon ke liye namumkin hai. Ibn-e-Jareer mein is aayat ki tafseer mein Muhammad bin Ishaq bin Yasar ki riwayat se ek ajeeb-o-ghareeb mutawwal asar naqal kiya gaya hai ajab nahin ke yeh Israeli riwayaton mein se ho wallahu a'alam. Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai ke ek Yahood ko kisi ne ek thappar mara tha woh Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas shikayat laya ke aap ke falan Ansari sahabi ne mujhe thappar mara hai. Aap ne use bulwaya aur us se poocha. Us ne kaha sach hai. Wajah yeh hui ke yeh keh raha tha us Allah ki qasam hai jis ne Musa A.S ko tamam jahan par fazeelat di toh main ne kaha kya Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par bhi? Aur ghussay mein aa kar main ne use thappar maar diya. Aap ne farmaya suno nabiyon ke darmiyan tum mujhe fazeelat na diya karo. Qayamat mein sab behosh honge sab se pehle mujhe hosh aayega toh main dekhunga ke Hazrat Musa A.S Arsh-e-Ilahi ka paya thaame hue hain. Main nahin keh sakta ke unhein mujh se pehle afaqa hua? Ya Toor ki behoshi ke badle yahan behosh hi nahin hue? Yeh hadith Bukhari Shareef mein kayi jagah hai aur Muslim Shareef mein bhi hai aur Abu Dawood mein bhi hai.

Bukhari-o-Muslim ki ek aur riwayat mein hai ke ek Musalman aur ek Yahudi ka jhagda ho gaya, is par Musalman ne kaha us ki qasam jis ne Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko tamam jahan par fazeelat di aur Yahudi ne kaha us ki qasam jis ne Hazrat Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko tamam jahan par fazeelat di. Is par Musalman ne use thappar mara. Is riwayat mein hai ke shayad Musa (A.S) un mein se hon jin ka Allah Ta'ala ne behoshi se istisna kar liya. Hafiz Abu Bakr Ibn Abi Dunya (R.H / Rahimahullah) ki riwayat mein hai ke yeh thappar marne wale Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) thay. Lekin Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke yeh koi Ansari (R.A) thay. Yehi zyada sahih aur zyada sareeh hai, Wallahu A'lam. Is hadith mein yeh farman ke tum nabiyon ke darmiyan mujhe fazeelat na do, aisa hi hai jaise aur hadith mein bhi farman hai ke nabiyon mein mujhe fazeelat na do. Na Hazrat Yunus bin Matta (A.S) par fazeelat do. Yeh farman bator-e-tawazo ke hai ya yeh farman us se pehle hai ke Aap (ﷺ) ko apni fazeelat ka ilm Allah ki taraf se hua ho. Ya yeh matlab hai ke gusse mein aa kar ya ta'assub ki bina par mujhe fazeelat na do ya yeh ke sirf apni raye se meri fazeelat qaim na karo. Wallahu A'lam. Log Qayamat ke din behosh honge, yeh behoshi maidan-e-Qayamat ki ba'az holnakiyon ki wajah se hogi, Wallahu A'lam. Bahut mumkin hai yeh us waqt ka haal ho jab Ilahul Mulk-o-Dayyan Tabarak-o-Ta'ala logon ke darmiyan haq faisle karne ke liye tashreef layega to us ki tajalli se log behosh ho jayenge. Jaise Hazrat Musa (A.S) Allah ke jamal ki bardasht ko Toor par na la sake. Isi liye Aap (ﷺ) ka farman hai ke na maloom mujh se pehle unhein afaqa hua ya Toor ki behoshi ke badle yahan behosh na huye. Qazi Ayaz (R.H) apni Kitab-ush-Shifa ke shuru mein likhte hain ke deedar-e-Ilahi ki is tajalli ki wajah se Hazrat Musa (A.S) us chinti ko bhi dekh liya karte thay jo das farsakh door raat ke andhere mein kisi patthar par chal rahi ho aur bahut mumkin hai ke hamare Nabi (ﷺ) un cheezon se jin ka hum ne zikr kiya, Me'raj ke waqiye ke baad makhsoos huye hon aur Aap (ﷺ) ne apne Rabb ki badi badi nishaniyan mulahiza farmayin. Is se maloom hota hai ke goya Qazi sahib ke nazdeek yeh riwayat sahih hai halankeh is ki sanad gaur talab hai. Is mein majhool rawi hain aur aisi baatein jab tak siqa rawiyon ke silsile se na sabit hon qabil-e-qabool nahin hotin. Wallahu A'lam.

Anbiya ki fazilat par ek tabsara Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko Janab-e-Bari farmata hai ke dohari nemat aap ko ata hui yani risalat aur ham-kalami. Magar chunke hamare Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tamam awwal-o-akhir nabiyon ke sardar hain is liye Allah Ta'ala ne risalat khatam karne wala aap ko banaya ke Qayamat tak aap hi ki shariat jari rahegi aur tamam anbiya aur rasoolon se aap ke tabe-dar tadad mein zyada honge. Fazilat ke aitbar se aap ke baad sab se afzal Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) hain jo Khalilullah thay. Phir Hazrat Musa (A.S) hain jo Kalimullah thay. Aye Musa! Jo munajat aur kalam tujhe main ne diya hai woh le le aur mazbooti se is par istiqamat rakh aur is par jitna tujh se ho sake shukr baja laya kar. Kaha gaya hai ke Taurat ki takhtiyan jawahar ki thin aur un mein Allah Ta'ala ne tamam ahkam halal-o-haram ke tafseel ke sath likh diye thay. Inhi takhtiyon mein Taurat thi jis ke mutaliq farman hai ke agle logon ki halakat ke baad hum ne Musa ko logon ki hidayat ke liye kitab ata farmayi. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke Taurat se pehle yeh takhtiyan mili thin, Wallahu A'lam. Al-gharaz deedar-e-Ilahi jis ki tamanna aap ne ki thi is ke ewaz yeh cheez aap ko mili. Kaha gaya ise manne ke irade se le lo aur apni qoum ko in achhaiyon par amal karne ki hidayat karo. Aap ko zyada takeed hui aur qoum ko in se kam. Tumhein maloom ho jayega ke meri hukm-aduli karne wale ka kya anjam hota hai? Jaise koi kisi ko dhamkate hue kahe ke tum meri mukhalifat ka anjam bhi dekh loge. Yeh bhi matlab ho sakta hai ke main tumhein Sham ke badkaron ke gharon ka malik bana doonga ya murad is se Firauniyon ka tarka ho. Lekin pehli baat hi zyada theek maloom hoti hai kyunke yeh farman Tih ke maidan se pehle aur Firaun se nijat pa lene ke baad ka hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Takabbur ka phal mahroomi. Takabbur ka natija hamesha jahalat hota hai. Aise logon ko haq samajhne, use qabool karne aur us par amal karne ki taufeeq naseeb nahin hoti. Un ke be-imani ki wajah se un ke dil ulat jate hain, aankh kaan bekar ho jate hain. Un ki kaji un ke dilon ko bhi kaj kar deti hai. Ulama ka maqoola hai ke mutakabbir aur poochne se jee churane wala kabhi aalim nahin ho sakta. Jo shakhs thodi der ke liye ilm ke hasil karne mein apne aap ko dusre ke samne na jhukaye woh umr bhar zillat-o-ruswai mein rehta hai. Mutakabbir logon ko Quran ki samajh kahan? Woh toh Rabb ki aayaton se bhagte rehte hain. Is ummat ke log hon ya aur ummaton ke, sab ke sath Allah Ta'ala ka tareeqa yahi raha hai ke takabbur ki wajah se haq ki pairwi naseeb nahin hoti. Chunke yeh log Allah Ta'ala ke azab ke mustahiq ho chuke hain, agarche yeh bade bade mojze bhi dekh lein, inhe iman naseeb nahin hoga. Go nijat ke raste un par khul jayen lekin is rah par chalna un ke liye dushwar hai. Haan buri rah samne aate hi yeh be-tarah us par lapke. Is liye ke un ke dilon mein jhutlana hai aur apne aamal ke natijon se be-khabar hain. Jo log hamari aayaton ko jhutlayen, aakhirat ka yaqeen na rakhein, isi aqeeday par marein, un ke aamal akaarat hain. Hum kisi par zulm nahin karte, badla sirf kiye huye aamal ka hi milta hai. Bhale ka bhala aur bure ka bura, jaisa karoge waisa bharoge.

Bani Israel ka bachhray ko poojna. Hazrat Musa (A.S) toh Allah Ta'ala ke waaday ke mutabiq Taurat lenay gaye, udhar Firauniyon ke jo zewar Bani Israel ke paas reh gaye thay, Samri ne unhein jama kiya aur apne paas se us mein khaak ki mutthi daal di jo Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ke ghoray ki taap talay se us ne utha li thi. Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat se woh sona ghul kar misl-e-ek gaaye ke jism ke ho gaya aur chunke khokhla tha, us mein se aawaz bhi aanay lagi aur woh bilkul ho-ba-ho gaaye ki si aawaz thi. Us ne Bani Israel ko behka kar us ki ibadat karani shuru kar di, bohat se log usay poojnay lagay. Allah Ta'ala ne Toor par Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko is fitnay ki khabar di. Yeh bachhra ya toh sach-much khoon gosht ka ban gaya tha ya sonay ka hi tha magar shakal gaaye ki thi, yeh Allah Ta'ala hi jaanay. Bani Israel toh aawaz suntay hi naachnay lagay aur us par reejh gaye. Samri ne keh diya ke Allah toh yahi hai, Musa (A.S) bhool gaye hain. Unhein itni bhi tameez na aayi ke woh Allah toh kisi baat ka jawab bhi nahin de sakta aur kisi nafa nuqsan ka ikhtiyar bhi nahin rakhta. Is bachhray ko us Allah Ta'ala ko chhor kar poojo jo sab ka maalik aur sab ka khaliq hai. Is ki wajah siwaye andhay pan aur be-aqli ke aur kya ho sakti hai? Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne sach farmaya, kisi cheez ki mohabbat insaan ko andha behra kar deti hai. Phir jab is mohabbat mein kami aayi, aankhein khulin toh apne is fe'l par nadim honay lagay aur yaqeen kar liya ke waqai hum gumrah ho gaye toh Allah Ta'ala se bakhshish maangnay lagay. Ek qira'at mein taghfir-ta se bhi hai. Jaan gaye ke agar maafi na mili toh baray nuqsan se do-char ho jayenge. Gharz Allah Ta'ala ki taraf tawajo se jhukay aur iltija karnay lagay.

Bani Israel ka bachhray ko poojna. Hazrat Musa (A.S) toh Allah Ta'ala ke waaday ke mutabiq Taurat lenay gaye, udhar Firauniyon ke jo zewar Bani Israel ke paas reh gaye thay, Samri ne unhein jama kiya aur apne paas se us mein khaak ki mutthi daal di jo Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ke ghoray ki taap talay se us ne utha li thi. Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat se woh sona ghul kar misl-e-ek gaaye ke jism ke ho gaya aur chunke khokhla tha, us mein se aawaz bhi aanay lagi aur woh bilkul ho-ba-ho gaaye ki si aawaz thi. Us ne Bani Israel ko behka kar us ki ibadat karani shuru kar di, bohat se log usay poojnay lagay. Allah Ta'ala ne Toor par Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko is fitnay ki khabar di. Yeh bachhra ya toh sach-much khoon gosht ka ban gaya tha ya sonay ka hi tha magar shakal gaaye ki thi, yeh Allah Ta'ala hi jaanay. Bani Israel toh aawaz suntay hi naachnay lagay aur us par reejh gaye. Samri ne keh diya ke Allah toh yahi hai, Musa (A.S) bhool gaye hain. Unhein itni bhi tameez na aayi ke woh Allah toh kisi baat ka jawab bhi nahin de sakta aur kisi nafa nuqsan ka ikhtiyar bhi nahin rakhta. Is bachhray ko us Allah Ta'ala ko chhor kar poojo jo sab ka maalik aur sab ka khaliq hai. Is ki wajah siwaye andhay pan aur be-aqli ke aur kya ho sakti hai? Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne sach farmaya, kisi cheez ki mohabbat insaan ko andha behra kar deti hai. Phir jab is mohabbat mein kami aayi, aankhein khulin toh apne is fe'l par nadim honay lagay aur yaqeen kar liya ke waqai hum gumrah ho gaye toh Allah Ta'ala se bakhshish maangnay lagay. Ek qira'at mein taghfir-ta se bhi hai. Jaan gaye ke agar maafi na mili toh baray nuqsan se do-char ho jayenge. Gharz Allah Ta'ala ki taraf tawajo se jhukay aur iltija karnay lagay.

Musa A.S ki Koh-e-Tur se wapsi. Hazrat Musa A.S ko chunke Tur par hi apni qoum ka yeh kufr maloom ho chuka tha is liye sakht ghazabnak ho kar wapas aaye aur farmane lage ke tum ne toh mere baad sakht nalaiqi ki. Tum ne mera intezar bhi na kiya, meri zara si takheer mein yeh zulm dhaya. Gusse ke mare takhtiyan haath se phenk dein. Kaha gaya hai ke yeh zumurrad ya yaqoot ya kisi aur cheez ki thin. Sach hai jo hadith mein hai ke dekhna sunna barabar nahin, apni qoum par gusse ho kar alwah haath se gira dein. Theek baat yahi hai, jamhoor-e-salaf-o-khalaf ka qaul bhi yahi hai lekin Ibn-e-Jarir ne Qatada se ek ajeeb qaul naqal kiya hai jis ki sanad bhi sahih nahin. Ibn-e-Atiya waghera ne is ki bahut tardeed ki hai aur waqai woh tardeed ke qabil bhi hai. Bahut mumkin hai ke Qatada ne yeh Ahl-e-Kitab se liya ho aur un ka kya aitbar hai? Un mein jhoote, banawat karne wale, ghar lene wale, bad-deen, be-deen har tarah ke log hain. Is khauf se ke kahin Hazrat Haroon A.S ne unhein baaz rakhne ki poori koshish na ki ho, aap ne un ke sar ke baalon ke bal unhein ghaseet liya aur farmane lage inhein gumrah hote hue dekh kar bhi toh ne meri ma-tahti mein inhein kyun na roka? Kya tu bhi mere farman ka munkir ban gaya? Is par Hazrat Haroon A.S ne jawab diya ke bhai jaan mere sar ke aur darhi ke baal na pakrein, main ne toh har mumkin tareeqe se inhein roka, zyada is liye na uljha ke kahin aap yeh na farma dein ke tu ne Bani Israel mein tafreeq daal di? Tu ne mera intezar kyun na kiya? Warna main toh in gumrahon se ab tak zameen ko paak kar chuka hota. Unhon ne toh mujhe kuch bhi na samjha balkeh mere qatl ke darpay ho gaye. Aap mujhe in hi ki tarah na samjhein na in mein milayein. Hazrat Haroon A.S ka yeh farmana ke ae mere maa jaye bhai, yeh sirf is liye tha ke Hazrat Musa A.S ko raham aa jaye, maa baap dono ke ek hi thay. Jab aap ko apne bhai Haroon A.S ki baraat ki tahqeeq ho gayi, Allah ki taraf se bhi un ki paak damani aur be-qasoori maloom ho gayi ke unhon ne apni qoum se pehle hi yeh farma diya tha ke afsos tum fitne mein par gaye, ab bhi kuch nahin bigra, Parwardigar bara hi Raheem-o-Kareem hai, tum meri maan lo aur phir se mere tabe-dar ban jao, toh aap Allah se duayein karne lage. Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain Allah Ta'ala Musa A.S par raham kare, waqai dekhne wale mein aur khabar sunne wale mein bahut farq hota hai. Qoum ki gumrahi ki khabar suni toh takhtiyan haath se na girayin lekin isi manzar ko dekh kar qabu mein na rahe, takhtiyan phenk dein.

Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain Allah Ta'ala Musa A.S par raham kare, waqai dekhne wale mein aur khabar sunne wale mein bahut farq hota hai. Qoum ki gumrahi ki khabar suni toh takhtiyan haath se na girayin lekin isi manzar ko dekh kar qabu mein na rahe, takhtiyan phenk dein.

Baham qatl ki saza in gausala paraston par Allah ka gazab nazil hua. Jab tak in logon ne aapas mein ek dusre ko qatl na kar liya in ki tauba qubool na hui jaise ke Surah Al-Baqarah ki tafsir mein tafseel-war bayan ho chuka hai ke inhe hukum hua tha ke apne Khaliq se tauba karo aur aapas mein ek dusre ko qatl karo yahi tumhare haq mein theek hai phir woh tumhari tauba qubool farmaye ga woh tauba qubool karne wala aur rahm-o-karam wala hai. Isi tarah duniya mein bhi in Yahudiyon par zillat nazil hui. Har bid'ati ki jo Allah ke deen mein jhoota toofan uthaye yahi saza hai. Rasool ki mukhalifat aur bid'at ka bojh us ke dil se nikal kar us ke kandhon par aa padta hai. Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain go woh dunyawi thaath rakhta ho lekin zillat us ke chehre par barasti hai. Qayamat tak yahi saza har jhoote iftara-baaz ki Allah ki taraf se muqarrar hai. Hazrat Sufyan bin Uyaynah (R.H) farmate hain ke har bid'ati zaleel hai. Phir farmate hain ke Allah tauba qubool karne wala hai khwah kaisa hi gunah ho lekin tauba ke baad woh maaf farma deta hai go kufr-o-shirk aur nifaq-o-shifaq hi kyun na ho. Farman hai ke jo log buraiyon ke baad tauba kar lein aur imaan layein to aye Rasool-e-Rahmat aur aye Nabi-e-Noor (yani Quran) tera Rab is fe'l ke baad bhi Ghafoor-ur-Rahim hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood (R.A) se sawal hua ke agar koi shakhs kisi aurat se zina-kari kare phir us se nikah kar le to? Aap ne yahi aayat tilawat farmayi koi das das martaba ise tilawat kiya aur koi hukum ya mana nahin kiya.
