Hazrat Musa A.S ko apni qoum par jo gussa tha jab woh jata raha toh sakht gussay ki halat mein jin takhtiyon ko unhon ne zameen par daal diya tha ab utha lein. Yeh gussa sirf Allah ki raah mein tha kyunke aap ki qoum ne bachray ki pooja ki thi. In takhtiyon mein hidayat-o-rahmat thi. Kehte hain ke jab Kaleemullah A.S ne takhtiyan zameen par daal dein toh woh toot gayin phir unhein jama kiya. Toh un mein rehbari aur reham paya aur tafseel utha li gayi thi. Kehte hain ke in takhtiyon ke tukray shahi khazanon mein Bani Israel ke paas daulat-e-Islamia ke ibtidai zamane tak mehfooz rahe, Wallahu A'lam. Is ki sehat ka koi pata nahin halankeh yeh baat mashhoor hai ke woh takhtiyan Jannati jauhar ki thin aur is aayat mein hai ke phir Hazrat Musa A.S ne khud hi unhein utha liya aur un mein rahmat-o-hidayat payi. Choonkeh rujat mutazammin hai khushoo-o-khuzoo ko is liye isay laam se muta'addi kiya. Qatada R.H kehte hain un mein aap ne likha dekha ke ek ummat tamam ummaton se behtar hogi jo logon ke liye qaim ki jaye gi jo bhali baton ka hukum kare gi aur buraiyon se rokay gi toh Hazrat Musa A.S ne dua ki ke Aye Allah meri ummat ko yahi ummat bana de, jawab mila ke yeh ummat Ummat-e-Ahmed ﷺ hai. Phir parha ke ek ummat hogi jo duniya mein sab se aakhir aaye gi aur Jannat mein sab se pehle jaye gi toh bhi aap ne yahi darkhwast ki aur yahi jawab paya. Phir parha ke ek ummat hogi jin ki kitab un ke seenon mein hogi jis ki woh tilawat karenge yani hifz karenge aur dusre log dekh kar parhte hain. Agar un ki kitabein uth jayen toh ilm jata rahe kyunke unhein hifz nahin. Is tarah ka hafiza isi ummat ke liye makhsoos hai kisi aur ummat ko nahin mila. Is par bhi aap ne yahi darkhwast ki aur yahi jawab paya. Phir dekha ke is mein likha hua hai ke ek ummat hogi jo agli pichli tamam kitabon par imaan laye gi aur gumrahon se jihad kare gi yahan tak ke kaanay Dajjal se jihad kare gi. Is par bhi aap ne yahi dua ki aur yahi jawab paya. Phir in takhtiyon mein aap ne parha ke ek ummat hogi jo khud bhi shafa'at kare gi aur un ki shafa'at dusre bhi karenge, aap ne phir yahi dua ki ke Aye Allah yeh martaba meri ummat ko de. Jawab mila yeh ummat Ummat-e-Ahmed ﷺ hai, is par aap ne takhtiyan le lein aur kehne lage Aye Allah mujhe Ummat-e-Ahmed mein kar de.

Musa A.S ki Koh-e-Toor se wapsi. Hazrat Musa A.S ne hasb-e-farman-e-Ilahi apni qoum se sattar shakhson ko muntakhab kiya aur Janab-e-Bari se duayein mangna shuru keen. Lekin yeh log apni dua mein had se tajawuz kar gaye, kehne lage Allah tu hamein woh de jo na hum se pehle kisi ko diya ho na hamare baad kisi ko de. Yeh dua Allah Ta'ala ko na-pasand aayi aur un par bhunchal aa gaya. Jis se ghabra kar Hazrat Musa A.S Allah se duayein karne lage. Suddi kehte hain unhein le kar aap Allah Ta'ala se Bani Israel ki gausala parasti ki ma'zarat karne ke liye gaye thay. Yahan jab woh pohanchay to kehne lage hum to jab tak khud Allah Ta'ala ko khulam-khula apni aankhon se na dekh lein imaan na layenge. Hum kalam sun rahe hain lekin dekhna chahte hain. Is par karakay ki aawaz hui aur yeh sab mar khap gaye. Hazrat Musa A.S ne rona shuru kiya ke Allah main Bani Israel ko kya munh dikhaunga? In ke yeh behtareen log thay agar yahi mansha thi to is se pehle hi hamein halak kar diya hota. Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq R.H ka qaul hai ke unhein is but parasti se tauba karne ke liye bator-e-wafad ke aap le chalay thay. Un se farma diya tha ke pak saaf ho jao, pak kapray pehan lo aur rozay se chalo. Yeh Allah ke bataye hue waqt par Toor-e-Sina pohanchay. Munajat mein mashghool hue to unhon ne khwahish ki ke Allah se dua kijiye ke hum bhi Allah ka kalam sunen. Aap ne dua ki jab hasb-e-aadat badal aaya aur Musa A.S aagay barh gaye aur badal mein chup gaye. Qoum se farmaya tum bhi qareeb aa jao, yeh bhi andar chalay gaye aur hasb-e-mamool Hazrat Musa A.S ki peshani par ek noor chamakne laga jo Allah ke kalam ke waqt barabar chamakta rehta tha. Us waqt koi insaan aap ke chehray par nigah nahin daal sakta tha, aap ne hijab kar liya. Log sab sajday mein gir paray aur Allah ka kalam shuru hua jo yeh log bhi sun rahe thay ke farman ho raha hai yeh kar, yeh na kar waghera. Jab baatein ho chukin aur abr uth gaya to un logon ne kaha hum to jab tak Allah ko khud khoob zahir na dekh lein imaan nahin layenge to un par karaka nazil hua aur sab ke sab ek sath mar gaye. Musa A.S bohat ghabraye aur munajat shuru kar di, is mein yahan tak kaha ke agar halak hi karna tha to is se pehle halak kiya hota. Ek riwayat yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Musa A.S Hazrat Haroon A.S ko aur Shabar aur Shabir ko le kar pahar ki ghati mein gaye. Haroon A.S ek buland jagah kharay thay ke un ki rooh qabz kar li gayi. Jab aap wapas Bani Israel ke paas pohanchay to unhon ne kaha ke chunke aap ke bhai baray milansar aur narm aadmi thay aap ne hi unhein alag le ja kar qatl kar diya. Is par aap ne farmaya achha tum apne mein se sattar aadmi chhant kar mere sath kar do, unhon ne kar diye jinhein le kar aap gaye aur Hazrat Haroon A.S ki laash se poocha ke aap ko kis ne qatl kiya?

Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat se woh bole kisi ne nahin balkay main apni maut mara hoon. Unhon ne kaha bas Musa (A.S) ab se aap ki nafarmani hargiz na ki jaye gi. Isi waqt zalzala aaya jis se woh sab mar gaye. Ab toh Hazrat Musa (A.S) bahut ghabraye, dayen bayen ghoomne lage aur woh arz karne lage jo Quran mein mazkoor hai. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne aap ki iltija qabool kar li, un sab ko zinda kar diya aur baad mein woh sab ambiya bane, lekin yeh asar bahut hi ghareeb hai, is ka ek rawi Amara bin Abd ghair maroof hai. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke un par is zalzalay ke aane ki wajah yeh thi ke yeh bachray ki parastish ke waqt khamosh thay, un pujariyon ko rokte na thay. Is qaul ki daleel mein Hazrat Musa (A.S) ka yeh farman bilkul theek utarta hai ke aye Allah! Hum mein se chand bewaqoofon ke fe'l ki wajah se tu hamain halak kar raha hai? Phir farmate hain yeh toh teri taraf ki aazmaish hi hai, tera hi hukm chalta hai aur teri hi chahat kamyab hai. Hidayat-o-zalalat tere hi hath mein hai, jis ko tu hidayat de usay koi behka nahin sakta aur jisay tu behkaye us ki koi rehbari nahin kar sakta. Tu jis se rok le usay koi de nahin sakta aur jisay de de us se koi cheen nahin sakta. Mulk ka malik tu akela, hukm ka hakim sirf tu hi hai. Khalq-o-amr tera hi hai, tu hamara wali hai, hamain bakhsh, hum par reham farma, tu sab se achha maaf farmane wala hai. Ghufar ke ma'ani hain chhupa dena aur pakad na karna, jab rehmat bhi is ke sath mil jaye toh yeh matlab hota hai ke aayinda is gunah se bachao ho jaye. Gunahon ka bakhsh dene wala sirf tu hi hai. Pas jis cheez se dar tha us ka bachao talab karne ke baad ab maqsood hasil karne ke liye dua ki jati hai ke hamain duniya mein bhalai ata farma, isay hamare naam likh de, wajib-o-sabit kar de. Hasna ki tafseer Surah Al-Baqarah mein guzar chuki hai. Hum teri taraf ruju karte hain, raghbat hamari teri hi janib hai, hamari tauba aur aajizi teri taraf hai. Hazrat Ali (R.A) se marwi hai ke chunke unhon ne hudna kaha tha is liye unhain Yahoodi kaha gaya hai, lekin is riwayat ki sanad mein Jabir bin Yazeed Ju'fi hain jo za'eef hain.

Allah Ta'ala ki rahmat aur insaan chunke Kaleemullah A.S ne apni dua mein kaha tha ke yeh mahaz Teri taraf se aazmaish hai, is ke jawab mein farmaya ja raha hai ke azaab toh sirf gunahgaron ko hi hota hai aur gunahgaron mein se bhi unhi ko jo meri nigah mein gunahgar hain, na ke har gunahgar ko. Main apni hikmat, adl aur poore ilm ke zariye se jaanta hoon ke mustahiq-e-azaab kaun hai? Sirf usi ko azaab pahunchata hoon. Haan albatta meri rahmat badi wasee cheez hai jo sab par shamil, sab par haavi aur sab par muheet hai. Chunancha Arsh ke uthane wale aur us ke gird-o-pesh rehne wale farishte farmate raha karte hain ke aye Rab! Tu ne apni rahmat aur apne ilm se tamam cheezon ko gher rakha hai. Musnad-e-Imam Ahmad mein hai ke ek Aarabi aaya, oont bitha kar use baandh kar namaz mein Huzoor ﷺ ke peeche khada ho gaya. Namaz se farigh ho kar oont ko khol kar us par sawar ho kar oonchi aawaz se dua karne laga ke aye Allah! Mujh par aur Muhammad ﷺ par raham kar aur apni rahmat mein kisi aur ko hum dono ka shareek na kar. Aap ﷺ yeh sun kar farmane lage, batao yeh khud raah gum karda hone mein badha hua hai ya is ka oont? Tum ne suna bhi is ne kya kaha? Sahaba R.A ne arz kiya, haan Huzoor ﷺ sun liya. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya, aye shakhs! Tu ne Allah ki bahut hi kushada rahmat ko bahut tang cheez samajh liya. Sun! Allah Ta'ala ne apni rahmat ke sau hisse kiye jin mein se sirf ek hi hissa duniya mein utara, isi se makhlooq ek dusre par taras khati hai aur raham karti hai, isi se haiwan bhi apni aulad ke sath narmi aur raham ka bartao karte hain. Baqi ke ninnanve hisse toh us ke paas hi hain jin ka izhaar Qayamat ke din hoga. Aur riwayat mein hai ke baroz-e-Qayamat isi hisse ke sath aur ninnanve hisse jo muakhar hain mila diye jayenge. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke isi nazil karda ek hisse mein parind bhi shareek hain. Tabri mein hai, qasam hai us ki jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai ke jo apne deen mein faajir hai, jo apni ma'ash mein ahmaq hai, woh bhi is mein dakhil hai. Is ki qasam jo meri jaan apne haath mein rakhta hai, woh bhi Jannat mein jayega jo mustahiq-e-Jahannam hoga. Is ki qasam jis ke qabze mein meri rooh hai, Qayamat ke din Allah ki rahmat ke karishme dekh kar Iblees bhi umeedwar ho kar haath phaila dega. Yeh hadees bahut hi ghareeb hai, is ka raawi Saad Ghari maroof hai. Pas main apni is rahmat ko un ke liye wajib kar dunga aur yeh bhi mahaz apne fazl-o-karam se. Jaise farman hai, tumhare Rab ne apni zaat par rahmat ko wajib kar liya hai. Pas jin par rahmat-e-Rab wajib ho jayegi un ke ausaaf bayan farmaye. Is se maloom hota hai ke murad is se Ummat-e-Muhammad ﷺ hai jo taqwa karein yani shirk se aur kabeera gunahon se bachein, Zakat dein yani apne zameer ko paak rakhein aur maal ki Zakat bhi ada karein (kyunke yeh aayat Makki hai) aur hamari aayaton ko maan lein, un par imaan layein aur unhein sach samjhein.

Sabiqa kitabon mein aakhri paighambar Khatam-ul-Anbiya (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke jo ausaf bayan hue thay jis se un nabiyon ki ummat aap ko pehchan jaye woh bayan ho rahe hain. Sab ko hukum tha ke in sifat ka paighambar agar tumhare zamane mein zahir ho to tum sab un ki tabedari mein lag jana. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, ek sahib farmate hain main kuch khareedo-farokht ka saman le kar Madine aaya, jab apni tijarat se farigh hua to main ne kaha is shakhs se bhi mil loon. Main chala to dekha ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Abu Bakr aur Umar (R.A) ke sath kahin ja rahe hain. Main bhi peeche peeche chalne laga, aap ek Yahudi aalim ke ghar gaye, uska naujawan khubsurat tanomand beta naz'a ki halat mein tha aur woh apne dil ko taskeen dene ke liye Taurat khole hue us ke paas baitha hua tilawat kar raha tha. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne us se daryaft farmaya ke tujhe us ki qasam jis ne yeh Taurat nazil farmayi hai, kya meri sifat aur mere mab'oos hone ki khabar is mein tumhare paas hai ya nahin? Us ne apne sar ke ishare se inkar kiya. Isi waqt us ka woh bacha bol utha ke us ki qasam jis ne Taurat nazil farmayi hai, hum aap ki sifat aur aap ke aane ka poora haal is Taurat mein majood paate hain aur meri teh-e-dil se gawahi hai ke Mabood-e-Barhaq sirf Allah Ta'ala hi hai aur aap us ke sache Rasool hain. Aap ne farmaya is Yahudi ko apne bhai ke paas se hatao, phir aap hi us ke kafan-dafan ke wali bane aur us ke janaze ki namaz parhayi. Mustadrak-e-Hakim mein hai, Hazrat Hisham bin Aas Umawi (R.A) farmate hain ke main aur ek sahib Room ke badshah Heraclius ko dawat-e-Islam dene ke liye rawana hue. Ghota-e-Damishq mein pahunch kar hum Hila bin Aym Ghassani ke haan gaye, us ne apna qasid bheja ke hum us se baatein kar lein. Hum ne kaha Wallah hum tum se koi baat na karenge, hum badshah ke paas bheje gaye hain, agar woh chahein to hum se khud sunen aur khud jawab dein, warna hum qasidon se guftagu karna nahin chahte. Qasidon ne yeh khabar badshah ko pahunchayi, us ne ijazat di aur hamein apne paas bula liya. Chunancha main ne us se baatein keen aur Islam ki dawat di. Woh us waqt siyah libas pehne hue tha, kehne laga ke dekh main ne yeh libas pehan rakha hai aur half uthaya hai ke jab tak tum logon ko Sham se na nikal doonga, is siyah libade ko na utaroon ga. Qasid-e-Islam ne yeh sun kar phir kaha, badshah hosh sambhalo, Allah ki qasam yeh aap ke takht ki jagah aur aap ke barhe badshah ka paye-takht bhi Insha'Allah anqareeb hum apne qabze mein kar lenge. Yeh koi hamari hawas nahin balkay hamare Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se hamein yeh pukhta khabar mil chuki hai. Us ne kaha tum woh log nahin, haan hum se hamara yeh takht-o-taj-o-qaum chheene gi jo dinon ko rozay se rehte hon aur raton ko tahajjud parhte hon. Acha tum batao tumhare rozay ke ahkaam kya hain? Ab jo hum ne bataye to us ka munh kala ho gaya.

Us ne usi waqt hamare sath apna ek aadmi kar diya aur kaha inhe Shah-e-Rum ke paas le jao. Jab hum us ke paye-takht ke paas pahunche to woh kehne laga tum is haal mein to is shehar mein nahin ja sakte, agar tum kaho to main tumhare liye umda sawariyan la doon, un par sawar ho kar tum shehar mein chalo. Hum ne kaha namumkin hai, hum to isi halat mein inhi sawariyon par chalenge. Unhon ne badshah se kehlwa bheja, wahan se ijazat aayi ke achha inhe oonton par hi le aao. Hum apne oonton par sawar gale mein talwarein latkaye shahi mahal ke paas pahunche, wahan hum ne apni sawariyan bithayin. Badshah dariche mein se hamein dekh raha tha, hamare munh se besakhta dua (La ilaha illallahu wallahu Akbar) ka naara nikal gaya. Allah khoob jaanta hai ke usi waqt Sham aur Rum ka mahal tharra utha, is tarah jis tarah kisi khoshe ko tez hawa ka jhonka hila raha ho. Usi waqt mahal se shahi qasid daudta hua aaya aur kehne laga aap ko yeh nahin chahiye ke apne deen ko is tarah hamare samne elaan karo, chalo tum ko badshah salamat yaad kar rahe hain. Chunancha hum us ke sath darbar mein gaye, dekha ke charon taraf surkh makhmal aur surkh resham hai, khud bhi surkh libas pehne hue hai, tamam darbar padriyon aur arkaan-e-saltanat se bhara hua hai. Jab hum paas pahunch gaye to muskura kar kehne laga jo salam tum mein aapas mein marooj hai tum ne mujhe woh salam kyun na kiya? Tarjuman ki marifat hamein badshah ka yeh sawal pahuncha to hum ne jawab diya ke jo salam hum mein hai us ke laiq tum nahin aur jo aadab ka dastoor tum mein hai woh hamein pasand nahin. Us ne kaha achha tumhara salam aapas mein kya hai? Hum ne kaha Assalamu Alaikum. Us ne kaha apne badshah ko tum kis tarah salam karte ho? Hum ne kaha sirf inhi alfaaz se. Poocha achha woh bhi tumhein koi jawab dete hain? Hum ne kaha yahi alfaaz woh kehte hain. Badshah ne daryaft kiya ke tumhare yahan sab se bada kalma kaun sa hai? Hum ne kaha dua (La ilaha illallahu wallahu Akbar). Allah Azzawajal ki qasam idhar hum ne yeh kalma kaha udhar phir se mahal mein zalzala pada yahan tak ke sara darbar chhat ki taraf nazrein kar ke seham gaya. Badshah haibat-zada ho kar poochne laga kyun ji apne gharon mein bhi jab kabhi tum yeh kalma padhte ho tumhare ghar bhi is tarah zalzale mein aa jate hain? Hum ne kaha kabhi nahin, hum ne to yeh baat yahin aap ke yahan hi dekhi hai. Badshah kehne laga kaash ke tum jab kabhi is kalme ko kehte tamam cheezein isi tarah hil jatin aur mera aadha mulk hi reh jata. Hum ne poocha yeh kyun? Us ne jawab diya is liye ke yeh aasaan tha ba-nisbat is baat ke ke yeh Amr-e-Nabuwwat ho. Phir us ne hum se hamara irada daryaft kiya, hum ne saaf bataya. Us ne kaha achha yeh batao ke tum namaz kis tarah padhte ho aur roza kis tarah rakhte ho? Hum ne dono baatein bata dein, us ne ab hamein rukhsat kiya aur bade ikraam-o-ehtram se hamein shahi moazzaz mehmanon mein rakha.

Teen din jab guzre toh raat ke waqt hamein qasid bulane aaya hum phir darbar mein gaye toh usne hum se phir hamara matlab poocha hum ne use dohraya phir usne ek haveli ki shakal ki sona mandhi hui ek cheez mangwai jis mein bahut saare makanat thay aur un ke darwaze thay usne use kunji se khol kar ek siyah rang ka reshmi jama nikala hum ne dekha ke is mein ek shakhs hai jis ki badi badi aankhein hain badi raanein hain. Badi lambi aur ghani daadhi hai aur sar ke baal do hisson mein nihayat hi khubsurat lambe lambe hain hum se poocha inhe jaante ho? Hum ne kaha nahin. Kaha yeh Hazrat Adam A.S hain un ke jism par baal bahut hi thay. Phir dusra darwaza khol kar is mein se siyah rang resham ka parcha nikala jis mein ek safed surat thi jis ke ghungrale baal thay surkh rang aankhein thin bade kale ke aadmi thay aur badi khush-waza daadhi thi hum se poocha inhe pehchante ho? Hum ne inkar kiya toh kaha yeh Hazrat Nuh A.S hain. Phir ek darwaza khol kar is mein se siyah reshmi kapda nikala is mein ek shakhs tha nihayat hi gora chitta rang, bahut khubsurat aankhein, kushada peshani, lambe rukhsaar, safed daadhi, yeh maloom hota tha ke goya woh muskura rahe hain. Hum se poocha inhe pehchana? Hum ne inkar kiya toh kaha yeh Hazrat Ibrahim A.S hain. Phir ek darwaza khola is mein se ek khubsurat safed shakal dikhai di jo ho-ba-ho Rasool Allah ﷺ ki thi. Hum se poocha inhe pehchante ho? Hum ne kaha yeh Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ hain. Yeh kaha aur hamare aansu nikal aaye. Badshah ab tak khada hua tha ab woh baith gaya aur hum se dobara poocha ke yahi shakal Huzoor ki hai hum ne kaha Wallah yahi hai isi tarah ke goya tu aap ko aap ki zindagi mein dekh raha hai. Pas woh thodi der tak gaur se use dekhta raha phir hum se kehne laga ke yeh aakhri ghar tha lekin main ne aur gharon ko chhod kar ise beech mein hi is liye khol diya ke tumhein aazma loon ke tum pehchan jaate ho ya nahin. Phir ek aur darwaza khol kar is mein se bhi siyah rang reshmi kapda nikala jis mein ek gandum-goon narmi wali surat thi. Baal ghungrale aankhein gehri nazrein tez tevar teekhe daant par daant hont mote ho rahe thay jaise ke gusse mein bhare hue hain. Hum se poocha inhe pehchana? Hum ne inkar kiya badshah ne kaha yeh Hazrat Musa A.S hain. Isi ke mutasil ek aur surat thi jo qareeb qareeb isi ki si thi. Magar un ke sar ke baal goya tel lage hue thay. Maatha kushada tha, aankhon mein kuch farakhi thi hum se poocha inhe jaante ho? Hamare inkar par kaha yeh Hazrat Haroon bin Imran A.S hain. Phir ek darwaza khol kar is mein se ek safed rang resham ka tukda nikala jis mein ek gandum-goon rang miyana qad seedhe baalon wala ek shakhs tha goya woh gazabnaak hai poocha inhe pehchana? Hum ne kaha nahin. Kaha yeh Hazrat Lut A.S hain.

Phir ek darwaza khol kar us mein se ek safed reshmi kapra nikal kar dikhaya jis mein sunhare rang ke ek aadmi thay jin ka qad taweel na tha, rukhsaar halke thay, chehra khubsurat tha. Hum se pucha inhe jante ho? Hum ne kaha nahin, kaha yeh Hazrat Ishaq A.S hain. Phir ek darwaza khol kar us mein se siyah rang ka reshmi kapra nikala jis mein ek shakal thi, safed rang, khubsurat, unchi naak wale, achhe qamat wale, noorani chehre wale jis mein khauf-e-Allah zahir tha, rang surkhi mail safed tha. Pucha inhe jante ho? Hum ne kaha nahin, kaha yeh tumhare Nabi ﷺ ke dada Hazrat Ismail A.S hain. Phir aur darwaza khol kar safed reshmi kapre ka tukra nikal kar dikhaya jis mein ek surat thi jo Hazrat Adam A.S ki surat se bahut hi milti julti thi aur chehra toh suraj ki tarah roshan tha, pucha inhe pehchana? Hum ne la-ilmi zahir ki toh kaha yeh Hazrat Yusuf A.S hain. Phir ek darwaza khol kar us mein se safed resham ka parcha nikal kar humein dikhaya jis mein ek surat thi, surkh rang, bhari pindliyan, kushada aankhein, uncha pet, qadre chota qad, talwar latkaye hue. Pucha inhe jante ho? Hum ne kaha nahin. Kaha yeh Hazrat Dawood A.S hain. Phir aur darwaza khol kar safed resham nikala jis mein ek surat thi, moti ranon wali, lambe pairon wali, ghore sawar. Pucha inhe pehchana? Hum ne kaha nahin, kaha yeh Hazrat Sulaiman A.S hain. Phir ek aur darwaza khola aur us mein se siyah rang hareeri parcha nikala jis mein ek surat thi, safed rang, naujawan, sakht siyah darhi, bahut zyada baal, khushnuma aankhein, khubsurat chehra. Pucha inhe jante ho? Hum ne kaha nahin, kaha yeh Hazrat Isa bin Maryam A.S hain. Hum ne pucha aap ke paas yeh suratein kahan se aayin? Yeh toh humein yaqeen ho gaya hai ke yeh tamam Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) ki asli surat ke bilkul theek namune hain, kyunke hum ne apne Paighambar ﷺ ki surat ko bilkul theek aur durust paya. Badshah ne jawab diya baat yeh hai ke Hazrat Adam A.S ne Rabb-ul-Izzat se dua ki ke aap ki aulad mein se jo Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) hain un sab ko dikhaya jaye, pas un ki suratein aap par nazil huin jo Hazrat Adam A.S ke khazane mein jo suraj ke ghuroob hone ki jagah par tha mehfooz thin, Zulqarnain ne inhe wahan se le liya aur Hazrat Daniyal ko dein. Phir badshah kehne lage ke main toh is par khush hoon ke apni badshahat chor doon, main agar ghulam hota toh tumhare hathon bik jata aur tumhari ghulami mein apni puri zindagi basar karta. Phir us ne humein bahut kuch tohfe-tahaif de kar achi tarah rukhsat kiya. Jab hum Khalifa-tul-Muslimeen Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.A ke darbar mein pohanche aur yeh sara waqea bayan kiya toh Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar R.A roye aur farmane lage is maskeen ke sath Allah ki taufiq rafeeq hoti toh yeh aisa kar guzarta. Hamein Rasool Allah ﷺ ne batlaya hai ke Nasrani aur Yahudi Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ ke ausaf apni kitabon mein barabar paate hain. Yeh riwayat Imam Baihaqi ki kitab Dalail-un-Nabuwwah mein bhi hai. Is ki asnad bhi khauf-o-khatar se khali hai.

Hazrat Ata bin Yasar farmate hain main ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr se poocha ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki jo sifatein Taurat mein hain woh mujhe batao toh unhon ne farmaya haan wallah aap ki sifatein Taurat mein hain jo Quran mein bhi hain ke aye Nabi hum ne aap ko gawah aur khushkhabri sunane wala aur aagah karne wala aur un-parhon ko gumrahi se bachane wala bana kar bheja hai. Aap mere bande aur Rasool hain, aap ka naam Mutawakkil hai, aap bad-go aur bad-khulq nahin hain. Allah Ta'ala aap ko qabz na kare ga jab tak ke aap ki wajah se logon ki zaban se La Ilaha Illallah kehwa kar terhay deen ko durust na kar de. Band dilon ko khol de ga, behray kanon ko sunne wala bana de ga, andhi aankhon ko dekhti kar de ga. Yeh riwayat Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein bhi hai. Hazrat Ata farmate hain phir main Hazrat Ka'ab se mila aur un se bhi yahi sawal kiya toh unhon ne bhi yahi jawab diya ek harf ki bhi kami beshi dono sahibon ke bayan mein na thi yeh aur baat hai ke aap ne apni lughat mein dono ke alfaaz bole. Bukhari Sharif ki is riwayat mein is zikr ke baad ke aap bad-khulq nahin yeh bhi hai ke aap bazaron mein shor-o-ghul karne wale nahin, aap burai ke badle burai karne wale nahin balkay maafi aur darguzar karne wale hain. Abdullah bin Amr ki hadith ke zikr ke baad hai ke salaf ke kalam mein umooman Taurat ka lafz Ahl-e-Kitab ki kitabon par bola jata hai. Is ke mushaba aur bhi riwayatein hain wallah aalam. Tabrani mein Hazrat Jubair bin Mut'im se marwi hai ke main tijarat ki gharz se Sham mein gaya wahan meri mulaqat Ahl-e-Kitab ke ek aalim se hui. Us ne mujh se poocha ke Nabi tum mein hue hain? Main ne kaha haan, us ne kaha agar tumhein un ki surat dikhayen toh tum pehchan lo ge? Main ne kaha zaroor chunancha woh mujhe ek ghar mein le gaya jahan bohat si suratein thin lekin un mein meri nigah mein Huzoor (ﷺ) ki koi shabih na aayi, isi waqt ek aur aalim aaya hum se poocha kya baat hai? Jab usay sari baat maloom hui toh woh hamain apne makan le gaya wahan jate hi meri nigah aap ki shabih par pari aur main ne dekha ke goya koi aap ke peeche hi aap ko thame hue hai, main ne yeh dekh kar us se poocha yeh dusre sahib peeche kaise hain? Us ne jawab diya ke jo Nabi aaya us ke baad bhi Nabi aaya lekin is Nabi ke baad koi Nabi nahin is ke peeche ka yeh shakhs is ka khalifa hai. Ab jo main ne gaur se dekha toh woh bilkul Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ki shakal thi. Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ne ek martaba apne muazzin Aqra ko ek padri ke paas bheja aap usay bula laye Ameer-ul-Momineen ne us se poocha ke batao tum meri sifat apni kitabon mein pate ho? Us ne kaha haan, kaha kya? Us ne jawab diya ke Qarn. Aap ne kora utha kar farmaya Qarn kya hai? Us ne kaha goya ke woh lohay ka seeng hai woh ameer hai deen mein bohat sakht. Farmaya achha mere baad wale ki sifat kya hai? Us ne kaha ke khalifa toh woh nek saleh hai lekin apne qarabatdaron ko woh dusron par tarjeeh de ga.

Aap ne farmaya Allah Usman par raham kare teen baar yeh farmaya phir farmaya achha un ke baad? Us ne kaha lohay ke tukray jaisa. Hazrat Umar ne apna haath apne sar par rakh liya aur afsos karne lage us ne kaha ae Ameer-ul-Momineen honge toh woh nek khalifa lekin banaye hi us waqt jayenge jab talwar khinchi hui ho aur khoon beh raha ho (Abu Dawood). In kitabon mein Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ek sifat yeh bhi thi ke aap nekiyon ka hukm denge buraiyon se rokenge. Fi-al-waqay aap aise hi thay konsi bhalai hai jis ka aap ne hukm na diya ho? Konsi burai hai jis se aap ne na roka ho? Jaise ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) farmate hain tum jab Quran ke yeh lafz suno ke ae imaan walo toh usi waqt hamah-tan-gosh ho jao kyunke ya toh kisi khair ka tumhein hukm kiya jayega ya kisi shar se tumhein bachaya jayega. In mein sab se zyada takeed Allah ki wahdaniyat thi jis ka hukm barabar har Nabi ko hota raha. Quran shahid hai ke har ummat ke Rasool ko pehla hukm yahi mila ke woh logon se keh dein ke ek Allah ki ibadat karo aur us ke masawa kisi ki ibadat na karo. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein farman-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai ke jab tum meri kisi hadith ko suno jisay tumhare dil pehchan lein tumhare jism us ki qabooliyat ke liye tayyar hojayen aur tumhein yeh maloom ho ke woh mere laiq hai toh main us se ba-nisbat tumhare zyada laiq hoon aur jab tum mere naam se koi aisi baat suno jis se tumhare dil inkaar karein aur tumhare jism nafrat karein aur tum dekho ke woh tum se bahut door hai pas main ba-nisbat tumhare bhi us se bahut door hoon. Is ki sanad bahut pakki hai. Isi ki ek aur riwayat mein Hazrat Ali (R.A) ka qaul hai ke jab tum Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se manqool koi hadith suno toh us ke sath woh khayal karo jo khoob raah wala bahut mubarak aur bahut parhezgari wala ho. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ek sifat bayan ho rahi hai ke aap kul paak saaf aur tayyab cheezon ko halal karte hain bahut si cheezin un mein aisi thin jinhein logon ne az-khud haram qarar de liya tha jaise janwaron ko buton ke naam kar ke nishan daal kar unhein haram samajhna waghera aur khabeeth aur gandi cheezin aap logon par haram karte hain jaise soor ka gosht sood waghera aur jo haram cheezin logon ne az-khud halal kar li thin. Baaz ulama ka farman hai ke Allah ki halal karda cheezin khao woh deen mein bhi taraqqi karti hain aur badan mein bhi faida pohanchati hain aur jo cheezin haram kar di hain un se bacho kyunke un se deen ke nuqsan ke ilawa sehat mein bhi nuqsan hota hai. Is aayat-e-karima se baaz logon ne istidlal kiya hai ke cheezon ki achhai burai darasal aqli hai.

Is ke bahut se jawab diye gaye hain lekin yeh jagah is ke bayan ki nahin. Isi aayat ko zer-e-nazar rakh kar ba'az aur ulama ne kaha hai ke jin cheezon ka halal-o-haram hona kisi ko na pahuncha ho aur koi aayat-o-hadith is ke bare mein na mili ho to dekhna chahiye ke Arab use achi cheez samajhte hain ya is se karahat karte hain. Agar use achi cheez jaan kar istemaal mein late hain to halal hai aur agar buri cheez samajh kar nafrat kar ke use na khate hon to woh haram hai. Is usool mein bhi bahut kuch guftagu hai. Phir farmata hai ke aap bahut saaf, aasaan aur sahal deen le kar aaye hain. Chunancha hadith-e-sharif mein hai ke main ek taraf aasaan deen de kar mab'oos kiya gaya hoon. Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari (R.A) aur Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal (R.A) ko jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Yaman ka ameer bana kar bhejte hain to farmate hain tum dono khush khabri dena, nafrat na dilana, aasani karna, sakhti na karna, mil kar rehna, ikhtilaf na karna. Aap ke sahabi Ayyubrza Aslami (R.A) farmate hain main Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath raha hoon aur aap ki aasaniyon ka khoob mushahida kiya hai. Pehli ummaton mein bahut sakhtiyan thin lekin Parwardigar-e-Aalam ne is ummat se woh tamam tangiyan door farma dein. Aasaan deen aur saholat wali shariat inhe ata farmayi. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain meri ummat ke dilon mein jo waswase guzrein un par inhe pakad nahin jab tak ke zaban se na nikalein ya amal na layein. Farmate hain meri ummat ki bhool chook aur ghalti se aur jo kaam un se jabran kiye karaye jayein un se Allah Ta'ala ne qalam utha liya hai. Yehi wajah hai ke is ummat ko khud Allah Ta'ala ne yeh taleem farmayi ke kaho ke aye hamare Parwardigar tu hamari bhool chook par hamari pakad na kar. Aye hamare Rab hum par woh bojh na lao jo hum se pehlon par tha. Aye hamare Rab hamein hamari taqat se zyada bojh na kar. Hamein maaf farma, hamein bakhsh, hum par raham farma. Tu hi hamara karsaz Maula hai. Pas hamein kafiron par madad ata farma. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai ke jab musalmanon ne yeh duayein keen to har jumle par Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya main ne yeh qabool farmaya. Pas jo log is Nabi-e-Akhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par imaan layein aur aap ka adab-o-izzat karein aur jo wahi aap par utri hai us noor ki pairwi karein wohi duniya-o-akhirat mein falah paane wale hain.

An-Nabi-ul-Aalim aur An-Nabi-ul-Khatim (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam). Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi-o-Rasool Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum farmata hai ke tamam Arab-o-Ajam, goron, kalon se keh do ke main tum sab ki taraf Allah ka bheja hua hoon. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sharafat-o-azmat hai ke aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Khatam-ul-Anbiya hain aur tamam duniya ke liye sirf aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hi Nabi hain. Jaise farman-e-Quran hai aayat: (Qulillahu shaheedum baini wa bainakum wa uhiya ilayya hadhal-Qur'anu li-undhirakum bihi wa mam balagh) (Surah Al-An'am: 19) yani elaan kar de ke mujh mein tum mein Allah gawah hai, is pak Quran ki wahi meri janib is liye utari gayi hai ke main is se tumhein aur jin logon tak yeh pahunche sab ko hoshiyar kar doon. Aur aayat mein hai: (Wa may yakfur bihi minal-ahzabi fan-naru mau'iduhu) (Surah Hud: 17) yani makhlooq ke mukhtalif giroh mein se jo bhi aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se inkaar kare us ki wa'da-gah jahannam hai. Aur aayat mein hai: (Wa qul lilladhina utul-kitaba wal-ummiyyina a-aslamtum fa-in aslamu faqad-ihtadaw wa in tawallaw fa-innama 'alaikal-balagh) (Surah Al-Imran: 20) yani Ahl-e-Kitab aur ghair Ahl-e-Kitab se keh do ke kya tum maante ho? Agar tasleem kar lein, musalman ho jayen to rah par hain warna tere zimme to sirf pahuncha dena hi hai. Is mazmoon ki aur bhi Qur'ani aayatein bakasrat hain aur hadeesein to is bare mein beshumar hain. Deen-e-Islam ki zara si bhi samajh jise hai woh bil-yaqeen jaanta aur maanta hai ke aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tamam jahan ke logon ki taraf Rasool-e-Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hain. Is aayat ki tafseer mein Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai ke ittefaq se Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) aur Hazrat Umar (R.A) mein kuch chashmak ho gayi. Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ne Hazrat Farooq (R.A) ko naraz kar diya. Hazrat Farooq (R.A) isi halat mein chale gaye. Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ne darkhwast ki ke aap maaf farmayen aur Allah se mere liye bakhshish chahein lekin Hazrat Umar (R.A) raazi na hue balki kawar band kar liye. Aap (R.A) laut kar darbar-e-Muhammadi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mein aaye, us waqt aur sahaba bhi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki majlis mein maujood the. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Tumhare is saathi ne inhein naraz aur ghazabnak kar diya. Hazrat Umar (R.A), Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ki wapsi ke baad bahut hi nadim hue aur usi waqt darbar-e-Risalat-ma'ab (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mein hazir ho kar tamam baat keh sunayi. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) naraz hue. Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) baar baar kehte jaate the ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) zyada zulm to mujh se sar-zad hua hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Kya tum mere saathi ko meri wajah se chhodte nahin? Suno jab main ne is aawaz-e-haq ko uthaya ke logo main tum sab ki taraf Allah ka paighambar bana kar bheja gaya hoon to tum ne kaha tu jhoota hai lekin is Abu Bakr (R.A) ne kaha aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sache hain. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marfu'an marwi hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Mujhe paanch cheezein aisi di gayi hain jo mujh se pehle kisi Nabi ko nahin di gayin.

Yaad rahe ke main ise fakhran nahin kehta, main tamam surkh-o-siyah logon ki janib bheja gaya hoon aur meri madad mahine bhar ke fasle se sirf ra'ab ke sath ki gayi hai aur mere liye ghanimaton ke maal halal kiye gaye hain halankeh mujh se pehle woh kisi ke liye halal nahin kiye gaye the aur mere liye sari zameen masjid aur wuzu ke liye halal kar di gayi hai aur mujhe apni ummat ki shafa'at ata farmayi gayi hai jise main ne un logon ke liye makhsoos kar rakha hai jo Allah ke sath kisi ko shareek na karein. (Musnad-e-Imam Ahmad). Riwayat hai ke Ghazwa-e-Tabook wale saal Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) raat ko Tahajjud ki namaz ke liye khade hue, pas bahut se Sahaba (R.A) aap ke peeche jama ho gaye ke aap ki chaukidari karein. Namaz ke baad aap un ki taraf mutawajjeh hue aur farmaya: Is raat mujhe paanch cheezein di gayi hain jo mujh se pehle aur kisi ko nahin di gayin. Main tamam logon ki taraf Rasool bana kar bheja gaya hoon, mujh se pehle ke tamam Rasool sirf apni apni qoum ki taraf hi Nabi bana kar bheje jate rahe. Mujhe apne dushmanon par ra'ab ke sath madad di gayi hai, go woh mujh se mahine bhar ke fasle par hon, wahin woh mar'oob ho jate hain. Mere liye maal-e-ghanimat halal kiye gaye hain halankeh mujh se pehle ke log un ki bahut azmat karte the, woh is maal ko jala diya karte the. Aur mere liye sari zameen masjid aur wuzu ki paak cheez bana di gayi hai, jahan kahin mere ummati ko namaz ka waqt aa jaye woh tayammum kar le aur namaz ada kar le. Mujh se pehle ke log is ki azmat karte the, siwaye un jaghon ke jo namaz ke liye makhsoos thin, aur jagah namaz nahin padh sakte the. Aur paanchwin khusoosiyat yeh hai ke mujh se farmaya gaya aap dua kijiye, mangiye kya mangte hain? Har Nabi maang chuka hai, toh main ne apne is sawal ko Qayamat par utha rakha hai, pas woh tum sab ke liye hai aur har us shakhs ke liye jo La Ilaha Illallah ki gawahi de. Is ki asnaad bahut pukhta hain aur Musnad-e-Ahmad mein yeh hadith majood hai. Musnad ki aur hadith mein hai ke meri is ummat mein se jis Yahudi ya Nasrani ke kaan mein mera zikr pade aur woh mujh par iman na laye woh Jannat mein nahin ja sakta, yeh hadith aur sanad se Sahih Muslim Sharif mein bhi hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke us Allah ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, mera zikr is ummat ke jis Yahudi Nasrani ke paas pahunche aur woh mujh par aur meri wahi par iman na laye aur mar jaye woh jahannami hai. Musnad ki ek aur hadith mein aap ne un paanchon cheezon ka zikr farmaya jo sirf aap ko hi mili hain, phir farmaya har Nabi ne shafa'at ka sawal kar liya hai aur main ne apne sawal ko chupa rakha hai aur un ke liye utha rakha hai jo meri ummat mein se tawheed par mare. Yeh hadith Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) ki riwayat se Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi majood hai ke mujhe paanch cheezein di gayi hain jo mujh se pehle ke Anbiya (A.S) ko nahin di gayin: Mahine bhar ki musafat tak ra'ab se imdad-o-nusrat, sari zameen ka masjid-o-tahoor hona ke meri ummat ko jahan waqt-e-namaz aa jaye ada kar le, ghanimaton ka halal kiya jana jo pehle kisi ke liye halal na thin.

Shafa'at ka diya jana, tamam logon ki taraf mab'oos kiya jana halankeh pehle ke ambiya sirf apni qoum ki taraf hi bheje jate thay. Phir farmata hai ke kaho mujhe us Allah ne bheja hai jo zameen-o-aasman ka badshah hai, sab cheezon ka khaliq-o-malik hai, jis ke haath mein mulk hai, jo maarne jilane par qadir hai, jis ka hukm chalta hai. Pas ae logo! tum Allah par aur us ke Rasool-o-Nabi par imaan lao jo an-parh hone ke bawajood duniya ko parha rahe hain, inhi ka tum se wada tha aur inhi ki basharat tumhari kitabon mein bhi hai. Inhi ki sifatein agli kitabon mein hain. Yeh khud Allah ki zaat par aur us ke kalmaat par imaan rakhte hain. Qoul-o-fe'l sab mein Allah ke kalam ke mutee' hain. Tum sab in ke matahat aur farmanbardar ho jao. Inhi ke tariqe par chalo, inhi ki farmanbardari karo, tum rah-e-raast par aa jao ge.

Anbiya ka qatil giroh khabar hai ke Ummat-e-Musa mein bhi ek giroh haq ka manne wala hai. Jaise farman hai aayat (Laisa sawan min ahlil kitabi ummatun qaimatun yatloona aayatillahi aana-al-laili wahum yasjudoon) (Surah Aal-e-Imran: 113), Ahl-e-Kitab mein se ek jamaat haq par qaim hai, raaton ko Allah ke kalam ki tilawat karti rehti hai aur barabar sajde kiya karti hai aur aayat mein hai (Wa inna min ahlil kitabi lamay yu'minu billahi wa ma unzila ilaikum wa ma unzila ilaihim khashi'eena lillahi la yashtaruna bi-aayatillahi samanan qaleela, ula-ika lahum ajruhum inda rabbihim, innallaha saree-ul-hisab) (Surah Aal-e-Imran: 199), yani Ahl-e-Kitab mein aise log bhi hain jo Allah par aur us par jo tumhari taraf nazil kiya gaya hai aur us par jo unki taraf utara gaya hai iman ka aur uski haqaniyat ka elaan karte hain aur kehte hain ke hum is se pehle hi musalman thay unhein unke sabr ka dohra ajar hai aur aayat mein hai (Allazeena aatainahumul kitaba yatloonahu haqqa tilawatihi, ula-ika yu'minoona bihi, wa may yakfur bihi fa-ula-ika humul khasiroon) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 121), jo log hamari kitab paye hue hain aur use haq tilawat ki adaigi ke sath parhte hain woh is Quran par bhi iman rakhte hain aur farman hai aayat (Qul aaminoo bihi au la tu'minoo, innallazeena ootul ilma min qablihi iza yutla alaihim yakhiroona lil-azqani sujjada) (Surah Al-Isra: 107) jo log pehle ilm diye gaye hain woh hamare pak Quran ki aayatein sun kar sajdon mein gir parte hain. Hamari pakeezgi ka izhar kar ke hamare wadon ki sachai bayan karte hain. Apni thodiyon ke bal rote hue sajde karte hain aur aajizi aur Allah se khauf khane mein sabqat le jate hain. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ne apni tafsir mein is jagah ek ajeeb khabar likhi hai ke Ibn-e-Jurayj farmate hain jab Bani Israel ne kufr kiya aur apne nabiyon ko qatl kiya unke barah giroh thay un mein se ek giroh is nalaiq giroh se alag raha Allah Ta'ala se ma'zoorat ki aur dua ki ke un mein aur un gyarah girohon mein woh tafreeq kar de. Chunancha zameen mein ek surang ho gayi yeh is mein chale gaye aur Cheen ke parle paar nikal gaye wahan par sache seedhe musalman unhein mile jo hamare qibla ki taraf namazein parhte thay. Kehte hain ke aayat (Wa qulna mim ba'dihi li-Bani Isra'ilas kunul arda fa-iza ja'a wa'dul aakhirati ji'na bikum lafeefa) (Surah Al-Isra: 104) ka yahi matlab hai. Is aayat mein jis dusre wade ka zikr hai yeh aakhirat ka wada hai. Kehte hain is surang mein dedh saal tak woh chalte rahe. Kehte hain is qoum ke aur tumhare darmiyan ek nehar hai.

Yeh sab aayatein Surah Baqarah mein guzar chuki hain aur wahin in ki poori tafsir bhi bihamdillah hum ne bayan kar di hai. Woh Surah Madaniyah hai aur yeh Makkiyah hai. In aayaton aur un aayaton ka farq bhi ma'a latafat ke hum ne wahin zikr kar diya hai, dobara ki zaroorat nahin.

Yeh sab aayatein Surah Baqarah mein guzar chuki hain aur wahin in ki poori tafsir bhi bihamdillah hum ne bayan kar di hai. Woh Surah Madaniyah hai aur yeh Makkiyah hai. In aayaton aur un aayaton ka farq bhi ma'a latafat ke hum ne wahin zikr kar diya hai, dobara ki zaroorat nahin.

Yeh sab aayatein Surah Baqarah mein guzar chuki hain aur wahin in ki poori tafsir bhi bihamdillah hum ne bayan kar di hai. Woh Surah Madaniyah hai aur yeh Makkiyah hai. In aayaton aur un aayaton ka farq bhi ma'a latafat ke hum ne wahin zikr kar diya hai, dobara ki zaroorat nahin.

Tasdeeq-e-Risalat se gurezan Yahudi ulama pehle aayat (Walaqad 'alimtumullazina'tadau minkum fis-sabti faqulna lahum kunu qiradatan khasi'in) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 65) guzar chuki hai, isi waqiye ka tafseeli bayan is aayat mein hai. Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum deta hai ke aap apne zamane ke Yahudiyon se unke pehle baap dadon ki babat sawal kijiye jinhon ne Allah ke farman ki mukhalifat ki thi, pas unki sarkashi aur heela joi ki wajah se hamari achanak pakad un par musallat hui. Is waqiye ko yaad dila ke yeh bhi meri nagahani saza se dar kar apni is mal'oon sifat ko badal dein aur aap ke jo ausaf unki kitabon mein hain unhein na chupayein, aisa na ho ke unki tarah un par bhi hamare azab unki bekhabari mein baras padein.

In logon ki yeh basti Bahr-e-Qulzum ke kinare waqay thi jiska naam Ailah tha. Madyan aur Toor ke darmiyan yeh shehar tha. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke is basti ka naam Madyan tha. Ek qaul yeh hai ke iska naam Mutna tha. Yeh Madyan aur Ainoon ke darmiyan tha. Inhein hukum mila ke yeh hafte ke din ki hurmat karein aur us din shikar na khelein, machli na pakdein. Idhar machliyon ki bahukum-e-Ilahi yeh halat hui ke hafte wale din to chadhi chali aatin, khulam khula hath lagtin, tairti phirtin, sab taraf se simat kar aa jatin aur jab hafta na hota ek machli bhi nazar na aati, balkay talash par bhi hath na lagti. Yeh hamari aazmaish thi ke machliyan hain to shikar mana aur shikar jaiz hai to machliyan nadarad. Chunke yeh log fasiq aur behukum the is liye hum ne bhi inko is tarah aazmaya. Aakhir in logon ne heela joi shuru ki, aise asbab jama karne shuru kiye jo batin mein is haram kaam ka zariya ban jayein.

Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Yahudiyon ki tarah heele kar ke zara si der ke liye Allah ke haram ko halal na kar lena. Is hadith ko Imam Ibn-e-Bat'ta laye hain aur iski sanad nihayat umdah hai, iske rawi Ahmad hain. Muhammad bin Muslim ka zikr Imam Khatib (R.H) ne apni tarikh mein kiya hai aur unhein siqah kaha hai, baqi aur sab rawi bahut mashhoor hain aur sab ke sab siqah hain, aisi bahut si sanadon ko Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) ne sahih kaha hai.

Ashab-e-Sabt jis basti ke logon ka zikr ho raha hai un ke teen giroh ho gaye thay. Ek toh haram shikar khelne wala aur heelay hawalon se machli pakadne wala. Dusra giroh unhein rokne wala aur un se bezari zahir kar ke un se alag ho jane wala aur teesra giroh chup chap reh kar na is kaam ko karne wala na is se rokne wala, jaise ke Surah Al-Baqarah ki tafsir mein hum khulasa-war bayan kar aaye hain. Jo log khamosh thay na burai karte thay na buron ko burai se rokte thay unhon ne rokne walon ko samjhana shuru kiya ke miyan in logon ko kehne sunne se kya faida? Unhon ne toh Allah ke azab mol le liye hain, Rabb ke ghazab ke liye tayyar ho gaye hain, ab tum in ke peeche kyun pade ho? Toh is pak giroh ne jawab diya ke is mein do faide hain. Ek toh yeh ke Allah ke paas hum ma'zarat khwah ho jayen ke hum apna farz barabar ada karte rahe, unhein har waqt samjhate bujhate rahe. Ma'zarat ke pesh se bhi ek qirat hai toh goya haza ka lafz yahan muqarrar mana yani unhon ne kaha yeh hamari ma'zarat hai aur zabar ki qirat par yeh matlab hai ke hum jo unhein rok rahe hain yeh kaam bator is ke kar rahe hain ke Allah ke han hum par ilzam na aaye kyunke Allah ka hukum hai ke hamesha neki ka hukum karte raho aur burai se rokte raho. Dusra faida is mein yeh hai ke bohat mumkin hai kisi waqt ki nasihat un par asar kar jaye, yeh log apni is haram-kari se baz aa jayen, Allah se tauba karein toh Allah Ta'ala bhi un par meherbani kare aur un ke gunah maaf farma de. Aakhir-e-kar un ki nasihat-e-khair-khwahi bhi be-natija sabit hui. In badkaron ne ek na mani toh hum ne is muslim giroh ko toh jo barabar un se nalan raha, un se alag raha aur unhein samjhata bujhata raha, nijat de di aur baqi ke zalimon ko jo hamari nafarmaniyon ke murtakib thay apne badtareen azabon se pakad liya. Ibadat ki umdagi mulahiza ho ke rokne walon ki nijat ka khule lafzon mein elan kiya, zalimon ki halakat ka bhi ghair-mushtaba alfaaz mein bayan kiya aur chup rehne walon ke halaat se sukoot kiya gaya, is liye ke har amal ki jaza usi ki hum-jins hai. Yeh log na toh is zulm-e-azeem mein shareek thay ke un ki muzammat elaniya ki jaye, na daleri se rokte thay ke saaf taur par qabil-e-tareef thehrein. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain jo giroh mumanat karne ke baad thak kar baith gaya tha aur phir rokna chhod diya tha, Allah ka azab jab aaya toh yeh giroh bhi is azab se bach gaya, sirf wahi halak hue jo gunah mein mubtala thay. Aap ke shagird Hazrat Ikrama (R.H) ka bayan hai ke pehle Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ko is mein bada taraddud tha ke aaya yeh log halak hue ya bach gaye, yahan tak ke ek roz main aaya toh dekha ke Quran god mein rakhe hue ro rahe hain.

Awwal awwal toh mera hausla na para ke samne aaun lekin der tak jab yahi halat rahi toh main ne qareeb aakar salam kiya, baith gaya aur rone ki wajah daryaft ki toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya dekho yeh Surah Al-A'raf hai is mein Ailah ke Yahudiyon ka zikr hai ke unhein hafte ke roz machli ke shikar ki muman'at kar di gayi aur un ki aazmaish ke liye machliyon ko hukum hua ke woh sirf hafte ke din hi niklein. Hafte ke din darya machliyon se bhare rehte thay. Taro taza moti aur umda bakasrat machliyan pani ke oopar uchalti koodti rehti thin aur dinon mein sakht koshish ke bawajood bhi na milti thin. Kuch dinon toh un ke dilon ke andar Amr-e-Ilahi ki azmat rahi aur yeh un ke pakarne se ruke rahe lekin phir Shaitan ne un ke dil mein yeh qayas daal diya ke is din mana khane se hai tum ne aaj khana nahin, pakar lo aur jaiz din kha lena. Sachay musalmanon ne unhein is heela joi se harchand roka aur samjhaya ke dekho shikar khelna shuru na karo, shikar aur khana dono mamnoo hain. Agle jumma ke din jo jamaat shaitani phande mein phans chuki thi woh apne baal bachon samet shikar ko nikal khari hui. Baqi ke logon ki do jamaatein ban gayin, ek un ke dayein, ek bayein. Dayein janib wali toh barabar unhein rokti rahi ke Allah se daro aur Allah ke azabon ke liye tayari na karo. Bayein walon ne kaha miyan tumhein kya pari? Yeh toh kharab hone wale hain ab tum inhein nasihat kar ke kya loge? Unhon ne jawab diya ke khair Allah ke haan hum toh chhoot jayenge aur hamein toh ab tak mayusi bhi nahin, kya ajab ke yeh log sanwar jayen toh halakat aur azab se mehfooz rahein. Hamari toh ain mansha yeh hai lekin yeh badkar apni beimani se baaz na aaye aur nasihat unhein kargar na hui toh dayein taraf ke logon ne kaha tum ne hamara kaha na mana, Allah ki nafarmani ki, irtikab-e-hurmat kiya. Ajab nahin raton raat tum par koi azab-e-Rabb aaye, Allah tumhein zameen mein dhansa de ya tum par patthar barsa de ya kisi aur tarah tumhein saza de. Raat hum toh yahin guzarenge tumhare sath shehar mein nahin rahenge. Jab subah ho gayi aur shehar ke darwaze na khule toh unhon ne kawar khat khataye, awazein dein lekin koi jawab na aaya. Aakhir seerhi laga kar ek shakhs ko qila ki deewar par charhaya, us ne dekha toh hairan ho gaya ke sab log bandar bana diye gaye. Us ne un sab musalmanon ko khabar di. Yeh darwaze tor kar andar gaye toh dekha ke sab dum-dar bandar ban gaye hain, yeh toh kisi ko pehchan na sake lekin woh pehchan gaye. Har bandar apne apne rishtedar ke qadmon mein lotne laga, un ke kapray pakar pakar kar rone laga toh unhon ne kaha dekho hum toh tumhein mana kar rahe thay lekin tum ne mana hi nahin. Woh apna sar hilate thay ke haan theek hai hamare aamal ki shamat ne hi hamein barbad kiya hai. Toh ab yeh toh Quran mein hai ke rokne wale nijat yafta hue lekin yeh bayan nahin ke jo rokne walon ko mana karte thay un ka kya hashr hua?

Ab hum bhi bohat si khilaf baatein dekhte hain aur kuch nahin kar sakte, main ne aap se yeh sun kar kaha Allah mujhe aap par nisar kar de aap yeh toh dekhiye ke woh log un ke is fe'l ko bura samajhte rahe the un ki mukhalifat karte the jaante the ke yeh halak hone wale hain zahir hai ke yeh bach gaye, aap ki samajh mein aa gaya aur usi waqt hukum diya ke mujhe do chadrein inaam mein di jayen. Al-gharaz is beech ki jamaat ki nisbat ek qaul toh yeh hai ke azaab se bach gayi dusra qaul yeh hai ke azaab un par bhi aaya. Ibn-e-Ruman farmate hain ke hafte wale din khoob machliyan aatin paani un se bhar jata phir beech ke kisi din nazar na aatin dusre hafte ko phir yahi haal hota, sab se pehle ek shakhs ne yeh heela nikala ke dor aur kanta tayyar kiya, machli ko is mein hafte ke din phansa liya aur paani mein hi chhor diya itwar ki raat ko ja kar nikal lin bhuna logon ko machli ki khushbu pahunchi toh sab ne gher liya. Har-chand pucha lekin awwal toh yeh sakhti se inkar karta raha aakhir us ne baat bana di ke darasal ek machli ka chhalka mujhe mil gaya tha main ne use bhuna tha, dusre hafte ke din us ne isi tarah do machliyan phans lin itwar ki raat ko nikal kar bhunne laga log aa gaye toh us ne kaha main ne ek tarkeeb nikal li hai jis se nafarmani bhi na ho aur kaam bhi na ruke ab jo heela bayan kiya toh un sab ne use pasand kiya aur aksar log yunhi karne lage. Yeh log raat ko shehr-e-panah ke phatak band kar ke sote the jis raat azaab aaya hasb-e-dastoor yeh shehr-e-panah ke phatak laga kar soye the. Subah ko jab bahar wale shehr mein dakhil hone ko aaye toh khilaf-e-mamool ab tak darwaze band paye aawazein dein koi jawab na mila qila par charh gaye dekha toh bandar bana diye gaye hain khol kar andar gaye toh bandar apne apne rishtedaron ke qadmon mein lotne lage is se pehle Surah Al-Baqarah ki aisi hi aayat ki tafseer ke mauqa par bil-tafseel un waqiyat ko achi tarah bayan kar chuke hain wahin dekh lijiye. Falhamdulillah, dusra qaul yeh hai ke jo chup rahe the woh bhi un gunahgaron ke sath halak huye, Ibn-e-Abbas se manqool hai ke pehle hafte ke din ki ta'zeem bator-e-bid'at khud un logon ne nikali ab Allah ki taraf se bator-e-aazmaish ke woh ta'zeem un par zaroori qarar de di gayi aur hukum ho gaya ke is din machli ka shikar na karo phir machliyon ka is din numaya hona aur dinon mein na nikalna waghera bayan farma kar farmaya ke phir un mein se ek shakhs ne ek machli hafte ke din pakri us ki naak mein surakh kar ke dor bandh kar ek keel kinare gaar kar is mein dor atka kar machli ko darya mein daal diya dusre din ja kar paani mein se nikal laya aur bhun kar kha li siwaye is paak-baaz haq-go jamaat ke logon ke kisi ne na use roka na mana kiya na samjhaya lekin un ki nasihat ka un par koi asar na hua. Is ek ki dekha-dekhi aur bhi yahi kaam karne lage yahan tak ke bazaron mein machli aane lagi aur a'laniya yeh kaam hone laga.

Ek aur jamaat ke logon ne is haq wali jamaat se kaha ke tum in logon ko kyun wa'z karte ho? Allah to inhe halak karne wala, sakht azab karne wala hai. Yeh teen grohon mein bat gaye the; ek to shikar khelne wala, ek mana karne wala, ek in mana karne walon se kehne wala ke ab nasihat bekar hai. Bas woh to bach gaye jo barabar rokte rahe the aur dono jamaatein halak kar di gayin. Sanad is ki nihayat umdah hai lekin Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka Hazrat Ikrama (R.H) ke qaul ki taraf ruju karna is qaul ke kehne se awla hai, is liye ke is qaul ke baad un par un ke haal ki haqeeqat khul gayi, Wallahu A'lam. Phir farman hai ke hum ne zalimon ko sakht azabon se daboch liya. Mafhoom ki dalalat to is baat par hai ke jo baqi rahe bach gaye. (Bi'sin) ki kayi ek qiratein hain, is ke ma'ni sakht ke, dardnak ke, takleef-deh ke hain aur sab ka matlab qareeb qareeb yaksan hai. Un ki sarkashi aur un ke had se guzar jaane ke ba'is hum ne un se keh diya ke tum zaleel, haqeer aur na-qadre bandar ban jao, chunancha woh aise hi ho gaye.

Ashab-e-Sabt jis basti ke logon ka zikr ho raha hai un ke teen giroh ho gaye thay. Ek toh haram shikar khelne wala aur heelay hawalon se machli pakadne wala. Subah ko jab bahar wale shehr mein dakhil hone ko aaye toh khilaf-e-mamool ab tak darwaze band paye aawazein dein koi jawab na mila qila par charh gaye dekha toh bandar bana diye gaye hain khol kar andar gaye toh bandar apne apne rishtedaron ke qadmon mein lotne lage is se pehle Surah Al-Baqarah ki aisi hi aayat ki tafseer ke mauqa par bil-tafseel un waqiyat ko achi tarah bayan kar chuke hain wahin dekh lijiye. Falhamdulillah, dusra qaul yeh hai ke jo chup rahe the woh bhi un gunahgaron ke sath halak huye, Ibn-e-Abbas se manqool hai ke pehle hafte ke din ki ta'zeem bator-e-bid'at khud un logon ne nikali ab Allah ki taraf se bator-e-aazmaish ke woh ta'zeem un par zaroori qarar de di gayi aur hukum ho gaya ke is din machli ka shikar na karo phir machliyon ka is din numaya hona aur dinon mein na nikalna waghera bayan farma kar farmaya ke phir un mein se ek shakhs ne ek machli hafte ke din pakri us ki naak mein surakh kar ke dor bandh kar ek keel kinare gaar kar is mein dor atka kar machli ko darya mein daal diya dusre din ja kar paani mein se nikal laya aur bhun kar kha li siwaye is paak-baaz haq-go jamaat ke logon ke kisi ne na use roka na mana kiya na samjhaya lekin un ki nasihat ka un par koi asar na hua. Is ek ki dekha-dekhi aur bhi yahi kaam karne lage yahan tak ke bazaron mein machli aane lagi aur a'laniya yeh kaam hone laga.

Ek aur jamaat ke logon ne is haq wali jamaat se kaha ke tum in logon ko kyun wa'z karte ho? Allah to inhe halak karne wala, sakht azab karne wala hai. To unhon ne woh jawab diya yani Allah ka farman dohraya. Lekin log farman-e-Rabbani ko bhool baithe aur azab-e-Rabb ke khud shikar ho gaye. Yeh teen grohon mein bat gaye the; ek to shikar khelne wala, ek mana karne wala, ek in mana karne walon se kehne wala ke ab nasihat bekar hai. Bas woh to bach gaye jo barabar rokte rahe the aur dono jamaatein halak kar di gayin. Sanad is ki nihayat umdah hai lekin Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka Hazrat Ikrama (R.H) ke qaul ki taraf ruju karna is qaul ke kehne se awla hai, is liye ke is qaul ke baad un par un ke haal ki haqeeqat khul gayi, Wallahu A'lam. Phir farman hai ke hum ne zalimon ko sakht azabon se daboch liya. Mafhoom ki dalalat to is baat par hai ke jo baqi rahe bach gaye. (Bi'sin) ki kayi ek qiratein hain, is ke ma'ni sakht ke, dardnak ke, takleef-deh ke hain aur sab ka matlab qareeb qareeb yaksan hai. Un ki sarkashi aur un ke had se guzar jaane ke ba'is hum ne un se keh diya ke tum zaleel, haqeer aur na-qadre bandar ban jao, chunancha woh aise hi ho gaye.

Allah Ta'ala ki nafarmani ka anjam zillat-o-ruswai. Allah Ta'ala ne Yahood ko ittila kardi ke unki is sakht nafarmani-o-bar bar ki baghawat aur har mauqa par nafarmani, Rabb se sarkashi aur Allah ke haram ko apne kaam mein lane ke liye heela joi kar ke use halal ki jama poshi ka badla yeh hai ke Qayamat tak tum dabe raho, zillat mein raho, log tumhein past karte chale jayen. Khud Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne bhi un par tawan muqarrar kardiya tha, saat saal ya terah saal tak yeh use ada karte rahe, sab se pehle khiraj ka tariqa aap ne hi ijad kiya, phir un par Yunaniyon ki hukumat hui, phir Kasraniyon, Kaldaniyon aur Nasraniyoon ki. Sab ke zamane mein zaleel aur haqeer rahe, un se jizya liya jata raha aur unhein pasti se ubharne ka koi mauqa na mila. Phir Islam aaya aur us ne bhi unhein past kiya, jizya aur khiraj barabar un se wasool hota raha. Garz yeh zaleel rahe, is ummat ke hathon bhi haqarat ke garhay mein gire rahe. Bil-akhir yeh Dajjal ke sath mil jayenge lekin Musalman Hazrat Isa (A.S) ke sath ja kar un ki tukhm rezi kardenge. Jo bhi Shariat-e-Ilahi ki mukhalifat karta hai, Allah ke farman ki tahqeer karta hai, Allah use jaldi hi saza de deta hai. Haan jo us ki taraf raghbat-o-rujoo kare, tauba kare, jhuke to woh bhi us ke sath bakhshish-o-rahmat se pesh aata hai. Chunke iman naam hai khauf aur umeed ka, isi liye yahan aur aksar jagah azab-o-sawab, pakar dakar aur bakhshish aur lalach dono ka ek sath bayan hua hai.

Rashwat-khori ka anjam zillat-o-ruswai hai. Bani Israel mukhtalif firqon aur giroh kar ke zameen mein phaila diye gaye. Jaise farman hai ke hum ne Bani Israel se kaha tum zameen mein raho saho, jab aakhirat ka wada aayega hum tumhein jama kar ke layenge. In mein kuch toh nek log thay, kuch bad thay, jinnat mein bhi yahi haal hai jaise Surah Jinn mein un ka qaul hai ke hum mein kuch toh nek hain aur kuch aur tarah ke hain. Hamare bhi mukhtalif firqe hote aaye hain. Phir farman hai ke main ne inhe sakhti-narmi se, lalach aur khauf se, aafiyat aur bala se, garz har tarah parakh liya taake woh apne kartoot se hat jayein. Jab yeh zamana bhi guzra jis mein nek-bad har tarah ke log thay, un ke baad toh aise nakhalaf aur nala'iq aaye jin mein koi bhalai aur khairiyat thi hi nahin. Yeh ab Taurat ki tilawat wale reh gaye, mumkin hai is se murad sirf Nasrani hon aur mumkin hai ke yeh khabar aam Nasrani-ghair Nasrani sab par mushtamil ho. Woh haq baat ko badalne aur mitane ki fikr mein lag gaye, jaib bhar do jo chaho kehwa lo. Pas hawas yeh hai ke hai kya? Tauba kar lenge maaf ho jayega, phir mauqa aaya phir duniya le kar Allah ki baatein badal dein. Gunah kiya tauba ki, phir mauqa milte hi lapak kar gunah kar liya. Maqsood un ka duniya talbi hai, halal se mile chahe haram se mile phir bhi maghfirat ki tamanna hai. Yeh hain jo waris-e-Rasool kehlate hain aur jin se Allah ne ahd liya hai, jaise dusri aayat mein hai ke un ke baad aise nakhalaf aaye jinhon ne namaz tak zaya kar di. Bani Israel ka aaway ka aawa bigad gaya. Aaj ek ko qazi banate hain woh rashwatein khane aur ahkam badalne lagta hai, woh use hata kar dusre ko qaim karte hain us ka bhi yahi haal hota hai. Poochte hain bhai aisa kyun karte ho? Jawab milta hai Allah Ghafoor-o-Raheem hai. Phir woh un logon mein se kisi ko is ohday par late hain jo agle qaziyon, hakimon aur jajon ka shaki tha lekin woh bhi rashwatein lene lagta hai aur na-haq faisle karne lagta hai. Pas Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke tum aisa kyun karte ho? Halanke tum se mazboot ahd-o-paiman hum ne le liya hai ke tum haq ko zahir kiya karo use na chupao, lekin zaleel duniya ke lalach mein aa kar azab-e-Rabb mol le rahe ho. Isi wade ka bayan aayat (Wa iz akhazallahu meesaqallazina utul kitaba latubayyinunnahu linnasi wa la taktumunahu fanabazu hu wara'a zuhurihim washtarau bihi samanan qalila, fabi'sa ma yashtarun) (Surah Al-Imran: 187) mein hua hai. Yani Allah Ta'ala ne Yahood-o-Nasara se ahd liya tha ke woh Kitabullah logon ke samne bayan karte rahenge aur is ki koi baat na chupayenge. Yeh bhi is ke khilaf tha ke gunah karte chale jayein, tauba na karein aur bakhshish ki umeed rakhein. Phir Allah Ta'ala unhein apne paas ke ajr-o-sawab ki lalach dikhata hai ke agar taqwa kiya, haram se bache, khwahish-e-nafsani ke peeche na lage, Rabb ki ita'at ki toh aakhirat ka bhala tumhein milega jo is fani duniya ke thaath se bahut hi behtar hai.

Kya tum mein itni bhi samajh nahin ke garan-baha cheez ko chhod kar raddi cheez ke peeche pade ho? Phir Janab-e-Bari Azzawajal un mominon ki tareef karta hai jo Kitabullah par qaim hain aur is kitab ki rahnumai ke mutabiq is Paighambar-e-Akhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki itteba karte hain, Kalam-e-Rabb par jam kar amal karte hain, ahkam-e-Ilahi ko dil se maante hain aur baja late hain, us ke mana karda kamon se ruk gaye hain, namaz ko pabandi, dilchaspi, khushoo aur khuzoo se ada karte hain. Haqiqatan yahi log islah par hain, namumkin hai ke in nek aur pakbaz logon ka badla Allah Ta'ala zaya kar de.

Isi tarah ki aayat (Wa iz akhazna misaqakum wa rafa'na fauqakumut-tur, khuzu ma atainakum biquwwatin wazkuru ma fihi la'allakum tattaqun) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 63) hai, yani hum ne un ke saron par Tur pahar la khara kiya. Ise farishtay utha laye thay. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka bayan hai ke jab Musa A.S unhein arz-e-muqaddas ki taraf le chalay aur gussa utar janay ke baad takhtiyan utha lein aur un mein jo hukm-e-ahkaam thay, woh unhein sunaye to unhein woh sakht maloom huay aur tasleem-o-ta'meel se saaf inkar kar diya to ba-hukm-e-Ilahi farishton ne pahar utha kar un ke saron par la khara kar diya. (Nasa'i mein) marwi hai ke jab Kaleemullah Alaihis Salam ne farmaya ke logo Allah ki kitab ke ahkaam qabool karo to unhon ne jawab diya ke hamein sunao is mein kya ahkaam hain? Agar aasaan huay to hum manzoor kar lenge warna na manenge. Hazrat Musa A.S ke baar baar ke israr par bhi yeh log yahi kehte rahay, aakhir usi waqt Allah ke hukm se pahar apni jagah se uth kar un ke saron par mu'allaq khara ho gaya aur Allah ke paighambar ne farmaya bolo ab mantay ho ya Allah Ta'ala tum par pahar gira kar tumhein fana kar de? Usi waqt yeh sab ke sab maaray dar ke sajday mein gir paray lekin baayin aankh sajday mein thi aur daayin se oopar dekh rahay thay ke kahin pahar gir na paray. Chunancha Yahudiyon mein ab tak sajday ka tareeqa yahi hai, woh samajhte hain ke isi tarah ke sajday ne hum par se azab-e-Ilahi door kar diya hai. Phir jab Hazrat Musa A.S ne un takhtiyon ko khola to un mein kitab thi jisay khud Allah Ta'ala ne apne haath se likha tha, usi waqt tamam pahar, darakht, patthar sab kaanp uthay. Aaj bhi Yahudi tilawat-e-Torat ke waqt kaanp uthte hain aur un ke sar jhuk jatay hain.

Har rooh ne Allah Ta'ala ko apna khaliq mana. Aulad-e-Adam se Allah Ta'ala ne un ki naslein un ki peethon se roz-e-awwal mein nikalein. Phir un sab se is baat ka iqrar liya ke Rabb, Khaliq, Malik, Mabood sirf wahi hai. Isi fitrat par phir duniya mein un sab ko un ke waqt par us ne paida kiya. Yehi woh fitrat hai jis ki tabdeeli namumkin hai, Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke har bacha fitrat par paida hota hai. Ek riwayat mein hai ke is deen par paida hota hai phir us ke maa baap use yahudi, nasrani ya majoosi bana dete hain jaise ke bakri ka bacha sahih salim paida hota hai lekin phir log us ke kaan kaat dete hain. Hadith-e-Qudsi mein hai ke main ne apne bandon ko muwahid-o-mukhlis paida kiya phir shaitan ne aa kar unhein un ke sachay deen se behka kar meri halal karda cheezein un par haram kar dein. Qabeela Banu Sa'ad ke ek sahabi Hazrat Aswad bin Saree' R.A farmate hain main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath chaar ghazway kiye, logon ne ladne wale kuffar ke qatl ke baad un ke bachon ko bhi pakad liya, jab Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko is ka ilm hua to bohat naraz hue aur farmaya log in bachon ko kyun pakad rahe hain? Kisi ne kaha huzoor woh bhi to mushrikon ke hi bache hain? Farmaya suno tum mein se behtar log mushrikeen ki aulad mein hain, yaad rakho har bacha fitrat-e-Islam par paida hota hai phir zaban chalne par us ke maa baap yahudiyat ya nasraniyat ki taleem dene lagte hain. Is ke rawi Hazrat Hasan R.H farmate hain isi ka zikr is aayat mein hai ke Allah ne aulad-e-Adam se apni tawheed ka iqrar liya hai (Ibn-e-Jareer). Is iqrar ke bare mein kayi ek hadeesein marwi hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Qayamat ke din dozakhi se kaha jaye ga agar tamam duniya teri ho to kya tu khush hai ke ise apne fidiye mein de kar mere azabon se aaj bach jaye? Woh kahe ga haan. Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga main ne to is se bohat hi halkay darjay ki cheez tujh se talab ki thi aur us ka wada bhi tujh se le liya tha ke mere siwa tu kisi aur ki ibadat na kare lekin tu ahd tooray baghair na raha aur dusre ko mera shareek-e-ibadat thehraya. Musnad mein hai Nu'man nami maidan mein Allah Ta'ala ne pusht-e-Adam mein se Arafah ke din un ki tamam aulad zahir farmayi, sab ko us ke samne phaila diya aur farmaya ke main tum sab ka Rabb nahin hoon? Sab ne kaha haan hum gawah hain, phir Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mubtiloon tak tilawat farmayi. Yeh riwayat mauqoof Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se bhi marwi hai, Wallahu A'lam. Us waqt log cheontiyon ki tarah thay aur tar zameen par thay. Hazrat Zahhak bin Muzahim R.H ke chhay din ki umr ke sahibzade ka inteqal ho gaya to Aap R.H ne farmaya Jabir ise dafan kar ke us ka munh kafan se khol dena aur girah bhi khol dena kyunke mera yeh bacha bitha diya jaye ga aur us se sawal kiya jaye ga. Jabir ne hukm ki baja awari ki, phir main ne poocha ke aap ke bache se kya sawal hoga aur kaun sawal kare ga? Farmaya is meesaq ke bare mein jo sulb-e-Adam mein liya gaya hai sawal kiya jaye ga. Main ne poocha woh meesaq kya hai?

Farmaya main ne Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas se suna hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne Adam A.S ki peeth par haath phera toh jitne insaan Qayamat tak paida hone wale hain sab ki roohein aa gayin. Allah ne un se ahd-o-paiman liya ke woh isi ki ibadat karenge, us ke siwa kisi aur ko mabood nahin manenge, khud un ke rizq ka kafeel bana, phir unhein sulb-e-Adam mein lauta diya. Pas yeh sab Qayamat se pehle hi pehle paida honge. Jis ne is wade ko pura kiya aur apni zindagi mein is par qaim raha use woh wada nafa de ga aur jis ne apni zindagi mein is ki khilaf warzi ki use pehle ka wada kuch faida na de ga. Bachpan mein hi jo mar gaya woh Misaq-e-Awwal par aur fitrat par mara. In aasar se bhi bazahir yahi maloom hota hai ke upar wali hadith ka mauqoof hona hi aksar aur zyada suboot wala hai. Ibn-e-Jarir ki hadith mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain Bani Adam ki peeth se Allah Ta'ala ne un ki naslein aisi nikalein jaise kanghi baalon mein se nikalti hai, un se apni rububiyat ka sawal kiya, unhon ne iqrar kiya, farishton ne shahadat di is liye ke yeh log Qayamat ke din is se ghaflat ka bahana na karein. Hazrat Umar R.A se is ayat ki tafseer puchi gayi toh aap ne farmaya yahi sawal Rasool Allah ﷺ se hua tha toh aap ne mere sunte hue farmaya ke Allah Azzawajal ne Hazrat Adam ko paida kiya, apne dahine haath se un ki peeth ko chua, is se aulad nikli, farmaya main ne inhein jahannam ke liye paida kiya hai, yeh jahannumiyon ke aamal karenge. Toh aap se sawal hua ke phir amal kis ginti mein hain? Aap ne farmaya jo jannati hai us se marte dam tak jannatiyon ke hi aamal sarzad honge aur jannat mein jayenge, haan jo jahannam ke liye paida kiya gaya hai us se wahi aamal sarzad honge, inhi par mare ga aur jahannam mein dakhil hoga (Abu Dawood). Aur hadith mein hai ke aulad-e-Adam ko nikal kar un ki dono aankhon ke darmiyan ek noor rakh kar Hazrat Adam ke samne pesh kiya. Hazrat ne pucha ke ya Allah yeh kaun hain? Farmaya yeh teri aulad hai. Un mein se ek ke mathe ki chamak ko Hazrat Adam ke samne pesh kiya, Hazrat ne pucha ke ya Allah yeh kaun hain? Farmaya yeh teri aulad mein se bahut door ja kar hain, un ka naam Dawood hai. Pucha un ki umar kya hai? Farmaya saath saal. Kaha ya Allah chalis saal meri umar mein se in ki umar mein zyada kar. Pas jab Hazrat Adam ki rooh ko qabz karne ke liye farishta aaya toh aap ne farmaya meri umar mein se toh abhi chalis saal baqi hain, farishte ne kaha aap ko yaad nahin ke aap ne yeh chalis saal apne bache Hazrat Dawood ko hiba kar diye hain. Baat yeh hai chunke Adam ne inkar kiya toh un ki aulad bhi inkar ki aadi hai, Adam khud bhool gaye un ki aulad bhi bhoolti hai, Adam ne khata ki un ki aulad bhi khata karti hai, yeh hadith Tirmidhi mein hai, Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Sahih likhte hain. Aur riwayat mein hai ke jab Adam A.S ne dekha ke koi in mein juzami hai, koi korhi hai, koi andha hai, koi bimar hai toh pucha ke ya Allah is mein kya maslahat hai? Farmaya yeh ke mera shukriya kiya jaye.

Hazrat Adam A.S ne poocha ke ya Allah in mein yeh zyada roshan aur noorani chehron wale kaun hain? Farmaya yeh Ambiya hain. Kisi shakhs ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se poocha ke hum jo kuch karte hain yeh hamara zaati amal hai ya ke faisal shuda hai? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne Adam ki aulad ko un ki peethon se nikala, unhein gawah banaya, phir apni dono mutthiyon mein le liya aur farmaya yeh Jannati hain aur yeh Jahannami. Pas Ahl-e-Jannat par toh nek kaam aasaan hote hain aur dozakhiyon par bure kaam aasaan hote hain. Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain jab Allah Ta'ala ne makhlooq ko paida kiya aur qaziya khatam kiya toh jin ke daayein haath mein nama-e-aamal milne wala hai unhein apni dahni mutthi mein liya aur baayein walon ko baayin mutthi mein liya, phir farmaya ae daayin taraf walo! Unhon ne kaha Labbaik wa Sa'daik. Farmaya kya main tumhara Rabb nahin hoon? Sab ne kaha haan, phir sab ko mila diya. Kisi ne poocha yeh kyun kiya? Farmaya is liye ke un ke liye aur aamal hain jinhein yeh karne wale hain, yeh toh sirf is liye kehwaya gaya hai ke unhein yeh uzr na rahe ke hum is se ghaafil thay. Phir sab ko sulb-e-Adam mein lauta diya. Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab R.A farmate hain is maidan mein us din sab ko jama kiya, soortein dein, bolne ki taqat di, phir ahd-o-meesaq liya aur apne Rabb hone par khud unhein gawah banaya aur saaton aasmanon, saaton zameenon aur Hazrat Adam A.S ko gawah banaya ke Qayamat ke din koi yeh na keh sake ke hamein ilm na tha. Jaan lo ke mere siwa koi aur Mabood nahin, na mere siwa koi aur Murabbi hai. Mere saath kisi ko shareek na karna, main apne Rasoolon ko bhejoon ga jo tumhein yeh wada yaad dilayenge, main apni kitabein utaaroon ga taake tumhein yeh ahd-o-meesaq yaad dilati rahein. Sab ne jawab mein kaha hum gawahi dete hain ke Tu hi hamara Rabb hai, Tu hi hamara Mabood hai, Tere siwa hamara koi Murabbi nahin. Pas sab se ita'at ka wada liya. Ab jo Hazrat Adam A.S ne nazar utha kar dekha toh ameer, ghareeb aur is ke siwa mukhtalif qisam ke logon par nazar padi toh Aap A.S kehne lage kya achha hota ke sab barabar ek hi halat ke hote, toh jawab mila ke yeh is liye hai ke har shakhs meri shukr guzari kare. Aap A.S ne dekha ke in mein Allah ke Paighambar bhi hain, un se phir alaihda ek aur meesaq liya gaya jis ka bayan aayat (وَاِذْ اَخَذْنَا مِنَ النَّـبِيّٖنَ مِيْثَاقَهُمْ وَمِنْكَ وَمِنْ نُّوْحٍ وَّاِبْرٰهِيْمَ وَمُوْسٰى وَعِيْسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ ۠ وَاَخَذْنَا مِنْهُمْ مِّيْثَاقًا غَلِيْظًا ۙ) (Surah Al-Ahzab: 7) mein hai. Isi aam meesaq ka bayan aayat (Fitratullah) mein hai, isi liye farman hai aayat (Haza nazeerun minan-nuzuril-oola), isi ka bayan is aayat mein hai (Wa ma wajadna li-aksarihim min ahd). (Musnad Ahmad). Hazrat Mujahid, Hazrat Ikrimah, Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair, Hazrat Hasan, Hazrat Qatadah, Hazrat Suddi aur bahut se salaf se in ahadees ke mutabiq aqwal marwi hain jin sab ke waarid karne se bahut tool ho jaye ga, mahasil sab ka yahi hai jo hum ne bayan kar diya.

Allah Ta'ala ne aulad-e-Adam ko aap ki peeth se nikala, jannati dozakhi alag alag kiye aur wahin un ko apne Rab hone par gawah kar liya. Yeh jin do ahadees mein hai woh dono marfoo nahin balkay mauqoof hain, isi liye salaf-o-khalaf mein is baat ke qail guzray hain ke is se murad fitrat par paida karna hai jaisa ke marfoo aur sahih ahadees mein warid hai. Yehi wajah hai ke aayat (min bani Adam) farmaya aur aayat (min zuhoorihim) kaha warna min Adam aur min zuhrihi hota. Un ki naslein us roz nikali gayin jo ke yakay baad deegray mukhtalif qarnon mein honay wali thin. Jaisay farman hai aayat (WA HUWAL LAZII JA'ALAKUM KHALA'IFAL ARDI WA RAFA'A BA'DAKUM FAWQA BA'DIN DARAJATIL LIYABLUWAKUM FII MAA ATAAKUM, INNA RABBAKA SARI'UL 'IQABI WA INNAHUU LAGHAFURUR RAHIIM) (Surah Al-An'am: 165). Allah hi ne tumhein zameen mein dusron ka janasheen kiya hai aur jagah hai wohi tumhein zameen ke khalifa bana raha hai aur aayat mein hai jaisay tumhein dusray logon ki aulad mein kiya. Al-gharaz haal-o-qaal se sab ne Allah ke Rab honay ka iqrar kiya. Shahadat qouli hoti hai jaisay aayat (shahidna 'ala anfusina) mein aur shahadat kabhi haal se hoti hai jaisay aayat (MAA KAANA LIL-MUSHRIKIINA AY YA'MURUU MASAJIDALLAHI SHAHIDIINA 'ALA ANFUSIHIM BIL-KUFRI, ULA'IKA HABITAT A'MALUHUM WA FIN-NAARI HUM KHALIDUUN) (Surah At-Tawbah: 17) mein, yani un ka haal un ke kufr ki khuli aur kafi shahadat hai, is tarah ki aayat (wa innahu 'ala zalika la-shaheed) hai. Isi tarah sawal bhi kabhi zaban se hota hai kabhi haal se. Jaisay farman hai (WA ATAAKUM MIN KULLI MAA SA'ALTUMUHU, WA IN TA'UDDUU NI'MATALLAHI LA TUHSIUHAA, INNAL INSANA LA-ZALUMUN KAFFAR) (Surah Ibrahim: 34). Is niyat mein tumharay ka munh manga diya. Kehti hain ke is baat par yeh daleel bhi hai ke un ke shirk karnay par yeh hujjat un ke khilaf pesh ki. Pas agar yeh waqay mein hua hota jaisa ke ek qaul hai to chahye tha ke har ek ko yaad hota taake is par hujjat rahay. Agar is ka jawab yeh ho ke farman-e-Rasool se khabar pa lena kafi hai to is ka jawab yeh hai ke jo Rasoolon ko hi nahin mantay woh Rasoolon ki di hui khabron ko kab sahih jantay hain? Halankeh Quran-e-Kareem ne Rasoolon ki takzeeb ke ilawa khud is shahadat ko mustaqil daleel thehraya hai. Pas is se yehi sabit hota hai ke is se murad fitrat-e-Rabbani hai jis par Allah Ta'ala ne sari makhlooq ko paida kiya hai aur woh fitrat-e-tauheed-e-Bari Ta'ala hai. Isi liye farmata hai ke yeh is liye ke tum Qayamat ke din yeh na keh sako ke hum tauheed se ghafil thay aur yeh bhi na keh sako ke shirk to hamaray aglay baap dadon ne kiya tha un ke is ijad karda gunah par hamein saza kyun? Phir tafseel-war aayat ke bayan farmanay ka raaz zahir kiya ke is ko sun kar buraiyon se baaz aa jana mumkin ho jata hai.

Har rooh ne Allah Ta'ala ko apna khaliq mana. Aulad-e-Adam se Allah Ta'ala ne un ki naslein un ki peethon se roz-e-awwal mein nikalein. Phir un sab se is baat ka iqrar liya ke Rabb, Khaliq, Malik, Mabood sirf wahi hai. Isi fitrat par phir duniya mein un sab ko un ke waqt par us ne paida kiya. Yehi woh fitrat hai jis ki tabdeeli namumkin hai, Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke har bacha fitrat par paida hota hai. Ek riwayat mein hai ke is deen par paida hota hai phir us ke maa baap use yahudi, nasrani ya majoosi bana dete hain jaise ke bakri ka bacha sahih salim paida hota hai lekin phir log us ke kaan kaat dete hain. Hadith-e-Qudsi mein hai ke main ne apne bandon ko muwahid-o-mukhlis paida kiya phir shaitan ne aa kar unhein un ke sachay deen se behka kar meri halal karda cheezein un par haram kar dein. Qabeela Banu Sa'ad ke ek sahabi Hazrat Aswad bin Saree' R.A farmate hain main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath chaar ghazway kiye, logon ne ladne wale kuffar ke qatl ke baad un ke bachon ko bhi pakad liya, jab Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko is ka ilm hua to bohat naraz hue aur farmaya log in bachon ko kyun pakad rahe hain? Kisi ne kaha huzoor woh bhi to mushrikon ke hi bache hain? Farmaya suno tum mein se behtar log mushrikeen ki aulad mein hain, yaad rakho har bacha fitrat-e-Islam par paida hota hai phir zaban chalne par us ke maa baap yahudiyat ya nasraniyat ki taleem dene lagte hain. Is ke rawi Hazrat Hasan R.H farmate hain isi ka zikr is aayat mein hai ke Allah ne aulad-e-Adam se apni tawheed ka iqrar liya hai (Ibn-e-Jareer). Is iqrar ke bare mein kayi ek hadeesein marwi hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Qayamat ke din dozakhi se kaha jaye ga agar tamam duniya teri ho to kya tu khush hai ke ise apne fidiye mein de kar mere azabon se aaj bach jaye? Woh kahe ga haan. Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga main ne to is se bohat hi halkay darjay ki cheez tujh se talab ki thi aur us ka wada bhi tujh se le liya tha ke mere siwa tu kisi aur ki ibadat na kare lekin tu ahd tooray baghair na raha aur dusre ko mera shareek-e-ibadat thehraya. Musnad mein hai Nu'man nami maidan mein Allah Ta'ala ne pusht-e-Adam mein se Arafah ke din un ki tamam aulad zahir farmayi, sab ko us ke samne phaila diya aur farmaya ke main tum sab ka Rabb nahin hoon? Sab ne kaha haan hum gawah hain, phir Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mubtiloon tak tilawat farmayi. Yeh riwayat mauqoof Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se bhi marwi hai, Wallahu A'lam. Us waqt log cheontiyon ki tarah thay aur tar zameen par thay. Hazrat Zahhak bin Muzahim R.H ke chhay din ki umr ke sahibzade ka inteqal ho gaya to Aap R.H ne farmaya Jabir ise dafan kar ke us ka munh kafan se khol dena aur girah bhi khol dena kyunke mera yeh bacha bitha diya jaye ga aur us se sawal kiya jaye ga. Jabir ne hukm ki baja awari ki, phir main ne poocha ke aap ke bache se kya sawal hoga aur kaun sawal kare ga? Farmaya is meesaq ke bare mein jo sulb-e-Adam mein liya gaya hai sawal kiya jaye ga. Main ne poocha woh meesaq kya hai?
