Allah hi ne tumhein zameen mein dusron ka janasheen kiya hai aur jagah hai wohi tumhein zameen ke khalifa bana raha hai aur aayat mein hai jaisay tumhein dusray logon ki aulad mein kiya. Al-gharaz haal-o-qaal se sab ne Allah ke Rab honay ka iqrar kiya. Shahadat qouli hoti hai jaisay aayat (shahidna 'ala anfusina) mein aur shahadat kabhi haal se hoti hai jaisay aayat (MAA KAANA LIL-MUSHRIKIINA AY YA'MURUU MASAJIDALLAHI SHAHIDIINA 'ALA ANFUSIHIM BIL-KUFRI, ULA'IKA HABITAT A'MALUHUM WA FIN-NAARI HUM KHALIDUUN) (Surah At-Tawbah: 17) mein, yani un ka haal un ke kufr ki khuli aur kafi shahadat hai, is tarah ki aayat (wa innahu 'ala zalika la-shaheed) hai. Isi tarah sawal bhi kabhi zaban se hota hai kabhi haal se. Jaisay farman hai (WA ATAAKUM MIN KULLI MAA SA'ALTUMUHU, WA IN TA'UDDUU NI'MATALLAHI LA TUHSIUHAA, INNAL INSANA LA-ZALUMUN KAFFAR) (Surah Ibrahim: 34). Is niyat mein tumharay ka munh manga diya. Kehti hain ke is baat par yeh daleel bhi hai ke un ke shirk karnay par yeh hujjat un ke khilaf pesh ki. Pas agar yeh waqay mein hua hota jaisa ke ek qaul hai to chahye tha ke har ek ko yaad hota taake is par hujjat rahay. Agar is ka jawab yeh ho ke farman-e-Rasool se khabar pa lena kafi hai to is ka jawab yeh hai ke jo Rasoolon ko hi nahin mantay woh Rasoolon ki di hui khabron ko kab sahih jantay hain? Halankeh Quran-e-Kareem ne Rasoolon ki takzeeb ke ilawa khud is shahadat ko mustaqil daleel thehraya hai. Pas is se yehi sabit hota hai ke is se murad fitrat-e-Rabbani hai jis par Allah Ta'ala ne sari makhlooq ko paida kiya hai aur woh fitrat-e-tauheed-e-Bari Ta'ala hai. Isi liye farmata hai ke yeh is liye ke tum Qayamat ke din yeh na keh sako ke hum tauheed se ghafil thay aur yeh bhi na keh sako ke shirk to hamaray aglay baap dadon ne kiya tha un ke is ijad karda gunah par hamein saza kyun? Phir tafseel-war aayat ke bayan farmanay ka raaz zahir kiya ke is ko sun kar buraiyon se baaz aa jana mumkin ho jata hai.

Har rooh ne Allah Ta'ala ko apna khaliq mana. Aulad-e-Adam se Allah Ta'ala ne un ki naslein un ki peethon se roz-e-awwal mein nikalein. Phir un sab se is baat ka iqrar liya ke Rabb, Khaliq, Malik, Mabood sirf wahi hai. Isi fitrat par phir duniya mein un sab ko un ke waqt par us ne paida kiya. Yehi woh fitrat hai jis ki tabdeeli namumkin hai, Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke har bacha fitrat par paida hota hai. Ek riwayat mein hai ke is deen par paida hota hai phir us ke maa baap use yahudi, nasrani ya majoosi bana dete hain jaise ke bakri ka bacha sahih salim paida hota hai lekin phir log us ke kaan kaat dete hain. Hadith-e-Qudsi mein hai ke main ne apne bandon ko muwahid-o-mukhlis paida kiya phir shaitan ne aa kar unhein un ke sachay deen se behka kar meri halal karda cheezein un par haram kar dein. Qabeela Banu Sa'ad ke ek sahabi Hazrat Aswad bin Saree' R.A farmate hain main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath chaar ghazway kiye, logon ne ladne wale kuffar ke qatl ke baad un ke bachon ko bhi pakad liya, jab Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko is ka ilm hua to bohat naraz hue aur farmaya log in bachon ko kyun pakad rahe hain? Kisi ne kaha huzoor woh bhi to mushrikon ke hi bache hain? Farmaya suno tum mein se behtar log mushrikeen ki aulad mein hain, yaad rakho har bacha fitrat-e-Islam par paida hota hai phir zaban chalne par us ke maa baap yahudiyat ya nasraniyat ki taleem dene lagte hain. Is ke rawi Hazrat Hasan R.H farmate hain isi ka zikr is aayat mein hai ke Allah ne aulad-e-Adam se apni tawheed ka iqrar liya hai (Ibn-e-Jareer). Is iqrar ke bare mein kayi ek hadeesein marwi hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Qayamat ke din dozakhi se kaha jaye ga agar tamam duniya teri ho to kya tu khush hai ke ise apne fidiye mein de kar mere azabon se aaj bach jaye? Woh kahe ga haan. Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga main ne to is se bohat hi halkay darjay ki cheez tujh se talab ki thi aur us ka wada bhi tujh se le liya tha ke mere siwa tu kisi aur ki ibadat na kare lekin tu ahd tooray baghair na raha aur dusre ko mera shareek-e-ibadat thehraya. Musnad mein hai Nu'man nami maidan mein Allah Ta'ala ne pusht-e-Adam mein se Arafah ke din un ki tamam aulad zahir farmayi, sab ko us ke samne phaila diya aur farmaya ke main tum sab ka Rabb nahin hoon? Sab ne kaha haan hum gawah hain, phir Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mubtiloon tak tilawat farmayi. Yeh riwayat mauqoof Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se bhi marwi hai, Wallahu A'lam. Us waqt log cheontiyon ki tarah thay aur tar zameen par thay. Hazrat Zahhak bin Muzahim R.H ke chhay din ki umr ke sahibzade ka inteqal ho gaya to Aap R.H ne farmaya Jabir ise dafan kar ke us ka munh kafan se khol dena aur girah bhi khol dena kyunke mera yeh bacha bitha diya jaye ga aur us se sawal kiya jaye ga. Jabir ne hukm ki baja awari ki, phir main ne poocha ke aap ke bache se kya sawal hoga aur kaun sawal kare ga? Farmaya is meesaq ke bare mein jo sulb-e-Adam mein liya gaya hai sawal kiya jaye ga. Main ne poocha woh meesaq kya hai?

Farmaya main ne Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas se suna hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne Adam A.S ki peeth par haath phera toh jitne insaan Qayamat tak paida hone wale hain sab ki roohein aa gayin. Allah ne un se ahd-o-paiman liya ke woh isi ki ibadat karenge, us ke siwa kisi aur ko mabood nahin manenge, khud un ke rizq ka kafeel bana, phir unhein sulb-e-Adam mein lauta diya. Pas yeh sab Qayamat se pehle hi pehle paida honge. Jis ne is wade ko pura kiya aur apni zindagi mein is par qaim raha use woh wada nafa de ga aur jis ne apni zindagi mein is ki khilaf warzi ki use pehle ka wada kuch faida na de ga. Bachpan mein hi jo mar gaya woh Misaq-e-Awwal par aur fitrat par mara. In aasar se bhi bazahir yahi maloom hota hai ke upar wali hadith ka mauqoof hona hi aksar aur zyada suboot wala hai. Ibn-e-Jarir ki hadith mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain Bani Adam ki peeth se Allah Ta'ala ne un ki naslein aisi nikalein jaise kanghi baalon mein se nikalti hai, un se apni rububiyat ka sawal kiya, unhon ne iqrar kiya, farishton ne shahadat di is liye ke yeh log Qayamat ke din is se ghaflat ka bahana na karein. Hazrat Umar R.A se is ayat ki tafseer puchi gayi toh aap ne farmaya yahi sawal Rasool Allah ﷺ se hua tha toh aap ne mere sunte hue farmaya ke Allah Azzawajal ne Hazrat Adam ko paida kiya, apne dahine haath se un ki peeth ko chua, is se aulad nikli, farmaya main ne inhein jahannam ke liye paida kiya hai, yeh jahannumiyon ke aamal karenge. Toh aap se sawal hua ke phir amal kis ginti mein hain? Aap ne farmaya jo jannati hai us se marte dam tak jannatiyon ke hi aamal sarzad honge aur jannat mein jayenge, haan jo jahannam ke liye paida kiya gaya hai us se wahi aamal sarzad honge, inhi par mare ga aur jahannam mein dakhil hoga (Abu Dawood). Aur hadith mein hai ke aulad-e-Adam ko nikal kar un ki dono aankhon ke darmiyan ek noor rakh kar Hazrat Adam ke samne pesh kiya. Hazrat ne pucha ke ya Allah yeh kaun hain? Farmaya yeh teri aulad hai. Un mein se ek ke mathe ki chamak ko Hazrat Adam ke samne pesh kiya, Hazrat ne pucha ke ya Allah yeh kaun hain? Farmaya yeh teri aulad mein se bahut door ja kar hain, un ka naam Dawood hai. Pucha un ki umar kya hai? Farmaya saath saal. Kaha ya Allah chalis saal meri umar mein se in ki umar mein zyada kar. Pas jab Hazrat Adam ki rooh ko qabz karne ke liye farishta aaya toh aap ne farmaya meri umar mein se toh abhi chalis saal baqi hain, farishte ne kaha aap ko yaad nahin ke aap ne yeh chalis saal apne bache Hazrat Dawood ko hiba kar diye hain. Baat yeh hai chunke Adam ne inkar kiya toh un ki aulad bhi inkar ki aadi hai, Adam khud bhool gaye un ki aulad bhi bhoolti hai, Adam ne khata ki un ki aulad bhi khata karti hai, yeh hadith Tirmidhi mein hai, Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan Sahih likhte hain. Aur riwayat mein hai ke jab Adam A.S ne dekha ke koi in mein juzami hai, koi korhi hai, koi andha hai, koi bimar hai toh pucha ke ya Allah is mein kya maslahat hai? Farmaya yeh ke mera shukriya kiya jaye.

Hazrat Adam A.S ne poocha ke ya Allah in mein yeh zyada roshan aur noorani chehron wale kaun hain? Farmaya yeh Ambiya hain. Kisi shakhs ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se poocha ke hum jo kuch karte hain yeh hamara zaati amal hai ya ke faisal shuda hai? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne Adam ki aulad ko un ki peethon se nikala, unhein gawah banaya, phir apni dono mutthiyon mein le liya aur farmaya yeh Jannati hain aur yeh Jahannami. Pas Ahl-e-Jannat par toh nek kaam aasaan hote hain aur dozakhiyon par bure kaam aasaan hote hain. Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain jab Allah Ta'ala ne makhlooq ko paida kiya aur qaziya khatam kiya toh jin ke daayein haath mein nama-e-aamal milne wala hai unhein apni dahni mutthi mein liya aur baayein walon ko baayin mutthi mein liya, phir farmaya ae daayin taraf walo! Unhon ne kaha Labbaik wa Sa'daik. Farmaya kya main tumhara Rabb nahin hoon? Sab ne kaha haan, phir sab ko mila diya. Kisi ne poocha yeh kyun kiya? Farmaya is liye ke un ke liye aur aamal hain jinhein yeh karne wale hain, yeh toh sirf is liye kehwaya gaya hai ke unhein yeh uzr na rahe ke hum is se ghaafil thay. Phir sab ko sulb-e-Adam mein lauta diya. Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab R.A farmate hain is maidan mein us din sab ko jama kiya, soortein dein, bolne ki taqat di, phir ahd-o-meesaq liya aur apne Rabb hone par khud unhein gawah banaya aur saaton aasmanon, saaton zameenon aur Hazrat Adam A.S ko gawah banaya ke Qayamat ke din koi yeh na keh sake ke hamein ilm na tha. Jaan lo ke mere siwa koi aur Mabood nahin, na mere siwa koi aur Murabbi hai. Mere saath kisi ko shareek na karna, main apne Rasoolon ko bhejoon ga jo tumhein yeh wada yaad dilayenge, main apni kitabein utaaroon ga taake tumhein yeh ahd-o-meesaq yaad dilati rahein. Sab ne jawab mein kaha hum gawahi dete hain ke Tu hi hamara Rabb hai, Tu hi hamara Mabood hai, Tere siwa hamara koi Murabbi nahin. Pas sab se ita'at ka wada liya. Ab jo Hazrat Adam A.S ne nazar utha kar dekha toh ameer, ghareeb aur is ke siwa mukhtalif qisam ke logon par nazar padi toh Aap A.S kehne lage kya achha hota ke sab barabar ek hi halat ke hote, toh jawab mila ke yeh is liye hai ke har shakhs meri shukr guzari kare. Aap A.S ne dekha ke in mein Allah ke Paighambar bhi hain, un se phir alaihda ek aur meesaq liya gaya jis ka bayan aayat (وَاِذْ اَخَذْنَا مِنَ النَّـبِيّٖنَ مِيْثَاقَهُمْ وَمِنْكَ وَمِنْ نُّوْحٍ وَّاِبْرٰهِيْمَ وَمُوْسٰى وَعِيْسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ ۠ وَاَخَذْنَا مِنْهُمْ مِّيْثَاقًا غَلِيْظًا ۙ) (Surah Al-Ahzab: 7) mein hai. Isi aam meesaq ka bayan aayat (Fitratullah) mein hai, isi liye farman hai aayat (Haza nazeerun minan-nuzuril-oola), isi ka bayan is aayat mein hai (Wa ma wajadna li-aksarihim min ahd). (Musnad Ahmad). Hazrat Mujahid, Hazrat Ikrimah, Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair, Hazrat Hasan, Hazrat Qatadah, Hazrat Suddi aur bahut se salaf se in ahadees ke mutabiq aqwal marwi hain jin sab ke waarid karne se bahut tool ho jaye ga, mahasil sab ka yahi hai jo hum ne bayan kar diya.

Allah Ta'ala ne aulad-e-Adam ko aap ki peeth se nikala, jannati dozakhi alag alag kiye aur wahin un ko apne Rab hone par gawah kar liya. Yeh jin do ahadees mein hai woh dono marfoo nahin balkay mauqoof hain, isi liye salaf-o-khalaf mein is baat ke qail guzray hain ke is se murad fitrat par paida karna hai jaisa ke marfoo aur sahih ahadees mein warid hai. Yehi wajah hai ke aayat (min bani Adam) farmaya aur aayat (min zuhoorihim) kaha warna min Adam aur min zuhrihi hota. Un ki naslein us roz nikali gayin jo ke yakay baad deegray mukhtalif qarnon mein honay wali thin. Jaisay farman hai aayat (WA HUWAL LAZII JA'ALAKUM KHALA'IFAL ARDI WA RAFA'A BA'DAKUM FAWQA BA'DIN DARAJATIL LIYABLUWAKUM FII MAA ATAAKUM, INNA RABBAKA SARI'UL 'IQABI WA INNAHUU LAGHAFURUR RAHIIM) (Surah Al-An'am: 165). Allah hi ne tumhein zameen mein dusron ka janasheen kiya hai aur jagah hai wohi tumhein zameen ke khalifa bana raha hai aur aayat mein hai jaisay tumhein dusray logon ki aulad mein kiya. Al-gharaz haal-o-qaal se sab ne Allah ke Rab honay ka iqrar kiya. Shahadat qouli hoti hai jaisay aayat (shahidna 'ala anfusina) mein aur shahadat kabhi haal se hoti hai jaisay aayat (MAA KAANA LIL-MUSHRIKIINA AY YA'MURUU MASAJIDALLAHI SHAHIDIINA 'ALA ANFUSIHIM BIL-KUFRI, ULA'IKA HABITAT A'MALUHUM WA FIN-NAARI HUM KHALIDUUN) (Surah At-Tawbah: 17) mein, yani un ka haal un ke kufr ki khuli aur kafi shahadat hai, is tarah ki aayat (wa innahu 'ala zalika la-shaheed) hai. Isi tarah sawal bhi kabhi zaban se hota hai kabhi haal se. Jaisay farman hai (WA ATAAKUM MIN KULLI MAA SA'ALTUMUHU, WA IN TA'UDDUU NI'MATALLAHI LA TUHSIUHAA, INNAL INSANA LA-ZALUMUN KAFFAR) (Surah Ibrahim: 34). Is niyat mein tumharay ka munh manga diya. Kehti hain ke is baat par yeh daleel bhi hai ke un ke shirk karnay par yeh hujjat un ke khilaf pesh ki. Pas agar yeh waqay mein hua hota jaisa ke ek qaul hai to chahye tha ke har ek ko yaad hota taake is par hujjat rahay. Agar is ka jawab yeh ho ke farman-e-Rasool se khabar pa lena kafi hai to is ka jawab yeh hai ke jo Rasoolon ko hi nahin mantay woh Rasoolon ki di hui khabron ko kab sahih jantay hain? Halankeh Quran-e-Kareem ne Rasoolon ki takzeeb ke ilawa khud is shahadat ko mustaqil daleel thehraya hai. Pas is se yehi sabit hota hai ke is se murad fitrat-e-Rabbani hai jis par Allah Ta'ala ne sari makhlooq ko paida kiya hai aur woh fitrat-e-tauheed-e-Bari Ta'ala hai. Isi liye farmata hai ke yeh is liye ke tum Qayamat ke din yeh na keh sako ke hum tauheed se ghafil thay aur yeh bhi na keh sako ke shirk to hamaray aglay baap dadon ne kiya tha un ke is ijad karda gunah par hamein saza kyun? Phir tafseel-war aayat ke bayan farmanay ka raaz zahir kiya ke is ko sun kar buraiyon se baaz aa jana mumkin ho jata hai.

Bal'am bin Ba'oora marwi hai ke jis ka waqia in ayaton mein bayan ho raha hai us ka naam Bal'am bin Ba'oora hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke us ka naam Zafi bin Rahib tha. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh Balqa ka ek shakhs tha jo Ism-e-Azam janta tha aur Jabbarin ke sath hi Bait-ul-Muqaddas mein raha karta tha. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh Yamani shakhs tha jis ne Kalam-e-Allah ko tark kar diya tha, yeh shakhs Bani Israel ke ulama mein se tha, us ki dua maqbool ho jaya karti thi. Bani Israel sakhtiyon ke waqt ise aage kar diya karte the. Allah us ki dua maqbool farma liya karta tha. Ise Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne Madyan ke badshah ki taraf Allah ke deen ki dawat dene ke liye bheja tha, us aqalmand badshah ne ise makr-o-fareb se apna kar liya. Us ke naam kayi gaon kar diye aur bohat kuch inaam-o-ikram diya. Yeh badnaseeb deen-e-Moosavi ko chhor kar us ke mazhab mein ja mila. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke us ka naam Bal'am tha. Yeh bhi hai ke yeh Umayyah bin Abu Salt hai. Mumkin hai yeh kehne wale ki yeh murad ho ke yeh Umayyah bhi isi ke mushabah tha. Ise bhi agli shariyaton ka ilm tha lekin yeh un se faida na utha saka. Khud Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke zamane ko bhi us ne paya, Aap (ﷺ) ki ayat-e-bayyinat dekhein, mojze apni aankhon se dekh liye, hazarha ko deen-e-haq mein dakhil hote dekha, lekin mushrikeen ke mel-jol, un mein imtiyaz, un mein dosti aur wahan ki sardari ki hawas ne ise Islam aur qabool-e-haq se rok diya. Isi ne Badri kafiron ke matam mein marsiye kahe, La'natullah. Ba'az ahadees mein warid hai ke us ki zaban to iman la chuki thi lekin dil momin nahin hua tha. Kehte hain ke is shakhs se Allah Ta'ala ne wada kiya tha ke us ki duayein jo bhi yeh kare ga maqbool hon gi. Us ki biwi ne ek martaba us se kaha ke in teen duaon mein se ek dua mere liye kar. Us ne manzoor kar liya aur poocha kya dua karana chahti ho? Us ne kaha yeh ke Allah Ta'ala mujhe is qadar husn-o-khoobsurti ata farmaye ke mujh se zyada haseen aurat Bani Israel mein koi na ho. Us ne dua ki aur woh aisi hi haseen ho gayi. Ab to us ne par nikale aur apne miyan ko mehez be-haqeeqat samajhne lagi, bade bade log us ki taraf jhukne lage aur yeh bhi un ki taraf mail ho gayi. Is se yeh bohat kadha aur Allah se dua ki ke Ya Allah ise kutiya bana de. Yeh bhi manzoor hui, woh kutiya ban gayi. Ab us ke bache aaye, unhon ne gher liya ke aap ne ghazab kiya, log hamein ta'na dete hain aur hum kutiya ke bache mashhoor ho rahe hain. Aap dua kijiye ke Allah ise is ki asli halat mein phir se la de. Us ne woh teesri dua bhi kar li, teeno duayein yun hi zaya ho gayin aur yeh khali hath be-khair reh gaya. Mashhoor baat to yahi hai ke Bani Israel ke buzurgon mein se yeh ek shakhs tha. Ba'az logon ne yeh bhi keh diya hai ke yeh Nabi tha. Yeh mehez ghalat hai, bilkul jhoot hai aur khula iftira hai.

Marwi hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) jab qoum-e-Jabbarin se ladai ke liye Bani Israel ki hamrahi mein gaye, inhi Jabbarin mein Bal'am nami yeh shakhs tha. Is ki qoum aur is ke qarabat-dar chacha waghera sab is ke paas aaye aur kaha ke Musa (A.S) aur is ki qoum ke liye aap bad-dua kijiye. Is ne kaha yeh nahin ho sakta, agar main aisa karunga to meri duniya-o-akhirat dono kharab ho jayengi, lekin qoum sar ho gayi. Yeh bhi lihaz-e-muruwwat mein aa gaya. Bad-dua ki, Allah Ta'ala ne is se karamat chheen li aur ise is ke martabe se gira diya. Suddi kehte hain ke jab Bani Israel ko Wadi-e-Teeh mein chalis saal guzar gaye to Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Yusha bin Noon (A.S) ko Nabi bana kar bheja. Unhon ne farmaya ke mujhe hukm hua hai ke main tumhein le kar jaaun aur in Jabbarin se jihad karoon. Yeh amada ho gaye, bai'at kar li. Inhi mein Bal'am nami ek shakhs tha jo bada aalim tha, Ism-e-Azam janta tha. Yeh bad-naseeb kafir ho gaya, qoum-e-Jabbarin mein ja mila aur un se kaha tum na ghabrao, jab Bani Israel ka lashkar aa jayega main un par bad-dua karunga to woh daf'atan halak ho jayega. Is ke paas tamam dunyawi thaath thay lekin aurton ki azmat ki wajah se yeh un se nahin milta tha balkay ek gadhi paal rakhi thi. Isi bad-qismat ka zikr is aayat mein hai. Shaitan is par ghalib aa gaya, ise apne phanday mein phans liya, jo woh kehta tha yeh karta tha, aakhir halak ho gaya. Musnad Abu Ya'la Mosuli mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya ke main tum sab se zyada us se darta hoon jo Quran padh lega, jo Islam ki chadar odhay hue hoga aur deeni taraqqi par hoga ke ek dam us se hat jayega, ise pas-e-pusht daal dega, apne padosi par talwar le daudega aur use shirk ki tohmat lagayega. Hazrat Huzaifa bin Yaman (R.A) ne yeh sun kar daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Mushrik hone ke zyada qabil kaun hoga? Yeh tohmat lagane wala? Ya woh jise tohmat laga raha hai? Farmaya nahin, balkay tohmat dharne wala. Phir farmata hai ke agar hum chahte to qadir thay ke ise buland martabe par pahunchayein, duniya ki aalaishon se pak rakhein, apni di hui aayaton ki tabedari par qaim rakhein, lekin woh dunyawi lazzaton ki taraf jhuk pada yahan tak ke Shaitan ka pura mureed ho gaya. Ise sajda kar liya. Kehte hain ke is Bal'am se logon ne darkhwast ki ke aap Hazrat Musa (A.S) aur Bani Israel ke haq mein bad-dua kijiye. Is ne kaha achha main Allah se hukm le loon. Jab is ne Allah Ta'ala se munajat ki to ise maloom hua ke Bani Israel Musalman hain aur in mein Allah ke Nabi (A.S) maujood hain. Is ne sab se kaha ke mujhe bad-dua karne se rok diya gaya hai. Unhon ne bahut saare tohfay-tahaif jama kar ke ise diye, is ne sab rakh liye.

Phir dobara darkhwast ki ke hamain in se bahut khauf hai aap zaroor in par bad-dua kijiye. Us ne jawab diya ke jab tak main Allah Ta'ala se ijazat na le loon main hargiz yeh na karunga. Us ne phir Allah se munajat ki lekin use kuch maloom na hosaka. Us ne yahi jawab unhein diya to unhon ne kaha dekho agar mana hi maqsood hota to aap ko rok diya jata jaisa ke is se pehle rok diya gaya. Is ki bhi samajh mein aagaya, uth kar bad-dua shuru ki. Allah ki shaan hai bad-dua un par karne ke bajaye us ki zaban se apni hi qoum ke liye bad-dua nikli aur jab apni qoum ki fatah ki dua mangna chahta to Bani Israel ki fatah-o-nusrat ki dua nikalti. Qoum ne kaha aap kya ghazab kar rahe hain? Us ne kaha kya karoon? Meri zaban mere qabu mein nahin. Suno agar sach much meri zaban se in ke liye bad-dua nikli bhi to qabool na hogi. Suno ab main tumhein ek tarkeeb batata hoon agar tum is mein kamyab hogaye to samajh lo ke Bani Israel barbad hojayenge. Tum apni naujawan ladkiyon ko banao singhar kara ke in ke lashkaron mein bhejo aur unhein hidayat kardo ke koi in ki taraf jhuke to yeh inkar na karein, mumkin hai bojh-e-musafarat yeh log zinakari mein mubtala hojayen. Agar yeh hua to chunke yeh haram-kari Allah ko sakht na-pasand hai isi waqt in par azab aajayega aur yeh tabah hojayenge. In be-ghairaton ne is baat ko maan liya aur yahi kiya. Khud badshah ki badi haseen-o-jameel ladki bhi ban than kar nikli, use hidayat kardi gayi thi ke siwaye Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke aur kisi ko apna nafs na sonpe. Yeh auratein jab Bani Israel ke lashkar mein pahunchin to aam log be-qabu hogaye, haram-kari se bach na sake. Shahzadi Bani Israel ke ek sardar ke paas pahunchi. Is sardar ne is ladki par dore dale lekin is ladki ne inkar kiya. Us ne bataya ke main falan falan hoon, us ne apne baap se ya Bal'am se puchwaya, us ne ijazat di. Yeh khabeeth apna munh kala kar raha tha jise Hazrat Haroon (A.S) ki aulad mein se kisi sahib ne dekh liya, apne naize se un donon ko piro diya. Allah Ta'ala ne is ke dast-o-bazu qawi kardiye, us ne yunhi un donon ko chuday hue utha liya, logon ne bhi unhein dekha. Ab is lashkar par azab-e-Rabb ba-shakl-e-ta'oon aaya aur sattar hazar aadmi foran halak hogaye. Bal'am apni gadhi par sawar ho kar chala, woh ek teele par chadh kar ruk gayi, ab Bal'am use marta peetta hai lekin woh qadam nahin uthati. Aakhir gadhi ne is ki taraf dekha aur kaha mujhe kyun maar raha hai? Samne dekh kaun hai? Us ne dekha to Shaitan-e-La'een khada hua tha, yeh utar pada aur sajde mein gir gaya. Al-gharaz iman se khali hogaya. Is ka naam ya to Bal'am tha, ya Bal'am bin Ba'oora, ya Ibn-e-Abr-e-Bar bin Ba'oor bin Shahoom bin Qooshtam bin Ma'ab bin Loot bin Haroon ya Ibn-e-Maran bin Aazar. Yeh Balqa ka raees tha, Ism-e-Azam janta tha lekin akhir mein deen-e-haq se hat gaya. Wallahu A'lam. Ek riwayat mein hai ke qoum ke zyada kehne sunne se jab yeh apni gadhi par sawar ho kar bad-dua ke liye chala to is ki gadhi baith gayi.

Us ne usay maar peet kar uthaya, kuch door chal kar phir baith gayi. Us ne usay phir maar peet kar uthaya, usay Allah ne zaban di. Us ne kaha tera naas jaye, tu kahan aur kyun ja raha hai? Allah ke muqablay us ke Rasool se larnay aur mominon ko nuqsan dilanay ja raha hai? Dekh to sahi farishtay meri raah rokay kharay hain. Us ne phir bhi kuch khayal na kiya, aagay barh gaya. Habban nami pahari par charh gaya jahan se Bani Israel ka lashkar samnay hi nazar aata tha. Ab un ke liye bad-dua aur apni qoum ke liye duayen karne laga lekin zaban ulat gayi, dua ki jagah bad-dua aur bad-dua ki jagah dua nikalnay lagi. Qoum ne kaha kya kar rahay ho? Kaha be-bas hoon. Isi waqt us ki zaban nikal pari, seenay par lataknay lagi. Us ne kaha lo meri dunya bhi kharab hui aur deen to bilkul barbad ho gaya. Phir us ne khubsurat larkiyan bhejnay ki tarkeeb batayi jaisay ke oopar bayan hua aur kaha ke agar in mein se aik ne bhi badkari kar li to un par azab-e-Rabb aa jaye ga. In aurton mein se aik bohat hi haseen aurat jo Kananiya thi aur jis ka naam Kasti tha, jo Soor nami aik raees ki beti thi, woh jab Bani Israel ke aik bohat baray sardar Zamri bin Shaloam ke paas se guzri jo Shamoon bin Yaqoob ki nasl mein se tha, woh us par farefta ho gaya. Daleri ke sath us ka haath thamay huay Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke paas gaya aur kehnay laga aap to shayad keh den ge ke yeh mujh par haram hai? Aap ne kaha beshak. Us ne kaha acha main aap ki yeh baat to nahin maan sakta, usay apnay khaimay mein le gaya aur us se munh kala karne laga. Wahin Allah Ta'ala ne un par ta'oon bhej diya. Hazrat Fahas bin Aizar bin Haroon (R.A) us waqt lashkar-gah se kahin bahar gaye huay thay, jab aaye aur tamam haqeeqat suni to betab ho kar gussay ke sath us bad-kirdar ke khaimay mein pohanchay aur apnay naizay mein un dono ko piro liya aur apnay haath mein naiza liye huay unhein oopar uthaye huay bahar niklay, kehni ko kakh par lagaye huay thay, kehnay lagay ya Allah hamein maaf farma, hum par se yeh waba door farma, dekh le hum teray nafarmanon ke sath yeh kartay hain. Un ki dua aur is fe'l se ta'oon uth gaya lekin itni dair mein jab hisab lagaya gaya to sattar hazar aadmi aur aik riwayat ki roo se bees hazar mar chukay thay. Din ka waqt tha aur Kananiyon ki yeh chhokriyan sauda bechnay ke bahanay sirf is liye aayi thin ke Bani Israel badkari mein phans jayen aur un par azab aa jaye. Bani Israel mein ab tak yeh dastoor chala aata hai ke woh apnay zabiha mein se gardan aur dast aur sari aur har qisam ka sab se pehla phal Fahas ki aulad ko diya kartay hain. Isi Bal'am bin Ba'oora ka zikr in aayaton mein hai. Farman hai ke us ki misaal kuttay ki si hai ke haanlay to hanpta hai aur dhutkara jaye to hanpta rehta hai. Ya to is misaal se yeh matlab hai ke Bal'am ki zaban neechay ko latak pari thi jo phir andar ko na hui, kuttay ki tarah hanpta rehta tha aur zaban bahar latkaye rehta tha.

Yeh bhi ma'ani hain ke us ki zalalat aur us par jame rehne ki misaal di ke use iman ki dawat, ilm ki daulat garz kisi cheez ne burai se na hataya jaise kutte ki us ki zaban latakne ki halat barabar qaim rehti hai khwah use paon tale rondo khwah chhor do. Jaise ba'az kuffar-e-Makkah ki nisbat farman hai ke unhein wa'az-o-pand kehna na kehna sab barabar hai unhein iman naseeb nahin hone ka aur jaise ba'az munafiqon ki nisbat farman hai ke un ke liye to istighfar kar ya na kar Allah unhein nahin bakhshe ga. Yeh bhi matlab is misaal ka bayan kiya gaya hai ke un kafiron, munafiqon aur gumrah logon ke dil bouday aur hidayat se khali hain yeh kabhi mutma'in nahin hote. Phir Allah Azzawajal apne Nabi ko hukm deta hai ke tu unhein pand-o-nasihat karta reh taake un mein se jo aalim hain, woh gaur-o-fikr kar ke Allah ki rah par aa jayen yeh sochen ke Bal'am mal'oon ka kya haal hua deeni ilm jaisi zabardast daulat ko jis ne duniya ki sufli rahat par kho diya. Aakhir na yeh mila na woh. Donon hath khali reh gaye. Isi tarah yeh ulama-e-Yahood jo apni kitabon mein Allah ki hidayatein parh rahe hain, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke ausaf likhe paate hain, unhein chahiye ke duniya ki tama' mein phans kar apne mureedon ko phans kar phool na jayen warna yeh bhi us ki tarah duniya mein kho diye jayen ge unhein chahiye ke apni ilmiyat se faida uthayen. Sab se pehle teri ita'at ki taraf jhuken aur auron par haq ko zahir karen. Dekh lo ke kuffar ki kaisi buri misalein hain ke kutton ki tarah sirf nigalne ugalne aur shahwat rani mein pare hue hain. Pas jo bhi ilm-o-hidayat ko chhor kar khwahish-e-nafs ke poora karne mein lag jaye woh bhi kutte jaisa hi hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain hamare liye buri misalein nahin apni hiba ki hui cheez ko phir le lene wala kutte ki tarah hai jo qai kar ke chaat leta hai. Phir farmata hai ke gunahgar log Allah ka kuch bigarte nahin yeh to apna hi khasara karte hain. Ta'at-e-Maula, itteba-e-huda se hata kar khwahish ki ghulami duniya ki chahat mein par kar apne donon jahan kharab karte hain.

Bal'am bin Ba'oora marwi hai ke jis ka waqia in ayaton mein bayan ho raha hai us ka naam Bal'am bin Ba'oora hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke us ka naam Zafi bin Rahib tha. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh Balqa ka ek shakhs tha jo Ism-e-Azam janta tha aur Jabbarin ke sath hi Bait-ul-Muqaddas mein raha karta tha. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh Yamani shakhs tha jis ne Kalam-e-Allah ko tark kar diya tha, yeh shakhs Bani Israel ke ulama mein se tha, us ki dua maqbool ho jaya karti thi. Bani Israel sakhtiyon ke waqt ise aage kar diya karte the. Allah us ki dua maqbool farma liya karta tha. Ise Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne Madyan ke badshah ki taraf Allah ke deen ki dawat dene ke liye bheja tha, us aqalmand badshah ne ise makr-o-fareb se apna kar liya. Us ke naam kayi gaon kar diye aur bohat kuch inaam-o-ikram diya. Yeh badnaseeb deen-e-Moosavi ko chhor kar us ke mazhab mein ja mila. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke us ka naam Bal'am tha. Yeh bhi hai ke yeh Umayyah bin Abu Salt hai. Mumkin hai yeh kehne wale ki yeh murad ho ke yeh Umayyah bhi isi ke mushabah tha. Ise bhi agli shariyaton ka ilm tha lekin yeh un se faida na utha saka. Khud Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke zamane ko bhi us ne paya, Aap (ﷺ) ki ayat-e-bayyinat dekhein, mojze apni aankhon se dekh liye, hazarha ko deen-e-haq mein dakhil hote dekha, lekin mushrikeen ke mel-jol, un mein imtiyaz, un mein dosti aur wahan ki sardari ki hawas ne ise Islam aur qabool-e-haq se rok diya. Isi ne Badri kafiron ke matam mein marsiye kahe, La'natullah. Ba'az ahadees mein warid hai ke us ki zaban to iman la chuki thi lekin dil momin nahin hua tha. Kehte hain ke is shakhs se Allah Ta'ala ne wada kiya tha ke us ki duayein jo bhi yeh kare ga maqbool hon gi. Us ki biwi ne ek martaba us se kaha ke in teen duaon mein se ek dua mere liye kar. Us ne manzoor kar liya aur poocha kya dua karana chahti ho? Us ne kaha yeh ke Allah Ta'ala mujhe is qadar husn-o-khoobsurti ata farmaye ke mujh se zyada haseen aurat Bani Israel mein koi na ho. Us ne dua ki aur woh aisi hi haseen ho gayi. Ab to us ne par nikale aur apne miyan ko mehez be-haqeeqat samajhne lagi, bade bade log us ki taraf jhukne lage aur yeh bhi un ki taraf mail ho gayi. Is se yeh bohat kadha aur Allah se dua ki ke Ya Allah ise kutiya bana de. Yeh bhi manzoor hui, woh kutiya ban gayi. Ab us ke bache aaye, unhon ne gher liya ke aap ne ghazab kiya, log hamein ta'na dete hain aur hum kutiya ke bache mashhoor ho rahe hain. Aap dua kijiye ke Allah ise is ki asli halat mein phir se la de. Us ne woh teesri dua bhi kar li, teeno duayein yun hi zaya ho gayin aur yeh khali hath be-khair reh gaya. Mashhoor baat to yahi hai ke Bani Israel ke buzurgon mein se yeh ek shakhs tha. Ba'az logon ne yeh bhi keh diya hai ke yeh Nabi tha. Yeh mehez ghalat hai, bilkul jhoot hai aur khula iftira hai.

Marwi hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) jab qoum-e-Jabbarin se ladai ke liye Bani Israel ki hamrahi mein gaye, inhi Jabbarin mein Bal'am nami yeh shakhs tha. Is ki qoum aur is ke qarabat-dar chacha waghera sab is ke paas aaye aur kaha ke Musa (A.S) aur is ki qoum ke liye aap bad-dua kijiye. Is ne kaha yeh nahin ho sakta, agar main aisa karunga to meri duniya-o-akhirat dono kharab ho jayengi, lekin qoum sar ho gayi. Yeh bhi lihaz-e-muruwwat mein aa gaya. Bad-dua ki, Allah Ta'ala ne is se karamat chheen li aur ise is ke martabe se gira diya. Suddi kehte hain ke jab Bani Israel ko Wadi-e-Teeh mein chalis saal guzar gaye to Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Yusha bin Noon (A.S) ko Nabi bana kar bheja. Unhon ne farmaya ke mujhe hukm hua hai ke main tumhein le kar jaaun aur in Jabbarin se jihad karoon. Yeh amada ho gaye, bai'at kar li. Inhi mein Bal'am nami ek shakhs tha jo bada aalim tha, Ism-e-Azam janta tha. Yeh bad-naseeb kafir ho gaya, qoum-e-Jabbarin mein ja mila aur un se kaha tum na ghabrao, jab Bani Israel ka lashkar aa jayega main un par bad-dua karunga to woh daf'atan halak ho jayega. Is ke paas tamam dunyawi thaath thay lekin aurton ki azmat ki wajah se yeh un se nahin milta tha balkay ek gadhi paal rakhi thi. Isi bad-qismat ka zikr is aayat mein hai. Shaitan is par ghalib aa gaya, ise apne phanday mein phans liya, jo woh kehta tha yeh karta tha, aakhir halak ho gaya. Musnad Abu Ya'la Mosuli mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya ke main tum sab se zyada us se darta hoon jo Quran padh lega, jo Islam ki chadar odhay hue hoga aur deeni taraqqi par hoga ke ek dam us se hat jayega, ise pas-e-pusht daal dega, apne padosi par talwar le daudega aur use shirk ki tohmat lagayega. Hazrat Huzaifa bin Yaman (R.A) ne yeh sun kar daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Mushrik hone ke zyada qabil kaun hoga? Yeh tohmat lagane wala? Ya woh jise tohmat laga raha hai? Farmaya nahin, balkay tohmat dharne wala. Phir farmata hai ke agar hum chahte to qadir thay ke ise buland martabe par pahunchayein, duniya ki aalaishon se pak rakhein, apni di hui aayaton ki tabedari par qaim rakhein, lekin woh dunyawi lazzaton ki taraf jhuk pada yahan tak ke Shaitan ka pura mureed ho gaya. Ise sajda kar liya. Kehte hain ke is Bal'am se logon ne darkhwast ki ke aap Hazrat Musa (A.S) aur Bani Israel ke haq mein bad-dua kijiye. Is ne kaha achha main Allah se hukm le loon. Jab is ne Allah Ta'ala se munajat ki to ise maloom hua ke Bani Israel Musalman hain aur in mein Allah ke Nabi (A.S) maujood hain. Is ne sab se kaha ke mujhe bad-dua karne se rok diya gaya hai. Unhon ne bahut saare tohfay-tahaif jama kar ke ise diye, is ne sab rakh liye.

Phir Allah Azzawajal apne Nabi ko hukm deta hai ke tu unhein pand-o-nasihat karta reh taake un mein se jo aalim hain, woh gaur-o-fikr kar ke Allah ki rah par aa jayen yeh sochen ke Bal'am mal'oon ka kya haal hua deeni ilm jaisi zabardast daulat ko jis ne duniya ki sufli rahat par kho diya. Aakhir na yeh mila na woh. Donon hath khali reh gaye. Isi tarah yeh ulama-e-Yahood jo apni kitabon mein Allah ki hidayatein parh rahe hain, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke ausaf likhe paate hain, unhein chahiye ke duniya ki tama' mein phans kar apne mureedon ko phans kar phool na jayen warna yeh bhi us ki tarah duniya mein kho diye jayen ge unhein chahiye ke apni ilmiyat se faida uthayen. Sab se pehle teri ita'at ki taraf jhuken aur auron par haq ko zahir karen. Dekh lo ke kuffar ki kaisi buri misalein hain ke kutton ki tarah sirf nigalne ugalne aur shahwat rani mein pare hue hain. Pas jo bhi ilm-o-hidayat ko chhor kar khwahish-e-nafs ke poora karne mein lag jaye woh bhi kutte jaisa hi hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain hamare liye buri misalein nahin apni hiba ki hui cheez ko phir le lene wala kutte ki tarah hai jo qai kar ke chaat leta hai. Phir farmata hai ke gunahgar log Allah ka kuch bigarte nahin yeh to apna hi khasara karte hain. Ta'at-e-Maula, itteba-e-huda se hata kar khwahish ki ghulami duniya ki chahat mein par kar apne donon jahan kharab karte hain.

Bal'am bin Ba'oora marwi hai ke jis ka waqia in ayaton mein bayan ho raha hai us ka naam Bal'am bin Ba'oora hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke us ka naam Zafi bin Rahib tha. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh Balqa ka ek shakhs tha jo Ism-e-Azam janta tha aur Jabbarin ke sath hi Bait-ul-Muqaddas mein raha karta tha. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh Yamani shakhs tha jis ne Kalam-e-Allah ko tark kar diya tha, yeh shakhs Bani Israel ke ulama mein se tha, us ki dua maqbool ho jaya karti thi. Bani Israel sakhtiyon ke waqt ise aage kar diya karte the. Allah us ki dua maqbool farma liya karta tha. Ise Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne Madyan ke badshah ki taraf Allah ke deen ki dawat dene ke liye bheja tha, us aqalmand badshah ne ise makr-o-fareb se apna kar liya. Us ke naam kayi gaon kar diye aur bohat kuch inaam-o-ikram diya. Yeh badnaseeb deen-e-Moosavi ko chhor kar us ke mazhab mein ja mila. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke us ka naam Bal'am tha. Yeh bhi hai ke yeh Umayyah bin Abu Salt hai. Mumkin hai yeh kehne wale ki yeh murad ho ke yeh Umayyah bhi isi ke mushabah tha. Ise bhi agli shariyaton ka ilm tha lekin yeh un se faida na utha saka. Khud Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke zamane ko bhi us ne paya, Aap (ﷺ) ki ayat-e-bayyinat dekhein, mojze apni aankhon se dekh liye, hazarha ko deen-e-haq mein dakhil hote dekha, lekin mushrikeen ke mel-jol, un mein imtiyaz, un mein dosti aur wahan ki sardari ki hawas ne ise Islam aur qabool-e-haq se rok diya. Isi ne Badri kafiron ke matam mein marsiye kahe, La'natullah. Ba'az ahadees mein warid hai ke us ki zaban to iman la chuki thi lekin dil momin nahin hua tha. Kehte hain ke is shakhs se Allah Ta'ala ne wada kiya tha ke us ki duayein jo bhi yeh kare ga maqbool hon gi. Us ki biwi ne ek martaba us se kaha ke in teen duaon mein se ek dua mere liye kar. Us ne manzoor kar liya aur poocha kya dua karana chahti ho? Us ne kaha yeh ke Allah Ta'ala mujhe is qadar husn-o-khoobsurti ata farmaye ke mujh se zyada haseen aurat Bani Israel mein koi na ho. Us ne dua ki aur woh aisi hi haseen ho gayi. Ab to us ne par nikale aur apne miyan ko mehez be-haqeeqat samajhne lagi, bade bade log us ki taraf jhukne lage aur yeh bhi un ki taraf mail ho gayi. Is se yeh bohat kadha aur Allah se dua ki ke Ya Allah ise kutiya bana de. Yeh bhi manzoor hui, woh kutiya ban gayi. Ab us ke bache aaye, unhon ne gher liya ke aap ne ghazab kiya, log hamein ta'na dete hain aur hum kutiya ke bache mashhoor ho rahe hain. Aap dua kijiye ke Allah ise is ki asli halat mein phir se la de. Us ne woh teesri dua bhi kar li, teeno duayein yun hi zaya ho gayin aur yeh khali hath be-khair reh gaya. Mashhoor baat to yahi hai ke Bani Israel ke buzurgon mein se yeh ek shakhs tha. Ba'az logon ne yeh bhi keh diya hai ke yeh Nabi tha. Yeh mehez ghalat hai, bilkul jhoot hai aur khula iftira hai.

Marwi hai ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) jab qoum-e-Jabbarin se ladai ke liye Bani Israel ki hamrahi mein gaye, inhi Jabbarin mein Bal'am nami yeh shakhs tha. Is ki qoum aur is ke qarabat-dar chacha waghera sab is ke paas aaye aur kaha ke Musa (A.S) aur is ki qoum ke liye aap bad-dua kijiye. Is ne kaha yeh nahin ho sakta, agar main aisa karunga to meri duniya-o-akhirat dono kharab ho jayengi, lekin qoum sar ho gayi. Yeh bhi lihaz-e-muruwwat mein aa gaya. Bad-dua ki, Allah Ta'ala ne is se karamat chheen li aur ise is ke martabe se gira diya. Suddi kehte hain ke jab Bani Israel ko Wadi-e-Teeh mein chalis saal guzar gaye to Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Yusha bin Noon (A.S) ko Nabi bana kar bheja. Unhon ne farmaya ke mujhe hukm hua hai ke main tumhein le kar jaaun aur in Jabbarin se jihad karoon. Yeh amada ho gaye, bai'at kar li. Inhi mein Bal'am nami ek shakhs tha jo bada aalim tha, Ism-e-Azam janta tha. Yeh bad-naseeb kafir ho gaya, qoum-e-Jabbarin mein ja mila aur un se kaha tum na ghabrao, jab Bani Israel ka lashkar aa jayega main un par bad-dua karunga to woh daf'atan halak ho jayega. Is ke paas tamam dunyawi thaath thay lekin aurton ki azmat ki wajah se yeh un se nahin milta tha balkay ek gadhi paal rakhi thi. Isi bad-qismat ka zikr is aayat mein hai. Shaitan is par ghalib aa gaya, ise apne phanday mein phans liya, jo woh kehta tha yeh karta tha, aakhir halak ho gaya. Musnad Abu Ya'la Mosuli mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya ke main tum sab se zyada us se darta hoon jo Quran padh lega, jo Islam ki chadar odhay hue hoga aur deeni taraqqi par hoga ke ek dam us se hat jayega, ise pas-e-pusht daal dega, apne padosi par talwar le daudega aur use shirk ki tohmat lagayega. Hazrat Huzaifa bin Yaman (R.A) ne yeh sun kar daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Mushrik hone ke zyada qabil kaun hoga? Yeh tohmat lagane wala? Ya woh jise tohmat laga raha hai? Farmaya nahin, balkay tohmat dharne wala. Phir farmata hai ke agar hum chahte to qadir thay ke ise buland martabe par pahunchayein, duniya ki aalaishon se pak rakhein, apni di hui aayaton ki tabedari par qaim rakhein, lekin woh dunyawi lazzaton ki taraf jhuk pada yahan tak ke Shaitan ka pura mureed ho gaya. Ise sajda kar liya. Kehte hain ke is Bal'am se logon ne darkhwast ki ke aap Hazrat Musa (A.S) aur Bani Israel ke haq mein bad-dua kijiye. Is ne kaha achha main Allah se hukm le loon. Jab is ne Allah Ta'ala se munajat ki to ise maloom hua ke Bani Israel Musalman hain aur in mein Allah ke Nabi (A.S) maujood hain. Is ne sab se kaha ke mujhe bad-dua karne se rok diya gaya hai. Unhon ne bahut saare tohfay-tahaif jama kar ke ise diye, is ne sab rakh liye.

Phir dobara darkhwast ki ke hamain in se bahut khauf hai aap zaroor in par bad-dua kijiye. Us ne jawab diya ke jab tak main Allah Ta'ala se ijazat na le loon main hargiz yeh na karunga. Us ne phir Allah se munajat ki lekin use kuch maloom na hosaka. Us ne yahi jawab unhein diya to unhon ne kaha dekho agar mana hi maqsood hota to aap ko rok diya jata jaisa ke is se pehle rok diya gaya. Is ki bhi samajh mein aagaya, uth kar bad-dua shuru ki. Allah ki shaan hai bad-dua un par karne ke bajaye us ki zaban se apni hi qoum ke liye bad-dua nikli aur jab apni qoum ki fatah ki dua mangna chahta to Bani Israel ki fatah-o-nusrat ki dua nikalti. Qoum ne kaha aap kya ghazab kar rahe hain? Us ne kaha kya karoon? Meri zaban mere qabu mein nahin. Suno agar sach much meri zaban se in ke liye bad-dua nikli bhi to qabool na hogi. Suno ab main tumhein ek tarkeeb batata hoon agar tum is mein kamyab hogaye to samajh lo ke Bani Israel barbad hojayenge. Tum apni naujawan ladkiyon ko banao singhar kara ke in ke lashkaron mein bhejo aur unhein hidayat kardo ke koi in ki taraf jhuke to yeh inkar na karein, mumkin hai bojh-e-musafarat yeh log zinakari mein mubtala hojayen. Agar yeh hua to chunke yeh haram-kari Allah ko sakht na-pasand hai isi waqt in par azab aajayega aur yeh tabah hojayenge. In be-ghairaton ne is baat ko maan liya aur yahi kiya. Khud badshah ki badi haseen-o-jameel ladki bhi ban than kar nikli, use hidayat kardi gayi thi ke siwaye Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke aur kisi ko apna nafs na sonpe. Yeh auratein jab Bani Israel ke lashkar mein pahunchin to aam log be-qabu hogaye, haram-kari se bach na sake. Shahzadi Bani Israel ke ek sardar ke paas pahunchi. Is sardar ne is ladki par dore dale lekin is ladki ne inkar kiya. Us ne bataya ke main falan falan hoon, us ne apne baap se ya Bal'am se puchwaya, us ne ijazat di. Yeh khabeeth apna munh kala kar raha tha jise Hazrat Haroon (A.S) ki aulad mein se kisi sahib ne dekh liya, apne naize se un donon ko piro diya. Allah Ta'ala ne is ke dast-o-bazu qawi kardiye, us ne yunhi un donon ko chuday hue utha liya, logon ne bhi unhein dekha. Ab is lashkar par azab-e-Rabb ba-shakl-e-ta'oon aaya aur sattar hazar aadmi foran halak hogaye. Bal'am apni gadhi par sawar ho kar chala, woh ek teele par chadh kar ruk gayi, ab Bal'am use marta peetta hai lekin woh qadam nahin uthati. Aakhir gadhi ne is ki taraf dekha aur kaha mujhe kyun maar raha hai? Samne dekh kaun hai? Us ne dekha to Shaitan-e-La'een khada hua tha, yeh utar pada aur sajde mein gir gaya. Al-gharaz iman se khali hogaya. Is ka naam ya to Bal'am tha, ya Bal'am bin Ba'oora, ya Ibn-e-Abr-e-Bar bin Ba'oor bin Shahoom bin Qooshtam bin Ma'ab bin Loot bin Haroon ya Ibn-e-Maran bin Aazar. Yeh Balqa ka raees tha, Ism-e-Azam janta tha lekin akhir mein deen-e-haq se hat gaya. Wallahu A'lam. Ek riwayat mein hai ke qoum ke zyada kehne sunne se jab yeh apni gadhi par sawar ho kar bad-dua ke liye chala to is ki gadhi baith gayi.

Us ne usay maar peet kar uthaya, kuch door chal kar phir baith gayi. Us ne usay phir maar peet kar uthaya, usay Allah ne zaban di. Us ne kaha tera naas jaye, tu kahan aur kyun ja raha hai? Allah ke muqablay us ke Rasool se larnay aur mominon ko nuqsan dilanay ja raha hai? Dekh to sahi farishtay meri raah rokay kharay hain. Us ne phir bhi kuch khayal na kiya, aagay barh gaya. Habban nami pahari par charh gaya jahan se Bani Israel ka lashkar samnay hi nazar aata tha. Ab un ke liye bad-dua aur apni qoum ke liye duayen karne laga lekin zaban ulat gayi, dua ki jagah bad-dua aur bad-dua ki jagah dua nikalnay lagi. Qoum ne kaha kya kar rahay ho? Kaha be-bas hoon. Isi waqt us ki zaban nikal pari, seenay par lataknay lagi. Us ne kaha lo meri dunya bhi kharab hui aur deen to bilkul barbad ho gaya. Phir us ne khubsurat larkiyan bhejnay ki tarkeeb batayi jaisay ke oopar bayan hua aur kaha ke agar in mein se aik ne bhi badkari kar li to un par azab-e-Rabb aa jaye ga. In aurton mein se aik bohat hi haseen aurat jo Kananiya thi aur jis ka naam Kasti tha, jo Soor nami aik raees ki beti thi, woh jab Bani Israel ke aik bohat baray sardar Zamri bin Shaloam ke paas se guzri jo Shamoon bin Yaqoob ki nasl mein se tha, woh us par farefta ho gaya. Daleri ke sath us ka haath thamay huay Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke paas gaya aur kehnay laga aap to shayad keh den ge ke yeh mujh par haram hai? Aap ne kaha beshak. Us ne kaha acha main aap ki yeh baat to nahin maan sakta, usay apnay khaimay mein le gaya aur us se munh kala karne laga. Wahin Allah Ta'ala ne un par ta'oon bhej diya. Hazrat Fahas bin Aizar bin Haroon (R.A) us waqt lashkar-gah se kahin bahar gaye huay thay, jab aaye aur tamam haqeeqat suni to betab ho kar gussay ke sath us bad-kirdar ke khaimay mein pohanchay aur apnay naizay mein un dono ko piro liya aur apnay haath mein naiza liye huay unhein oopar uthaye huay bahar niklay, kehni ko kakh par lagaye huay thay, kehnay lagay ya Allah hamein maaf farma, hum par se yeh waba door farma, dekh le hum teray nafarmanon ke sath yeh kartay hain. Un ki dua aur is fe'l se ta'oon uth gaya lekin itni dair mein jab hisab lagaya gaya to sattar hazar aadmi aur aik riwayat ki roo se bees hazar mar chukay thay. Din ka waqt tha aur Kananiyon ki yeh chhokriyan sauda bechnay ke bahanay sirf is liye aayi thin ke Bani Israel badkari mein phans jayen aur un par azab aa jaye. Bani Israel mein ab tak yeh dastoor chala aata hai ke woh apnay zabiha mein se gardan aur dast aur sari aur har qisam ka sab se pehla phal Fahas ki aulad ko diya kartay hain. Isi Bal'am bin Ba'oora ka zikr in aayaton mein hai. Farman hai ke us ki misaal kuttay ki si hai ke haanlay to hanpta hai aur dhutkara jaye to hanpta rehta hai. Ya to is misaal se yeh matlab hai ke Bal'am ki zaban neechay ko latak pari thi jo phir andar ko na hui, kuttay ki tarah hanpta rehta tha aur zaban bahar latkaye rehta tha.

Yeh bhi ma'ani hain ke us ki zalalat aur us par jame rehne ki misaal di ke use iman ki dawat, ilm ki daulat garz kisi cheez ne burai se na hataya jaise kutte ki us ki zaban latakne ki halat barabar qaim rehti hai khwah use paon tale rondo khwah chhor do. Jaise ba'az kuffar-e-Makkah ki nisbat farman hai ke unhein wa'az-o-pand kehna na kehna sab barabar hai unhein iman naseeb nahin hone ka aur jaise ba'az munafiqon ki nisbat farman hai ke un ke liye to istighfar kar ya na kar Allah unhein nahin bakhshe ga. Yeh bhi matlab is misaal ka bayan kiya gaya hai ke un kafiron, munafiqon aur gumrah logon ke dil bouday aur hidayat se khali hain yeh kabhi mutma'in nahin hote. Aakhir na yeh mila na woh. Donon hath khali reh gaye. Isi tarah yeh ulama-e-Yahood jo apni kitabon mein Allah ki hidayatein parh rahe hain, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke ausaf likhe paate hain, unhein chahiye ke duniya ki tama' mein phans kar apne mureedon ko phans kar phool na jayen warna yeh bhi us ki tarah duniya mein kho diye jayen ge unhein chahiye ke apni ilmiyat se faida uthayen. Sab se pehle teri ita'at ki taraf jhuken aur auron par haq ko zahir karen. Dekh lo ke kuffar ki kaisi buri misalein hain ke kutton ki tarah sirf nigalne ugalne aur shahwat rani mein pare hue hain. Pas jo bhi ilm-o-hidayat ko chhor kar khwahish-e-nafs ke poora karne mein lag jaye woh bhi kutte jaisa hi hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain hamare liye buri misalein nahin apni hiba ki hui cheez ko phir le lene wala kutte ki tarah hai jo qai kar ke chaat leta hai. Phir farmata hai ke gunahgar log Allah ka kuch bigarte nahin yeh to apna hi khasara karte hain. Ta'at-e-Maula, itteba-e-huda se hata kar khwahish ki ghulami duniya ki chahat mein par kar apne donon jahan kharab karte hain.

Behtareen dua: Rabb jinhein raah dikhaye unhein koi berah nahin kar sakta aur jise woh hi ghalat raah par daal de us ki shumi-e-qismat mein kya shak hai? Allah ka chaha hota hai us ka na chaha kabhi nahin ho sakta. Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ki hadith mein hai ke sab tareefein Allah hi ke liye hain hum us ki hamd bayan karte hain aur usi se madad chahte hain aur usi se hidayat talab karte hain aur usi se bakhshish mangte hain. Hum apne nafs ki shararaton se Allah ki panah lete hain aur apne a'maal ki buraiyon se bhi. Allah ke raah dikhaye huye ko koi behka nahin sakta aur us ke gumrah kiye huye ko koi raah-e-raast par la nahin sakta. Main gawahi deta hoon ke mabood sirf Allah hi hai woh akela hai us ka koi shareek nahin aur meri gawahi hai ke Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us ke bande aur us ke Rasool hain. (Musnad-e-Ahmad waghera)

Allah Ta'ala Aalim-ul-Ghaib hai. Bahut se insaan aur jinn jahannami hone wale hain aur un se waise hi aamaal sarzad hote hain. Makhlooq mein se kaun kaise amal karega? Yeh Allam-ul-Ghuyub ko un ki paidaish se pehle hi maloom hota hai. Pas apne ilm ke mutabiq apni kitab mein aasman-o-zameen ki paidaish se pachaas hazaar baras pehle hi likh liya, jabke Us ka Arsh paani par tha, chunancha Sahih Muslim Sharif ki hadith mein hai. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek Ansari nabaligh bachche ke janaze par bulwaye gaye to main ne kaha mubarak ho is ko, yeh to jannat ki chidiya hai, na burai ki, na burai ka waqt paya. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya kuch aur bhi? Sun, Allah Ta'ala ne jannat ko aur jannat walon ko paida kiya hai aur unhein jannati muqarrar kardiya hai halanke abhi to woh apne baapon ki peethon mein hi the. Isi tarah Us ne jahannam banayi hai aur us ke rehne wale paida kiye hain, unhein isi liye muqarrar kardiya hai dar-aan-haale-ke ab tak woh apne baapon ki pusht mein hi hain. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadithein hain aur taqdeer ka masla koi mamooli masla nahin ke yahan poora bayan hojaye. Yahan maqsad yeh hai ke aise khaali az khair mehroom-e-qismat log kisi cheez se faida nahin uthate. Tamam aaza hote hain lekin quwwatein sab se chhin jaati hain, andhe behre goonge ban kar zindagi garhay mein hi guzaar dete hain. Agar un mein khair baqi hoti to Allah apni baatein unhein sunata bhi. Yeh to khair se bilkul khaali hogaye, sunte hain aur ansuni kar jaate hain, aankhein hi nahin balki dil ki aankhein andhi hogayi hain. Rahman ke zikr se munh modne ki saza yeh mili hai ke shaitan ke bhai ban gaye hain, rah-e-haq se door ja pade hain magar samajh yahi rahe hain ke hum sachche aur sahi raaste par hain. In mein aur chaupaye janwaron mein koi farq nahin. Na yeh haq ko dekhein, na hidayat ko dekhein, na Allah ki baaton ko sochein. Chaupaye bhi to apne hawaas ko duniya ke kaam mein laate hain, isi tarah yeh bhi fikr-e-uqba se, zikr-e-Rabb se, rah-e-Maula se ghafil, goonge aur andhe hain. Jaise farman hai aayat (Wama-salul-lazina kafaru kamasalil-lazi yan'iqu bima la yasma'u illa du'a-an wa nida-an, bukmun 'umyun fahum la ya'qilun) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 171). Yani un kafiron ki misaal to us shakhs ki si hai jo us ke peeche chilla raha hai jo darhaqiqat sunti-wunti khaak bhi nahin, haan sirf shor-o-ghul to us ke kaan mein padta hai. Chaupaye aawaz to sunte hain lekin kya kaha? Use samjhein un ki bala. Phir taraqqi kar ke farmata hai ke yeh zalim to chaupayon se bhi badtareen hain ke chaupaye go na samjhein lekin aawaz par kaan to khade kardete hain, isharon par harkat to karte hain, yeh to apne Maalik ko itna bhi nahin samajhte. Apni paidaish ki ghayat ko aaj tak maloom hi nahin kiya, jabhi to Allah se kufr karte hain aur ghair-Allah ki ibadat karte hain. Is ke bar-khilaf jo Allah ka muti' insaan ho woh Allah ke itaat-guzar farishte se behtar hai aur kuffar-e-insaan se chaupaye janwar behtar hain, aise log poore ghafil hain.

Asma-ul-Husna: Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ke ek kam ek sau naam hain, unhein jo mehfooz kar le woh Jannati hai. Woh Witr hai, taaq ko hi pasand farmata hai (Bukhari waghera). Tirmidhi mein hai ninnanve (99) naam is tarah hain: (Allah-ul-ladhi la ilaha illa huwar-Rahman-ur-Rahim-ul-Malik-ul-Quddus-us-Salam-ul-Mumin-ul-Muhaimin-ul-Aziz-ul-Jabbar-ul-Mutakabbir-ul-Khaliq-ul-Bari-ul-Musawwir-ul-Ghaffar-ul-Qahhar-ul-Wahhab-ur-Razzaq-ul-Fattah-ul-Alim-ul-Qabid-ul-Basit-ul-Khafid-ur-Rafi-ul-Muizz-ul-Mudhill-us-Sami-ul-Basir-ul-Hakam-ul-Adl-ul-Latif-ul-Khabir-ul-Halim-ul-Azim-ul-Ghafoor-ush-Shakoor-ul-Ali-ul-Kabir-ul-Hafiz-ul-Muqit-ul-Hasib-ul-Jalil-ul-Karim-ur-Raqib-ul-Mujib-ul-Wasi-ul-Hakim-ul-Wadud-ul-Majid-ul-Baith-ush-Shahid-ul-Haq-ul-Wakil-ul-Qawi-ul-Matin-ul-Wali-ul-Hamid-ul-Muhsi-ul-Mubdi-ul-Muid-ul-Muhyi-ul-Mumit-ul-Hayy-ul-Qayyum-ul-Wajid-ul-Wahid-ul-Ahad-ul-Fard-us-Samad-ul-Qadir-ul-Muqtadir-ul-Muqaddim-ul-Muakhkhir-ul-Awwal-ul-Akhir-uz-Zahir-ul-Batin-ul-Wali-ul-Muta'ali-ul-Barr-ut-Tawwab-ul-Muntaqim-ul-Afu-ur-Rauf-Malik-ul-Mulk-Dhul-Jalal-i-wal-Ikram-ul-Muqsit-ul-Jami-ul-Ghani-ul-Mughni-ul-Mani-ud-Darr-un-Nafi-un-Nur-ul-Hadi-ul-Badi-ul-Baqi-ul-Warith-ur-Rashid-us-Saboor). Yeh hadith ghareeb hai, kuch kami ziyadati ke sath isi tarah yeh naam Ibn-e-Majah ki hadith mein bhi warid hain. Ba'az buzurgon ka khayal hai ke yeh naam rawiyon ne Quran mein se chhaant liye hain. Wallahu A'lam. Yeh yaad rahe ke yahi ninnanve (99) naam Allah ke hon aur na hon yeh baat nahin. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jise kabhi bhi koi gham-o-ranj pahunche aur woh yeh dua kare: (Allahumma inni abduka ibn-e-abdika ibn-e-amatika nasiyati biyadik, madin fiyya hukmuka, adlun fiyya qada'uka, as'aluka bikulli ismin huwa laka sammaita bihi nafsaka, aw anzaltahu fi kitabika, aw allamtahu ahadan min khalqika, aw ista'tharta bihi fi ilmil-ghaibi indaka, an taj'alal-Qur'anal-azima rabi'a qalbi, wa nura sadri, wa jala'a huzni, wa dhahaba hammi). To Allah Ta'ala uske gham-o-ranj ko door kar dega aur uski jagah rahat-o-khushi ata farmayega. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya gaya ke phir kya hum ise auron ko bhi sikhayen? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan beshak, jo ise sune use chahiye ke dusron ko bhi sikhaye. Imam Abu Hatim bin Hibban Busti (R.H) bhi is riwayat ko isi tarah apni Sahih mein laye hain. Imam Abu Bakr bin Arabi (R.H) bhi apni kitab Al-Ahwadhi fi Sharh-it-Tirmidhi mein likhte hain ke ba'az logon ne Allah Ta'ala ke Asma-e-Husna Kitab-o-Sunnat se jama kiye hain jin ki tadaad ek hazar tak pahunch gayi hai, Wallahu A'lam. Allah ke namon se ilhad karne walon ko chhod do, jaise ke lafz-e-Allah se kafiron ne apne but ka naam Laat rakha aur Aziz se mushtaq kar ke Uzza naam rakha. Yeh bhi ma'ani hain ke jo Allah ke namon mein shareek karte hain unhein chhodo. Jo unhein jhutlate hain un se munh mod lo. Ilhad ke lafzi ma'ani hain darmiyana seedhe raste se hat jana aur ghoom jana. Isi liye baghli qabr ko lahad kehte hain kyunke seedhi khudai se hata kar banai jati hai.

Ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke ausaf yani baaz log haq-o-adl par qaim hain. Haq baat hi zaban se nikalte hain, haq kaam hi karte hain, haq ki taraf hi auron ko bulate hain, haq ke sath hi insaf karte hain aur baaz aasar mein marwi hai ke is se murad Ummat-e-Muhammad (ﷺ) hai. Chunancha Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) farmate hain mujhe yeh riwayat pahunchi hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab is aayat ki tilawat farmate to farmate ke yeh tumhare liye hai, tum se pehle yeh wasf qoum-e-Musa (A.S) ka tha. Rabee bin Anas (R.H) farmate hain ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ka irshad hai meri ummat mein se ek jamaat haq par qaim rahegi yahan tak ke Hazrat Isa bin Maryam (A.S) utrein, woh khwah kabhi bhi utrein. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai aap (ﷺ) farmate hain meri ummat ka ek giroh hamesha haq par zahir rahega, unhein un ki dushmani karne wale kuch nuqsan na pahuncha sakenge yahan tak ke Qayamat aajaye. Ek aur riwayat mein hai yahan tak ke Allah ka Amr-e-Ilahi aajaye, woh isi par rahenge. Ek riwayat mein hai (is waqt) woh Sham mein honge.

Samaan-e-ta'ayyush ki kasrat azaab-e-Ilahi bhi hai, ya'ni aise logon ko rozi mein kushadgi di jayegi, ma'ash ki aasaniyan milengi, woh dhoke mein par jayenge aur haqaniyat ko bhool jayenge. Jab poore mast ho jayenge aur hamari nasihat ko gayi guzri kar denge toh hum unhein har tarah ke aaram denge yahan tak ke woh mast ho jayenge tab unhein hum nagahani pakar mein pakar lenge. Us waqt woh mayoosi ke sath munh takte reh jayenge aur un zalimon ki rag kat jayegi. Haqiqatan tareefon ke laiq sirf Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Inhein mein toh dheel doonga aur yeh mere is daao se bekhabar honge. Meri tadbeer kabhi nakam nahin hoti, woh bari mazboot aur mustahkam hoti hai.

Samaan-e-ta'ayyush ki kasrat azaab-e-Ilahi bhi hai, ya'ni aise logon ko rozi mein kushadgi di jayegi, ma'ash ki aasaniyan milengi, woh dhoke mein par jayenge aur haqaniyat ko bhool jayenge. Jab poore mast ho jayenge aur hamari nasihat ko gayi guzri kar denge toh hum unhein har tarah ke aaram denge yahan tak ke woh mast ho jayenge tab unhein hum nagahani pakar mein pakar lenge. Us waqt woh mayoosi ke sath munh takte reh jayenge aur un zalimon ki rag kat jayegi. Haqiqatan tareefon ke laiq sirf Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Inhein mein toh dheel doonga aur yeh mere is daao se bekhabar honge. Meri tadbeer kabhi nakam nahin hoti, woh bari mazboot aur mustahkam hoti hai.

Sadaqat-e-Risalat par Allah ki gawahi. Kya in kafiron ne kabhi is baat par gaur kiya ke Janab-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ) mein junoon ki koi baat bhi hai? Jaise farman hai aayat (Qul innama a'izukum biwahidatin an taqumu lillahi masna wa furada summa tatafakkaru ma bisahibikum min jinnatin in huwa illa nazirullakum baina yadai azabin shadid) (Surah Saba: 46). Aao meri ek baat to maan lo, zara si der khuloos ke sath Allah ko hazir jaan kar akele-o-akele gaur to karo ke mujh mein kaunsa deewana-pan hai? Main to tumhein aane wale sakht khatre ki ittila de raha hoon ke is se hoshiyar raho. Jab tum yeh karoge to khud is natije par pahunch jaoge ke main majnoon nahin balkay Allah ka paigham de kar tum mein bheja gaya hoon. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne ek martaba Safa pahar par charh kar Quraishiyon ke ek-ek qabeele ka alag-alag naam le kar unhein Allah ke azabon se daraya aur isi tarah subh kar di to baaz kehne lage deewana ho gaya hai, is par yeh aayat utri.

Shaitani chakkar Allah Ta'ala Jalla Shanuhu ki itni bari wasee badshahat mein se aur zameen-o-aasman ki har tarah ki makhlooq mein se kisi ek cheez ne bhi baad az gaur-o-fikr unhein yeh taufeeq na di ke yeh ba-imaan ho jate? Aur Rabb ko be-nazeer-o-be-shuba wahid-o-farda maan lete? Aur jaan lete ke itni bari khalq ka khaliq itne bare mulk ka wahid malik hi ibadaton ke laiq hai? Phir yeh imaan qabool kar lete isi ki ibadaton mein lag jate aur shirk-o-kufr se yaksu ho jate? Unhein dar lagne lagta ke kya khabar hamari maut ka waqt qareeb hi aa gaya ho? Hum kufr par hi mar jayen toh abadi sazaon mein par jayen? Jab unhein itni nishaniyon ke dekh lene ke baad, is qadar baatein samjha dene ke baad bhi imaan-o-yaqeen na aaya, Allah ki kitab aur us ke Rasool ke aa jane ke baad bhi yeh rah-e-rast par na aaye toh ab kis baat ko manenge? Musnad ki ek hadith mein hai ke Mi'raj wali raat jab main satwein aasman par pahuncha toh main ne dekha ke goya oopar ki taraf bijli karak aur khar-kharahat ho rahi hai, main kuch aise logon ke paas pahuncha jin ke pet bare bare gharon jitne oonche the jin mein saanp bhar rahe the jo bahar se hi nazar aate the main ne Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) se daryaft kiya ke yeh kaun log hain? Unhon ne batlaya yeh sood khor hain jab main wahan se utarne laga toh aasman-e-awwal par aa kar main ne dekha ke neeche ki janib dhuan, gubar aur shor-o-ghul hai main ne poocha yeh kya hai? Jibraeel (A.S) ne kaha yeh shaitan hain jo apni khurmastiyon aur dhenga mushtiyon se logon ki aankhon par parde daal rahe hain ke woh aasman-o-zameen ki badshahat ki cheezon mein gaur-o-fikr na kar sakein agar yeh baat na hoti toh woh bare ajaibat dekhte. Is ke ek rawi Ali bin Zaid bin Jad'an ki bahut si riwayat munkar hain.

Meri nishaniyan aur taleem gumrahon ke liye besood hain, jis par gumrahi likh di gayi hai use koi hidayat nahin de sakta. Woh chahe sari nishaniyan dekh le lekin sab besood. Allah ka irada jis ke liye fitne ka ho to us ka koi ikhtiyar nahin rakhta. Mera hukm to yahi hai ke aasman-o-zameen ki meri beshumar nishaniyon par gaur karo lekin yeh zahir hai ke aayatein aur daraway be-imanon ke liye sood-mand nahin.

Qayamat kab aur kis waqt? Yeh daryaft karne wale Quraishi bhi thay aur Yahudi bhi, lekin chunke yeh aayat Makki hai is liye theek yahi hai ke Quraishiyon ka sawal tha. Chunke woh Qayamat ke qail hi na thay is liye is qisam ke sawal kiya karte thay ke agar sachay ho toh is ka theek waqt bata do. Idhar be-imaan is ki jaldi macha rahe hain. Idhar imandar isay haq jaan kar is se dar rahe hain. Baat yeh hai ke jinhein is mein bhi shak hai woh roz-e-gumrahi mein toh wahi hain. Poocha karte thay ke Qayamat waqay kab hogi? Jawab sikhaya gaya ke is ke sahih waqt ka ilm siwaye Allah ke kisi ko nahin, wahi is ke sahih waqt se waqif hai, bajuz is ke kisi ko is ke waqay hone ka waqt maloom nahin. Is ka ilm zameen-o-aasman par bhi bhari hai, in ke rehne wali sari makhlooq is ilm se khali hai. Woh jab aayegi sab par ek hi waqt waqay hogi, sab ko zarar pohanchay ga. Aasman phat jaye ga, sitaray jhar jayenge, suraj be-noor ho jayenge, pahar urnay lagenge, isi liye woh sari makhlooq par garan guzar rahi hai. Is ke waqay hone ke sahih waqt ka ilm sari makhlooq par bhari hai. Zameen-o-aasman wale sab is se aajiz aur be-khabar hain. Woh toh achanak sab ki be-khabari mein hi aayegi. Koi buzurg se buzurg farishta, koi baray se bara paighambar bhi is ke aanay ke waqt ka aalim nahin. Woh toh sab ki be-khabari mein hi aa jayegi. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain duniya ke kul kaam hasb-e-dastoor ho rahe honge, janwaron wale apne janwaron ke pani pilanay ke hauz durust kar rahe honge, tijarat wale tol-taal mein mashghool honge ke Qayamat aa jayegi. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Qayamat qaim hone se pehle suraj maghrib ki taraf se niklay ga, isay dekhte hi sab log imaan qabool kar lenge lekin us waqt ka imaan un ke liye be-sood hoga. Jo is se pehle imaan na laye hon aur jinhon ne is se pehle nekiyan na ki hon. Qayamat is tarah daf'atan aa jayegi ke ek shakhs kapra phailaye dusre ko dikha raha hoga aur dusra dekh raha hoga, bhao-tao ho raha hoga ke Qayamat ho jayegi, na yeh khareedo-farokht kar sakenge na kapray ki teh kar sakenge. Koi doodh doh kar le aa raha hoga, pee na sakay ga ke Qayamat aa jayegi. Koi hauz durust kar raha hoga, abhi janwaron ko pani na pila chuka hoga ke Qayamat aa jayegi. Koi luqma uthaye hue hoga, abhi munh mein na dala hoga ke Qayamat aa jayegi. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai aadmi doodh ka katora utha kar peena chahta hi hoga, abhi munh se na lag paye ga ke Qayamat qaim ho jayegi. Kapray ke khareedar bhi sauda na kar chukay honge ke Qayamat aa jayegi, hauz wale bhi leepa-poti kar rahe honge ke Qayamat barpa ho jayegi. Tujh se is tarah poochte hain goya tu un ka sacha rafeeq hai, yeh tere pakkay dost hain. Is tarah poochte hain goya ke tujhe is ka haal maloom hai, halankeh kisi muqarrab farishtay ya Nabi ya Rasool ko is ka ilm hargiz nahin. Quraishiyon ne yeh bhi kaha tha ke Huzoor! Hum toh aap ke qarabatdar hain, hamein toh bata dijiye ke Qayamat kab aur kis din kis saal aayegi?

Is tarah poocha ke goya aap ko maloom hai halankeh is ka ilm sirf Allah ke paas hi hai jaise farman hai aayat (Innal-laha indahu ilmus-sa'ati wa yunazzilul-ghaitha wa ya'lamu ma fil-arhami wa ma tadri nafsun maza taksibu ghada wa ma tadri nafsun bi-ayyi ardin tamutu innallaha 'alimun khabir) (Surah Luqman: 34). Qayamat ka ilm sirf Allah ko hi hai yahi ma'ni zyada tarjeeh wale hain wallahu a'lam. Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ne bhi jab a'rabi ka roop dhar kar sail ki waza mein aap ke paas baith kar aap se qayamat ke bare mein poocha to aap ne saaf jawab diya ke is ka ilm na mujhe hai na tujhe. Is se pehle ke sawalat aap bata chuke the is sawal ke jawab mein apni la-ilmi zahir kar ke poori Surah Luqman ki aakhri aayat padhi ke in paanch cheezon ko Allah ke siwa koi nahin jaanta. Ya'ni ilm-e-qayamat, barish ka aana, mada ke pet ke bache ka haal, kal ke halaat, maut ki jagah. Haan jab aap ne is ki alamatein poochin to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne bata dein. Phir isi aayat ko tilawat farmaya. Jibraeel (A.S) aap ke har jawab par yahi farmate jaate the ke aap ne sach farmaya. Un ke chale jaane ke baad sahaba ne ta'ajjub se poocha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh kaun sahib the? Aap ne farmaya Jibraeel (A.S) the tumhein deen sikhane aaye the. Jab kabhi woh mere paas jis hai'at mein aaye main ne unhein pehchan liya lekin ab ki martaba to main khud ab tak na pehchan saka tha. Alhamdulillah main ne is ke tamam tareeqe kul sanadon ke sath poori behas kar ke Bukhari Sharif ki sharah ke awwal mein hi zikr kar diye hain. Ek a'rabi ne aa kar ba-awaz-e-buland aap ka naam le kar aap ko pukara aap ne isi tarah jawab diya. Us ne kaha qayamat kab hogi? Aap ne farmaya woh aane wali to qatan hai, to bata tu ne is ke liye kya tayari ki hai? Us ne jawab diya ke rozay namaz to mere paas zyada nahin albata main Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki mohabbat se apne dil ko pur pata hoon. Aap ne farmaya insaan isi ke hamrah hoga jis se mohabbat rakhta ho, momin is hadith ko sun kar bohat hi khush hue ke is qadar khushi unhein aur kisi cheez par nahin hui thi. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aadat-e-mubarak hi thi ke jab koi aap se aisa sawal kare jis ki zaroorat na ho to aap use woh baat batate jo is se kahin zyada mufeed ho. Isi liye is sail ko bhi farmaya ke waqt ka ilm kya faida de ga? Ho sake to tayari kar lo. Sahih Muslim mein hai ke a'rab log Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se jab kabhi qayamat ke bare sawal karte to aap jo un mein sab se kam umr hota use dekh kar farmate ke agar yeh apni tab'i umr tak pahuncha to is ke budhape tak hi tum apni qayamat ko pa lo ge.

Is se murad un ki maut hai jo aakhirat ke barzakh mein pahuncha deti hai. Baaz riwayaton mein un ke is qisam ke sawal par Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) ka ala-itlaq yahi farmana bhi marwi hai ke is nau-umar ke barhapay tak Qayamat aajayegi. Yeh itlaq bhi isi taqleed par majhool hoga yani murad is se un logon ki maut ka waqt hai. Wafat se ek mah qabl Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya tum mujh se Qayamat ke baray mein sawal karte ho, is ke sahih waqt ka ilm to sirf Allah Ta'ala hi ko hai, main qasamia bayan karta hoon ke is waqt roo-e-zameen par jitne mutanaffis (jaan-daar) hain un mein se ek bhi sau saal tak baqi na rahe ga. (Muslim). Matlab is se yeh hai ke sau saal tak is zamanay ke mojood logon se yeh duniya khali hojayegi. Aap (ﷺ) farmate hain Mi'raj wali shab meri mulaqat Hazrat Musa aur Isa (Alaihimas Salam) se hui, wahan Qayamat ke waqt ka zikr chala to Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ki taraf sab ne baat ko jhuka diya. Aap (A.S) ne jawab diya ke mujhe to is ka ilm nahin, sab Hazrat Musa (A.S) ki taraf mutawajja hue, yahi jawab wahan se mila, phir Hazrat Isa (A.S) ki taraf mutawajja hue to Aap (A.S) ne farmaya is ke waqay hone ka waqt to bajuz Allah Ta'ala ke koi nahin janta. Haan mujh se mere Rab ne farma rakha hai ke Dajjal nikalne wala hai, mere sath do shakhein hongi, woh mujhe dekh kar seesay ki tarah pighalne lage ga, aakhir Allah use mere hathon halak kare ga, yahan tak ke darakht aur patthar bhi bolne lagenge ke ae Musalman! Yahan mere neeche ek kafir chupa hua hai, aa aur ise qatl kar daal. Jab Allah Ta'ala un sab ko halak kar de ga tab log apne shehron aur watanon ko lautenge. Is waqt Ya'juj Ma'juj niklenge jo koodte phalangte charon taraf phail jayenge, jahan se guzrenge tabahi phaila denge, jis pani se guzrenge sab pee jayenge. Aakhir log tang aa kar mujh se shikayat karenge, main Allah se dua karunga, Allah Ta'ala sab ko halak kar de ga, un ki lashon ka sarand phailay gi jis se log tang aajayenge, Allah Ta'ala barish barsaye ga jo un ki lashon ko baha kar samundar mein daal aayegi, phir to pahar udne lagenge aur zameen sukarne lage gi. Jab yeh sab kuch zahir hoga us waqt Qayamat aisi qareeb hogi jaisi pooray din wali hamila aurat ke bacha hone ka zamana qareeb hota hai ke ghar ke log hoshiyar rehte hain ke na janen din ko hojaye ya raat ko. (Ibn-e-Majah, Musnad waghera). Is se maloom hua ke Qayamat ka ilm kisi Rasool ko bhi nahin. Hazrat Isa (A.S) bhi is ki alamat bayan farmate hain na ke muqarrara waqt. Is liye ke Aap (A.S) ahkaam-e-Rasool (ﷺ) ke jari karne aur Dajjal ko qatl karne aur apni dua ki barkat se Ya'juj Ma'juj ko halak karne ke liye is ummat ke aakhir zamanay mein nazil honge jis ka ilm Allah ne Aap (A.S) ko de diya hai.

Anhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se Qayamat ki babat sawal hua toh Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya is ka ilm Allah ke paas hi hai siwaye is ke ise aur koi nahin jaanta, haan main tumhein is ki shartein batlata hoon, is se pehle bade bade fitne aur ladaiyan hongi, logon ke khoon aise safed ho jayenge ke goya koi kisi ko jaanta pehchanta hi nahin (Musnad). Aap (ﷺ) is aayat ke utarne se pehle bhi aksar Qayamat ka zikr farmate raha karte the, pas gaur kar lo ke yeh Nabi-e-Ummi (ﷺ) jo Sayyid-ur-Rusul hain, Khatam-ul-Anbiya hain, Nabi-ur-Rahmat hain, Nabi-ullah hain, Al-Malhama hain, Aaqib hain, Muqaffi hain, Hashir hain, jin ke qadmon par logon ka hashr hoga, jin ka farman hai ke main aur Qayamat is tarah aaye hain aur Aap (ﷺ) ne apni dono ungliyan jod kar batayin yani shahadat ki ungli aur us ke paas ki ungli, lekin bawajood is ke Qayamat ka ilm Aap (ﷺ) ko na tha. Aap (ﷺ) se jab sawal hua toh yahi hukm mila jawab do ke is ka ilm sirf Allah hi ko hai lekin aksar log be-ilm hain.

Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko ilm-e-ghaib nahin tha. Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum farmata hai ke aap tamam kaam supurd-e-Ilah karein aur saaf keh dein ke ghaib ki kisi baat ka mujhe ilm nahin. Main toh sirf woh jaanta hoon jo Allah Ta'ala mujhe maloom kara de. Jaise Surah Jinn mein hai ke Aalim-ul-Ghaib Allah Ta'ala hi hai, woh apne ghaib par kisi ko aagah nahin karta. Mujhe agar ghaib ki ittila hoti toh main apne liye bahut si bhalaaiyan samet leta. Mujahid (R.H) se marwi hai ke agar mujhe apni maut ka ilm hota toh nekiyon mein bhi sabqat le jaata. Lekin yeh qaul ghaur-talab hai kyunke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke aamaal daaimi thay, jo neki ek baar karte phir usey mamool bana lete. Saari zindagi aur zindagi ka har ek din balkeh har ek ghari ek hi tarah ki thi. Goya ke aap ki nigahein har waqt Allah Ta'ala ki taraf lagti rehti thin. Zyada se zyada yeh baat yun ho sakti hai ke dusron ko main un ki maut ke waqt se khabardar kar ke unhein aamaal-e-neik ki raghbat dilata, wallahu aalam. Is se zyada achha qaul is ki tafsir mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ka hai ke main maal jama kar leta, mujhe maloom ho jaata ke is cheez ke khareedne mein nafa hai main usey khareed leta. Jaanta ke is ki kharidari mein nuqsan hai na khareedta. Khushk saali ke liye tarsaali mein zakheera jama kar leta. Arzani ke waqt girani ke ilm se sauda jama kar leta. Kabhi koi burai mujhe na pahunchti kyunke main ilm-e-ghaib se jaan leta ke yeh burai hai toh main pehle se hi is se jatan kar leta. Lekin main ilm-e-ghaib nahin jaanta is liye faqiri bhi mujh par aati hai, takleef bhi hoti hai. Mujh mein tum yeh wasf na maano. Suno mujh mein wasf yeh hai ke main bure logon ko azaab-e-Ilahi se darata hoon, imandaron ko jannat ki khushkhabri sunata hoon. Jaise farman hai aayat (فَاِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ وَتُنْذِرَ بِهٖ قَوْمًا لُّدًّا 97؀) (Maryam: 97) hum ne ise teri zaban par aasaan kar diya hai ke tu parhezgaron ko khushkhabri suna de aur buron ko dara de.

Ek hi baap ek hi maa aur tamam nasl-e-Adam tamam insanon ko Allah Ta'ala ne sirf Hazrat Adam A.S se hi paida kiya. Inhi se unki biwi Hazrat Hawa ko paida kiya phir un dono se nasl-e-insan jaari ki. Jaise farman hai aayat (Yaa ayyuhan-naasu inna khalaqnaakum min zakarin wa unsaa wa ja'alnaakum shu'uuban wa qabaa'ila lita'aarafuu, inna akramakum 'indallahi atqaakum, innallaha 'aliimun khabiir) (Surah Al-Hujurat: 13). Logo hum ne tumhein ek hi mard-o-aurat se paida kiya hai phir tumhare kunbay aur qabeelay bana diye taake aapas mein ek dusre ko pehchante raho. Allah ke haan sab se zyada zi-izzat woh hai jo parhezgari mein sab se aagay hai. Surah Nisa ke shuru mein hai ae logo apne parwardigar se daro jis ne tum sab ko ek hi shakhs yani Hazrat Adam se paida kiya hai inhi se unki biwi ko paida kiya phir un dono miyan-biwi se bohat se mard-o-aurat phaila diye. Yahan farmata hai ke inhi se unki biwi ko banaya taake yeh aaram uthayen chunancha ek aur aayat mein hai (Litaskunuu ilaiha wa ja'ala bainakum mawaddatan wa rahmah) logo yeh bhi Allah ki ek meherbani hai ke us ne tumhare liye tumhari biwiyan bana dein taake tum un se sukoon-o-aaram hasil karo aur us ne tum mein baham mohabbat-o-ulfat paida kar di. Pas yeh Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se chahat hai jo miyan-biwi mein woh paida kar deta hai. Isi liye jadugaron ki burai bayan karte hue Quran ne farmaya ke woh apni makkariyon se miyan-biwi mein judai dalwa dete hain. Aurat mard ke milne se ba-hukm-e-Ilahi aurat ko hamal thehar jata hai jab tak woh nutfay, khoon aur lothray ki shakal mein hota hai halka sa rehta hai woh barabar apne kaam-kaaj mein aamad-o-raft mein lagi rehti hai koi aisi zyada takleef aur baar nahin maloom hota aur andar hi andar woh barabar barhta rehta hai use to yunhi sa kuch weham kabhi hota hai ke shayad kuch ho. Kuch waqt yunhi guzar jaane ke baad bojh maloom hone lagta hai hamal zahir ho jata hai bacha pait mein bada ho jata hai tabiyat thakne lagti hai ab maa baap dono Allah se duayen karne lagte hain ke agar woh hamein sahih salim beta ata farmaye to hum shukr-guzari karenge. Darr lagta hai ke kahin kuch aur baat na ho jaye. Ab jabke Allah Ta'ala ne meherbani farmayi aur sahih salim insani shakal-o-surat ka bacha ata farmaya to Allah ke sath shirk karne lagte hain. Mufassireen ne is jagah bohat se aasar-o-ahadees bayan kiye hain jinhein main yahan naqal karta hoon aur un mein jo baat hai woh bhi bayan karunga phir jo baat sahih hai use bataunga Insha'Allah. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke jab Hazrat Hawa ko aulad hui to Iblees ghoomne laga un ke bachay zinda nahin rehte thay shaitan ne sikhaya ke ab is ka naam Abdul Haris rakh de to yeh zinda rahe ga chunancha unhon ne yahi kiya aur yahi hua aur asal mein yeh shaitani harkat thi aur isi ka hukum tha.

Imam Tirmidhi ne bhi ise warid kiya hai phir farmaya hai hasan ghareeb hai, main kehta hoon is hadith mein teen illatein hain. Ek toh yeh ke is ke ek rawi Umar bin Ibrahim Misri ki babat Imam Abu Hatim Razi (R.H) farmate hain ke yeh rawi aisa nahin ke is se hujjat pakdi jaye, go Imam Ibn-e-Mueen ne is ki tauseeq ki hai lekin Ibn-e-Marduyah ne ise Muammar se, us ne apne baap se, us ne Samurah se marfoo'an riwayat kiya hai, wallahu a'lam. Dusre yeh ke yahi riwayat mauqoofan Hazrat Samurah ke apne qaul se marwi hui hai jo ke marfoo' nahin. Ibn-e-Jareer mein khud Hazrat Samurah bin Jundub ka apna farman hai ke Hazrat Adam (A.S) ne apne ladke ka naam Abdul Haris rakha. Teesre is ayat ki tafseer is ke rawi Hazrat Hasan se bhi is ke alawa bhi marwi hai. Zahir hai ke agar yeh marfoo' hadith un ki riwayat karda hoti toh yeh khud is ke khilaf tafseer na karte. Chunancha Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai Hazrat Hasan farmate hain yeh Hazrat Adam (A.S) ka waqia nahin balkay ba'az mazahib walon ka waqia hai aur riwayat mein aap ka yeh farman manqool hai ke is se murad ba'az mushrik insaan hain jo aisa karte hain, farmate hain ke yeh Yahood-o-Nasara ka fe'l bayan hua hai ke apni auladon ko apni raush par daal lete hain. Yeh sab asnadein Hazrat Hasan tak bilkul sahih hain aur is ayat ki jo kuch tafseer ki gayi hai is mein sab se behtar tafseer yahi hai. Khair maqsad yeh tha ke itna bada muttaqi aur parhezgar aadmi ek ayat ki tafseer mein ek marfoo' hadith qaul-e-Paighambar (ﷺ) riwayat kare phir is ke khilaf khud tafseer kare yeh bilkul anhoni baat hai. Is se sabit hota hai ke woh hadith marfoo' nahin balkay woh Hazrat Samurah ka apna qaul hai. Is ke baad yeh bhi khayal hota hai ke bahut mumkin hai ke Hazrat Samurah ne ise Ahl-e-Kitab se makhooz kiya ho jaise Ka'ab-o-Wahb waghera jo musalman ho gaye thay, Insha'Allah is ka bayan bhi anqareeb hoga. Bahar soorat is riwayat ka marfoo' hona hum tasleem nahin karte, wallahu a'lam. Ab aur aasar jo is bare mein hain unhein suniye. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) kehte hain Hazrat Hawwa (R.A) ke jo bachay paida hote thay un ka naam Abdullah, Ubaidullah waghera rakhti thin, woh bachay faut ho jate thay. Phir un ke paas Iblees aaya aur kaha agar tum koi aur naam rakho toh tumhare bachay zinda rahenge. Chunancha un dono ne yahi kiya, jo bacha paida hua us ka naam Abdul Haris rakha, is ka bayan in ayaton mein hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke un ke do bachay is se pehle mar chuke thay, ab halat-e-hamal mein shaitan un ke paas aaya aur kehne laga ke tumhein maloom bhi hai ke tumhare pet mein kya hai? Mumkin hai koi janwar hi ho, mumkin hai sahih salim na paida ho, mumkin hai aglon ki tarah yeh bhi mar jaye, tum meri maan lo aur ab jo bacha paida ho us ka naam mere naam par rakho toh insaan hoga, sahih salim hoga, zinda rahega. Yeh bhi is ke behkawe mein aa gaye aur Abdul Haris naam rakha. Isi ka bayan in ayaton mein hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke pehli dafa hamal ke waqt yeh aaya aur unhein daraya ke main wahi hoon jis ne tumhein jannat se niklwaya, ab ya tum meri ita'at karo.

Warna main isay yeh kar daloon ga woh kar daloon ga waghaira har chand daraya magar unhon ne us ki ita'at na ki. Allah ki shaan woh bacha murda paida hua dobara hamal thehra phir yeh mal'oon pohancha aur isi tarah khauf zada karne laga ab bhi unhon ne us ki ita'at na ki chunancha yeh doosra bacha bhi murda hua. Teesray hamal ke waqt yeh khabeeth phir aaya ab ki martaba aulad ki mohabbat mein aa kar unhon ne us ki maan li aur us ka naam Abdul Haris rakha isi ka bayan in aayaton mein hai. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se is asar ko le kar un ke shagirdon ki aik jama'at ne bhi yahi kaha hai jaise Hazrat Mujahid R.H, Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair R.H, Hazrat Ikrama R.H aur doosray tabqay mein se Qatada R.H, Suddi R.H waghaira isi tarah salaf se khalaf tak bohat se mufassireen ne is aayat ki tafseer mein yahi kaha hai. Lekin zahir yeh hai ke yeh asar Ahl-e-Kitab se liya gaya hai. Is ki bari daleel yeh hai ke Ibn-e-Abbas R.A isay Ubay bin Ka'ab R.A se riwayat karte hain jaise ke Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai pas zahir hai ke yeh Ahl-e-Kitab ke aasar se hai. Jin ki babat Rasool-e-Kareem ﷺ farmate hain ke un ki baton ko na sachi kaho na jhooti. Un ki riwayatein teen tarah ki hain. Aik to woh jin ki sehat hamaray yahan kisi aayat ya hadees se hoti hai. Aik woh jin ki takzeeb kisi aayat ya hadees se hoti ho. Aik woh jis ki babat koi aisa faisla hamaray deen mein na milay to baqol Huzoor ﷺ is riwayat ke bayan mein to koi haraj nahin lekin tasdeeq takzeeb jaiz nahin. Mere nazdeek to yeh asar doosri qisam ka hai yani maanne ke qabil nahin aur jin sahaba aur tabieen se yeh marwi hai unhon ne isay teesri qisam ka apni aulad ke mamlay mein Allah ke sath karne ka bayan in aayaton mein hai na ke Hazrat Adam A.S o Hawwa A.S ka. Hazrat Imam Hasan Basri R.H farmate hain ke mushrikon ka apni aulad ke mamlay mein Allah ke sath karne ka bayan in aayaton mein hai na ke Hazrat Adam A.S o Hawwa A.S ka. Pas Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke Allah is shirk se aur un ke shareek thehrane se buland-o-bala hai. In aayaton mein yeh zikr aur un se pehle Adam A.S o Hawwa A.S ka zikr misl-e-tamheed ke hai ke un asli maa baap ka zikr kar ke phir aur maa baapon ka zikr hua aur un hi ka shirk bayan hua. Zikr-e-shakhs se zikr-e-jins ki taraf istatrad ke tor par jaise aayat (Walaqad zayyannas sama'ad dunya bimasaabeeh) mein hai yani hum ne dunya ke aasman ko sitaron se zeenat di aur unhein shaitanon par angaray barsanay wala banaya aur yeh zahir hai ke jo sitaray zeenat ke hain woh jharte nahin un se shaitanon ko maar nahin parti. Yahan bhi istatrad taron ki shakhsiyat se taron ki jins ki taraf hai is ki aur bhi bohat si misalein Quran-e-Kareem mein mojood hain, Wallahu A'alam.
