Insaan ka almiya khud-saaz khuda aur Allah se doori hai. Jo log Allah ke siwa auron ko poojte hain woh sab Allah ke hi banaye hue hain, wahi unka paalne wala hai. Woh bilkul be-ikhtiyar hain, kisi nafa-nuqsan ka unhein ikhtiyar nahin. Woh apne pujariyon ko koi nafa nahin pahuncha sakte, balkeh woh toh hil-jul bhi nahin sakte, dekh aur sun bhi nahin sakte. In buton se toh unke pujari hi tawana, tandurust aur achhe hain ke unki aankhein bhi hain, kaan bhi hain. Yeh be-waqoof toh unhein poojte hain jinhon ne saari makhlooq mein se ek cheez ko bhi paida nahin kiya, balkeh woh khud Allah Ta'ala ke paida kiye hue hain. Jaise aur jagah hai ke logo! Aao ek lateef misaal suno, tum jinhein pukaar rahe ho, yeh saare hi jama ho kar ek makkhi bhi paida karna chahein toh unki taqat se kharij hai. Balkeh unki kamzori toh yahan tak hai ke koi makkhi unki kisi cheez ko chheen le jaye toh yeh us se wapas bhi nahin kar sakte. Talab karne wale aur jin se talab ki ja rahi hai, bahut hi bode hain. Ta'ajjub hai ke itne kamzoron ki ibadat ki jaati hai jo apna haq bhi ek makkhi se nahin le sakte, woh tumhari roziyon aur madad par kaise qadir honge? Hazrat Khalilullah (A.S) ne apni qoum se farmaya tha ke kya tum unki ibadat karte ho jinhein tum khud hi ghadte aur banate ho? Woh na toh apne pujariyon ki madad kar sakte hain, na khud apni hi koi madad kar sakte hain. Yahan tak ke Hazrat Khalilullah (A.S) ne unhein tod-tod kar tukde-tukde kar diya, lekin un se yeh na ho saka ke apne aap ko unke haath se bacha lete. Haath mein tabar le kar sab ko choora kar diya aur in ma'boodan-e-baatil se yeh bhi na ho saka ke kisi tarah apna bachao kar lete. Khud Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ) ke zamane mein bhi Hazrat Mu'az bin Amr bin Jamuh aur Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal (R.A) yahi kaam karte the ke raat ke waqt chupke se ja kar mushrikeen ke but tod aate aur jo lakdi ke hote unhein tod kar bewa aurton ko de dete ke woh apna indhan bana lein aur qoum ke but-parast ibrat hasil karein. Khud Hazrat Mu'az ka baap Amr bin Jamuh bhi but-parast tha. Yeh dono naujawan dost wahan bhi pahunchte aur us but ko paleedi se aalooda kar aate. Jab yeh aata toh apne khuda ko is halat mein dekh kar bahut pech-o-taab khata, phir dhota, phir us par khushbu malta. Ek martaba us ne us ke paas talwar rakh di aur kaha dekh aaj tera dushman aaye toh is talwar se us ka kaam tamam kar dena. Yeh us raat bhi pahunche aur us ki durgat kar ke paakhane se leep kar ke chale aaye, magar taham use asar na hua. Subah ko isi tarah us ne dho-dha kar theek-thaak kar ke khushbu laga kar baitha kar dandwat ki, ya'ni (uthak-baithak) ki.

Jab un dono ne dekha ke kisi tarah yeh nahin maanta toh ek raat us but ko utha laye aur ek kutte ka pilla jo mara pada tha uske gale mein baandh diya aur mohalle ke ek kunwein mein daal diya. Subah usne apne but ko na pa kar talash ki toh kunwein mein use nazar aaya ke kutte ke murda bachche ke saath pada hua hai. Ab use but se aur but-parasti se nafrat ho gayi aur usne kaha (Tallahu lau kunta ilahan mustadan lam tak wal-kalbu jami'an fi qarnin) yani agar tu sach-much Allah hota toh kunwein mein kutte ke pille ke saath pada hua na hota. Phir hazir-e-huzoor Sarkar-e-Madina (ﷺ) hue aur musharraf ba-Islam ho gaye, phir toh Islam mein poore pakke ho gaye. Uhud ki ladai mein shareek hue aur kuffar ko qatl karte hue shaheed ho gaye. Dua (Razi Allahu Anhu wa arzah wa ja'ala jannatul firdaus mawa). Inhein agar bulaya jaye toh yeh qabool karna toh darkinar sun bhi nahin sakte, mehez patthar hain, be-jaan hain, be-aankh aur be-kaan hain. Jaise ke Hazrat Khalilullah (A.S) ne farmaya ke mere walid! Aap inki ibadat kyun karte hain jo na sunen na dekhein, na tujhe koi nafa pahuncha sakein na tere kisi kaam aa sakein. Inhein pukarna na pukarna dono barabar hain. Yeh toh tum jaise hi be-bas aur Allah ki makhlooq hain, batao toh kabhi unhone tumhari faryad-rasi ki hai? Ya kabhi tumhari dua ka jawab diya hai? Haqeeqat mein unse afzal-o-aala toh tum khud ho. Tum sunte, dekhte, chalte-phirte, bolte-chalte ho, yeh toh itna bhi nahin kar sakte. Achha tum inse mera kuch bigadne ki darkhwast karo, main elaan karta hoon ke agar inse ho sake toh bila-tammul apni poori taqat se jo mera bigad sakte hon bigad lein. Suno main toh Allah ko apna himayati aur madadgar samajhta hoon, wahi mera bachane wala hai aur woh mujhe kaafi-o-waafi hai, isi par mera bharosa hai, isi se mera lagao hai. Main hi nahin har nek banda yahi karta hai aur woh bhi apne tamam sachche ghulamon ki nigahbani aur hifazat karta rehta hai aur karta rahega. Mere baad bhi un sab ka nigran aur muhafiz wahi hai. Hazrat Hud (A.S) se aapki qoum ne kaha ke hamara toh khayal hai ke tu jo hamare maboodon par imaan nahin rakhta isi sabab se unhone tujhe in mushkilat mein daal diya hai. Iske jawab mein Allah ke paighambar ne farmaya suno tum ko aur Allah ko gawah kar ke main kehta hoon aur ala-al-elaan kehta hoon ke main tumhare Allah ke siwa aur tamam maboodon se bari aur bezar aur un sab ka dushman hoon. Tum mera kuch bigad sakte ho toh bigad lo, tumhein bhi qasam hai jo zara si kotahi karo. Mera tawakkul Allah ki zaat par hai, tamam jaandaron ki chotiyan usi ke haath hain, mera Rabb hi sachchi raah par hai. Hazrat Khalilullah (A.S) ne bhi yahi farmaya tha ke tum aur tumhare buzurg jin ki parastish karte hain main un sab ka dushman hoon aur woh mujhse door hain siwaye us Rabb-ul-Aalameen ke jisne mujhe paida kiya aur meri rehbari ki.

Aap ne apne walid aur qoum se bhi yahi farmaya ke main tumhare maboodan-e-batil se bari aur bezar hoon siwaye us sachay mabood ke jis ne mujhe paida kiya hai, wohi meri rehbari kare ga. Hum ne isi kalmay ko us ki nasl mein hamesha ke liye baqi rakh diya taake log apne batil khayalat se hat jayen. Pehle toh ghaibana farmaya tha phir aur takeed ke taur par khitab kar ke farmata hai ke jin jin ko Allah ke siwa tum pukarte ho woh tumhari imdad nahin kar sakte aur na woh khud apna hi koi nafa kar sakte hain. Yeh toh sun hi nahin sakte, tujhe toh yeh aankhon wale dikhayi dete hain lekin darasal un ki asli aankhein hi nahin ke kisi ko dekh saken. Jaise farman hai ke agar tum unhein pukaro toh woh suntay nahin, chunke woh tasaveer aur but hain, un ki masnooi aankhein hain, mehsoos toh yeh hota hai ke woh dekh rahe hain lekin darasal dekh nahin rahe, chunke woh patthar basoorat-e-insan hain is liye zameer bhi zawi-ul-uqool ki laye. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke is se murad kuffar hain lekin awwal hi awla hai, yahi Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ka ikhtiyar karda aur Qatada ka qaul bhi yahi hai.

In buton se toh unke pujari hi tawana, tandurust aur achhe hain ke unki aankhein bhi hain, kaan bhi hain. Yeh be-waqoof toh unhein poojte hain jinhon ne saari makhlooq mein se ek cheez ko bhi paida nahin kiya, balkeh woh khud Allah Ta'ala ke paida kiye hue hain. Jaise aur jagah hai ke logo! Ta'ajjub hai ke itne kamzoron ki ibadat ki jaati hai jo apna haq bhi ek makkhi se nahin le sakte, woh tumhari roziyon aur madad par kaise qadir honge? Yahan tak ke Hazrat Khalilullah (A.S) ne unhein tod-tod kar tukde-tukde kar diya, lekin un se yeh na ho saka ke apne aap ko unke haath se bacha lete. Haath mein tabar le kar sab ko choora kar diya aur in ma'boodan-e-baatil se yeh bhi na ho saka ke kisi tarah apna bachao kar lete. Khud Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ) ke zamane mein bhi Hazrat Mu'az bin Amr bin Jamuh aur Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal (R.A) yahi kaam karte the ke raat ke waqt chupke se ja kar mushrikeen ke but tod aate aur jo lakdi ke hote unhein tod kar bewa aurton ko de dete ke woh apna indhan bana lein aur qoum ke but-parast ibrat hasil karein. Khud Hazrat Mu'az ka baap Amr bin Jamuh bhi but-parast tha. Yeh dono naujawan dost wahan bhi pahunchte aur us but ko paleedi se aalooda kar aate. Jab yeh aata toh apne khuda ko is halat mein dekh kar bahut pech-o-taab khata, phir dhota, phir us par khushbu malta. Ek martaba us ne us ke paas talwar rakh di aur kaha dekh aaj tera dushman aaye toh is talwar se us ka kaam tamam kar dena. Yeh us raat bhi pahunche aur us ki durgat kar ke paakhane se leep kar ke chale aaye, magar taham use asar na hua. Subah ko isi tarah us ne dho-dha kar theek-thaak kar ke khushbu laga kar baitha kar dandwat ki, ya'ni (uthak-baithak) ki.

Jab un dono ne dekha ke kisi tarah yeh nahin maanta toh ek raat us but ko utha laye aur ek kutte ka pilla jo mara pada tha uske gale mein baandh diya aur mohalle ke ek kunwein mein daal diya. Subah usne apne but ko na pa kar talash ki toh kunwein mein use nazar aaya ke kutte ke murda bachche ke saath pada hua hai. Ab use but se aur but-parasti se nafrat ho gayi aur usne kaha (Tallahu lau kunta ilahan mustadan lam tak wal-kalbu jami'an fi qarnin) yani agar tu sach-much Allah hota toh kunwein mein kutte ke pille ke saath pada hua na hota. Phir hazir-e-huzoor Sarkar-e-Madina (ﷺ) hue aur musharraf ba-Islam ho gaye, phir toh Islam mein poore pakke ho gaye. Uhud ki ladai mein shareek hue aur kuffar ko qatl karte hue shaheed ho gaye. Dua (Razi Allahu Anhu wa arzah wa ja'ala jannatul firdaus mawa). Inhein agar bulaya jaye toh yeh qabool karna toh darkinar sun bhi nahin sakte, mehez patthar hain, be-jaan hain, be-aankh aur be-kaan hain. Jaise ke Hazrat Khalilullah (A.S) ne farmaya ke mere walid! Aap inki ibadat kyun karte hain jo na sunen na dekhein, na tujhe koi nafa pahuncha sakein na tere kisi kaam aa sakein. Inhein pukarna na pukarna dono barabar hain. Yeh toh tum jaise hi be-bas aur Allah ki makhlooq hain, batao toh kabhi unhone tumhari faryad-rasi ki hai? Ya kabhi tumhari dua ka jawab diya hai? Haqeeqat mein unse afzal-o-aala toh tum khud ho. Tum sunte, dekhte, chalte-phirte, bolte-chalte ho, yeh toh itna bhi nahin kar sakte. Achha tum inse mera kuch bigadne ki darkhwast karo, main elaan karta hoon ke agar inse ho sake toh bila-tammul apni poori taqat se jo mera bigad sakte hon bigad lein. Suno main toh Allah ko apna himayati aur madadgar samajhta hoon, wahi mera bachane wala hai aur woh mujhe kaafi-o-waafi hai, isi par mera bharosa hai, isi se mera lagao hai. Main hi nahin har nek banda yahi karta hai aur woh bhi apne tamam sachche ghulamon ki nigahbani aur hifazat karta rehta hai aur karta rahega. Mere baad bhi un sab ka nigran aur muhafiz wahi hai. Hazrat Hud (A.S) se aapki qoum ne kaha ke hamara toh khayal hai ke tu jo hamare maboodon par imaan nahin rakhta isi sabab se unhone tujhe in mushkilat mein daal diya hai. Iske jawab mein Allah ke paighambar ne farmaya suno tum ko aur Allah ko gawah kar ke main kehta hoon aur ala-al-elaan kehta hoon ke main tumhare Allah ke siwa aur tamam maboodon se bari aur bezar aur un sab ka dushman hoon. Tum mera kuch bigad sakte ho toh bigad lo, tumhein bhi qasam hai jo zara si kotahi karo. Mera tawakkul Allah ki zaat par hai, tamam jaandaron ki chotiyan usi ke haath hain, mera Rabb hi sachchi raah par hai. Hazrat Khalilullah (A.S) ne bhi yahi farmaya tha ke tum aur tumhare buzurg jin ki parastish karte hain main un sab ka dushman hoon aur woh mujhse door hain siwaye us Rabb-ul-Aalameen ke jisne mujhe paida kiya aur meri rehbari ki.

Aap ne apne walid aur qoum se bhi yahi farmaya ke main tumhare maboodan-e-batil se bari aur bezar hoon siwaye us sachay mabood ke jis ne mujhe paida kiya hai, wohi meri rehbari kare ga. Hum ne isi kalmay ko us ki nasl mein hamesha ke liye baqi rakh diya taake log apne batil khayalat se hat jayen. Pehle toh ghaibana farmaya tha phir aur takeed ke taur par khitab kar ke farmata hai ke jin jin ko Allah ke siwa tum pukarte ho woh tumhari imdad nahin kar sakte aur na woh khud apna hi koi nafa kar sakte hain. Yeh toh sun hi nahin sakte, tujhe toh yeh aankhon wale dikhayi dete hain lekin darasal un ki asli aankhein hi nahin ke kisi ko dekh saken. Jaise farman hai ke agar tum unhein pukaro toh woh suntay nahin, chunke woh tasaveer aur but hain, un ki masnooi aankhein hain, mehsoos toh yeh hota hai ke woh dekh rahe hain lekin darasal dekh nahin rahe, chunke woh patthar basoorat-e-insan hain is liye zameer bhi zawi-ul-uqool ki laye. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke is se murad kuffar hain lekin awwal hi awla hai, yahi Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ka ikhtiyar karda aur Qatada ka qaul bhi yahi hai.

In buton se toh unke pujari hi tawana, tandurust aur achhe hain ke unki aankhein bhi hain, kaan bhi hain. Yeh be-waqoof toh unhein poojte hain jinhon ne saari makhlooq mein se ek cheez ko bhi paida nahin kiya, balkeh woh khud Allah Ta'ala ke paida kiye hue hain. Jaise aur jagah hai ke logo! Ta'ajjub hai ke itne kamzoron ki ibadat ki jaati hai jo apna haq bhi ek makkhi se nahin le sakte, woh tumhari roziyon aur madad par kaise qadir honge? Yahan tak ke Hazrat Khalilullah (A.S) ne unhein tod-tod kar tukde-tukde kar diya, lekin un se yeh na ho saka ke apne aap ko unke haath se bacha lete. Haath mein tabar le kar sab ko choora kar diya aur in ma'boodan-e-baatil se yeh bhi na ho saka ke kisi tarah apna bachao kar lete. Khud Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ) ke zamane mein bhi Hazrat Mu'az bin Amr bin Jamuh aur Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal (R.A) yahi kaam karte the ke raat ke waqt chupke se ja kar mushrikeen ke but tod aate aur jo lakdi ke hote unhein tod kar bewa aurton ko de dete ke woh apna indhan bana lein aur qoum ke but-parast ibrat hasil karein. Khud Hazrat Mu'az ka baap Amr bin Jamuh bhi but-parast tha. Yeh dono naujawan dost wahan bhi pahunchte aur us but ko paleedi se aalooda kar aate. Jab yeh aata toh apne khuda ko is halat mein dekh kar bahut pech-o-taab khata, phir dhota, phir us par khushbu malta. Ek martaba us ne us ke paas talwar rakh di aur kaha dekh aaj tera dushman aaye toh is talwar se us ka kaam tamam kar dena. Yeh us raat bhi pahunche aur us ki durgat kar ke paakhane se leep kar ke chale aaye, magar taham use asar na hua. Subah ko isi tarah us ne dho-dha kar theek-thaak kar ke khushbu laga kar baitha kar dandwat ki, ya'ni (uthak-baithak) ki.

Jab un dono ne dekha ke kisi tarah yeh nahin maanta toh ek raat us but ko utha laye aur ek kutte ka pilla jo mara pada tha uske gale mein baandh diya aur mohalle ke ek kunwein mein daal diya. Subah usne apne but ko na pa kar talash ki toh kunwein mein use nazar aaya ke kutte ke murda bachche ke saath pada hua hai. Ab use but se aur but-parasti se nafrat ho gayi aur usne kaha (Tallahu lau kunta ilahan mustadan lam tak wal-kalbu jami'an fi qarnin) yani agar tu sach-much Allah hota toh kunwein mein kutte ke pille ke saath pada hua na hota. Phir hazir-e-huzoor Sarkar-e-Madina (ﷺ) hue aur musharraf ba-Islam ho gaye, phir toh Islam mein poore pakke ho gaye. Uhud ki ladai mein shareek hue aur kuffar ko qatl karte hue shaheed ho gaye. Dua (Razi Allahu Anhu wa arzah wa ja'ala jannatul firdaus mawa). Inhein agar bulaya jaye toh yeh qabool karna toh darkinar sun bhi nahin sakte, mehez patthar hain, be-jaan hain, be-aankh aur be-kaan hain. Jaise ke Hazrat Khalilullah (A.S) ne farmaya ke mere walid! Aap inki ibadat kyun karte hain jo na sunen na dekhein, na tujhe koi nafa pahuncha sakein na tere kisi kaam aa sakein. Inhein pukarna na pukarna dono barabar hain. Yeh toh tum jaise hi be-bas aur Allah ki makhlooq hain, batao toh kabhi unhone tumhari faryad-rasi ki hai? Ya kabhi tumhari dua ka jawab diya hai? Haqeeqat mein unse afzal-o-aala toh tum khud ho. Tum sunte, dekhte, chalte-phirte, bolte-chalte ho, yeh toh itna bhi nahin kar sakte. Achha tum inse mera kuch bigadne ki darkhwast karo, main elaan karta hoon ke agar inse ho sake toh bila-tammul apni poori taqat se jo mera bigad sakte hon bigad lein. Suno main toh Allah ko apna himayati aur madadgar samajhta hoon, wahi mera bachane wala hai aur woh mujhe kaafi-o-waafi hai, isi par mera bharosa hai, isi se mera lagao hai. Main hi nahin har nek banda yahi karta hai aur woh bhi apne tamam sachche ghulamon ki nigahbani aur hifazat karta rehta hai aur karta rahega. Mere baad bhi un sab ka nigran aur muhafiz wahi hai. Hazrat Hud (A.S) se aapki qoum ne kaha ke hamara toh khayal hai ke tu jo hamare maboodon par imaan nahin rakhta isi sabab se unhone tujhe in mushkilat mein daal diya hai. Iske jawab mein Allah ke paighambar ne farmaya suno tum ko aur Allah ko gawah kar ke main kehta hoon aur ala-al-elaan kehta hoon ke main tumhare Allah ke siwa aur tamam maboodon se bari aur bezar aur un sab ka dushman hoon. Tum mera kuch bigad sakte ho toh bigad lo, tumhein bhi qasam hai jo zara si kotahi karo. Mera tawakkul Allah ki zaat par hai, tamam jaandaron ki chotiyan usi ke haath hain, mera Rabb hi sachchi raah par hai. Hazrat Khalilullah (A.S) ne bhi yahi farmaya tha ke tum aur tumhare buzurg jin ki parastish karte hain main un sab ka dushman hoon aur woh mujhse door hain siwaye us Rabb-ul-Aalameen ke jisne mujhe paida kiya aur meri rehbari ki.

Aap ne apne walid aur qoum se bhi yahi farmaya ke main tumhare maboodan-e-batil se bari aur bezar hoon siwaye us sachay mabood ke jis ne mujhe paida kiya hai, wohi meri rehbari kare ga. Hum ne isi kalmay ko us ki nasl mein hamesha ke liye baqi rakh diya taake log apne batil khayalat se hat jayen. Pehle toh ghaibana farmaya tha phir aur takeed ke taur par khitab kar ke farmata hai ke jin jin ko Allah ke siwa tum pukarte ho woh tumhari imdad nahin kar sakte aur na woh khud apna hi koi nafa kar sakte hain. Yeh toh sun hi nahin sakte, tujhe toh yeh aankhon wale dikhayi dete hain lekin darasal un ki asli aankhein hi nahin ke kisi ko dekh saken. Jaise farman hai ke agar tum unhein pukaro toh woh suntay nahin, chunke woh tasaveer aur but hain, un ki masnooi aankhein hain, mehsoos toh yeh hota hai ke woh dekh rahe hain lekin darasal dekh nahin rahe, chunke woh patthar basoorat-e-insan hain is liye zameer bhi zawi-ul-uqool ki laye. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke is se murad kuffar hain lekin awwal hi awla hai, yahi Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ka ikhtiyar karda aur Qatada ka qaul bhi yahi hai.

Insaan ka almiya khud-saaz khuda aur Allah se doori hai. Jo log Allah ke siwa auron ko poojte hain woh sab Allah ke hi banaye hue hain, wahi unka paalne wala hai. Woh bilkul be-ikhtiyar hain, kisi nafa-nuqsan ka unhein ikhtiyar nahin. Woh apne pujariyon ko koi nafa nahin pahuncha sakte, balkeh woh toh hil-jul bhi nahin sakte, dekh aur sun bhi nahin sakte. In buton se toh unke pujari hi tawana, tandurust aur achhe hain ke unki aankhein bhi hain, kaan bhi hain. Yeh be-waqoof toh unhein poojte hain jinhon ne saari makhlooq mein se ek cheez ko bhi paida nahin kiya, balkeh woh khud Allah Ta'ala ke paida kiye hue hain. Jaise aur jagah hai ke logo! Aao ek lateef misaal suno, tum jinhein pukaar rahe ho, yeh saare hi jama ho kar ek makkhi bhi paida karna chahein toh unki taqat se kharij hai. Balkeh unki kamzori toh yahan tak hai ke koi makkhi unki kisi cheez ko chheen le jaye toh yeh us se wapas bhi nahin kar sakte. Talab karne wale aur jin se talab ki ja rahi hai, bahut hi bode hain. Ta'ajjub hai ke itne kamzoron ki ibadat ki jaati hai jo apna haq bhi ek makkhi se nahin le sakte, woh tumhari roziyon aur madad par kaise qadir honge? Achhay a'maal ki nishandahi Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmatay hain matlab yeh hai ke un se woh maal le jo un ki zaroorat se zyada hon aur jisay yeh bakhushi Allah ki raah mein pesh karein. Pehlay chunke Zakat ke ahkaam ba-tafseel nahin utray thay is liye yahi hukum tha. Yeh bhi ma'ani kiye gaye hain ke zaroorat se zaid cheez Allah ki raah mein kharch kardiya karo. Yeh bhi matlab hai ke mushrikeen se badla na le, das saal tak to yahi hukum raha ke darguzar kartay ho phir Jihad ke ahkaam utray. Yeh bhi matlab hai ke logon ke achhay akhlaq aur umda aadaat jo zahir hon unhi par nazrein rakh, un ke batin na tatol, tajassus na karo. Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubair (R.A) waghaira se bhi yahi tafseer marwi hai, yahi qaul zyada mashhoor hai. Hadees mein hai ke is aayat ko sun kar Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) se Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne daryaft kiya ke is ka kya matlab hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yeh ke jo tujh par zulm kare to us se darguzar kar. Jo tujhay na de to us ke sath bhi ehsan-o-sulook kar. Jo tujh se qata-e-ta'alluq kare to us ke sath bhi ta'alluq rakh. Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai Hazrat Uqba bin Aamir (R.A) farmatay hain ke main Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se mila aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka haath thaam kar darkhwast ki ke mujhay afzal a'maal bataiye. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo tujh se toray to us se bhi jor, jo tujh se rokay to usay de, jo tujh par zulm kare to us par bhi raham kar. Oopar wali riwayat mursal hai aur yeh riwayat za'eef hai. 'Urf' se murad nek hai. Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai ke Uyaynah bin Hisn bin Huzaifa apne bhai Hur bin Qais ke haan aa ke thehra. Hazrat Hur, Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ke khaas darbariyon mein thay, Aap (R.A) ke darbari aur nazdeeki ka sharaf sirf unhein hasil tha jo Quran-e-Kareem ke mahir thay khwah woh jawan hon khwah boorhay. Us ne darkhwast ki ke mujhay Aap Ameer-ul-Momineen Umar (R.A) ke darbar mein haziri ki ijazat dilwa dijiye. Aap (R.A) ne wahan ja kar un ke liye ijazat chahi, Ameer-ul-Momineen (R.A) ne ijazat de di. Yeh jatay hi kehnay lagay ke ae Ibn-e-Khattab! Tu hamein bakasrat maal bhi nahin deta aur hum mein adl ke sath faislay bhi nahin karta. Aap (R.A) ko yeh kalaam bhi bura laga, mumkin tha ke usay us ki is tohmat par saza detay lekin usi waqt Hazrat Hur (R.A) ne kaha ae Ameer-ul-Momineen! Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum farmaya hai ke afw-o-darguzar ki aadat rakh, achhaiyon ka hukum karta reh aur jahilon se chashm-poshi kar. Ameer-ul-Momineen! Yaqeen kijiye ke yeh nira jahil hai. Quran-e-Kareem ki is aayat ka kaan mein parna tha ke Aap (R.A) ka tamam ranj-o-gham, gussa-o-ghazab jata raha. Aap (R.A) ki yeh to aadat hi thi ke idhar Kalaam-e-Allah suna, udhar gardan jhuka di. Ameer-ul-Momineen (R.A) ke potay Hazrat Salim bin Abdullah (R.H) ka zikr hai ke Aap (R.H) ne shamiyon ke ek qafilay ko dekha, jis mein ghanti thi to Aap (R.H) ne farmaya yeh ghantiyan mana hain. Unhon ne kaha hum is maslay ko Aap (R.H) se zyada jantay hain, bari bari ghantiyon se mana hai, is jaisi choti ghantiyon mein kya harj hai? Hazrat Salim (R.H) ne isi aayat ka aakhri jumla parh kar un jahilon se chashm-poshi karli. Urf, Ma'roof, Aarif, Aarifa sab ke ek hi ma'ani hain.

Is mein har achi baat ki itaat ka zikr aa gaya phir hukum diya ke jahilon se munh pher liya kar go yeh hukum aap ko hai lekin darasal tamam bandon ko yahi hukum hai. Matlab yeh hai zulm bardasht kar liya karo takleef dahi ka khayal bhi na karo. Yeh maani nahin ke deen-e-haq ke mamlay mein jo jahalat se pesh aaye tum us se kuch na kaho, musalmanon se jo kufr par jam kar muqabla kare tum usay kuch na kehna. Yeh matlab is jumlay ka nahin. Yeh woh pakeeza akhlaq hain jin ka mujassam amli namoona Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) thay kisi ne isi mazmoon ko apne sher'on mein bandha hai. Sher: Khuzil-afwa wa mur bil-urfi kama umirta wa a'rid anil-jahileen, wa lin fil-kalami bi kullil-anami famustahsanun min zawil-jahileen. Ya'ni darguzar kiya kar, bhali baat bata diya kar jaise ke tujhe hukum hua hai, nadanon se hat jaya kar, har ek se narm kalami se pesh aa. Yaad rakh ke izzat-o-jah par pohanch kar narm aur khush-akhlaq rehna hi kamal hai. Ba'az musalmanon ka maqoola hai ke log do tarah ke hain ek to bhale aur mohsin jo ehsan-o-sulook karein qabool kar le aur un ke sar na ho ja ke un ki wus'at se zyada un par bojh daal de. Dusre bad aur zalim unhein neki aur bhalai ka hukum de phir bhi agar woh apni jahalat par aur bad kirdari par aray rahein aur tere samne sarkashi ikhtiyar karein to tu un se ro-gardani kar le yahi cheez usay us ki burai se hata de gi jaise ke Allah ka farman hai aayat (Idfa' billati hiya ahsanus-sayyi'ata nahnu a'lamu bima yasifoon) (Surah Al-Mu'minun: 96). Behtareen tareeq se dafa' kar do to tumhare dushman bhi tumhare dost ban jayenge lekin yeh inhi se ho sakta hai jo sabir hon aur naseebon wale hon. Is ke baad shaitani waswason se Allah ki panah mangne ka hukum hua is liye ke woh sakht tareen dushman hai aur hai bhi ehsan faramosh. Insani dushmanon se bachao to azw-e-darguzar aur sulook-o-ehsan se ho jata hai lekin is mal'oon se siwaye Allah ki panah ke aur koi bachao nahin. Yeh teeno hukum jo Surah A'raf ki in teen aayaton mein hain yahi Surah Mu'minun mein bhi hain aur Surah Ha-Meem As-Sajdah mein bhi. Shaitan to Hazrat Adam (A.S) ke waqt se dushman-e-insan hai. Yeh jab gussa dilaye josh mein laye farman-e-Ilahi ke khilaf ubhare jahilon se badla lene par amada kare to Allah Ta'ala se panah mang liya karo. Woh jahilon ki jahalat ko bhi janta hai aur tere bachao ki tarkeebon ko bhi janta hai. Sari makhlooq ka usay ilm hai woh tamam kamon se khabardar hai. Kehte hain ke jab agle teen hukum sunay to kaha aye Allah in kamon ke karne ke waqt to shaitan in ke khilaf buri tarah amada kar de ga aur nafs to josh-e-inteqam se pur hota hi hai kahin in ki khilaf warzi na ho jaye to yeh pichli aayat nazil hui ke aisa karne se shaitani waswasa dafa' ho jaye ga aur tum in akhlaq-e-karimana par aamil ho jao ge.

Main ne apni isi tafsir ke shuru mein hi A'ooz ki behas mein is hadith ko bhi warid kiya hai ke do shakhs lad jhagad rahe thay jin mein se ek sakht ghazabnak tha. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya mujhe ek aisa kalma yaad hai agar yeh keh le to abhi yeh baat jaati rahe. Woh kalma ("A'oozu billahi minash-shaitanir-rajeem") hai. Kisi ne is mein bhi zikr kiya to us ne kaha ke kya main koi deewana ho gaya hoon? Naz'a ke asli ma'ani fasad ke hain woh khwah gusse se ho ya kisi aur wajah se. Farman-e-Quran hai ke mere bandon ko aagah kar do ke woh bhali baat zaban se nikala karein. Shaitan in mein fasad ki aag bhadkana chahta hai. A'yaz ke ma'ani iltija aur istinad ke hain aur laaz ka lafz talab-e-khair ke waqt bola jata hai jaise Hassan bin Hani ka sher hai: (Baman aloozu bihi fima uma'alluhu wa man a'oozu bihi mimma uhaziruhu, la yajburun-nasa azman anta kasiruhu wa la yahi-zun azman anta jabiruhu) yani aye Allah tu meri aarzuon ka markaz hai aur mere bachao aur panah ka maskan hai mujhe yaqeen hai ke jis haddi ko tu todna chahe use koi jod nahin sakta aur jise tu jodna chahe use koi tod nahin sakta. Baqi hadithein jo A'ooz ke mutaliq thin woh hum apni is tafsir ke shuru mein hi likh aaye hain.

Achhay a'maal ki nishandahi Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmatay hain matlab yeh hai ke un se woh maal le jo un ki zaroorat se zyada hon aur jisay yeh bakhushi Allah ki raah mein pesh karein. Pehlay chunke Zakat ke ahkaam ba-tafseel nahin utray thay is liye yahi hukum tha. Yeh bhi ma'ani kiye gaye hain ke zaroorat se zaid cheez Allah ki raah mein kharch kardiya karo. Yeh bhi matlab hai ke mushrikeen se badla na le, das saal tak to yahi hukum raha ke darguzar kartay ho phir Jihad ke ahkaam utray. Yeh bhi matlab hai ke logon ke achhay akhlaq aur umda aadaat jo zahir hon unhi par nazrein rakh, un ke batin na tatol, tajassus na karo. Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubair (R.A) waghaira se bhi yahi tafseer marwi hai, yahi qaul zyada mashhoor hai. Hadees mein hai ke is aayat ko sun kar Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) se Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne daryaft kiya ke is ka kya matlab hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yeh ke jo tujh par zulm kare to us se darguzar kar. Jo tujhay na de to us ke sath bhi ehsan-o-sulook kar. Jo tujh se qata-e-ta'alluq kare to us ke sath bhi ta'alluq rakh. Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai Hazrat Uqba bin Aamir (R.A) farmatay hain ke main Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se mila aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka haath thaam kar darkhwast ki ke mujhay afzal a'maal bataiye. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo tujh se toray to us se bhi jor, jo tujh se rokay to usay de, jo tujh par zulm kare to us par bhi raham kar. Oopar wali riwayat mursal hai aur yeh riwayat za'eef hai. 'Urf' se murad nek hai. Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai ke Uyaynah bin Hisn bin Huzaifa apne bhai Hur bin Qais ke haan aa ke thehra. Hazrat Hur, Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ke khaas darbariyon mein thay, Aap (R.A) ke darbari aur nazdeeki ka sharaf sirf unhein hasil tha jo Quran-e-Kareem ke mahir thay khwah woh jawan hon khwah boorhay. Us ne darkhwast ki ke mujhay Aap Ameer-ul-Momineen Umar (R.A) ke darbar mein haziri ki ijazat dilwa dijiye. Aap (R.A) ne wahan ja kar un ke liye ijazat chahi, Ameer-ul-Momineen (R.A) ne ijazat de di. Yeh jatay hi kehnay lagay ke ae Ibn-e-Khattab! Tu hamein bakasrat maal bhi nahin deta aur hum mein adl ke sath faislay bhi nahin karta. Aap (R.A) ko yeh kalaam bhi bura laga, mumkin tha ke usay us ki is tohmat par saza detay lekin usi waqt Hazrat Hur (R.A) ne kaha ae Ameer-ul-Momineen! Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum farmaya hai ke afw-o-darguzar ki aadat rakh, achhaiyon ka hukum karta reh aur jahilon se chashm-poshi kar. Ameer-ul-Momineen! Yaqeen kijiye ke yeh nira jahil hai. Quran-e-Kareem ki is aayat ka kaan mein parna tha ke Aap (R.A) ka tamam ranj-o-gham, gussa-o-ghazab jata raha. Aap (R.A) ki yeh to aadat hi thi ke idhar Kalaam-e-Allah suna, udhar gardan jhuka di. Ameer-ul-Momineen (R.A) ke potay Hazrat Salim bin Abdullah (R.H) ka zikr hai ke Aap (R.H) ne shamiyon ke ek qafilay ko dekha, jis mein ghanti thi to Aap (R.H) ne farmaya yeh ghantiyan mana hain. Unhon ne kaha hum is maslay ko Aap (R.H) se zyada jantay hain, bari bari ghantiyon se mana hai, is jaisi choti ghantiyon mein kya harj hai? Hazrat Salim (R.H) ne isi aayat ka aakhri jumla parh kar un jahilon se chashm-poshi karli. Urf, Ma'roof, Aarif, Aarifa sab ke ek hi ma'ani hain.

Is mein har achi baat ki itaat ka zikr aa gaya phir hukum diya ke jahilon se munh pher liya kar go yeh hukum aap ko hai lekin darasal tamam bandon ko yahi hukum hai. Matlab yeh hai zulm bardasht kar liya karo takleef dahi ka khayal bhi na karo. Yeh maani nahin ke deen-e-haq ke mamlay mein jo jahalat se pesh aaye tum us se kuch na kaho, musalmanon se jo kufr par jam kar muqabla kare tum usay kuch na kehna. Yeh matlab is jumlay ka nahin. Yeh woh pakeeza akhlaq hain jin ka mujassam amli namoona Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) thay kisi ne isi mazmoon ko apne sher'on mein bandha hai. Sher: Khuzil-afwa wa mur bil-urfi kama umirta wa a'rid anil-jahileen, wa lin fil-kalami bi kullil-anami famustahsanun min zawil-jahileen. Ya'ni darguzar kiya kar, bhali baat bata diya kar jaise ke tujhe hukum hua hai, nadanon se hat jaya kar, har ek se narm kalami se pesh aa. Yaad rakh ke izzat-o-jah par pohanch kar narm aur khush-akhlaq rehna hi kamal hai. Ba'az musalmanon ka maqoola hai ke log do tarah ke hain ek to bhale aur mohsin jo ehsan-o-sulook karein qabool kar le aur un ke sar na ho ja ke un ki wus'at se zyada un par bojh daal de. Dusre bad aur zalim unhein neki aur bhalai ka hukum de phir bhi agar woh apni jahalat par aur bad kirdari par aray rahein aur tere samne sarkashi ikhtiyar karein to tu un se ro-gardani kar le yahi cheez usay us ki burai se hata de gi jaise ke Allah ka farman hai aayat (Idfa' billati hiya ahsanus-sayyi'ata nahnu a'lamu bima yasifoon) (Surah Al-Mu'minun: 96). Behtareen tareeq se dafa' kar do to tumhare dushman bhi tumhare dost ban jayenge lekin yeh inhi se ho sakta hai jo sabir hon aur naseebon wale hon. Is ke baad shaitani waswason se Allah ki panah mangne ka hukum hua is liye ke woh sakht tareen dushman hai aur hai bhi ehsan faramosh. Insani dushmanon se bachao to azw-e-darguzar aur sulook-o-ehsan se ho jata hai lekin is mal'oon se siwaye Allah ki panah ke aur koi bachao nahin. Yeh teeno hukum jo Surah A'raf ki in teen aayaton mein hain yahi Surah Mu'minun mein bhi hain aur Surah Ha-Meem As-Sajdah mein bhi. Shaitan to Hazrat Adam (A.S) ke waqt se dushman-e-insan hai. Yeh jab gussa dilaye josh mein laye farman-e-Ilahi ke khilaf ubhare jahilon se badla lene par amada kare to Allah Ta'ala se panah mang liya karo. Woh jahilon ki jahalat ko bhi janta hai aur tere bachao ki tarkeebon ko bhi janta hai. Sari makhlooq ka usay ilm hai woh tamam kamon se khabardar hai. Kehte hain ke jab agle teen hukum sunay to kaha aye Allah in kamon ke karne ke waqt to shaitan in ke khilaf buri tarah amada kar de ga aur nafs to josh-e-inteqam se pur hota hi hai kahin in ki khilaf warzi na ho jaye to yeh pichli aayat nazil hui ke aisa karne se shaitani waswasa dafa' ho jaye ga aur tum in akhlaq-e-karimana par aamil ho jao ge.

Main ne apni isi tafsir ke shuru mein hi A'ooz ki behas mein is hadith ko bhi warid kiya hai ke do shakhs lad jhagad rahe thay jin mein se ek sakht ghazabnak tha. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya mujhe ek aisa kalma yaad hai agar yeh keh le to abhi yeh baat jaati rahe. Woh kalma ("A'oozu billahi minash-shaitanir-rajeem") hai. Kisi ne is mein bhi zikr kiya to us ne kaha ke kya main koi deewana ho gaya hoon? Naz'a ke asli ma'ani fasad ke hain woh khwah gusse se ho ya kisi aur wajah se. Farman-e-Quran hai ke mere bandon ko aagah kar do ke woh bhali baat zaban se nikala karein. Shaitan in mein fasad ki aag bhadkana chahta hai. A'yaz ke ma'ani iltija aur istinad ke hain aur laaz ka lafz talab-e-khair ke waqt bola jata hai jaise Hassan bin Hani ka sher hai: (Baman aloozu bihi fima uma'alluhu wa man a'oozu bihi mimma uhaziruhu, la yajburun-nasa azman anta kasiruhu wa la yahi-zun azman anta jabiruhu) yani aye Allah tu meri aarzuon ka markaz hai aur mere bachao aur panah ka maskan hai mujhe yaqeen hai ke jis haddi ko tu todna chahe use koi jod nahin sakta aur jise tu jodna chahe use koi tod nahin sakta. Baqi hadithein jo A'ooz ke mutaliq thin woh hum apni is tafsir ke shuru mein hi likh aaye hain.

Jo Allah se darta hai, Shaitan us se darta hai. Taif ki dusri qira'at Taif hai. Yeh dono mashhoor qira'atein hain, dono ke ma'ani ek hain, ba'az ne lafzi ta'reef bhi ki hai. Farman hai ke woh log jo Allah se darne wale hain, jinhein Allah ka darr hai, jo nekiyon ke aamil aur buraiyon se rukne wale hain, unhein jab kabhi gussa aa jaye, Shaitan un par apna koi da'o chalana chahe, un ke dil mein kisi gunah ki raghbat dale, un se koi gunah karana chahe to yeh Allah ke azab se bachne mein jo sawab hai use bhi yaad kar lete hain, Rabb ke wa'ade-o-wa'eed ki yaad karte hain aur foran chaukne ho jate hain, tauba kar lete hain, Allah ki taraf jhuk jate hain aur Allah Ta'ala se shaitani sharr se panah mangne lagte hain aur usi waqt Allah ki janab mein ruju karte hain aur istiqamat ke sath sehat par jam jate hain. Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke ek aurat Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aayi jise mirgi ka daura para karta tha. Us ne darkhwast ki ke mere liye aap dua kijiye. Aap ne farmaya agar tum chaho to main dua karoon aur Allah tumhein shifa bakhshe aur agar chaho to sabr karo aur Allah tum se hisab na lega. Us ne kaha huzoor main sabr karti hoon ke mera hisab maaf ho jaye. Sunan mein bhi yeh hadith hai ke us aurat ne kaha tha ke main gir parti hoon aur behoshi ki halat mein mera kapra khul jata hai jis se be-pardagi hoti hai, Allah se meri shifa ki dua kijiye. Aap ne farmaya tum in dono baton mein se ek ko pasand kar lo, ya to main dua karoon aur tumhein shifa ho jaye ya tum sabr karo aur tumhein jannat mile. Us ne kaha main sabr karti hoon ke mujhe jannat mile. Lekin itni dua to zaroor kijiye ke main be-parda na ho jaya karoon. Aap ne dua ki, chunancha un ka kapra kaisi hi woh talmalatein apni jagah se nahin hatta tha. Hafiz Ibn Asakir (Rahimahullah / R.H) apni tareekh mein Amr bin Jame ke halat mein naqal karte hain ke ek naujawan aabid masjid mein raha karta tha aur Allah ki ibadat ka bahut mushtaq tha. Ek aurat ne us par dore dalne shuru kiye yahan tak ke use behka liya, qareeb tha ke woh us ke sath kothri mein chala jaye jo use yeh aayat (Iza massahum...) yaad aayi aur ghash kha kar gir para. Bahut der ke baad jab use hosh aaya us ne phir is aayat ko yaad kiya aur is qadar Allah ka khauf us ke dil mein samaya ke us ki jaan nikal gayi. Hazrat Umar Farooq (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne us ke walid se hamdardi aur gham-khwari ki. Chunke unhein raat hi ko dafan kar diya gaya tha, aap un ki qabr par gaye, aap ke sath bahut se aadmi the. Aap ne wahan ja kar un ki qabr par namaz-e-janaza ada ki aur use aawaz de kar farmaya: "Ae naujawan! Aayat (Wa liman khafa maqama rabbihi jannatan - Surah Ar-Rahman: 46) jo shakhs apne Rabb ke samne khade hone ka darr rakhe us ke liye do do jannatein hain." Usi waqt qabr ke andar se aawaz aayi ke mujhe mere Rabb Azz-o-Jal ne woh dono do do martabe ata farma diye.

Yeh toh tha haal Allah walon aur parhezgaron ka ke woh shaitani jhatkon se bach jate hain, uske fan-e-fareb se chhoot jate hain. Ab unka haal bayan ho raha hai jo khud shaitan ke bhai bane hue hain. Jaise fazool kharch logon ko Quran ne shaitan ke bhai qarar diya hai, aise log uski baatein sunte hain, maante hain aur un par hi amal karte hain. Shayateen unke samne buraiyan achhe rang mein pesh karte hain, un par woh aasaan ho jati hain aur yeh poori mashghuliyat ke sath un mein phans jate hain. Din-ba-din apni badkari mein barhte jate hain, jahalat aur nadani ki had kar dete hain. Na shaitan unke behkane mein kotahi barte hain, na yeh buraiyan karne mein kami karte. Yeh unke dilon mein waswase dalte rehte hain aur woh un waswason mein phanste rehte hain, yeh unhein bharkate rehte hain aur gunahon par amada karte rehte hain, woh bure amal kiye jate hain aur buraiyon par mudawamat aur lazzat ke sath jame rehte hain.

Sab se bada mojiza Quran-e-Kareem hai. Yeh log koi mojiza maangte aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) use pesh na karte toh kehte ke Nabi hota toh aisa kar leta, bana leta, Allah se maang leta, apne aap ghad leta, aasman se ghasit lata. Al-gharaz mojiza talab karte aur woh talab bhi sarkashi aur inaad ke sath hoti. Jaise farman-e-Quran hai aayat (In nasha nunazzil 'alaihim minas-sama'i ayatan fazallat a'naquhum laha khadi'in) (Ash-Shu'ara: 4) Agar hum chahte toh koi nishan in par aasman se utarte jis se in ki gardanein jhuk jatein. Woh log Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kehte rehte the ke jo hum maangte hain woh mojiza apne Rab se talab kar ke hamein zaroor dikha dijiye. Toh hukum diya ke in se farma dijiye ke main toh Allah ki baatein manne wala aur in par amal karne wala Wahi-e-Ilahi ka tabe hoon. Main us ki janab mein koi gustakhi nahin kar sakta, aage nahin badh sakta, jo hukum de sirf use baja lata hoon. Agar koi mojiza woh ata farmaye dikha doon. Jo woh zahir na farmaye main use la nahin sakta mere bas mein kuch nahin main us se mojiza talab nahin kiya karta mujh mein itni jurrat nahin haan agar us ki ijazat pa leta hoon toh us se dua karta hoon woh hikmaton wala aur ilm wala hai. Mere paas toh mere Rab ka sab se bada mojiza yeh Quran-e-Kareem hai jo sab se zyada wazeh daleel sab se zyada sachi hujjat aur sab se zyada roshan burhan hai jo hikmat hidayat aur rahmat se pur hai agar dil mein imaan hai toh is achhe sache umda aur aala mojize ke baad dusre mojize ki talab baqi hi nahin rehti.

Surah Fatiha ke baghair namaz nahin hoti. Chunki oopar ki ayat mein bayan tha ke yeh Quran logon ke liye baseerat-o-basarat hai aur saath hi hidayat-o-rahmat hai, is liye is ayat mein Allah Ta'ala Jalla Wa 'Ala hukum farmata hai ke is ki azmat aur ehtram ke taur par is ki tilawat ke waqt kaan laga kar ise suno. Aisa na karo jaisa kuffar-e-Quraish ne kiya ke woh kehte thay ayat (Wa qaalallazeena kafaroo laa tasma'oo lihazal qur-aani walghau feehi la'allakum taghliboon) (Fussilat: 26), is Quran ko na suno aur is ke parhay janay ke waqt shor-o-ghul macha do. Is ki aur zyada takeed ho jati hai jabke farz namaz mein imam ba-awaz-e-buland qira'at parhta ho. Jaise ke Sahih Muslim Shareef mein Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari R.A ki riwayat se hai ke imam iqtida ke kiye janay ke liye muqarrar kiya gaya hai. Jab woh takbeer kahe tum takbeer kaho aur jab woh parhay tum khamosh raho. Is tarah sunan mein bhi yeh hadith barwayat Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A marwi hai. Imam Muslim bin Hajjaj R.H ne bhi ise sahih kaha hai aur apni kitab mein nahin laye. (Yeh yaad rahe ke is hadith mein jo khamosh rehne ka hukum hai yeh sirf us qira'at ke liye hai jo Al-Hamd ke siwa ho. Jaise ke Tabrani Kabeer mein sahih hadith hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmatay hain hadith (Man salla khalfal imami falyaqra bi fatihatil kitab) yani jo shakhs imam ke peechay namaz parh raha ho woh Surah Fatiha zaroor parh le. Pas Surah Fatiha parhne ka hukum hai aur qira'at ke waqt khamoshi ka hukum hai, Wallahu A'lam. (Mutarjim). Is ayat ke shaan-e-nuzool ke mutaliq Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A farmatay hain ke log pehle namaz parhtay huay baatein bhi kar liya kartay thay tab yeh ayat utri aur doosri ayat mein chup rehne ka hukum kiya gaya. Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood R.A farmatay hain ke namaz parhtay huay hum aapas mein ek doosre ko salam kiya kartay thay pas yeh ayat utri. Aap ne ek martaba namaz mein logon ko imam ke saath hi saath parhtay huay sun kar farigh ho kar farmaya ke tum mein is ki samajh boojh ab tak nahin aayi ke jab Quran parha jaye to ise suno aur chup raho jaise ke Allah Ta'ala ne tumhein hukum diya hai. (Wazeh rahe ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Mas'ood R.A ki raye mein is se murad imam ke ba-awaz-e-buland Al-Hamd ke siwa doosri qira'at ke waqt muqtadi ka khamosh rehna hai na ke past awaz ki qira'at wali namaz mein, na buland awaz ki qira'at wali namaz mein Al-Hamd se khamoshi. Imam ke peechay Al-Hamd to khud aap bhi parha kartay thay jaise ke Juz-ul-Qira'at Bukhari mein hai hadith (Annahu qaraa fil asri khalfal imami fir rak'atainil awwalayaini bi ummil qur-aani wa soorah) yani aap ne imam ke peechay Asr ki namaz ki pehli do rak'aton mein Surah Al-Hamd bhi parhi aur doosri soorat bhi milayi. Pas aap ke mandaraja-e-bala farman ka matlab sirf isi qadar hai ke jab imam oonchi awaz se qira'at kare to muqtadi Al-Hamd ke siwa doosri qira'at ke waqt sunay aur chup rahe, Wallahu A'lam).

Mutarjim Hazrat Zuhri R.H farmate hain ke yeh aayat us Ansari naujawan ke baare mein nazil hui hai jis ki aadat thi ke jab kabhi Rasool Allah ﷺ Quran se kuch parhte yeh bhi use parhta pas yeh aayat utri. Musnad-e-Ahmad aur Sunan mein Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A se marwi hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ us namaz se farigh ho kar palte jis mein aap ne ba-aawaz-e-buland qirat parhi thi phir poocha ke kya tum mein se kisi ne mere saath parha tha? Ek shakhs ne kaha haan Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ. Aap ne farmaya main keh raha tha ke yeh kya baat hai ke mujh se Quran ki chheenta-jhapti ho rahi hai? Rawi ka kehna hai ke us ke baad log Rasool Allah ﷺ ke saath un namazon mein jin mein aap oonchi aawaz se qirat parha karte the qirat se ruk gaye jabke unhon ne Rasool ﷺ se yeh suna. Imam Tirmidhi ise Hasan kehte hain aur Abu Hatim Razi is ki tas-heeh karte hain (Matlab is hadith ka bhi yahi hai ke Imam jab pukar kar qirat parhe us waqt muqtadi siwaye Al-Hamd ke kuch na parhe kyunke aisi hi riwayat Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi, Nasai, Ibn Majah, Muwatta Imam Malik, Musnad-e-Ahmad waghera mein hai jis mein hai ke jab aap ke sawal ke jawab mein yeh kaha gaya hai ke hum parhte hain to aap ne farmaya hadith (La taf'alu illaa bi-faatihatil kitaab fa-innahu laa salaata liman lam yaqra' bihaa) yani aisa na kiya karo sirf Surah Fatiha parho kyunke jo ise nahin parhta us ki namaz nahin hoti. Pas log oonchi aawaz wali qirat ki namaz mein jis qirat se ruk gaye woh Al-Hamd ke ilawa thi kyunke isi se roka tha isi se Sahaba ruk gaye. Al-Hamd to parhne ka hukum diya tha. Balkay saath hi farma diya tha ke us ke baghair namaz hi nahin wallahu a'lam. (Mutarjim). Zuhri ka qaul hai ke Imam jab oonchi aawaz se qirat parhe to unhein Imam ki qirat kaafi hai Imam ke peeche wale na parhein go unhein Imam ki aawaz sunayi bhi na de. Haan albatta jab Imam aahista aawaz se parh raha ho us waqt muqtadi bhi aahista parh liya karein aur kisi ko laiq nahin ke us ke saath saath parhe khwah jahri namaz ho khwah sirri. Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai ke jab Quran parha jaye to tum use suno aur chup raho taake tum par raham kiya jaye. Ulama ke ek giroh ka mazhab hai ke jab Imam oonchi aawaz se qirat kare to muqtadi par na Surah Fatiha parhna wajib hai na kuch aur. Imam Shafi'i ke is baare mein do qaul hain jin mein se ek qaul yeh bhi hai lekin yeh qaul pehle ka hai jaise ke Imam Malik ka mazhab, ek aur riwayat mein Imam Ahmad ka ba-sabab un dalail ke jin ka zikr guzar chuka. Lekin us ke baad ka aap ka yeh farman hai ke muqtadi sirf Surah Fatiha Imam ke sakton ke darmiyan parh le. Sahaba, Tabi'een aur un ke baad wale giroh ka yahi farman hai. Imam Abu Hanifa aur Imam Ahmad farmate hain muqtadi par mutlaqan qirat wajib nahin na us namaz mein jis mein Imam aahista qirat parhe na us mein jis mein buland aawaz se qirat parhe is liye ke hadith mein hai Imam ki qirat muqtadiyon ki bhi qirat hai. Ise Imam Ahmad ne apni Musnad mein Hazrat Jabir R.A se marfoo'an riwayat kiya hai.

Yahi hadith Muwatta Imam Malik mein mauqoofan marwi hai aur yahi zyada sahih hai yani yeh qaul Hazrat Jabir R.A ka hona zyada sahih hai na ke farman-e-Rasool Allah ﷺ ka (lekin yeh bhi yaad rahe ke khud Hazrat Jabir R.A se Ibn-e-Majah mein marwi hai ke hadith: "Kuna naqra'u fiz-zuhr-e-wal-asr-e-khalfal-imam-e-fir-rak'atain-il-oolayain-bi-fatihatil-kitab-e-wa-surah-wa-fil-ukhrayain-bi-fatihatil-kitab" yani hum zuhr aur asr ki namaz mein imam ke peeche pehli do rak'aton mein Surah Fatiha bhi parhte thay aur koi aur surat bhi aur pichli do rak'aton mein sirf Surah Fatiha parha karte thay. Pas maloom hota hai ke aap ne jo farmaya ke imam ki qira'at usay kaafi hai us se murad Alhamd ke ilawa qira'at hai. Wallahu A'lam, Mutarjim). Yeh masla aur jagah nihayat tafseel se bayan kiya gaya hai. Isi khaas maslay par Hazrat Imam Abu Abdullah Bukhari R.H ne ek mustaqil risala likha hai aur us mein sabit kiya hai ke har namaz mein khwah us mein qira'at oonchi parhi jaati ho ya aahista, muqtadiyon par Surah Fatiha ka parhna farz hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain yeh aayat farz namaz ke baare mein hai. Talha ka bayan hai ke Ubaid bin Umar aur Ata bin Abi Rabah ko main ne dekha ke wa'iz wa'z keh raha tha aur woh aapas mein baatein kar rahe thay to main ne kaha tum is wa'z ko nahin sunte aur wa'eed ke qabil ho rahe ho? Unhon ne meri taraf dekha phir baaton mein mashghool ho gaye. Main ne phir yahi kaha, unhon ne phir meri taraf dekha aur phir baaton mein mashghool ho gaye. Main ne phir yahi kaha, unhon ne phir meri taraf dekha aur phir apni baaton mein lag gaye, main ne phir teesri martaba un se yahi kaha. Teesri baar unhon ne meri taraf dekh kar farmaya yeh namaz ke baare mein hai.

Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain namaz ke siwa jab koi parh raha ho to kalam karne mein koi harj nahin aur bhi bohat se buzurgon ka farman hai ke murad is se namaz mein hai. Hazrat Mujahid R.H se marwi hai ke yeh aayat namaz aur jum'a ke khutbay ke baare mein hai. Hazrat Ata R.H se bhi isi tarah marwi hai. Hasan R.H farmate hain namaz mein aur zikr ke waqt. Saeed bin Jubair R.H farmate hain Baqra Eid aur Meethi Eid aur jum'a ke din aur jin namazon mein imam oonchi qira'at parhay. Ibn-e-Jarir R.H ka faisla bhi yahi hai ke murad is se namaz mein aur khutbay mein chup rehna hai jaise ke hukm hua hai imam ke peeche khutbay ki halat mein chup raho. Mujahid R.H ne isay makrooh samjha ke jab imam khauf ki aayat ya rahmat ki aayat tilawat kare to us ke peeche se koi shakhs kuch kahe balkay khamoshi ke liye kaha (hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ jab kabhi kisi khauf ki aayat se guzarte to panah maangte aur jab kabhi kisi rahmat ke bayan wali aayat se guzarte to Allah se sawal karte. (Mutarjim). Hazrat Hasan R.H farmate hain jab tu Quran sunne baithe to us ke ehtram mein khamosh raha kar. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein farman-e-Rasool Allah ﷺ hai ke jo shakhs kaan laga kar Kitabullah ki kisi aayat ko sunay to us ke liye kasrat se barhne wali neki likhi jaati hai aur agar usay parhay to us ke liye Qayamat ke din noor hoga.)))

Allah ki yaad bakasrat karo magar khamoshi se. Allah Ta'ala hukum farmata hai ke subh-o-sham us ki bakasrat yaad kar. Yahan bhi yeh farmaya aur jagah bhi hai aayat (Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tulu'ish shamsi wa qablal ghurub) yani apne Rabb ki tasbeeh aur hamd bayan kiya karo suraj tulu aur suraj ghurub hone se pehle. Yeh aayat Makkiyah hai aur yeh hukum Me'raj se pehle ka hai. Ghudu kehte hain din ke ibtidai hissay ko, Aasal jama hai Aseel ki, jaise ke Yameen jama hai Yamin ki. Hukum diya ke raghbat, lalach aur dar-o-khauf ke sath Allah ki yaad apne dil mein apni zaban se karte raho, cheekhne chillane ki zaroorat nahin. Isi liye mustahab yahi hai ke pukar ke sath aur chilla chilla kar Allah ka zikr na kiya jaye. Sahaba ne jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya ke kya hamara Rabb qareeb hai ke hum us se sargoshi chupke chupke kar liya karein ya door hai ke hum pukar pukar kar aawazein dein? To Allah Ta'ala Jalla wa 'Ala ne yeh aayat utari (Wa iza sa'alaka 'ibadi 'anni al-aayah), jab mere banday tujh se meri babat sawal karein to jawab de ke main bohat hi nazdeek hoon. Dua karne wale ki dua ko jab bhi woh mujh se dua kare qabool farma liya karta hoon. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke logon ne ek safar mein ba-aawaz buland duayein karni shuru keen to Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: "Logon! Apni janon par taras khao, tum kisi behray ko ya kisi ghaib ko nahin pukar rahe, jise tum pukarte ho woh to bohat hi past aawaz sunne wala aur bohat hi qareeb hai, tumhari sawari ki gardan jitni tum se qareeb hai us se bhi zyada woh tum se nazdeek hai." Ho sakta hai ke murad is aayat se bhi wahi ho jo aayat (Wala tajhar bisalatika al-aayah) se hai. Mushrikeen Quran sun kar Quran ko, Jibraeel ko, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko aur khud Allah Ta'ala ko galiyan dene lagte to Allah Ta'ala ne Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum diya ke na to Aap is qadar buland aawaz se padhein ke mushrikeen charh kar bakne jhakne lagein, na is qadar past aawaz se padhein ke Aap ke sahaba bhi na sun sakein, balkay is ke darmiyan ka rasta dhoond nikalen, yani na bohat buland na bohat aahista. Yahan bhi farmaya ke bohat buland aawaz se na ho aur ghafil na banna. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer aur un se pehle Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam (R.H) ne farmaya hai ke murad is se yeh hai ke oopar ki aayat mein Quran ke sunne wale ko jo khamoshi ka hukum tha usi ko dohraya ja raha hai ke Allah ka zikr apni zaban se apne dil mein kiya karo. Lekin yeh ba'eed hai aur insaaf ke munafi hai jis ka hukum farmaya gaya hai aur yeh ke murad is se ya to namaz mein hai ya namaz aur khutbay mein aur yeh zahir hai ke us waqt khamoshi ba-nisbat zikr-e-Rabbani ke afzal hai, khwah woh posheeda ho khwah zahir, pas in dono ki mutaba'at nahin ki gayi. Pas murad is se bandon ko subh-o-sham zikr ki kasrat ki raghbat dilana hai taake woh ghafilon mein se na ho jayein. (In dono buzurgon ke ilawa Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) waghera ka bhi yahi farman hai).

Tafsir-e-Baizawi waghera mein bhi yahi hai, dono aayaton ke zahiri rabt ka taqaza bhi yahi hai, Wallahu A'lam. Isi liye farishton ki tareef bayan hui ke woh raat din Allah ki tasbeeh mein lage rehte hain, bilkul thakte nahin. Pas farmata hai ke jo tere Rab ke paas hain woh uski ibadat se takabbur nahin karte. Unka zikr is liye kiya ke is kasrat-e-ibadat-o-ita'at mein unki iqtida ki jaye, isi liye hamare liye bhi shariat ne sajda muqarrar kiya, farishte bhi sajda karte rehte hain. Hadith-e-Shareef mein hai: Tum isi tarah safein kyun nahin bandhte jaise ke farishte apne Rab ke paas safein bandhte hain ke woh pehle awwal saff ko pura karte hain aur safon mein zara si bhi gunjaish aur jagah baqi nahin chhodte. Is aayat par ijma ke sath sajda wajib hai, padhne wale par bhi aur sunne wale par bhi. Quran mein tilawat ka pehla sajda yahi hai. Ibn-e-Majah mein hadith hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne is aayat ko sajde ki aayaton mein se gina. Alhamdulillah, Surah A'raf ki tafsir khatam hui.
